original: | śrīgaṇeśāya namaḥ | śrījagadaṃbāyai namaḥ | athāvantyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmyaṃ prārabhyate | vyāsa uvāca | sraṣṭāro'pi prajānāṃ prabalabhavabhayādyaṃ namasyaṃti devā | yo hyavyakte praviṣṭaḥ pravihitamanasāṃ dhyānayuktātmanāṃ ca | lokānāmādidevaḥ sa jayatu bhagavāñchrīmahā kālanāmā bibhrāṇaḥ somalekhāmahivalayayutaṃ vyaktaliṃgaṃ kapālam || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ śrī jagat ambāyai namaḥ atha āvantya khaṇḍe avantī kṣetra māhātmyam prārabhyate vyāsaḥ uvāca sraṣṭāraḥ api prajānām prabala bhava bhaya ādyam namasyaṃti devāḥ yaḥ hi avyakte praviṣṭaḥ pravihita manasām dhyāna yukta ātmanām ca lokānām ādidevaḥ sa jayatu bhagavān śrī mahā kāla nāmā bibhrāṇaḥ soma lekhā mahi valaya yutam vyakta liṃgam kapālam  /

original: umovāca | pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni puṇyāśca saritastathā | kathyaṃtāṃ tāni yatnena śraddhā yeṣu prajāyate || 2 ||
analyzed: umā uvāca pṛthivyām yāni tīrthāni puṇyāḥ ca saritaḥ tathā kathyaṃtām tāni yatnena śraddhā yeṣu prajāyate

original: īśvara uvāca | asti lokeṣu vikhyātā gaṃgā tripathagā nadī | sevitā devagandharvairmunibhiśca niṣevitā || 3 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca asti lokeṣu vikhyātā gaṃgā tripathagā nadī sevitā deva gandharvaiḥ munibhiḥ ca niṣevitā  /

original: tapanasya sutā devī yamunā lokapāvanī | pitṝṇāṃ vallabhā devī mahāpātakanāśinī || 4 ||
analyzed: tapanasya sutā devī yamunā loka pāvanī pitṝṇām vallabhā devī mahāpātaka nāśinī   /

original: candrabhāgā vitastā ca narmadā'marakaṇṭake | kurukṣetraṃ gayā devi prabhāsaṃ naimiṣaṃ tathā || 5 ||
analyzed: candrabhāgā vitastā ca narmadā amarakaṇṭake  kurukṣetram gayā devi prabhāsam naimiṣam tathā

original: kedāraṃ puṣkaraṃ caiva tathā kāyāvarohaṇam | tathā puṇyatamaṃ devi mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 6 ||
analyzed: kedāram puṣkaram ca eva tathā kāyāvarohaṇam tathā puṇyatamam devi mahākāla vanam śubham

original: yatrāste śrīmahākālaḥ pāpendhanahutāśanaḥ | kṣetraṃ yojanaparyaṃtaṃ brahmahatyādināśanam || 7 ||
analyzed: yatra āste śrī mahākālaḥ pāpa indhana hutāśanaḥ kṣetram yojana paryaṃtam brahmahatyā ādi nāśanam   /

original: bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ kṣetraṃ kalika lmaṣanāśanam | pralaye'pyakṣayaṃ devi duṣprāpaṃ tridaśairapi || 8 ||
analyzed: bhukti dam mukti dam kṣetram kalika lmaṣa nāśanam pralaye api akṣayam devi duṣprāpam tridaśaiḥ api  /

original: umovāca | prabhāvaḥ kathyatāṃ deva kṣetrasyāsya maheśvara | yāni tīrthāni vidyante yāni liṃgāni saṃti vai || 9 ||
analyzed: umā uvāca prabhāvaḥ kathyatām deva kṣetrasya asya maheśvara yāni tīrthāni vidyante yāni liṃgāni saṃti vai  /

original: tānyahaṃ śrotumicchāmi paraṃ kautūhalaṃ hi me || 10 ||
analyzed: tāni aham śrotum icchāmi param kautūhalam hi me

original: mahādeva uvāca | śṛṇu devi prayatnena prabhāvaṃ pāpanāśanam | kṣetramādyaṃ mahādevi sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 11 ||
analyzed: mahādevaḥ uvāca śṛṇu devi prayatnena prabhāvam pāpa nāśanam kṣetram ādyam mahādevi sarva pāpa praṇāśanam

original: śrīmeroḥ saṃnidhāne ca śikharaṃ ratnacihnitam | anekāścaryanilayaṃ bahupādapasaṃkulam || 12 ||
analyzed: śrī meroḥ saṃnidhāne ca śikharam ratna cihnitam aneka āścarya nilayam bahu pādapa saṃkulam  /

original: vicitradhātubhiścitraṃ svacchasphaṭikavedikam | vicitravarṇaśobhāḍhyamṛṣisaṃghanināditam || 13 ||
analyzed: vicitra dhātubhiḥ citram su accha sphaṭika vedikam vicitra varṇa śobhā āḍhyam ṛṣi saṃgha nināditam  /

original: mṛganāgendrasaṃyuktaṃ gajayūthasamākulam | nirjharāṃbuprapātotthaśīkarākarasaṃkulam || 14 ||
analyzed: mṛga nāga indra saṃyuktam gaja yūtha samākulam nirjhara aṃbu prapāta uttha śīkara ākara saṃkulam

original: vātāhatataruvrātaprasūnāsthānacitritam | mṛganābhivarāmodavāsitā śeṣakānanam || 15 ||
analyzed: vāta āhata taru vrāta prasūna āsthāna citritam mṛganābhi vara āmoda vāsitā śeṣa kānanam  /

original: latāgṛharatisthānaṃ siddhavidyādharāśrayam | pravīṇakinnaravrātamadhuradhvanināditam || 16 ||
analyzed: latā gṛha rati sthānam siddha vidyādhara āśrayam pravīṇa kinnara vrāta madhura dhvani nāditam  /

original: tasminvane mahāramye śobhitāśeṣa bhūmikam | vairājaṃ nāma bhavanaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: tasmin vane mahā ramye śobhita aśeṣa bhūmikam vairājam nāma bhavanam brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  /

original: tatra divyāṃganāgītamadhuradhvanināditā | pārijātatarucchannamaṃjarīdāmaśobhitā || 18 ||
analyzed: tatra divya aṃganā gīta madhura dhvani nāditā pārijāta taru channa maṃjarī dāma śobhitā

original: bahuvādyasamunnaddhamahāsvananināditā | layatālayutānekagītavāditranāditā || 19 ||
analyzed: bahu vādya samunnaddha mahā svana nināditā  laya tāla yuta aneka gīta vāditra nāditā

original: vinyastā koṭibhiḥ staṃbhairnirmalādarśaśobhitā | layatālayutānekamahākautukasaṃyutā || 20 ||
analyzed: vinyastā koṭibhiḥ staṃbhaiḥ nirmala ādarśa śobhitā laya tāla yuta aneka mahā kautuka saṃyutā

original: apsaronṛtyavinyāsavilāsollāsaśobhitā | sabhā kāṃtimatīnāma devānāṃ harṣadāyikā || 21 ||
analyzed: apsaraḥ nṛtya vinyāsa vilāsa ullāsa śobhitā sabhā kāṃtimatī nāma devānām harṣa dāyikā   /

original: ṛṣisaṃghasamākīrṇā munivṛndaniṣevitā | dvijātivedaśabdena nāditā'naṃdadāyikā || 22 ||
analyzed: ṛṣi saṃgha samākīrṇā muni vṛnda niṣevitā dvijāti veda śabdena nāditā anaṃda dāyikā

original: tasyāṃ niviṣṭaṃ vāgīśaṃ śaṃkarārādhane ratam | sanatkumāraṃ brahmarṣiṃ brahmaṇo mānasaṃ sutam || 23 ||
analyzed: tasyām niviṣṭam vāgīśam śaṃkara ārādhane ratam sanatkumāram brahmarṣim brahmaṇaḥ mānasam sutam

original: munimadhyātsamutthāya kṛṣṇadvaipāyano muniḥ | parāśarasuto vyāsaḥ praṇipatya yathāvidhi || 24 ||
analyzed: muni madhyāt samutthāya kṛṣṇadvaipāyanaḥ muniḥ parāśara sutaḥ vyāsaḥ praṇipatya yathāvidhi

original: kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā bhavabhaktyānubhāvitaḥ | papraccha parayā tuṣṭyā harṣitāṃgaruhānanaḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: kṛta aṃjali puṭaḥ bhūtvā bhava bhaktyā anubhāvitaḥ papraccha parayā tuṣṭyā harṣita aṃgaruha ānanaḥ

original: mahākālasya māhātmyaṃ prāṇināṃ mohanāśanam | vyāsa uvāca | mahākālavanaṃ kasmātprocyate sarvato varam || 26 ||
analyzed: mahākālasya māhātmyam prāṇinām moha nāśanam vyāsaḥ uvāca mahākāla vanam kasmāt procyate sarvatas varam

original: bhagavankṣetramāhātmyaṃ mahākālasya kathyatām | kathaṃ guhyavanaṃ proktaṃ pīṭhatvamūṣaraṃ tathā || 27 ||
analyzed: bhagavan kṣetra māhātmyam mahākālasya kathyatām  katham guhya vanam proktam pīṭha tvam ūṣaram tathā

original: phalaṃ yathātra vasatāṃ mṛtānāṃ ca gatiryathā | snānena yadbhavetpuṇyaṃ dānenāpi ca yatphalam || 28 ||
analyzed: phalam yathā atra vasatām mṛtānām ca gatiḥ yathā snānena yat bhavet puṇyam dānena api ca yat phalam  /

original: kathametatsmaśānaṃ ca kṣetraṃ proktaṃ yathā tathā | pṛṣṭaṃ me śaṃkare bhaktyā brūhi tvaṃ śāstrakovida || 29 ||
analyzed: katham etat smaśānam ca kṣetram proktam yathā tathā pṛṣṭam me śaṃkare bhaktyā brūhi tvam śāstra kovida  /

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | kṣīyate pātakaṃ yatra tenedaṃ kṣetramucyate | yasmātsthānaṃ ca mātṝṇāṃ pīṭhaṃ tenaiva kathyate || 30 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca kṣīyate pātakam yatra tena idam kṣetram ucyate yasmāt sthānam ca mātṝṇām pīṭham tena eva kathyate

original: mṛtāḥ punarna jāyaṃte tenedamūṣaraṃ smṛtam | guhyametatpriyaṃ nityaṃ kṣetraṃ śaṃbhormahā tmanaḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: mṛtāḥ punar na jāyaṃte tena idam ūṣaram smṛtam  guhyam etat priyam nityam kṣetram śaṃbhoḥ mahā tmanaḥ

original: yasmādiṣṭaṃ hi bhūtānāṃ smaśānamativallabham | mahākālavanaṃ yacca tathā caivāvimuktikam || 32 ||
analyzed: yasmāt iṣṭam hi bhūtānām smaśānam ati vallabham mahākāla vanam yat ca tathā ca eva avimuktikam

original: ekāmrakaṃ bhadrakālaṃ karavīravanameva ca | kolāgiristathā kāśī prayāgamamareśvaram || 33 ||
analyzed: ekāmrakam bhadrakālam karavīra vanam eva ca kolā giriḥ tathā kāśī prayāgam amara īśvaram  /

original: bharathaṃ caiva kedāraṃ divyaṃ rudramahālayam | divyasmaśānānyetāni rudrasyeṣṭāni nityaśaḥ || 34 ||
analyzed: bharatham ca eva kedāram divyam rudra mahālayam divya smaśānāni etāni rudrasya iṣṭāni nityaśas

original: ramate bhagavāneṣu siddhakṣetreṣu sarvadā | pṛthivyāṃ naimiṣaṃ tīrthamuttamaṃ tīrthapuṣkaram || 35 ||
analyzed: ramate bhagavān eṣu siddha kṣetreṣu sarvadā pṛthivyām naimiṣam tīrtham uttamam tīrthapuṣkaram  /

original: trayāṇāmapi lokānāṃ kurukṣetraṃ praśasyate | kurukṣetrāddaśaguṇā puṇyā vārāṇasī matā || 36 ||
analyzed: trayāṇām api lokānām kurukṣetram praśasyate  kurukṣetrāt daśaguṇā puṇyā vārāṇasī matā

original: tasyā daśaguṇaṃ vyāsa mahākālavanottamam | prabhāsādyāni tīrthāni pṛthivyāmiha yāni tu || 37 ||
analyzed: tasyāḥ daśaguṇam vyāsa mahākāla vana uttamam prabhāsa ādyāni tīrthāni pṛthivyām iha yāni tu

original: prabhāsamuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ kṣetramādyaṃ pinākinaḥ | śrīśailamuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ devadāruvanaṃ tathā || 38 ||
analyzed: prabhāsam uttamam tīrtham kṣetram ādyam pinākinaḥ  śrīśailam uttamam tīrtham devadāru vanam tathā

original: tasmādapyuttamaṃ vyāsa puṇyā vārāṇasī matā | tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ proktaṃ sarvatīrthottamaṃ yataḥ || 39 ||
analyzed: tasmāt api uttamam vyāsa puṇyā vārāṇasī matā tasmāt daśaguṇam proktam sarva tīrtha uttamam yatas

original: mahākālavanaṃ guhyaṃ siddhakṣetraṃ tathoṣaram | kiṃcidguhyānyathānyāni smaśānānyūṣarāṇi ca || 40 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vanam guhyam siddha kṣetram tathā ūṣaram kiṃcid guhyāni atha anyāni smaśānāni ūṣarāṇi ca  /

original: sarvatastu samākhyātaṃ mahākālavanaṃ mune | smaśānamūṣarakṣetraṃ pīṭhaṃ tu vanameva ca || 41 ||
analyzed: sarvatas tu samākhyātam mahākāla vanam mune smaśānam ūṣara kṣetram pīṭham tu vanam eva ca  /

original: paṃcaikatra na labhyaṃte mahākālapurādṛte || 42 ||
analyzed: paṃca ekatra na labhyaṃte mahākāla purāt ṛte

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye mahākālavanapraśaṃsāvarṇanaṃnāma prathamo'dhyāyaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe avantī kṣetra māhātmye mahākālavanapraśaṃsāvarṇanam nāma prathamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | purā tvekārṇave prāpte naṣṭe sthāvarajaṃgame | nāgnirna vāyurādityo na bhūmirna diśo nabhaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca purā tu ekārṇave prāpte naṣṭe sthāvara jaṃgame  na agniḥ na vāyuḥ ādityaḥ na bhūmiḥ na diśaḥ nabhaḥ

original: na nakṣatrāṇi na jyotirna dyaurneṃdurgrahā stathā | na devāsuragaṃdharvāḥ piśācoragarākṣasāḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: na nakṣatrāṇi na jyotiḥ na dyauḥ na iṃduḥ grahāḥ tathā na deva asura gaṃdharvāḥ piśāca uraga rākṣasāḥ  /

original: sarāṃsi naiva girayo nāpagā nābdhayastathā | sarvamevatamobhūtaṃ na prājñāyata kiṃcana || 3 ||
analyzed: sarāṃsi nā eva girayaḥ nā āpagāḥ nā abdhayaḥ tathā sarvam eva tamaḥ bhūtam na prājñāyata kiṃcana  /

original: tadaiko hi mahākālo lokānugrahakāraṇāt | tasthau sthānānyaśeṣāṇi kāṣṭhāsvālokayanprabhuḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: tadā ekaḥ hi mahākālaḥ loka anugraha kāraṇāt tasthau sthānāni aśeṣāṇi kāṣṭhāsu ālokayan prabhuḥ

original: sṛṣṭyarthaṃ sa mahākālaḥ kare kāmaṃ pratiṣṭhitam | dakṣiṇasya tu tarjanyāṃ sa mamaṃthāviśoṣitam || 5 ||
analyzed: sṛṣṭi artham sa mahākālaḥ kare kāmam pratiṣṭhitam dakṣiṇasya tu tarjanyām sa mamaṃtha a viśoṣitam

original: kalalaṃ budbudaṃ bhūtvā tavivegavivarddhitam | jajñe tadaṃḍaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ suṣṭhu vṛttaṃ hiraṇmayam || 6 ||
analyzed: kalalam budbudam bhūtvā tavi vega vivarddhitam jajñe tat aṃḍam su dṛḍham suṣṭhu vṛttam hiraṇmayam

original: kareṇa tāḍitaṃ taddhi babhūva dvidalaṃ mahat | adhaḥkhaṃḍaṃ smṛtā bhūmirūrdhvaṃ dyaustārakānvitam || 7 ||
analyzed: kareṇa tāḍitam tat hi babhūva dvi dalam mahat adhas khaṃḍam smṛtā bhūmiḥ ūrdhvam dyauḥ tārakā anvitam

original: madhye'bhavattadā brahmā paṃcavaktraścaturbhujaḥ | maheśvaro'numānyaiva tamayojadanaṃtaram || 8 ||
analyzed: madhye abhavat tadā brahmā paṃcavaktraḥ caturbhujaḥ maheśvaraḥ anumānya eva tam ayojat anantaram

original: kuru sṛṣṭiṃ mahābāho vicitrāṃ madanugrahāt | ityuktvāṃtarhitaḥ kvāpi devo brahmā na jagmivān || 9 ||
analyzed: kuru sṛṣṭim mahā bāho vicitrām mad anugrahāt iti uktvā aṃtarhitaḥ kvāpi devaḥ brahmā na jagmivān

original: preryamāṇo'pi vai sraṣṭuṃ brahmā devamaciṃtayat | brahmaṇā dhyāyamānaśca jñānārthaṃ bhagavānbhavaḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: preryamāṇaḥ api vai sraṣṭum brahmā devam aciṃtayat brahmaṇā dhyāyamānaḥ ca jñāna artham bhagavān bhavaḥ

original: brahmaṇastapasā dṛṣṭaḥ prādādvedaṃ ṣaḍaṃgakam | labdhe vede'pi na cirātsaṣṭiṃ kartuṃ śaśāka saḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: brahmaṇaḥ tapasā dṛṣṭaḥ prādāt vedam ṣaṣ aṃgakam  labdhe vede api na cirāt saṣṭim kartum śaśāka saḥ

original: tapasā'tiṣṭhadā bhūyaḥ samārādhayituṃ bhavam | nāpaśyatsa yadā devaṃ tadā tuṣṭāva bhāvitaḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: tapasā atiṣṭhat ā bhūyas samārādhayitum bhavam  na apaśyat sa yadā devam tadā tuṣṭāva bhāvitaḥ

original: brahmovāca | namaḥ śivāyāmalasattvacetase guṇatrayātītavisāritejase | ṣaḍaṃgavedasya mamāpi vedhase parasvarūpānubhavāya cakṣuṣe || 13 ||
analyzed: brahmā uvāca namaḥ śivāya amala sattva cetase guṇatraya atīta visāri tejase ṣaṣ aṃga vedasya mama api vedhase para svarūpa anubhavāya cakṣuṣe

original: namo' stu te sṛṣṭividhau rajojuṣe jagatsthitau sattvamadhiṣṭhitāya te |  vināśahetau tamasā mahīyase śivāya nirvāṇasukhapradāyine || 14 ||
analyzed: namaḥ astu te sṛṣṭi vidhau rajaḥ juṣe jagat sthitau sattvam adhiṣṭhitāya te     vināśa hetau tamasā mahīyase śivāya nirvāṇa sukha pradāyine

original: aśeṣabhūtaprakṛteḥ parā ya vai parātmarūpāya namaḥ śivāya vai | nṛbuddhyahaṃkāramanovidhāyine bhartre ca ṣaḍviṃśakarūpakāya vai || 15 ||
analyzed: aśeṣa bhūta prakṛteḥ parā vai parātma rūpāya namaḥ śivāya vai nṛ buddhi ahaṃkāra manaḥ vidhāyine bhartre ca ṣaḍviṃśaka rūpakāya vai

original: bhūtoyavahnyambaravāyucaṃdrasūryātmarūpābhiridaṃ tanūbhiḥ | vyāptaṃ jagadyasya namo'stu tasmai bhūtaṃ bhaviṣyamatha vartamānam || 16 ||
analyzed: bhū toya vahni ambara vāyu caṃdra sūrya ātma rūpābhiḥ idam tanūbhiḥ vyāptam jagat yasya namaḥ astu tasmai bhūtam bhaviṣyam atha vartamānam

original: yānīha tejāṃsi jagaṃti yāni bhūtāni bhavyānyatha kāraṇāni | bhavaṃti sṛṣṭau vilayaṃ vināśe vrajaṃti yasyātmani taṃ namāmi || 17 ||
analyzed: yāni iha tejāṃsi jagaṃti yāni bhūtāni bhavyāni atha kāraṇāni bhavanti sṛṣṭau vilayam vināśe vrajaṃti yasya ātmani tam namāmi  /

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | evaṃ saṃstuvato vyāsa brahmaṇo bhagavānparaḥ | antarhita uvācedaṃ brahmansaṃyācyatāṃ varaḥ || 18 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca evam saṃstuvataḥ vyāsa brahmaṇaḥ bhagavān paraḥ antarhitaḥ uvāca idam brahman saṃyācyatām varaḥ

original: sa vavre manasā putraṃ bhavaṃ gauravakāraṇāt | vijñāyāṃtargataṃ tasya parameśa uvāca tam || 19 ||

original: eṣa naḥ paramaḥ kāmo devadeva namo'stu te | tvaṃ cedvasasi deveśa vane'sminviśvabhāvana || 42 ||
analyzed: eṣa naḥ paramaḥ kāmaḥ devadeva namaḥ astu te tvam ced vasasi deveśa vane asmin viśvabhāvana

original: sarvātmanā prapannā vai yācāmahe varottamam | kimanyavarakoṭībhireṣa no dīyatāṃ varaḥ || 43 ||
analyzed: sarva ātmanā prapannāḥ vai yācāmahe vara uttamam  kim anya vara koṭībhiḥ eṣa naḥ dīyatām varaḥ

original: ityuktaḥ pādapaiḥ sarvaiḥ śaraṇāgatavatsalaḥ | varaṃ dadau pādapebhyaḥ procyamānaṃ mayā śṛṇu || 44 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ pādapaiḥ sarvaiḥ śaraṇa āgata vatsalaḥ varam dadau pādapebhyaḥ procyamānam mayā śṛṇu  /

original: maheśvara uvāca | bāḍhaṃ me manasā vāso nityamatra vanottame | varaṃ dadāmi bhūyo vo na vṛthā darśanaṃ mama || 45 ||
analyzed: maheśvaraḥ uvāca bāḍham me manasā vāsaḥ nityam atra vana uttame  varam dadāmi bhūyas vaḥ na vṛthak darśanam mama

original: nāgnirna vāyurna jalaṃ na sūryakiraṇātapaḥ | na vidyudaśaniḥ śītaṃ rujaṃ vo janayiṣyati || 46 ||
analyzed: na agniḥ na vāyuḥ na jalam na sūrya kiraṇa ātapaḥ na vidyut aśaniḥ śītam rujam vaḥ janayiṣyati  /

original: nityaṃ puṣpavaropetā nityaṃ susthirayauvanāḥ | kāmagāḥ kāmarūpāśca kāmarūpaphalapradāḥ || 47 ||
analyzed: nityam puṣpa vara upetāḥ nityam susthira yauvanāḥ kāma gāḥ kāma rūpāḥ ca kāma rūpa phala pradāḥ

original: kāmasaṃdarśanāḥ puṃsāṃ tapaḥsaṃdhyājvaladṛśām | śriyā paramayā yuktā matprasādādbhaviṣyatha || 48 ||
analyzed: kāma saṃdarśanāḥ puṃsām tapaḥ saṃdhyā jvala dṛśām śriyā paramayā yuktāḥ mad prasādāt bhaviṣyatha  /

original: evaṃ sa varadaḥ śaṃbhuranujagrāha pādapān | sthitvā varṣasahasraṃ tu kapālaṃ cākṣipadbhuvi || 49 ||
analyzed: evam sa vara daḥ śaṃbhuḥ anujagrāha pādapān sthitvā varṣa sahasram tu kapālam ca akṣipat bhuvi

original: kṣitiṃ nipatatā tena kaṃpate sma rasātalam | vivaśāstatyajurvelāṃ sāgarāḥ kṣubhitormayaḥ || 50 ||
analyzed: kṣitim nipatatā tena kaṃpate sma rasātalam vivaśāḥ tatyajuḥ velām sāgarāḥ kṣubhita ūrmayaḥ

original: śakrāśanihatānīva vyāghravyālānvitāni ca | śikharāṇi vyaśīryaṃta parvatānāṃ sahasraśaḥ || 51 ||
analyzed: śakra aśani hatāni iva vyāghra vyāla anvitāni ca śikharāṇi vyaśīryaṃta parvatānām sahasraśas

original: devasiddhavimānāni gaṃdharvanagarāṇi ca | prasphuranti viniṣpeturvinineśurdharātale || 52 ||
analyzed: deva siddha vimānāni gaṃdharva nagarāṇi ca prasphuranti viniṣpetuḥ vinineśuḥ dharā tale

original: kapotameṣāścātyaṃtaṃ punaḥ saṃghātadarśanāḥ | jyotirgrahāśchādayaṃto babhūvustīrṇabhāskarāḥ || 53 ||
analyzed: kapota meṣāḥ ca atyaṃtam punar saṃghāta darśanāḥ jyotiḥ grahāḥ chādayaṃtaḥ babhūvuḥ tīrṇa bhāskarāḥ

original: mahatā tasya śabdena jaḍāṃdhabadhiraṃ kṛtam | babhūva vyākulaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 54 ||
analyzed: mahatā tasya śabdena jaḍa aṃdha badhiram kṛtam babhūva vyākulam sarvam trailokyam sacarācaram

original: surāsurāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ śarīrāṇi manāṃsi ca | avase duścakaṃpuśca kimetaditi jajñire || 55 ||
analyzed: sura asurāṇām sarveṣām śarīrāṇi manāṃsi ca avase duścakaṃpuḥ ca kim etat iti jajñire  /

original: dhairyamālaṃbya sarve'pi samāgamyeṃdrapūrvakāḥ | brahmalokaṃ samāsādya brahmāṇamidamūcire || 56 ||
analyzed: dhairyam ālaṃbya sarve api samāgamya iṃdra pūrvakāḥ brahma lokam samāsādya brahmāṇam idam ūcire  /

original: kiṃ nimittaṃ tu bhagavannetadutpātadarśane | trailokyaṃ kaṃpitaṃ yena saṃyuktaṃ kālakarmaṇā || 57 ||
analyzed: kim nimittam tu bhagavan etad utpāta darśane trailokyam kaṃpitam yena saṃyuktam kāla karmaṇā

original: jātaṃ kalpāvasānaṃ ca bhinnamaryādasāgaram | catvāro diggajāḥ kiṃ nu babhūvuracalāścalāḥ || 58 ||
analyzed: jātam kalpa avasānam ca bhinna maryāda sāgaram  catvāraḥ diggajāḥ kim nu babhūvuḥ acalāḥ calāḥ  /

original: dharā samādhṛtā kasmātsaptasāgaravāriṇā | utpattirnāsti sarvasya bhagavanna prayojanam || 59 ||
analyzed: dharā samādhṛtā kasmāt sapta sāgara vāriṇā utpattiḥ nā asti sarvasya bhagavat na prayojanam

original: yādṛśo'yaṃ śrutaḥ śabdo na bhūto nāpi viśrutaḥ | trailokyamākulaṃ yena cakre raudreṇa bhūyasā || 60 ||
analyzed: yādṛśaḥ ayam śrutaḥ śabdaḥ na bhūtaḥ na api viśrutaḥ trailokyam ākulam yena cakre raudreṇa bhūyasā

original: evamukto'bravīdbrahmā parameśānubhāvitaḥ | tatprasādātprati jñānī jñātvā rudramupasthitam || 61 ||
analyzed: evam uktaḥ abravīt brahmā parameśa anubhāvitaḥ tad prasādāt prati jñānī jñātvā rudram upasthitam   /

original: yatpṛṣṭaṃ marutaḥ sarve śṛṇudhvaṃ tatra kāraṇam | niścayenātra vijñeyaṃ śraddadhānairyathāvidhi || 62 ||
analyzed: yat pṛṣṭam marutaḥ sarve śṛṇudhvam tatra kāraṇam niścayena atra vijñeyam śraddadhānaiḥ yathāvidhi

original: mukhaṃ chittvā nakhāgreṇa maddehātpaṃcamaṃ śiraḥ | kapālapāṇirbhagavānviṣṇorāśramamabhyagāt || 63 ||
analyzed: mukham chittvā nakha agreṇa mad dehāt paṃcamam śiraḥ kapāla pāṇiḥ bhagavān viṣṇoḥ āśramam abhyagāt  /

original: yayāce pātramādāya bhikṣāṃ nārāyaṇaṃ prabhum | utpapāta munistatra naronāma dhanurdharaḥ || 64 ||
analyzed: yayāce pātram ādāya bhikṣām nārāyaṇam prabhum  utpapāta muniḥ tatra naraḥ nāma dhanurdharaḥ

original: tataḥ kuśasthalīmetya bhagavāṃstadvanottamam | viveśa tarumārgeṇa puṣpāmodābhinaṃditaḥ || 65 ||
analyzed: tatas kuśasthalīm etya bhagavān tat vana uttamam  viveśa taru mārgeṇa puṣpa āmoda abhinaṃditaḥ

original: anugṛhyātha bhagavānvanaṃ tatsarvagāṃḍajam | jagato'nugrahārthāya tatra vāsamarocayat || 66 ||
analyzed: anugṛhya atha bhagavān vanam tat sarva gāṃḍajam jagataḥ anugraha arthāya tatra vāsam arocayat  /

original: tatkapālaṃ karasthaṃ yannyastaṃ bhagavatā kṣitau | tenaiṣā kampitā bhūmiḥ kṛtaṃ trailokyamākulam || 67 ||
analyzed: tat kapālam kara stham yat nyastam bhagavatā kṣitau tena eṣā kampitā bhūmiḥ kṛtam trailokyam ākulam

original: taddrakṣyatha virūpākṣaṃ prapadyata mayā saha | ārādhyamāno bhaga vānpradāsyati varaṃ hi vaḥ || 68 ||
analyzed: tat drakṣyatha virūpākṣam prapadyata mayā saha ārādhyamānaḥ bhaga vān pradāsyati varam hi vaḥ  /

original: ityuktvā bhagavānbrahmā saha tairdevadānavaiḥ | jagāma tadvanoddeśaṃ yatrāste vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ || 69 ||
analyzed: iti uktvā bhagavān brahmā saha taiḥ deva dānavaiḥ jagāma tad vana uddeśam yatra āste vṛṣabhadhvajaḥ

original: prahṛṣṭamanasaḥ sarve kokilālāpalāpitām | puṣpoccayokṣitāṃ sīmāṃ viviśuḥ śaṃkarepsavaḥ || 70 ||
analyzed: prahṛṣṭa manasaḥ sarve kokila ālāpa lāpitām puṣpa uccaya ukṣitām sīmām viviśuḥ śaṃkara īpsavaḥ

original: saṃprāptaṃ sarvametaistadvanaṃ naṃdanasaṃmitam | suvallīgṛhaśobhāḍhyaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ śuśubhe tadā || 71 ||
analyzed: saṃprāptam sarvam etaiḥ tat vanam naṃdana saṃmitam su vallī gṛha śobhā āḍhyam su dṛḍham śuśubhe tadā

original: dṛṣṭvā tadvanamuttamaṃ tanubhṛtāmāhrādakaṃ cetasāṃ nānāsatphalapuṣpapādapavanairāsevitaṃ sarvataḥ | tasminbarhiṇahaṃsasārasakulai rmaṃḍūkamatsyairyute drakṣyāmo haramatra cetasi surāḥ prāpurmudaṃ te tadā || 72 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā tat vanam uttamam tanubhṛtām āhrādakam cetasām nānā sat phala puṣpa pāda pavanaiḥ āsevitam sarvatas tasmin barhiṇa haṃsa sārasa kulaiḥ maṃḍūka matsyaiḥ yute drakṣyāmaḥ haram atra cetasi surāḥ prāpuḥ mudam te tadā  /

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtya khaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye devāgamanavarṇanaṃnāma paṃcamo'dhyāyaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe avantī kṣetra māhātmye devāgamanavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | praviśyātha vanaṃ devāḥ sarvapuṣpopaśobhitam | iha devo 'tra devo'tra viviśuste didṛkṣavaḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca  praviśya atha vanam devāḥ sarva puṣpa upaśobhitam iha devaḥ atra devaḥ atra viviśuḥ te didṛkṣavaḥ

original: adbhutasya vanasyāṃte na te dadṛśire surāḥ | vicinvaṃto mahādevaṃ devairbahuvilokitaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: adbhutasya vanasya aṃte na te dadṛśire surāḥ vicinvaṃtaḥ mahādevam devaiḥ bahu vilokitaḥ

original: tamuvāca sa bhadraṃ vai drakṣyadhvaṃ na tapo vinā | vicinvanto virūpākṣaṃ nainaṃ paśyata śaṃkaram || 3 ||
analyzed: tam uvāca sa bhadram vai drakṣyadhvam na tapaḥ vinā vicinvantaḥ virūpākṣam na enam paśyata śaṃkaram

original: sa yuktaṃ hṛdaye smṛtvā brahmā devāṃstato'bravīt | trividho darśanopāyastasya devasya sarvadā || 4 ||
analyzed: sa yuktam hṛdaye smṛtvā brahmā devān tatas abravīt trividhaḥ darśana upāyaḥ tasya devasya sarvadā

original: śraddhājñānena tapasā yogenaiva nigadyate | sakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ cāpi devāḥ paśyaṃti yoginaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: śraddhā jñānena tapasā yogena eva nigadyate sakalam niṣkalam ca api devāḥ paśyaṃti yoginaḥ

original: tapasvinastu sakalaṃ jñānino niṣkalaṃ param | samutpanne'pi vijñāne maṃdaśraddho na paśyati || 6 ||
analyzed: tapasvinaḥ tu sakalam jñāninaḥ niṣkalam param samutpanne api vijñāne maṃda śraddhaḥ na paśyati  /

original: bhaktyā paramayopetāḥ paraṃ paśyaṃti yoginaḥ | draṣṭavyo nirvikāro'sau pradhānapuruṣeśvaraḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: bhaktyā paramayā upetāḥ param paśyaṃti yoginaḥ draṣṭavyaḥ nirvikāraḥ asau pradhāna puruṣa īśvaraḥ

original: nādīkṣitairato devāḥ śaivīṃ dīkṣāṃ prapadyata | karmaṇā manasā vācā nityayuktā maheśvare || 8 ||
analyzed: na a dīkṣitaiḥ atas devāḥ śaivīm dīkṣām prapadyata karmaṇā manasā vācā nitya yuktāḥ maheśvare

original: tapaścarata bhadraṃ vo rudrārādha natatparāḥ | śivadīkṣāṃ prapannānāṃ bhaktānāṃ ca tapasvinām || 9 ||
analyzed: tapaḥ carata bhadram vaḥ rudra ārādha na tatparāḥ śiva dīkṣām prapannānām bhaktānām ca tapasvinām  /

original: sarvakālaṃ vijānāti dātavyaṃ darśanaṃ mayā | brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā hitameva yadu ktavān || 10 ||
analyzed: sarvakālam vijānāti dātavyam darśanam mayā brahmaṇaḥ vacanam śrutvā hitam eva yat u ktavān

original: śivekṣāviṣṭamatayo brahmāṇamidamabuvan | mārgeṇa vidhinā caiva śivadīkṣāsu tatparāḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: śiva īkṣā āviṣṭa matayaḥ brahmāṇam idam abuvan mārgeṇa vidhinā ca eva śiva dīkṣāsu tatparāḥ

original: prayaccha brahmansarveṣāṃ dīkṣāṃ naḥ śivatoṣadām | śrutveti vacanaṃ brahmā pratyuvāca vicāritam || 12 ||
analyzed: prayaccha brahman sarveṣām dīkṣām naḥ śiva toṣa dām  śrutvā iti vacanam brahmā pratyuvāca vicāritam

original: saṃdidīkṣayiṣuḥ kṣipramamarāñchivadīkṣayā | śivayajñārthasaṃbhārānānayadhvamalaṃ surāḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: saṃdidīkṣayiṣuḥ kṣipram amarān śiva dīkṣayā śiva yajña artha saṃbhārān ānayadhvam alam surāḥ

original: vedī prakalpyatāmatra yaṣṭavyo'ṣṭatanuḥ śivaḥ | padmayonervacaḥ śrutvā cakruḥ sarvamataḥ surāḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: vedī prakalpyatām atra yaṣṭavyaḥ aṣṭa tanuḥ śivaḥ padmayoneḥ vacaḥ śrutvā cakruḥ sarvam atas surāḥ

original: vinītaveṣāḥ praṇatā anena sastamanvaguḥ | śivaprasādasaṃprāptyai puṣkarajñānamīritam || 15 ||
analyzed: vinīta veṣāḥ praṇatāḥ anena sastam anvaguḥ śiva prasāda saṃprāptyai puṣkara jñānam īritam  /

original: yajñaṃ cakāra vidhinā vedhāścandrārdhadhāriṇaḥ | padmayoniḥ puraskṛtya tadā dīkṣāṃ pra yogataḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: yajñam cakāra vidhinā vedhāḥ candra ardha dhāriṇaḥ padmayoniḥ puraskṛtya tadā dīkṣām pra yogataḥ

original: anugraheṇa devāṃstānakārayata bhāvataḥ | tato vratānāṃ pravaraṃ vrataṃ divyaṃ mahāprabhuḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: anugraheṇa devān tān akārayata bhāvataḥ  tatas vratānām pravaram vratam divyam mahā prabhuḥ

original: tebhyo dadau devatābhyaḥ sa tadapyavirodhavit | paṭhyate śivaśālāyāṃ mahāpāśupataṃ vratam || 18 ||
analyzed: tebhyaḥ dadau devatābhyaḥ sa tat api avirodha vid paṭhyate śiva śālāyām mahāpāśupatam vratam  /

original: śaivaṃ yathoditaṃ yacca āgamācāraceṣṭitam | śivārādhanamukhyānāṃ munīnāṃ tīvratejasām || 19 ||
analyzed: śaivam yathā uditam yat ca āgama ācāra ceṣṭitam śiva ārādhana mukhyānām munīnām tīvra tejasām  /

original: sarvānugrāhakaḥ śaṃbhuḥ sarvadevaiḥ prakalpitam | tadevaṃ prārthitaṃ buddhyā vrataṃ raudraṃ śivaṃ samam || 20 ||
analyzed: sarva anugrāhakaḥ śaṃbhuḥ sarva devaiḥ prakalpitam tat evam prārthitam buddhyā vratam raudram śivam samam

original: tattebhyo vismayaṃ tyaktvā prāyacchatkanakāṃḍajaḥ | kāmikaṃ bhasmanāmāḍhyaṃ sarvadā kīrtitaṃ śubham || 21 ||
analyzed: tat tebhyaḥ vismayam tyaktvā prāyacchat kanaka aṃḍajaḥ kāmikam bhasma nāma āḍhyam sarvadā kīrtitam śubham

original: pāpaghraṃ duḥkhaśamanaṃ puṣṭiśrībalavardhanam | siddhidaṃ kīrtikṛtkāṃtaṃ kalikalmaṣamokṣaṇam || 22 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena bhasmasnānaṃ samāhitāḥ | kurvaṃto mānavā dāṃtā dīkṣitāḥ saṃyateṃdriyāḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: tasmāt sarva prayatnena bhasma snānam samāhitāḥ kurvaṃtaḥ mānavāḥ dāṃtāḥ dīkṣitāḥ saṃyata iṃdriyāḥ

original: sarve kamaṃḍaludharāḥ sarve rudrākṣadhāriṇaḥ | aniṣṭadarśanālāpa saṃgatyā parivarjitāḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: sarve kamaṃḍalu dharāḥ sarve rudra akṣa dhāriṇaḥ aniṣṭa darśana ālāpa saṃgatyā parivarjitāḥ  /

original: evaṃ vratadharāḥ sarve vane tasminmaheśvaram | ārādhayaṃstamīśānaṃ vratenaiva umādhavam || 25 ||
analyzed: evam vrata dharāḥ sarve vane tasmin maheśvaram  ārādhayan tam īśānam vratena eva umādhavam

original: bhaktyā paramayā yuktā vidhinā parameṇa ca | kālena mahatā dhyānādevaṃ jñātvā manogatam || 26 ||
analyzed: bhaktyā paramayā yuktāḥ vidhinā parameṇa ca  kālena mahatā dhyānāt evam jñātvā manogatam

original: rudradhyānāgninirdagdhakalmaṣāśca śriyānvitāḥ | tadā hatvā'suraṃ śaṃbhuḥ pratyakṣo bhagavānabhūt || 27 ||
analyzed: rudra dhyāna agni nirdagdha kalmaṣāḥ ca śriyā anvitāḥ tadā hatvā asuram śaṃbhuḥ pratyakṣaḥ bhagavān abhūt

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | brahmadattaṃ varaṃ devāḥ sarve śarvānubhāvitāḥ | samacīkaranpratyuktā brahmāpīśānabhāvitaḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca brahma dattam varam devāḥ sarve śarva anubhāvitāḥ samacīkaran pratyuktāḥ brahmā api īśāna bhāvitaḥ

original: gate varṣasahasre sa divye deveśvareśvaraḥ | jātānukaṃpo devānāṃ dīpo darśanameyivān || 29 ||
analyzed: gate varṣa sahasre sa divye deveśvara īśvaraḥ jāta anukaṃpaḥ devānām dīpaḥ darśanam eyivān  /

original: gaṇairnānāvidhaiḥ sārdhaṃ nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitaiḥ | sudarpodbhūtadarpaghraighorairghoravighātibhiḥ || 30 ||
analyzed: gaṇaiḥ nānāvidhaiḥ sārdham nānā bhūṣaṇa bhūṣitaiḥ su darpa udbhūta darpa ghraiḥ ghoraiḥ ghora vighātibhiḥ  /

original: kāmarūpairakāmaiśca sarvakāmasamanvitaiḥ | karīṃdrakaraṭāṭopapāṭanaiḥ siṃhadehibhiḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: kāma rūpaiḥ akāmaiḥ ca sarva kāma samanvitaiḥ karīṃdra karaṭa āṭopa pāṭanaiḥ siṃha dehibhiḥ  /

original: aṇimādi guṇairdivyairyogaiśvaryādināmabhiḥ | vyālolakeśaraśanādaṃṣṭrākaṭakaṭodbhavaiḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: aṇima ādi guṇaiḥ divyaiḥ yoga aiśvarya ādi nāmabhiḥ vyālola keśa raśanā daṃṣṭrā kaṭakaṭa udbhavaiḥ

original: vyāghravyālānanai raudraiḥ kākakaṃkavaṭaistathā || 33 ||

original: dhārayiṣyaṃti ye viprāḥ kapālaṃ bhūtamohanam | mama tulyāstu te brahmanvicaraṃti mahītale || 1 ||
analyzed: dhārayiṣyaṃti ye viprāḥ kapālam bhūta mohanam  mama tulyāḥ tu te brahman vicaranti mahī tale

original: japaikaniratā dhīrāḥ kapālakṛtabhūṣaṇāḥ | mahāpāśupatā loke rudrāḥ saṃsāratārakāḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: japa eka niratāḥ dhīrāḥ kapāla kṛta bhūṣaṇāḥ mahā pāśupatāḥ loke rudrāḥ saṃsāra tārakāḥ   /

original: dharmādharmavimuktāśca kṛtyākṛtyavivarjitāḥ | dīkṣayā jñānayogena prāṇinastārayaṃti te || 3 ||
analyzed: dharma adharma vimuktāḥ ca kṛtyā akṛtya vivarjitāḥ dīkṣayā jñāna yogena prāṇinaḥ tārayaṃti te   /

original: yāni tīrthāni loke'sminyajñakoṭiśatāni ca | viśuddhasya vijñānasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīm || 4 ||
analyzed: yāni tīrthāni loke asmin yajña koṭi śatāni ca viśuddhasya vijñānasya kalām na arhanti ṣoḍaśīm  /

original: yathāhaṃ sarvadevānāṃ saṃpūjyo vai pitāmaha | tathaiva sarvayogebhyaḥ saṃpūjyo'yaṃ mahāvratī || 5 ||
analyzed: yathā aham sarva devānām saṃpūjyaḥ vai pitāmaha tathā eva sarva yogebhyaḥ saṃpūjyaḥ ayam mahāvratī

original: saṃsārabandhamokṣārthaṃ śivaguhyamidaṃ vratam | yadetatsarvadharmeṇa apunarbhavakāraṇam || 6 ||
analyzed: saṃsāra bandha mokṣa artham śiva guhyam idam vratam yat etat sarva dharmeṇa apunarbhava kāraṇam   /

original: kapālavratamādāya yastyajedajite ndriyaḥ | rauravaṃ sa prayātyāśu praṇīto yamakiṃkaraiḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: kapāla vratam ādāya yaḥ tyajet ajite ndriyaḥ rauravam sa prayāti āśu praṇītaḥ yama kiṃkaraiḥ

original: ālāpayati bhāvena na tu karma karoti yaḥ | sarāgacittaḥ śṛṃgārī na ca dharmapriyaṃkaraḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: ālāpayati bhāvena na tu karma karoti yaḥ sa rāga cittaḥ śṛṃgārī na ca dharma priyaṃkaraḥ  /

original: ekatra bhojī miṣṭāśी kaitavena priyastathā | kugrāmanagare vāsī kṛṣivāṇijyasevakaḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: ekatra bhojī miṣṭāḥ kaitavena priyaḥ tathā ku grāma nagare vāsī kṛṣi vāṇijya sevakaḥ  /

original: ityādiduṣṭadoṣaśca tasya saṃbhāṣaṇādapi | naro narakagāmī syādyato madvratadūṣakaḥ || 110 ||
analyzed: ityādi duṣṭa doṣaḥ ca tasya saṃbhāṣaṇāt api naraḥ naraka gāmī syāt yatas mad vrata dūṣakaḥ

original: dṛṣṭvā ca śiṣṭamatha 3 mahāvratadharo naraḥ | na spṛśedaṃgamaṃgena spṛṣṭvā snāyāttu cāṃbubhiḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā ca śiṣṭam atha mahā vrata dharaḥ naraḥ na spṛśet aṃgam aṃgena spṛṣṭvā snāyāt tu ca ambubhiḥ   /

original: evaṃ ca sarvamākhyātaṃ kapālasya ca mokṣaṇam | yathā mayātra nikṣiptamajñānena hataṃ svayam || 12 ||
analyzed: evam ca sarvam ākhyātam kapālasya ca mokṣaṇam yathā mayā atra nikṣiptam ajñānena hatam svayam  /

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | evamuktvā sa bhagavānbrahmādyairamaraiḥ saha | kṣetraṃ nivāsayāmāsa yathāvatkathayāmi te || 13 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca evam uktvā sa bhagavān brahma ādyaiḥ amaraiḥ saha kṣetram nivāsayāmāsa yathāvat kathayāmi te  /

original: ādyametatatsmaśānaṃ ca paṭhyate munisattamaiḥ | mahākālavanaṃ vyāsa yatra sanni hito haraḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: ādyam etat tat smaśānam ca paṭhyate muni sattamaiḥ mahākāla vanam vyāsa yatra sanni hitaḥ haraḥ  /

original: anugrahasya bhuvanaṃ bhūmibhāgo na saṃśayaḥ | anugrahārthaṃ bhūtānāṃ kṣetrāṃtarmṛtyudharmiṇām || 15 ||
analyzed: anugrahasya bhuvanam bhūmi bhāgaḥ na saṃśayaḥ anugraha artham bhūtānām kṣetra antar mṛtyu dharmiṇām  /

original: suvarṇavajraparyaṃkavedikā ca mahīkṛtā | vicitrakusumāratnaiḥ kāritā sarvaśobhanā || 16 ||
analyzed: suvarṇa vajra paryaṃka vedikā ca mahī kṛtā vicitra kusuma aratnaiḥ kāritā sarva śobhanā

original: svarṇavajrāṃkitatalā śreṣṭhā haritaśādvalā | triṃśaccatvāriṃśapūrṇāḥ kalaśāḥ koṇasaṃsthitāḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: svarṇa vajra aṃkita talā śreṣṭhā harita śādvalā triṃśaccatvāriṃśa pūrṇāḥ kalaśāḥ koṇa saṃsthitāḥ  /

original: dvārāṇi tatra catvāri pravarṇāni tapaṃti ca | kumbhāḥ śobhaṃti tatrasthāḥ uditā bhāskarā iva || 18 ||
analyzed: dvārāṇi tatra catvāri pravarṇāni tapaṃti ca kumbhāḥ śobhaṃti tatrasthāḥ uditāḥ bhāskarāḥ iva  /

original: ramate tatra bhagavānvanānāmuttame vane | sanaṃdidevagaṇapaḥ kāladaṃḍādisaṃyutaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: ramate tatra bhagavān vanānām uttame vane sa naṃdi deva gaṇapaḥ kāladaṃḍa ādi saṃyutaḥ  /

original: etatkṛtayuge sarvaṃ pratyakṣaṃ dṛśyate vane | tretāyāṃ dharmaniratāstāpasā brahmacāriṇaḥ || 120 ||
analyzed: etat kṛta yuge sarvam pratyakṣam dṛśyate vane tretāyām dharma niratāḥ tāpasāḥ brahmacāriṇaḥ  /

original: dvāpare dharmaśīlā ye śrutavi jñānaśālinaḥ | kalau tu śuddhavijñānaśālinaḥ śaṃkaraṃ haram || 21 ||
analyzed: dvāpare dharma śīlāḥ ye jñāna śālinaḥ kalau tu śuddha vijñāna śālinaḥ śaṃkaram haram

original: tapodhikāḥ prapaśyaṃti devadevaṃ maheśvaram | mahākālavane nityaṃ śūlapaṭṭiśadhāriṇam || 22 ||
analyzed: tapodhikāḥ prapaśyaṃti devadevam maheśvaram mahākāla vane nityam śūla paṭṭiśa dhāriṇam  /

original: etatte tathyamākhyātaṃ lokānugrahakārakam | sahitānukrameṇātra mantraiśca vidhipūrvakam || 23 ||
analyzed: etat te tathyam ākhyātam loka anugraha kārakam sahita anukrameṇa atra mantraiḥ ca vidhi pūrvakam

original: samarcayaṃti ye viprā bhaktyā śaṃbhumahāpadam || | vasaṃtīha samīpaṃ te mahākālānubhāvitāḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: samarcayanti ye viprāḥ bhaktyā śaṃbhu mahā padam   vasaṃti iha samīpam te mahākāla anubhāvitāḥ

original: paṭhati ya iha loke tasya saṃsthānametatprathitaguṇagaṇaughairarcitaṃ doṣahaṃ tat | śubhamatirabhiṣiktaḥ so'marairarcyamāno vrajati harapuraṃ yaḥ saṃśṛṇotyekacittaḥ || 125 ||
analyzed: paṭhati yaḥ iha loke tasya saṃsthānam etat prathita guṇa gaṇa oghaiḥ arcitam doṣa ham tat  śubha matiḥ abhiṣiktaḥ saḥ amaraiḥ arcyamānaḥ vrajati hara puram yaḥ saṃśṛṇoti ekacittaḥ

original: | vyāsa uvāca | bhagavankena vidhinā mahākālavane naraiḥ | rudralokamabhīpsadbhirvastavyaṃ kṣetravāsibhiḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: vyāsaḥ uvāca bhagavan kena vidhinā mahākāla vane naraiḥ rudra lokam abhīpsadbhiḥ vastavyam kṣetra vāsibhiḥ

original: kiṃ manuṣyairuta strībhiḥ siddhyarthaṃ hyāśramānvitaiḥ | vasadbhiḥ kimanuṣṭheyametatsarvaṃ bravīhi naḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: kim manuṣyaiḥ uta strībhiḥ siddhi artham hi āśrama anvitaiḥ vasadbhiḥ kim anuṣṭheyam etat sarvam bravīhi naḥ  /

original: naraiḥ strībhiśca vastavyaṃ varṇaiścāśramavāsibhiḥ | svadharmācāraniratairdaṃbhamohavivarjitaiḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: naraiḥ strībhiḥ ca vastavyam varṇaiḥ ca āśrama vāsibhiḥ svadharma ācāra nirataiḥ daṃbha moha vivarjitaiḥ

original: karmaṇā manasā vācā rudrabhaktairyatendriyaiḥ | anuśrutibhirakṣudraiḥ sarvabhūta hite rataiḥ | kiṃ kurvāṇairnaraiḥ karma rudrabhaktiṃ bravīhi naḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: karmaṇā manasā vācā rudra bhaktaiḥ yata indriyaiḥ anuśrutibhiḥ akṣudraiḥ sarva bhūta hite rataiḥ kim kurvāṇaiḥ naraiḥ karma rudra bhaktim bravīhi naḥ  /

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | trividhā kathitā hyatra manovākkāyasaṃbhavā | laukikī vaidikī cānyā bhavedādhyātmikī tathā || 5 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca trividhā kathitā hi atra manaḥ vāc kāya saṃbhavā laukikī vaidikī ca anyā bhavet ādhyātmikī tathā

original: dhyānadhāraṇayā buddhyā rudrāṇāṃ smaraṇaṃ hi tat | rudrabhaktikarī caiṣā mānasī bhaktiru cyate || 6 ||
analyzed: dhyāna dhāraṇayā buddhyā rudrāṇām smaraṇam hi tat rudra bhakti karī ca eṣā mānasī bhaktiḥ u cyate

original: vratopavāsaniyamairyatedriyanirodhibhiḥ | kāyikā bhaktī rudrasya jñānadhyānasya dharmiṇām || 7 ||
analyzed: vrata upavāsa niyamaiḥ yata idriya nirodhibhiḥ kāyikā bhaktī rudrasya jñāna dhyānasya dharmiṇām  /

original: goghṛtakṣīradadhibhirgaṃdharaktakuśo dakaiḥ | gandhamālyaiśca vividhairdhātubhiścopapāditā || 8 ||
analyzed: go ghṛta kṣīra dadhibhiḥ gaṃdha rakta kuśaḥ dakaiḥ gandha mālyaiḥ ca vividhaiḥ dhātubhiḥ ca upapāditā  /

original: ghṛtagugguladhūpaiśca kṛṣṇāgarusugaṃdhibhiḥ | bhūṣaṇairhemaratnānāṃ citrābhiḥ sragbhireva ca || 9 ||
analyzed: ghṛta guggula dhūpaiḥ ca kṛṣṇa agaru sugaṃdhibhiḥ bhūṣaṇaiḥ hema ratnānām citrābhiḥ sragbhiḥ eva ca

original: vāsapravisarāstotraiḥ patākāvyajanocchritaiḥ | nṛtyavāditragītaiśca sarvapratyupahārakaiḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: vāsa pravisara āstotraiḥ patākā vyajana ucchritaiḥ nṛtya vāditra gītaiḥ ca sarva pratyupahārakaiḥ

original: bhakṣyabhojyānupānaiśca yāvatpūjākṣatairnaraiḥ | maheśvaraṃ puraskṛtya bhaktiḥ sā laukikī matā || 11 ||
analyzed: bhakṣya bhojya anupānaiḥ ca yāvat pūjā akṣataiḥ naraiḥ maheśvaram puraskṛtya bhaktiḥ sā laukikī matā  /

original: vedamantrahaviryāgairyā kriyā vaidikī matā || 12 ||
analyzed: veda mantra haviḥ yāgaiḥ yā kriyā vaidikī matā

original: darśe ca pūrṇamāsyāṃ vā kartavyaṃ cāgnihotrakam || | prāśanaṃ dakṣiṇādānaṃ puroḍāśaśca satkriyā || 13 ||
analyzed: darśe ca pūrṇamāsyām vā kartavyam ca agnihotrakam   prāśanam dakṣiṇā dānam puroḍāśaḥ ca satkriyā

original: iṣṭavṛttiḥ somapānaṃ yājñikaṃ sarvakarma ca | ṛgyajuḥsāmajāpyāni saṃhitādhyayanāni ca || 14 ||
analyzed: iṣṭavṛttiḥ soma pānam yājñikam sarva karma ca  ṛk yajuḥ sāma jāpyāni saṃhitā adhyayanāni ca

original: kriyate rudramuddiśya sā bhaktirvaidikī smṛtā | agnibhūmyanilākāśaniśākaradivākarān || 15 ||
analyzed: kriyate rudram uddiśya sā bhaktiḥ vaidikī smṛtā agni bhūmi anila ākāśa niśākara divākarān

original: samuddiśya kṛtaṃ karma tatsarvaṃ daivikaṃ bhavet || | ādhyātmikī tu dvividhā rudrabhaktiḥ sthitā mune || 16 ||
analyzed: samuddiśya kṛtam karma tat sarvam daivikam bhavet   ādhyātmikī tu dvividhā rudra bhaktiḥ sthitā mune

original: sāṃkhyākhyā yaugikī cānyā vibhāgaṃ tatra me śṛṇu | caturviṃśatitattvāni pradhānādīni saṃkhyayā || 17 ||
analyzed: sāṃkhya ākhyā yaugikī ca anyā vibhāgam tatra me śṛṇu caturviṃśati tattvāni pradhāna ādīni saṃkhyayā

original: acetanāni yojyāni puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ | cetanaḥ puruṣo bhoktā na kāryaṃ tasya karmaṇaḥ || 18 ||
analyzed: acetanāni yojyāni puruṣaḥ pañcaviṃśakaḥ  cetanaḥ puruṣaḥ bhoktā na kāryam tasya karmaṇaḥ  /

original: rudraḥ ṣaḍviṃśakaḥ kartā sarvajñaścetanaḥ prabhuḥ | ajanmā nityamavyaktamadhiṣṭhātā prayojakaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: rudraḥ ṣaḍviṃśakaḥ kartā sarvajñaḥ cetanaḥ prabhuḥ ajanmā nityam avyaktam adhiṣṭhātā prayojakaḥ

original: puruṣo nityavyaktaḥ syātkāraṇaṃ ca maheśvaraḥ | tattvasargaṃ bhavetsargaṃ bhūtasargaṃ ca tattvataḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: puruṣaḥ nitya vyaktaḥ syāt kāraṇam ca maheśvaraḥ tattva sargam bhavet sargam bhūta sargam ca tattvataḥ

original: saṃkhyayā parisargāya pradhānaṃ ca guṇātmakam | sādharmyamātmanaiśvaryaṃ pradhānaṃ vai vidharmi ca || 21 ||
analyzed: saṃkhyayā parisargāya pradhānam ca guṇa ātmakam sādharmyam ātmanā aiśvaryam pradhānam vai vidharmi ca  /

original: kāraṇaṃ tacca rudrasya kāmya tvamidamucyate | sarvatra kartṛtā rudre puruṣe cāpyakartṛtā || 22 ||
analyzed: kāraṇam tat ca rudrasya kāmya tvam idam ucyate sarvatra kartṛ tā rudre puruṣe ca api akartṛ tā  /

original: acaitanyaṃ pradhāne ca tacca tattvamidaṃ smṛtam | tattvāṃtareṇa mucyaṃte kāryaṃ kāraṇameva ca || 23 ||
analyzed: acaitanyam pradhāne ca tat ca tattvam idam smṛtam tattva aṃtareṇa mucyaṃte kāryam kāraṇam eva ca  /

original: prayojane ca vaijātyaṃ jñātvā tattvamasaṃkhyayā | saṃkhyāstītyucyate prājñai rudratattvārthaciṃtakaiḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: prayojane ca vaijātyam jñātvā tattvam asaṃkhyayā saṃkhyā asti iti ucyate prājñaiḥ rudra tattva artha ciṃtakaiḥ

original: iti tasya tattvabhāvaṃ tattvasaṃkhyā ca tattvataḥ | rudratattvādhikaṃ cāpi jñānatattvaṃ vidurbudhāḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: iti tasya tattva bhāvam tattva saṃkhyā ca tattvataḥ rudra tattva adhikam ca api jñāna tattvam viduḥ budhāḥ

original: sāṃkhye kṛtā bhaktireṣā sadbhirādhyātmikī matā | yogināmapi me bhaktyā śṛṇu bhaktiṃ mahāsura || 26 ||
analyzed: sāṃkhye kṛtā bhaktiḥ eṣā sadbhiḥ ādhyātmikī matā yoginām api me bhaktyā śṛṇu bhaktim mahā asura

original: prāṇāyāmaparo nityaṃ dhyāyate niyateṃdriyaḥ | dhāraṇāṃ hṛdaye dhṛtvā dhyāyate yo maheśvaram || 27 ||
analyzed: prāṇāyāma paraḥ nityam dhyāyate niyata iṃdriyaḥ dhāraṇām hṛdaye dhṛtvā dhyāyate yaḥ maheśvaram

original: hṛtkañjakarṇikāsīnaṃ pañcavaktraṃ trilocanam | śaśāṃkajyotijaṭharaṃ vyālavṛttakaṭītaṭam || 28 ||
analyzed: hṛd kañja karṇikā āsīnam pañcavaktram trilocanam śaśāṃka jyoti jaṭharam vyāla vṛtta kaṭī taṭam

original: śvetaṃ daśabhujaṃ bhadraṃ varadābhayahastakam | yogajā mānasī vyāsa rudrabhaktiḥ parā smṛtā || 29 ||
analyzed: śvetam daśa bhujam bhadram varada abhaya hastakam  yoga jā mānasī vyāsa rudra bhaktiḥ parā smṛtā

original: ya eva bhaktimānrudre rudrabhaktaḥ sa ucyate | vidhiṃ tu śṛṇu me vyāsa yaḥ smṛtaḥ kṣetravāsinām || 30 ||
analyzed: yaḥ eva bhaktimān rudre rudra bhaktaḥ saḥ ucyate vidhim tu śṛṇu me vyāsa yaḥ smṛtaḥ kṣetra vāsinām  /

original: svayaṃ rudreṇa vihito brahmādīnāṃ samāgame | kathito vistarātpūrvaṃ sarveṣāṃ tatra sannidhau || 31 ||
analyzed: svayam rudreṇa vihitaḥ brahma ādīnām samāgame kathitaḥ vistarāt pūrvam sarveṣām tatra sannidhau  /

original: nirmamā nirahaṃkārā niḥsaṃgā niṣparigrahāḥ | baṃdhuvargeṇa niḥ snehāḥ samaloṣṭāśmakāṃcanāḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: nirmamāḥ nirahaṃkārāḥ niḥsaṃgāḥ niṣparigrahāḥ baṃdhu vargeṇa niḥ snehāḥ sama loṣṭa aśma kāṃcanāḥ   /

original: bhūtānāṃ karmabhirnityaṃ trividhairabhayapradāḥ | sāṃkhyayogavidhijñāśca dharmajñāśchinnasaṃśayāḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: bhūtānām karmabhiḥ nityam trividhaiḥ abhaya pradāḥ sāṃkhya yoga vidhi jñāḥ ca dharma jñāḥ chinna saṃśayāḥ

original: yajaṃto vivi dhairyajñairye viprāḥ kṣetravāsinaḥ | mahākālavane teṣāṃ mṛtānāṃ yatphalaṃ śṛṇu || 34 ||
analyzed: yajantaḥ dhaiḥ yajñaiḥ ye viprāḥ kṣetra vāsinaḥ mahākāla vane teṣām mṛtānām yat phalam śṛṇu

original: vrajaṃtyeva suduṣprāpyaṃ brahmasāyujyamakṣayam | saṃprāpya na puna rjanma labhaṃte mokṣamavyayam || 35 ||
analyzed: vrajanti eva su duṣprāpyam brahma sāyujyam akṣayam saṃprāpya na punar janma labhaṃte mokṣam avyayam

original: punarāvartanaṃ hitvā vidhiṃ māheśvaraṃ sthitāḥ | punarāvṛttiranyeṣāṃ prapaṃcāśramavāsinām || 36 ||
analyzed: punarāvartanam hitvā vidhim māheśvaram sthitāḥ punarāvṛttiḥ anyeṣām prapaṃca āśrama vāsinām

original: gārhasthyaṃ vidhimāsādya ṣaṭkarmaniratāḥ sadā | juhvate vidhinā samyaṅmaṃtrastotrairniyaṃtritāḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: gārhasthyam vidhim āsādya ṣaṭkarma niratāḥ sadā juhvate vidhinā samyak maṃtra stotraiḥ niyaṃtritāḥ  /

original: adhikaṃ phalamāyāṃti sarvaduḥkhavivarjitāḥ | sarva lokeṣu cānyatra gatistasya na hanyate || 38 ||
analyzed: adhikam phalam āyānti sarva duḥkha vivarjitāḥ lokeṣu ca anyatra gatiḥ tasya na hanyate  /

original: divyenaiśvaryayogena svārūḍhaḥ svaparigrahaḥ | bahusūryaprakāśena vimānena suvarcasā || 39 ||
analyzed: divyena aiśvarya yogena su ārūḍhaḥ sva parigrahaḥ bahu sūrya prakāśena vimānena su varcasā

original: vṛtaḥ strīṇāṃ sahasraiśca svacchaṃdagamanālayaḥ | vicaratyavicāryaiva sarvalokāndivaukasām || 40 ||

original: gacchetamujjayinyāṃ vai kṛtavidyau bhaviṣyatha | tataḥ sāṃdīpaniṃ vipraṃ jagmatū rāmakeśavau || 7 ||
analyzed: gacchetam ujjayinyām vai kṛtavidyau bhaviṣyatha tatas sāṃdīpanim vipram jagmatuḥ rāma keśavau

original: kaṇṭhasthāṃścakraturvedānācāramakhilaṃ ca tau | sarahasyaṃ dhanurvedaṃ sasaṃhāraṃ tathaiva ca || 8 ||
analyzed: kaṇṭha sthān cakratuḥ vedān ācāram akhilam ca tau sa rahasyam dhanurvedam sa saṃhāram tathā eva ca

original: ahorātraiścatuḥṣaṣṭyā tadadbhutamabhūddvija | sāṃdīpanirasaṃbhāvyaṃ tayoḥ karmātimānuṣam || 9 ||
analyzed: ahorātraiḥ catuḥṣaṣṭyā tat adbhutam abhūt dvija sāṃdīpaniḥ asaṃbhāvyam tayoḥ karma ati mānuṣam  /

original: viciṃtya tau tadā mene prāptau caṃdra divākarau | tataḥ kiṃcitsa novāca snātuṃ tīrthamathāyayau || 10 ||
analyzed: viciṃtya tau tadā mene prāptau caṃdra divākarau tatas kiṃcid sa nā uvāca snātum tīrtham atha āyayau

original: śiṣyaistu sahito vipro mahākālavane'viśat | śiṣyaiḥ saha praviṣṭau dvau tadā tau rāmakeśavau || 11 ||
analyzed: śiṣyaiḥ tu sahitaḥ vipraḥ mahākāla vane aviśat śiṣyaiḥ saha praviṣṭau dvau tadā tau rāma keśavau

original: vandamānau mahākālaṃ sa taṃ keśavamavravīt | tvayā nāthena devānāṃ mānuṣyatve hi tiṣṭhatā || 12 ||
analyzed: vandamānau mahākālam sa tam keśavam avravīt tvayā nāthena devānām mānuṣya tve hi tiṣṭhatā  /

original: sukhamāsīcca sādhūnāmajñānānāṃ ca sarvadā | jane pīḍākarā ye tu sadā vā baladarpitāḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: sukham āsīt ca sādhūnām ajñānānām ca sarvadā jane pīḍā karāḥ ye tu sadā vā bala darpitāḥ  /

original: yuvābhyāṃ te hatāḥ sarve kaṃsapramukhato nṛpāḥ | munisiddhasurādīnāṃ sthitiḥ kāryā tvayā'nagha || 14 ||
analyzed: yuvābhyām te hatāḥ sarve kaṃsa pramukhatas nṛpāḥ muni siddha sura ādīnām sthitiḥ kāryā tvayā anagha  /

original: kariṣyāmi tamityuktvā sa namasya tato yayau | dṛṣṭvā sāṃdīpaniṃ śiṣyā ūcurevaṃ dinedine || 15 ||
analyzed: kariṣyāmi tam iti uktvā sa namasya tatas yayau  dṛṣṭvā sāṃdīpanim śiṣyāḥ ūcuḥ evam dine dine

original: kasya na śraddadhe teṣāṃ vacastvatyadbhutaṃ yataḥ | svayaṃ yayau tato draṣṭumāścaryaṃ śiṣyabhāṣitam || 16 ||
analyzed: kasya na śraddadhe teṣām vacaḥ tu ati adbhutam yatas svayam yayau tatas draṣṭum āścaryam śiṣya bhāṣitam  /

original: tatastatrotthitaḥ śabdaḥ saṃśleṣe ca tathā tayoḥ | tāvāgatau gṛhaṃ tatra gururvacanamabravīt || 17 ||
analyzed: tatas tatra utthitaḥ śabdaḥ saṃśleṣe ca tathā tayoḥ  tau āgatau gṛham tatra guruḥ vacanam abravīt

original: na vai jñātau mayā vīrau yaduvṛṣṇikulodbhavau | tataḥ sāṃdīpaniṃ kṛṣṇaḥ kṛtakṛtyo'bravīdvacaḥ || 18 ||
analyzed: na vai jñātau mayā vīrau yadu vṛṣṇi kula udbhavau tatas sāṃdīpanim kṛṣṇaḥ kṛtakṛtyaḥ abravīt vacaḥ

original: gurvarthaṃ kiṃ dadāmīti saha rāmeṇa harṣitaḥ | tacchutvā vacanaṃ hṛdyaṃ guruḥ provāca harṣitaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: guru artham kim dadāmi iti saha rāmeṇa harṣitaḥ tat śutvā vacanam hṛdyam guruḥ provāca harṣitaḥ

original: putramicchāmyahaṃ tvatto yo mṛto lavaṇāṃbhasi | putra eko hi me jātaḥ sa cāpi timinā hṛtaḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: putram icchāmi aham tvattaḥ yaḥ mṛtaḥ lavaṇāṃbhasi putraḥ ekaḥ hi me jātaḥ sa ca api timinā hṛtaḥ  /

original: prabhāse tīrthayātrāyāṃ tvameva tamihānaya | tatheti cābravītkṛṣṇo rāmasyānumate gataḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: prabhāse tīrtha yātrāyām tvam eva tam iha ānaya tathā iti ca abravīt kṛṣṇaḥ rāmasya anumate gataḥ  /

original: taṃ samudra uvācedaṃ daityaḥ paṃcajano mahān | timi rūpeṇa taṃ bālaṃ grastavānmayi saṃsthitaḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: tam samudraḥ uvāca idam daityaḥ paṃcajanaḥ mahān rūpeṇa tam bālam grastavān mayi saṃsthitaḥ

original: tataḥ paṃcajanaṃ hatvā grāharūpaṃ mahābalam | tanmadhyasthaṃ ca jagrāha śaṃkhaṃ grasto hi yaḥ purā || 23 ||
analyzed: tatas paṃcajanam hatvā grāha rūpam mahā balam tad madhya stham ca jagrāha śaṃkham grastaḥ hi yaḥ purā  /

original: jaleśvaragṛhāttena grāheṇātīva līlayā | tasyodare yadā bālaṃ nāptavāṃstu janārdanaḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: jaleśvara gṛhāt tena grāheṇa atīva līlayā tasya udare yadā bālam na āptavān tu janārdanaḥ  /

original: yamālayagataṃ matvā tadā varuṇamabravīt | bhagavānyādasāmīśa ratho me dīyatāṃ mahān || 25 ||
analyzed: yama ālaya gatam matvā tadā varuṇam abravīt bhagavān yādasām īśa rathaḥ me dīyatām mahān

original: purājire hatā daityā dānavā baladarpitāḥ | mayā yena rathenādya mahyaṃ sa dīyatāṃ rathaḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: purā ajire hatāḥ daityāḥ dānavāḥ bala darpitāḥ mayā yena rathena adya mahyam sa dīyatām rathaḥ  /

original: nyāsabhūto ratho yaste vidhṛto nihatāriṇā | mayā dharmaṃ puraskṛ्tya sa dīyatāmapāṃpate || 27 ||
analyzed: nyāsa bhūtaḥ rathaḥ yaḥ te vidhṛtaḥ nihata ariṇā mayā dharmam puraskṛtya sa dīyatām apām pate

original: yenāhave pretarājaṃ jitvā paśyāmi bālakam | etacchrutvā prahṛṣṭātmā jñātvā kāryārthinaṃ harim | dadau taṃ rathamakṣobhyaṃ raṇe tasmai surāsuraiḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: yena āhave pretarājam jitvā paśyāmi bālakam  etat śrutvā prahṛṣṭa ātmā jñātvā kārya arthinam harim dadau tam ratham akṣobhyam raṇe tasmai sura asuraiḥ  /

original: tato hariḥ samālokya rathaṃ ratnapariṣkṛtam | dvīpicarmaparīdhānaṃ vaiyāghraparivāritam || 29 ||
analyzed: tatas hariḥ samālokya ratham ratna pariṣkṛtam dvīpi carma parīdhānam vaiyāghra parivāritam  /

original: nānā citravicitrāṃgaṃ garuḍadhvajarājitam | saṃyuktaṃ śaibyasugrīvapuṣpadaṃtabalāhakaiḥ || 30 ||
analyzed: nānā citra vicitra aṃgam garuḍa dhvaja rājitam saṃyuktam śaibya sugrīva puṣpadaṃta balāhakaiḥ

original: ajeyaṃ devadeveṃdradānavāsurarākṣasaiḥ | anekāyudhasaṃpūrṇaṃ maṇividrumabhūṣitam || 31 ||
analyzed: ajeyam devadeva iṃdra dānava asura rākṣasaiḥ aneka āyudha saṃpūrṇam maṇi vidruma bhūṣitam  /

original: sahasrasūryapratimaṃ cāruvaktracaturyugam | kiṃkiṇīśataśobhāḍhyaṃ ghaṃṭācāmaracaṃ drikam || 32 ||
analyzed: sahasra sūrya pratimam cāru vaktra catur yugam kiṃkiṇī śata śobhā āḍhyam ghaṃṭā cāmara cam

original: saṃvartākāraviṣamaṃ khageṃdravaraketanam | dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaḥ sarāmastu mumude vītavismayāt || 33 ||
analyzed: saṃvarta ākāra viṣamam khaga iṃdra vara ketanam dṛṣṭvā kṛṣṇaḥ sarāmaḥ tu mumude vīta vismayāt

original: pradakṣiṇamupākṛtya devatābhyaḥ praṇamya ca | āruroha rathaṃ viṣṇurvimānaṃ sāgrayojanam || 34 ||
analyzed: pradakṣiṇam upākṛtya devatābhyaḥ praṇamya ca  āruroha ratham viṣṇuḥ vimānam sāgra yojanam  /

original: tato jagāma tvarito janārdano jagannivāso yamalokamāśritām | diśaṃ sahasraiḥ kiraṇai rvṛtāṃ purīṃ dadhmau ca śaṃkhaṃ parigṛhya cācyutaḥ || 35 ||
analyzed: tatas jagāma tvaritaḥ janārdanaḥ jagannivāsaḥ yama lokam āśritām  diśam sahasraiḥ kiraṇaiḥ rvṛtām purīm dadhmau ca śaṃkham parigṛhya ca acyutaḥ  /

original: tatra pradhyāpayāmāsa śaṃkhaṃ śārṅgadhanurdharaḥ | tena śabdena vitrastāḥ kṛtāṃtālayavāsinaḥ || 36 ||
analyzed: tatra pradhyāpayāmāsa śaṃkham śārṅga dhanuḥ dharaḥ tena śabdena vitrastāḥ kṛtāṃta ālaya vāsinaḥ

original: narakāṃtargatā martyāḥ pāpācāraparāyaṇāḥ | sukhamāpuḥ prasannāśca vahnayaḥ kṛṣṇadarśanāt || 37 ||
analyzed: naraka aṃtargatāḥ martyāḥ pāpa ācāra parāyaṇāḥ sukham āpuḥ prasannāḥ ca vahnayaḥ kṛṣṇa darśanāt  /

original: śastrāṇi kuṃṭhatāṃ prāpuryaṃtrāṇi vividhāni ca | vidīrṇāni tadā cāsurdevadevasya darśanāt || 38 ||
analyzed: śastrāṇi kuṃṭha tām prāpuḥ yaṃtrāṇi vividhāni ca vidīrṇāni tadā ca āsuḥ devadevasya darśanāt  /

original: asipatravanaṃnāma śīrṇaparṇamajāyata | rauravanāma narakamabhairavamabhūttadā || 39 ||
analyzed: asipatravanam nāma śīrṇa parṇam ajāyata raurava nāma narakam abhairavam abhūt tadā

original: abhairavaṃ bhairavākhyaṃ kuṃbhīpākamavācikam | śṛṃgāṭaṃ śṛṃgasadṛśaṃ lohasūcyapyasūcikā || 40 ||
analyzed: abhairavam bhairava ākhyam kuṃbhīpākam avācikam śṛṃgāṭam śṛṃga sadṛśam loha sūcī api asūcikā  /

original: dustarā sutarā jātā nadī vaitaraṇī nṛṇām | narakāṃte tadā jāte gate viśveśvare vibhau || 41 ||
analyzed: dustarā sutarā jātā nadī vaitaraṇī nṛṇām naraka aṃte tadā jāte gate viśveśvare vibhau

original: pāpakṣayāttataḥ sarve te muktā nārakā narāḥ | padamavyayamāsādya dṛṣṭvā viṣṇuṃ tamo'paham || 42 ||
analyzed: pāpa kṣayāt tatas sarve te muktāḥ nārakāḥ narāḥ padam avyayam āsādya dṛṣṭvā viṣṇum tamaḥ apaham

original: vimāneṣu sahasreṣu hyārūḍhāste samaṃtataḥ | samīkṣya puṃḍarīkākṣaṃ muktāste sarvapātakāt || 43 ||
analyzed: vimāneṣu sahasreṣu hi ārūḍhāḥ te samaṃtataḥ samīkṣya puṃḍarīkākṣam muktāḥ te sarva pātakāt

original: tataḥ śūnyaṃ mune jātaṃ sarvaṃ nirayamaṃḍalam | darśanāttasya devasya viṣṇorviśvasvarūpiṇaḥ || 44 ||
analyzed: tatas śūnyam mune jātam sarvam niraya maṃḍalam darśanāt tasya devasya viṣṇoḥ viśva svarūpiṇaḥ

original: tato dūtāḥ kṛtāṃtasya kṛṣṇaṃ ca yuddhakāriṇam | vārayāmāsuratyugrā viśaṃtaṃ narakānprati || 45 ||
analyzed: tatas dūtāḥ kṛtāṃtasya kṛṣṇam ca yuddha kāriṇam vārayāmāsuḥ ati ugrāḥ viśaṃtam narakān prati  /

original: kiṃkarā ūcuḥ | mā vīrānena mārgeṇa rathamānaya mānavan | prayāṃtyadhogatiṃ pāpātparastrīsvāpahārakāḥ || 46 ||
analyzed: kiṃkarāḥ ūcuḥ mā vīra anena mārgeṇa ratham ānaya mānavan prayāṃti adhogatim pāpāt para strī sva apahārakāḥ   /

original: yamādiṣṭā narāḥ pāpā ye'mocyā varṣakoṭibhiḥ | dṛṣṭvā ta eva sadyastvāṃ gatāḥ svargamapāvṛtāḥ || 47 ||
analyzed: yam ādiṣṭāḥ narāḥ pāpāḥ ye a mocyāḥ varṣa koṭibhiḥ  dṛṣṭvā te eva sadyas tvām gatāḥ svargam apāvṛtāḥ  /

original: etacchrutvā vacasteṣāṃ kṛpayā pīḍito bhṛśam | punaḥ provāca madhuhā mokṣāyāhamupāgataḥ || 48 ||
analyzed: etat śrutvā vacaḥ teṣām kṛpayā pīḍitaḥ bhṛśam punar provāca madhuhā mokṣāya aham upāgataḥ  /

original: sarveṣāṃ svargadātāhaṃ yamalokanivārakaḥ | aṃjasā yamarāḍdūtā yamāyākhyāta me vacaḥ || 49 ||
analyzed: sarveṣām svarga dātā aham yama loka nivārakaḥ aṃjasā yamarāj dūtāḥ yamāya ākhyāta me vacaḥ

original: etacchrutvā vaco dūtāḥ satvarā yamamāgatāḥ | sarvamācakṣire vṛttaṃ yathā nārakamokṣaṇam || 50 ||
analyzed: etat śrutvā vacaḥ dūtāḥ sa tvarāḥ yamam āgatāḥ sarvam ācakṣire vṛttam yathā nāraka mokṣaṇam  /

original: tato yamo ruṣāviṣṭaḥ prāha tānyamakiṃkarān | yaḥ kaścidāgato martyo maryādābhedakṛnnaraḥ || 51 ||
analyzed: tatas yamaḥ ruṣā āviṣṭaḥ prāha tān yama kiṃkarān  yaḥ kaścid āgataḥ martyaḥ maryādā bheda kṛt naraḥ

original: taṃ gatvā vārayadhvaṃ vai gṛhītvānīyatāmiti | ayaṃ narāṃtako yātu kiṃkaraḥ saha kiṃkaraiḥ || 52 ||
analyzed: tam gatvā vārayadhvam vai gṛhītvā ānīyatām iti ayam narāṃtakaḥ yātu kiṃkaraḥ saha kiṃkaraiḥ  /

original: evamukto yamenātha kiṃkaraḥ sa narāṃtakaḥ | gatvā taṃ vārayāmāsa vāgbhirugrābhiracyutam || 53 ||
analyzed: evam uktaḥ yamena atha kiṃkaraḥ sa narāṃtakaḥ gatvā tam vārayāmāsa vāgbhiḥ ugrābhiḥ acyutam

original: yadā na vāritastasthau tadā kruddho narāṃtakaḥ | tadā śarairatīvograistāḍitastena keśavaḥ || 54 ||
analyzed: yadā na vāritaḥ tasthau tadā kruddhaḥ narāṃtakaḥ tadā śaraiḥ atīva ugraiḥ tāḍitaḥ tena keśavaḥ

original: baladevopi samare tāḍito vividhaiḥ śaraiḥ | tāvubhau tāḍitau ghoraiḥ samaṃtādyamakiṃkaraiḥ || 55 ||
analyzed: baladevaḥ api samare tāḍitaḥ vividhaiḥ śaraiḥ tau ubhau tāḍitau ghoraiḥ samaṃtāt yama kiṃkaraiḥ

original: ādāya dhanuṣī divye jaghnaturyamakiṃkarān | bāṇairanekasāhasraiḥ kruddhau rāmajanādarnau || 56 ||
analyzed: ādāya dhanuṣī divye jaghnatuḥ yama kiṃkarān  bāṇaiḥ aneka sāhasraiḥ kruddhau rāma janādarnau

original: narāṃtako'pi samare balena balinārditaḥ | papāta gadayā bhinno mūrdhni niryātalocanaḥ || 57 ||
analyzed: narāṃtakaḥ api samare balena balinā arditaḥ papāta gadayā bhinnaḥ mūrdhni niryāta locanaḥ

original: tato narāṃtake vīre patite yamakiṃkare | kiṃkarāṇāmabhūtsainyamārtaṃ raṇaparāṅmukham || 58 ||
analyzed: tatas narāṃtake vīre patite yama kiṃkare kiṃkarāṇām abhūt sainyam ārtam raṇa parāṅmukham  /

original: rāmakṛṣṇābhyāṃ te dūtā hanyamānā bhayāturāḥ | yamāya kathayāmāsurnarāṃtakastu pātitaḥ || 59 ||
analyzed: rāma kṛṣṇābhyām te dūtāḥ hanyamānāḥ bhaya āturāḥ yamāya kathayāmāsuḥ narāṃtakaḥ tu pātitaḥ  /
