original: tato yamo yayau kruddhaḥ samaṃtātkiṃkarairvṛtaḥ | prāha tato yamaḥ kruddho no jitohaṃ purā paraiḥ || 60 ||
analyzed: tatas yamaḥ yayau kruddhaḥ samaṃtāt kiṃkaraiḥ vṛtaḥ prāha tatas yamaḥ kruddhaḥ no jitaḥ ham purā paraiḥ  /

original: tato vāditranirghoṣaistumulānakagomukhaiḥ | nānāḍamarukaiścaiva citraguptaiśca gacchati || 61 ||
analyzed: tatas vāditra nirghoṣaiḥ tumula ānaka gomukhaiḥ nānā ḍamarukaiḥ ca eva citraguptaiḥ ca gacchati  /

original: devā vidyādharāḥ siddhā dṛṣṭvā yāṃtaṃ mahābalam | kṛtāṃtasya raṇe'kṣobhyaṃ kāmapālaṃ jagatpatim || 62 ||
analyzed: devāḥ vidyādharāḥ siddhāḥ dṛṣṭvā yāṃtam mahā balam kṛtāṃtasya raṇe akṣobhyam kāmapālam jagatpatim

original: tataste kiṃkarāḥ sarve citraguptena noditāḥ | rathamāvṛtya bāṇaughaiḥ pravivyadhuḥ samaṃtataḥ || 63 ||
analyzed: tatas te kiṃkarāḥ sarve citraguptena noditāḥ ratham āvṛtya bāṇa oghaiḥ pravivyadhuḥ samaṃtataḥ

original: balaṃ ca keśavaṃ saṃkhye jaghnatustāvubhāvapi | raṇe ca vividhairbāṇaiścitraguptasya paśyataḥ || 64 ||
analyzed: balam ca keśavam saṃkhye jaghnatuḥ tau ubhau api raṇe ca vividhaiḥ bāṇaiḥ citraguptasya paśyataḥ  /

original: vidārya ca sahasrāṇi kiṃkarāṇāṃ samaṃtataḥ | kṛtāṃtānīkinīmadhye kṛtāṃta iva keśavaḥ | cacāra raṇadurdharṣaḥ kāmapālena pālitaḥ || 65 ||
analyzed: vidārya ca sahasrāṇi kiṃkarāṇām samaṃtataḥ kṛtāṃta anīkinī madhye kṛtāṃtaḥ iva keśavaḥ cacāra raṇa durdharṣaḥ kāmapālena pālitaḥ  /

original: tataścitragupto raṇe kiṃkarādyaṃ vidīrṇaṃ nirīkṣyārtanādaṃ cakāra || 66 ||
analyzed: tatas citraguptaḥ raṇe kiṃkara ādyam vidīrṇam nirīkṣya ārta nādam cakāra

original: śaraiḥ paṃcabhiḥ kṛṣṇamāyāṃtamājau jaghānāṣṭabhirvaktradeśe sa bhinnaḥ | śarārto rathopastha āsīttadārtastamālokya bhinnaṃ raṇe naṣṭasaṃjñam || 67 ||
analyzed: śaraiḥ paṃcabhiḥ kṛṣṇam āyāṃtam ājau jaghāna aṣṭabhiḥ vaktra deśe sa bhinnaḥ śara ārtaḥ rathopasthaḥ āsīt tadā ārtaḥ tam ālokya bhinnam raṇe naṣṭa saṃjñam

original: rathaṃ svaṃ samādāya yātaḥ kṛtāṃtastataścitragupte śarārte prasupte | raṇe kīrtilupte bhayakṣobhayuktaḥ svasainyaiśca yukto bhayārto niṣaṇṇaḥ || 68 ||
analyzed: ratham svam samādāya yātaḥ kṛtāṃtaḥ tatas citragupte śara ārte prasupte raṇe kīrti lupte bhaya kṣobha yuktaḥ sva sainyaiḥ ca yuktaḥ bhaya ārtaḥ niṣaṇṇaḥ  /

original: pradhānāśca bhagnā vicitrāśca bhagrāstataścitraguptaṃ niśamyātha bhagnam | sa kālastamāyāṃtamālokya dūrādvarasainyamādāya devāri śatrum || 69 ||
analyzed: pradhānāḥ ca bhagnāḥ vicitrāḥ ca bhagrāḥ tatas citraguptam niśamya atha bhagnam sa kālaḥ tam āyāntam ālokya dūrāt vara sainyam ādāya devāri śatrum  /

original: vināśāya yudhyadyugāṃte prajānāṃ yathā vāḍavo jvālavṛddhaḥ pravṛttaḥ | tamāyāṃtamālokya kālaṃ karālaṃ śarairāvṛṇodaṃtakaṃ kālakalpaiḥ || 70 ||
analyzed: vināśāya yudhyat yuga aṃte prajānām yathā vāḍavaḥ jvāla vṛddhaḥ pravṛttaḥ tam āyāṃtam ālokya kālam karālam śaraiḥ āvṛṇot aṃtakam kāla kalpaiḥ  /

original: sa kālaḥ karālaṃ samādāya daṃḍaṃ mumocācyute paśyatāṃ devatānām | tataḥ kāladaṃḍaḥ prajānāṃ vināśo hareḥ saṃnikāśaṃ samabhyājagāma || 71 ||
analyzed: sa kālaḥ karālam samādāya daṃḍam mumoca acyute paśyatām devatānām  tatas kāla daṃḍaḥ prajānām vināśaḥ hareḥ saṃnikāśam samabhyājagāma  /

original: tato devagaṃdharvayakṣā munīṃdrāḥ paraṃ vismayaṃ prāpurāvīkṣya rāmam | jvalaṃtaṃ ca jagrāha kālasya daṃḍaṃ sa rāmo varalīlayā'naṃtamūrtiḥ || 72 ||
analyzed: tatas deva gaṃdharva yakṣāḥ muni iṃdrāḥ param vismayam prāpuḥ ā vīkṣya rāmam jvalantam ca jagrāha kālasya daṃḍam sa rāmaḥ vara līlayā ananta mūrtiḥ  /

original: gṛhīte balenāhave kāladaṃḍe moktukāme punaḥ kālanāśāya vai | tūrṇamabhyetya tatrāṃtare raṇe vārayāmāsa kṛṣṇaṃ tadā || 73 ||
analyzed: gṛhīte balena āhave kāladaṃḍe moktu kāme punar kāla nāśāya vai tūrṇam abhyetya tatra aṃtare raṇe vārayāmāsa kṛṣṇam tadā  /

original: mā muṃcetyabravīdvedhāḥ kālaṃ kālāyudhaṃ bala | tvayā balavatā vīra carācaradharā dharā || 74 ||
analyzed: mā muṃca iti abravīt vedhāḥ kālam kāla āyudham bala tvayā balavatā vīra carācara dharā dharā

original: dhāryate śirasā deva saṃsāre nāsti te samaḥ | tvayā viśvapatirviṣṇurutsaṃgena sadohyate | ko'nyosti tvatsamo rāma yo jagaddahane kṣamaḥ | jagatsraṣṭā jagadgoptā jagaddhartā jagatpatiḥ || 76 ||
analyzed: dhāryate śirasā deva saṃsāre nā asti te samaḥ tvayā viśvapatiḥ viṣṇuḥ utsaṃgena sadā uhyate  kaḥ anyaḥ asti tvad samaḥ rāma yaḥ jagat dahane kṣamaḥ jagatsraṣṭā jagadgoptā jagat dhartā jagatpatiḥ   /

original: pālyate yattvayā sopi viṣṇurviśvaikanāyakaḥ | kaste stutikaro'stīha ko guṇānvaktumarhati || 77 ||
analyzed: pālyate yat tvayā saḥ api viṣṇuḥ viśva eka nāyakaḥ kaḥ te stuti karaḥ asti iha kaḥ guṇān vaktum arhati  /

original: tato vayaṃ tvadaṃkasthaviṣṇunābhibhavā yataḥ | ityuktvā baladevaṃ ca vāsudevaṃ punarvacaḥ || 78 ||
analyzed: tatas vayam tvad aṃka stha viṣṇunā abhibhavāḥ yatas iti uktvā baladevam ca vāsudevam punar vacaḥ

original: uvāca caturāsyastu stutiśca vṛtaḥ suraiḥ | kṛṣṇakṛṣṇa karālasya kālasyāsya kṛpāṃ kuru || 79 ||
analyzed: uvāca catur āsyaḥ tu stutiḥ ca vṛtaḥ suraiḥ kṛṣṇa kṛṣṇa karālasya kālasya asya kṛpām kuru  /

original: yato bhavaṃtamāyāṃtaṃ viṣṇuṃ viśvaikanāyakam | vetti nāyaṃ jagannāthaṃ narakārṇavatārakam || 80 ||
analyzed: yatas bhavantam āyāṃtam viṣṇum viśva eka nāyakam  vetti na ayam jagannātham naraka arṇava tārakam

original: tvayā vai bhagavanpūrvaṃ yamaḥ saṃsthāpitaḥ pade | nṛṇāṃ duṣkṛtakartṝṇāṃ narakāya yamaḥ prabho || 81 ||
analyzed: tvayā vai bhagavan pūrvam yamaḥ saṃsthāpitaḥ pade nṛṇām duṣkṛta kartṝṇām narakāya yamaḥ prabho

original: tasmādasya jagannātha kṣamyatāṃ puruṣottama | vibho kṛpāṃ kuruṣvāsya brūhi yatte vivakṣitam || 82 ||
analyzed: tasmāt asya jagannātha kṣamyatām puruṣottama vibho kṛpām kuruṣva asya brūhi yat te vivakṣitam

original: etacchutvā'bravītkṛṣṇo dhātaḥ śṛṇu gurormama | sāṃdīpaneḥ samānītaḥ sutastenāgatāviha || 83 ||
analyzed: etat śutvā abravīt kṛṣṇaḥ dhātar śṛṇu guroḥ mama sāṃdīpaneḥ samānītaḥ sutaḥ tena āgatau iha   /

original: samarpyatāṃ guruśreṣṭha śreṣṭhāya gurudakṣiṇā | āvābhyāṃ vai pratijñāto tasmātsā pālyatāṃ vibho || 84 ||
analyzed: samarpyatām guru śreṣṭha śreṣṭhāya guru dakṣiṇā āvābhyām vai tasmāt sā pālyatām vibho

original: etatpitāmahaḥ śrutvā yamaṃ samaranirjitam | samāhūyābravīdviṣṇuryadbravīti kuruṣva tat || 85 ||
analyzed: etat pitāmahaḥ śrutvā yamam samara nirjitam samāhūya abravīt viṣṇuḥ yat bravīti kuruṣva tat

original: tacchrutvā dharmarājastu viraṃcimidamabravīt | bhagavanviśvakṛlloke naiṣa mārgastvayā kṛtaḥ || 86 ||
analyzed: tat śrutvā dharmarājaḥ tu viraṃcim idam abravīt bhagavan viśvakṛt loke na eṣa mārgaḥ tvayā kṛtaḥ  /

original: yamalokamanuprāpya kāyahīnaḥ śarīravān | yatkāyarahito yāti naitadatra prapadyate || 87 ||
analyzed: yama lokam anuprāpya kāya hīnaḥ śarīravān yat kāya rahitaḥ yāti na etat atra prapadyate

original: tacchutvā hi punarbrahmā viśvasyāsya vibhuḥ svayam | viśvakṛdviśvahadyasmādyadicchati karotu tat || 88 ||
analyzed: tat śutvā hi punar brahmā viśvasya asya vibhuḥ svayam viśva kṛt viśvahat yasmāt yat icchati karotu tat

original: tasmādarpaya putraṃ tvaṃ muneḥ sāṃdīpaneśca yaḥ | narake yaṃ punaḥ kṛtvā taṃ cānaya mahāmate || 89 ||
analyzed: tasmāt arpaya putram tvam muneḥ sāṃdīpaneḥ ca yaḥ narake yam punar kṛtvā tam ca ānaya mahāmate

original: tacchutvā dharmarājastu putraṃ sāṃdīpanestathā | sasarja bāla rūpaṃ ca tadātmānaṃ tadudbhavam || 90 ||
analyzed: tat śutvā dharmarājaḥ tu putram sāṃdīpaneḥ tathā sasarja bāla rūpam ca tadā ātmānam tad udbhavam

original: arpayāmāsa kṛṣṇasya bālaṃ rūpasamanvitam | sa sarvadevatānāṃ ca tadadbhutamivābhavat || 91 ||
analyzed: arpayāmāsa kṛṣṇasya bālam rūpa samanvitam sa sarva devatānām ca tat adbhutam iva abhavat  /

original: tataḥ prāpya guroḥ putraṃ prabhuḥ prītaḥ prajāpatim | prāha prāpto mayā brahmansvarūpo dvijadārakaḥ || 92 ||
analyzed: tatas prāpya guroḥ putram prabhuḥ prītaḥ prajāpatim  prāha prāptaḥ mayā brahman sva rūpaḥ dvija dārakaḥ  /

original: śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca | adyaprabhṛti lokeśa deśe maccaraṇāṃ kite | avaṃtyāmaṃkapādākhye mṛtā nekṣaṃti te yamam || 93 ||
analyzed: śrī kṛṣṇaḥ uvāca adya prabhṛti lokeśa deśe kite  avantyām aṃkapāda ākhye mṛtāḥ na īkṣaṃti te yamam

original: mahākālapure devamādyaṃ vai puruṣottamam | viśvarūpaṃ ca goviṃdaṃ śaṃkhoddhāraṃ ca keśa vam || 94 ||
analyzed: mahākāla pure devam ādyam vai puruṣottamam  viśvarūpam ca goviṃdam śaṃkhoddhāram ca

original: ye paśyaṃti kuśasthalyāmeteṣāṃ mūrtipaṃcakam | te narā na gamiṣyaṃti viraṃce nirayaṃ kvacit || 95 ||
analyzed: ye paśyaṃti kuśasthalyām eteṣām mūrti paṃcakam  te narāḥ na gamiṣyaṃti viraṃce nirayam kvacid  /

original: tathaivāgamanādatra mama rāmasya nā rakāḥ | vimuktāste tvaghādghorātprāpnuvaṃtvakhilā divam || 96 ||
analyzed: tathā eva āgamanāt atra mama rāmasya nā rakāḥ vimuktāḥ te tu aghāt ghorāt prāpnuvaṃtu akhilāḥ divam

original: ityukte vacane vedhāḥ provāca prītimānharim | yattvayoktaṃ vacaḥ kṛṣṇa tadastu sakalaṃ sadā || 97 ||
analyzed: iti ukte vacane vedhāḥ provāca prītimān harim  yat tvayā uktam vacaḥ kṛṣṇa tat astu sakalam sadā

original: ye ca tvāmādipuruṣaṃ prathamaṃ puruṣottamam | praṇamya paścādrakṣyaṃti snātvā śivasarasyapi || 98 ||
analyzed: ye ca tvām ādipuruṣam prathamam puruṣottamam praṇamya paścāt rakṣyaṃti snātvā śiva sarasi api  /

original: adhojvālaṃ mahākālaṃ so'śvamedhaphalaṃ labhet | evamukto hariḥ putramādāya balinā saha || 99 ||
analyzed: adhojvālam mahākālam saḥ aśvamedha phalam labhet evam uktaḥ hariḥ putram ādāya balinā saha  /

original: saṃmānya vedhasaṃ kālaṃ samārohadrathaṃ tataḥ | śaṃkhamāpūrayāmāsa kṛtakāryo janārdanaḥ || 100 ||
analyzed: saṃmānya vedhasam kālam samārohat ratham tatas śaṃkham āpūrayāmāsa kṛta kāryaḥ janārdanaḥ

original: mokṣāya nirayasthānāṃ nṛṇāṃ vai pāpakarmaṇām | tataste śaṃkhaśabdena smaraṇenācyutasya ca || 1 ||
analyzed: mokṣāya niraya sthānām nṛṇām vai pāpa karmaṇām tatas te śaṃkha śabdena smaraṇena acyutasya ca  /

original: divyānvimānānāruhya divamevākhilā gatāḥ | śūnyaṃ tanmaṃḍalaṃ jātaṃ nārāyaṇasamāgame || 2 ||
analyzed: divyān vimānān āruhya divam eva akhilāḥ gatāḥ śūnyam tat maṃḍalam jātam nārāyaṇa samāgame

original: kālo'pi daṃḍamāsādya baladevātpunaḥ puram | praviveśa tato dhātā tatraivāṃtaradhīyata || 3 ||
analyzed: kālaḥ api daṃḍam āsādya baladevāt punar puram  praviveśa tatas dhātā tatra eva aṃtaradhīyata

original: kṛṣṇopi balavāndhīraḥ prāpta ujjayinīṃ purīm | baladevasahāyastu satvareṇāśugāminā || 4 ||
analyzed: kṛṣṇaḥ api balavān dhīraḥ prāptaḥ ujjayinīm purīm baladeva sahāyaḥ tu sa tvareṇa āśu gāminā

original: tataḥ sāṃdīpaneḥ putramarpayāmāsa keśihā | gurave yatpratijñātaṃ sa tasmādanṛṇo'bhavat || 5 ||
analyzed: tatas sāṃdīpaneḥ putram arpayāmāsa keśi hā gurave yat pratijñātam sa tasmāt anṛṇaḥ abhavat  /

original: evaṃ sāṃdīpaniḥ putraṃ dṛṣṭvā ca punarāgatam | nāgarāstatra rājā ca vismayaṃ paramaṃ yayuḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: evam sāṃdīpaniḥ putram dṛṣṭvā ca punar āgatam nāgarāḥ tatra rājā ca vismayam paramam yayuḥ  /

original: tau vīrāvarcayāmāsurmatvā devottamottamau | sāṃdīpaniruvācedaṃ tau ca rāmajanārdanau || 7 ||
analyzed: tau vīrau arcayāmāsuḥ matvā deva uttama uttamau sāṃdīpaniḥ uvāca idam tau ca rāma janārdanau  /

original: iha sthāsyati vāṃ kīrtiryāvadābhūtasaṃplavam | sthāne madīya etasmiṃstiṣṭhaṃtau yadunaṃdanau || 8 ||
analyzed: iha sthāsyati vām kīrtiḥ yāvat ābhūtasaṃplavam sthāne madīye etasmin tiṣṭhaṃtau yadu naṃdanau  /

original: na vijñātau mayā vīrau yaduvṛṣṇikulodbhavau | naranārāyaṇau devau devakāryārthamāgatau || 9 ||
analyzed: na vijñātau mayā vīrau yadu vṛṣṇi kula udbhavau nara nārāyaṇau devau deva kārya artham āgatau  /

original: nālpamṛtyurbhavettasya na vyādhirna ca durgatiḥ | prāpya hyatra ca yaḥ snāti svargaloke sa modate || 110 ||
analyzed: na alpa mṛtyuḥ bhavet tasya na vyādhiḥ na ca durgatiḥ prāpya hi atra ca yaḥ snāti svarga loke sa modate  /

original: śaṃkhinaṃ viśvarūpaṃ ca govidaṃ cakriṇaṃ tathā | catvāri viṣṇukṣetrāṇi aṃkapādastu paṃcamaḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: śaṃkhinam viśvarūpam ca govidam cakriṇam tathā catvāri viṣṇu kṣetrāṇi aṃkapādaḥ tu paṃcamaḥ

original: eṣāṃ yātrāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathā kāryā manīṣibhiḥ | maṃdākinyāṃ kṛtasnāno dṛṣṭvā rāmajanārdanau || 12 ||
analyzed: eṣām yātrām pravakṣyāmi yathā kāryā manīṣibhiḥ maṃdākinyām kṛta snānaḥ dṛṣṭvā rāma janārdanau  /

original: śaṃkhoddhāre tataḥ snātvā prapaśyedbalakeśavau | snānaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ kuṃḍe goviṃdaṃ ca samarcayeta || 13 ||
analyzed: śaṃkhoddhāre tatas snātvā prapaśyet bala keśavau  snānam kṛtvā tatas kuṃḍe goviṃdam ca samarcayeta  /

original: cakriṇaṃ ca tato dṛṣṭvā devadevaṃ ca śaṃkhinam | aṃkapādau tato dṛṣṭvā viśvarūpaṃ tato vrajet || 14 ||
analyzed: cakriṇam ca tatas dṛṣṭvā devadevam ca śaṃkhinam aṃkapādau tatas dṛṣṭvā viśvarūpam tatas vrajet

original: tasyāgrataḥ karīkuṃḍe snānaṃ kṛtvā yathāvidhi | punastena prakāreṇa prapaśyedbalakeśavau || 15 ||
analyzed: tasya agratas karīkuṃḍe snānam kṛtvā yathāvidhi punar tena prakāreṇa prapaśyet bala keśavau  /

original: snānaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ kuṃḍe goviṃdaṃ ca samarcayet | tathaiva cakrihalinau dṛṣṭvā taṃ keśavaṃ vrajet || 16 ||
analyzed: snānam kṛtvā tatas kuṃḍe goviṃdam ca samarcayet tathā eva cakri halinau dṛṣṭvā tam keśavam vrajet

original: śiprāṃbhasi naraḥ snātvā bhaktyā saṃpūjya keśavam | parāvṛtyāṃkapāde tu tāṃ rātriṃ gamayecchuciḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: śiprā aṃbhasi naraḥ snātvā bhaktyā saṃpūjya keśavam parāvṛtya aṃka pāde tu tām rātrim gamayet śuciḥ

original: prātarvai bhojayettatra paṃca viprāṃśca suvratān | godakṣiṇāṃ śaṃkhine tu viśvarūpāya vai hayam || 18 ||
analyzed: prātar vai bhojayet tatra paṃca viprān ca suvratān  go dakṣiṇām śaṃkhine tu viśvarūpāya vai hayam

original: goviṃdāya gajaṃ dadyātsarvaṃ dadyācca keśave | upoṣya dvādaśīṃ vipra yoṃ'kapādaṃ samarcayet || 19 ||
analyzed: goviṃdāya gajam dadyāt sarvam dadyāt ca keśave  upoṣya dvādaśīm vipra yaḥ oṃ akapādam samarcayet

original: gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca dhūpaiśca naivedyairvividhaistathā | śrāddhaṃ yaḥ kurute sarvaṃ tasya puṇyaphalaṃ śṛṇu || 120 ||
analyzed: gaṃdha puṣpaiḥ ca dhūpaiḥ ca naivedyaiḥ vividhaiḥ tathā śrāddham yaḥ kurute sarvam tasya puṇya phalam śṛṇu  /

original: kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ | gītanṛtyādibhogaiśca vaikuṃṭhe suciraṃ vaset || 21 ||
analyzed: kulānām śatam uddhṛtya vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ gīta nṛtya ādi bhogaiḥ ca vaikuṃṭhe su ciram vaset  /

original: punarloka mimaṃ prāpya pavitre jāyate kule | prāpnotyanaṃtasaṃtānaṃ viṣṇulokaṃ punarvrajet || 122 ||
analyzed: punar loka mimam prāpya pavitre jāyate kule prāpnoti anaṃta saṃtānam viṣṇu lokam punar vrajet  /

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi devaṃ trailokyaviśrutam | caṃdrādityamiti khyātaṃ caṃdrādityārcitaṃ purā || 1 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca atha anyam saṃpravakṣyāmi devam trailokya viśrutam caṃdrādityam iti khyātam caṃdra āditya arcitam purā

original: yastaṃ samarcayeddevaṃ surāsuranamaskṛtam | gaṃdhapupostathā dhūpairnaivedyaivividhaistathā || 2 ||
analyzed: yaḥ tam samarcayet devam sura asura namaskṛtam  dhūpaiḥ naivedyaiḥ vividhaiḥ tathā

original: caṃdrādityādisālokyaṃ prayāti sarvakāmikam | vimānaṃ sūryasaṃkāśairyāvaccaṃdradivākarau || 3 ||
analyzed: caṃdra āditya ādi sālokyam prayāti sarvakāmikam vimānam sūrya saṃkāśaiḥ yāvat caṃdra divākarau  /

original: iti candrādityamāhātmyam | sanatkumāra uvāca | karabheśaṃ tato gaccheddevadevaṃ maheśvaram | yasya darśanamātreṇa kuyonau naiva jāyate || 4 ||
analyzed: iti candrādityamāhātmyam sanatkumāraḥ uvāca karabheśam tatas gacchet devadevam maheśvaram yasya darśana mātreṇa ku yonau nā eva jāyate  /

original: vyāsa uvāca | karabheśamahaṃ devaṃ śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ | kathaṃ devaḥ samutpannaḥ karabheśetisaṃjñitaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: vyāsaḥ uvāca karabheśam aham devam śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ katham devaḥ samutpannaḥ karabheśa iti saṃjñitaḥ

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | purā devagaṇaiḥ sārdhaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ | vane'sminkrīḍayāmāsa paramāhlādasaṃyutaḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca purā deva gaṇaiḥ sārdham devadevaḥ maheśvaraḥ vane asmin krīḍayāmāsa parama āhlāda saṃyutaḥ  /

original: krīḍanbahutithe kāle śaṃkaraḥ karabho'bhavat | jñāyate ca sa no devaiḥ śaṃkaraḥ karabhākṛtiḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: krīḍan bahutithe kāle śaṃkaraḥ karabhaḥ abhavat jñāyate ca sa naḥ devaiḥ śaṃkaraḥ karabha ākṛtiḥ   /

original: anveṣayaṃti te devāstato vismayasaṃyutāḥ | na paśyaṃti yadā tatra taṃ devaṃ śūlapāṇinam || 8 ||
analyzed: anveṣayaṃti te devāḥ tatas vismaya saṃyutāḥ na paśyaṃti yadā tatra tam devam śūlapāṇinam

original: devaiḥ pṛṣṭastato brahmā kvāsti devo maheśvaraḥ | dhyātvātha brahmaṇā dṛṣṭo gupto yogaprabhurharaḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: devaiḥ pṛṣṭaḥ tatas brahmā kva asti devaḥ maheśvaraḥ  dhyātvā atha brahmaṇā dṛṣṭaḥ guptaḥ yoga prabhuḥ haraḥ

original: devaiḥ sārdhaṃ tato brahmā papraccha gaṇanāyakam | na dṛṣṭaḥ śaṃkaro'smābhirgataḥ kutra vināyaka || 10 ||
analyzed: devaiḥ sārdham tatas brahmā papraccha gaṇanāyakam  na dṛṣṭaḥ śaṃkaraḥ asmābhiḥ gataḥ kutra vināyaka

original: kathayasva namastubhyaṃ dāsyāmo laḍḍukānvibho | evamuktastadā hṛṣṭaḥ provāca gaṇanāyakaḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: kathayasva namaḥ tubhyam dāsyāmaḥ laḍḍukān vibho evam uktaḥ tadā hṛṣṭaḥ provāca gaṇanāyakaḥ

original: karabho'yaṃ mahā'devo dṛśyate vibudho ttamāḥ | śrutvā caivaṃ vaco devāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ karabhaṃ yayuḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: karabhaḥ ayam mahā adevaḥ dṛśyate vibudha uttamāḥ  śrutvā ca evam vacaḥ devāḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ karabham yayuḥ

original: jñāto'smābhirmahādeva jalpaṃta iti te svayam | gatvā caiva tataḥ sarva caturdikṣu sthitāḥ svayam || 13 ||
analyzed: jñātaḥ asmābhiḥ mahādeva jalpaṃtaḥ iti te svayam gatvā ca eva tatas sarva catur dikṣu sthitāḥ svayam

original: viciṃtyeti kathaṃ jñātaḥ śaṃkaro vismayaṃ gataḥ | tyaktvātha kārabhaṃ rūpaṃ devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: viciṃtya iti katham jñātaḥ śaṃkaraḥ vismayam gataḥ tyaktvā atha kārabham rūpam devadevaḥ maheśvaraḥ

original: liṃgamutpādayāmāsa divyaṃ yatkarabhe śvaram | te dṛṣṭvā'tha surāḥ sarve sāṣṭāṃgapraṇatisthitāḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: liṃgam utpādayāmāsa divyam yat karabhe śvaram  te dṛṣṭvā atha surāḥ sarve sa aṣṭāṃga praṇati sthitāḥ

original: tataḥprabhṛti vikhyātaḥ śaṃkaraḥ karabheśvaraḥ | koṭitīrthāduttarasminsthāpayāmāsa vighnapam || 16 ||
analyzed: tatas prabhṛti vikhyātaḥ śaṃkaraḥ karabheśvaraḥ koṭitīrthāt uttarasmin sthāpayāmāsa vighnapam

original: svanāmnā prathitaṃ cakre karabhaṃ cātipūjitam | snātvā tatra śucirbhūtvā yastamarcayate śivam || 17 ||
analyzed: sva nāmnā prathitam cakre karabham ca ati pūjitam snātvā tatra śuciḥ bhūtvā yaḥ tam arcayate śivam

original: gaṃdhapuṣpaiśca naivedyaiḥ śṛṇu teṣāṃ ca yatphalam | sarvamedheṣu yatpuṇyaṃ sarvadāneṣu yatphalam || 18 ||
analyzed: gaṃdha puṣpaiḥ ca naivedyaiḥ śṛṇu teṣām ca yat phalam sarvamedheṣu yat puṇyam sarva dāneṣu yat phalam

original: tato'dhikaṃ sa labhate nātra kāryā vicāraṇā | mahākālaṃ tato gacchansaṃpūrṇaṃ phalamāpnuyāt || 19 ||
analyzed: tatas adhikam sa labhate na atra kāryā vicāraṇā mahākālam tatas gacchan saṃpūrṇam phalam āpnuyāt

original: tataḥ prasiddho loke'sminnṛddhidaḥ karabheśvaraḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: tatas prasiddhaḥ loke asmin ṛddhi daḥ karabheśvaraḥ

original: iti karabheśvaramāhātmyam || cha | sanatkumāra uvāca | laiḍukaiśca tato devairvighnanāthaḥ samarcitaḥ | tadāprabhṛti vikhyāto viśveśo laḍḍukapriyaḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: iti karabheśvara māhātmyam  cha  sanatkumāraḥ uvāca laiḍukaiḥ ca tatas devaiḥ vighnanāthaḥ samarcitaḥ tadā prabhṛti vikhyātaḥ viśveśaḥ laḍḍuka priyaḥ   /

original: yaḥ samarcayate bhaktyā tasya vighno na jāyate | tasmai dadāti saṃtuṣṭaḥ sarvānkāmānvināyakaḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: yaḥ samarcayate bhaktyā tasya vighnaḥ na jāyate tasmai dadāti saṃtuṣṭaḥ sarvān kāmān vināyakaḥ

original: nirāhāraścaturthyāṃ ca snātvā śiprāṃ viśeṣataḥ | raktāṃbaradharobhūtvā raktapuṣpairvināyakam || 23 ||
analyzed: nirāhāraḥ caturthyām ca snātvā śiprām viśeṣataḥ rakta aṃbara dharaḥ bhūtvā rakta puṣpaiḥ vināyakam

original: raktacaṃdanatoyena maṃtraiḥ snapanapūrvakam | caṃdanenāpi raktena taṃ vilepya prapūjayet || 24 ||
analyzed: raktacaṃdana toyena maṃtraiḥ snapana pūrvakam caṃdanena api raktena tam vilepya prapūjayet  /

original: dhūpaṃ dadyāttathā divyaṃ sugaṃdhaṃ laḍḍukapriye | naivedye laḍḍukā deyā ājyakhaṃḍapariplutāḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: dhūpam dadyāt tathā divyam su gaṃdham laḍḍuka priye naivedye laḍḍukāḥ deyāḥ ājya khaṃḍa pariplutāḥ

original: na tasya jāyate vyādhirbhayaṃ vighnaṃ kadācana | labhate ca sadābhīṣṭaṃ mṛtaḥ śivapuraṃ vrajet || 26 ||
analyzed: na tasya jāyate vyādhiḥ bhayam vighnam kadācana  labhate ca sadā abhīṣṭam mṛtaḥ śiva puram vrajet  /

original: avatīrṇaḥ punarloke jāyate vasudhādhipaḥ | matimānputravāñchūro nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 27 ||
analyzed: avatīrṇaḥ punar loke jāyate vasudhādhipaḥ matimān putravān śūraḥ na atra kāryā vicāraṇā

original: iti gaṇeśamā hātmyam | sanatkumāra uvāca | kusumeśaṃ suradvāre surāsuranamaskṛtam | śraddhayā pūjayedyastu śivaloke sa modate || 28 ||
analyzed: iti gaṇeśa mā hātmyam sanatkumāraḥ uvāca kusumeśam suradvāre sura asura namaskṛtam śraddhayā pūjayet yaḥ tu śiva loke sa modate  /

original: jayeśvaraṃ tu yaḥ paśyeddevadevaṃ maheśvaram | jayī syātsarvakāryeṣu śivalokaṃ sa gacchati || 29 ||
analyzed: jayeśvaram tu yaḥ paśyet devadevam maheśvaram  jayī syāt sarva kāryeṣu śiva lokam sa gacchati  /

original: śivadvāre śivaṃ liṃgamarcayenmānavo yadi | tridivaṃ yāti yānena gāṇapatyaṃ ca viṃdati || 30 ||
analyzed: śivadvāre śivam liṃgam arcayet mānavaḥ yadi tridivam yāti yānena gāṇapatyam ca viṃdati  /

original: athānyaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi mārkaṃḍeśvaramuttamam | mārkaṇḍeyo muniryatra taptavānsumahattapaḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: atha anyam saṃpravakṣyāmi mārkaṃḍeśvaram uttamam mārkaṇḍeyaḥ muniḥ yatra taptavān su mahat tapaḥ

original: dṛṣṭvā taṃ śaṃkaraṃ devaṃ vājapeyaphalaṃ labhet | sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā cirāyurjāyate naraḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā tam śaṃkaram devam vājapeya phalam labhet sarva pāpa viśuddha ātmā cira āyūḥ jāyate naraḥ

original: śṛṇu vyāsa mahāsthānaṃ yasyāṃ puryāmanuttamam | yatra tiṣṭhati sā devī brahmāṇī haṃsavāhinī || 33 ||
analyzed: śṛṇu vyāsa mahā sthānam yasyām puryām anuttamam  yatra tiṣṭhati sā devī brahmāṇī haṃsa vāhinī   /

original: bhaktānāṃ pūrayedāśāṃ putravatparipālayet | yathā mātā tathā devī dṛṣṭā śāṃtiparairapi || 34 ||
analyzed: bhaktānām pūrayet āśām putra vat paripālayet  yathā mātā tathā devī dṛṣṭā śāṃti paraiḥ api  /

original: arcitā brahmaṇā sā tu stutā devī surottamaiḥ | arcayedgaṃdhṛpuṣpaiśca naivedyaiḥ sarvasiddhidām | api yā brahmaṇaḥ pūrvamabhūdeva susiddhidā || 35 ||
analyzed: arcitā brahmaṇā sā tu stutā devī sura uttamaiḥ  arcayet gaṃdhṛ puṣpaiḥ ca naivedyaiḥ sarva siddhi dām  api yā brahmaṇaḥ pūrvam abhūt eva su siddhi dā

original: yaḥ snātvā brahmasarasi paśye dbrahmeśvaraṃ śivam | bhavabaṃdhavinirmukto brahmaloke sa modate || 36 ||
analyzed: yaḥ snātvā brahmasarasi paśyet brahmeśvaram śivam bhava baṃdha vinirmuktaḥ brahma loke sa modate

original: athānyāṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi yajñavāpīmanuttamām | yatra vai brahmaṇā pūrvamiṣṭo yajñaḥ sadakṣiṇaḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: atha anyām saṃpravakṣyāmi yajña vāpīm anuttamām  yatra vai brahmaṇā pūrvam iṣṭaḥ yajñaḥ sa dakṣiṇaḥ

original: yajñārthaṃ yatkṛtaṃ kuṃḍaṃ yajñavāpī ca sā smṛtā | paśuśca patito yasmāttasmātpaśupatiḥ smṛtaḥ || 38 ||
analyzed: yajña artham yat kṛtam kuṃḍam yajña vāpī ca sā smṛtā paśuḥ ca patitaḥ yasmāt tasmāt paśupatiḥ smṛtaḥ

original: tasyāṃ snātvā śucirbhūtvā paśyetpaśupatiṃ tu yaḥ | uddharetsa pitṝnvyāsa paśuyonigatānapi || 39 ||
analyzed: tasyām snātvā śuciḥ bhūtvā paśyet paśupatim tu yaḥ  uddharet sa pitṝn vyāsa paśu yoni gatān api  /

original: suvarṇamaṇimuktādyairvimānaiḥ sarvakāmagaiḥ | yāti rudrapuraṃ divyaṃ yatra devo maheśvaraḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: suvarṇa maṇi muktā ādyaiḥ vimānaiḥ sarva kāma gaiḥ  yāti rudra puram divyam yatra devaḥ maheśvaraḥ   /

original: rūpakuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā surūpo jāyatenaraḥ | svarge sa devagaṃdharvaiḥ spṛhaṇīyavapurbhavet || 41 ||
analyzed: rūpakuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā surūpaḥ jāyate naraḥ svarge sa deva gaṃdharvaiḥ spṛhaṇīya vapuḥ bhavet

original: kuṃḍe snātvāpyanaṃge yaḥ śucirbhūtvā samāhitaḥ | paśyecca devadeveśamanaṃgenārcitaṃ purā | kāmaṃ sa labhate'bhīṣṭaṃ mṛto yāti śivālayam || 42 ||
analyzed: kuṃḍe snātvā api anaṃge yaḥ śuciḥ bhūtvā samāhitaḥ paśyet ca devadeveśam anaṃgena arcitam purā kāmam sa labhate abhīṣṭam mṛtaḥ yāti śiva ālayam

original: āṣāḍhe tu sitāṣṭamyāṃ jāgaraṃ yastu kārayet | kedāre yatphalaṃ proktaṃ tatsamānamavāpnuyāt || 43 ||
analyzed: āṣāḍhe tu sita aṣṭamyām jāgaram yaḥ tu kārayet kedāre yat phalam proktam tad samānam avāpnuyāt

original: karīkuṃḍe naraḥ snātvā viśvarūpaṃ tu yo'rcayet | mucyate sarvapāpebhyo viṣṇulokaṃ sa gacchati || 44 ||
analyzed: karīkuṇḍe naraḥ snātvā viśvarūpam tu yaḥ arcayet mucyate sarva pāpebhyaḥ viṣṇu lokam sa gacchati  /

original: ajāgaṃdhe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā brahmeśvaraṃ śivam | brahmahatyāsamaṃ pāpaṃ tatkṣaṇātsaṃvyapohati || 45 ||
analyzed: ajāgaṃdhe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā brahmeśvaram śivam brahmahatyā samam pāpam tad kṣaṇāt saṃvyapohati  /

original: cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā cakra svāminamarcayet | jāyate sa naro vyāsa cakravartī sadā bhuvi || 46 ||
analyzed: cakratīrthe naraḥ snātvā cakra svāminam arcayet jāyate sa naraḥ vyāsa cakravartī sadā bhuvi

original: siddheśvaraṃ yadā paśyetsnātvā suvidhipūrvakam | kāmikena vimānena rudralokaṃ sa gacchati || 47 ||
analyzed: siddheśvaram yadā paśyet snātvā su vidhi pūrvakam  kāmikena vimānena rudra lokam sa gacchati  /

original: iti yajñavāpīmāhātmyam | somavatyāṃ naraḥ snātvā yaḥ someśvaramarcayet | somavannirmalo bhūtvā somaloke sa modate || 48 ||
analyzed: iti yajñavāpīmāhātmyam somavatyām naraḥ snātvā yaḥ someśvaram arcayet soma vat nirmalaḥ bhūtvā soma loke sa modate  /

original: vyāsa uvāca | tīrthaṃ somavatīnāma liṃgaṃ someśvaraṃ tathā | abhūdetatkathaṃ nāma śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ || 49 ||
analyzed: vyāsaḥ uvāca tīrtham somavatī nāma liṃgam someśvaram tathā abhūt etat katham nāma śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | śṛṇu vyāsa yathotpannaṃ somatīrthaṃ suśobhanam | someśvaraṃ yathā liṃgametatsatyaṃ vadāmi te || 50 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca śṛṇu vyāsa yathā utpannam somatīrtham su śobhanam  someśvaram yathā liṃgam etat satyam vadāmi te  /

original: yo devo bhagavānsomo lokasyāpyāyanaṃ param | āsīttasya purā vyāsa pitā vipro mahātapāḥ || 51 ||
analyzed: yaḥ devaḥ bhagavān somaḥ lokasya āpyāyanam param  āsīt tasya purā vyāsa pitā vipraḥ mahā tapāḥ

original: avantyāṃ ca mahābhāgo yo'trirnāmā taponidhiḥ | varṣāṇāṃ trīṇi divyāni sahasrāṇi tapo mahat || 52 ||
analyzed: avantyām ca mahābhāgaḥ yaḥ atriḥ nāmā taponidhiḥ varṣāṇām trīṇi divyāni sahasrāṇi tapaḥ mahat

original: ūrdhvabāhuḥ sa vai tepe brahmadhyānaparāyaṇaḥ | ūrdhvaṃ gataṃ tato vyāsa brāhmyaṃ tejo mahātmanaḥ || 53 ||
analyzed: ūrdhvabāhuḥ sa vai tepe brahma dhyāna parāyaṇaḥ  ūrdhvam gatam tatas vyāsa brāhmyam tejaḥ mahātmanaḥ

original: netrābhyāṃ tena susrāva bhāsayacca diśo daśa | tejastatsahasā dṛṣṭvā diśo daśoddhataṃ svataḥ || 54 ||
analyzed: netrābhyām tena susrāva bhāsayat ca diśaḥ daśa  tejaḥ tat sahasā dṛṣṭvā diśaḥ daśa uddhatam svatas

original: diśaśca tadyadā vyāsa sarvā dhartuṃ na cāśakan | asusravattadā digbhyastaddhi tejotiduḥsaham || 55 ||
analyzed: diśaḥ ca tat yadā vyāsa sarvāḥ dhartum na ca aśakan asusravat tadā digbhyaḥ tat hi tejaḥ uti duḥsaham

original: lokāṃśca bhāsayatsarvāndharaṇyāṃ vai papāta ha | somo jātastatastena śītāṃśuśca janapriyaḥ || 56 ||
analyzed: lokān ca bhāsayat sarvān dharaṇyām vai papāta ha somaḥ jātaḥ tatas tena śītāṃśuḥ ca jana priyaḥ  /

original: vāri somātsamutpannaṃ vyāsa tenaiva tejasā | praviṣṭā sā nadī śiprāmamṛtenātipūritā || 57 ||
analyzed: vāri somāt samutpannam vyāsa tena eva tejasā praviṣṭā sā nadī śiprām amṛtena atipūritā  /

original: tataḥ somavatī śiprā vikhyātā sarvasi ddhidā | somayuktāṃ nadīṃ śiprāṃ dṛṣṭvā pāpaṃ vyapohati || 58 ||
analyzed: tatas somavatī śiprā vikhyātā sarva siddhi dā  soma yuktām nadīm śiprām dṛṣṭvā pāpam vyapohati  /

original: khyātā ca triṣu lokeṣu pāpināṃ puṇyadāyinī | brahmahā vā surāpo vā steyī vā gurutalpagaḥ || 59 ||
analyzed: khyātā ca triṣu lokeṣu pāpinām puṇya dāyinī brahma hā vā surā paḥ vā steyī vā guru talpa gaḥ

original: catvāro'pyatra pāpena mucyaṃte darśanāddhruvam | amāsomau yadā yuktau somavatyāṃ tadā mune || 60 ||
analyzed: catvāraḥ api atra pāpena mucyaṃte darśanāt dhruvam amā somau yadā yuktau somavatyām tadā mune

original: snānaṃ dānaṃ ca yo dhīmāñjapaṃ homaṃ samācaret | akṣayaṃ tasya tatsarvaṃ yāvaccaṃdradivākarau || 61 ||
analyzed: snānam dānam ca yaḥ dhīmān japam homam samācaret  akṣayam tasya tat sarvam yāvat caṃdra divākarau

original: tilodakapradānena piṃḍadānena kāritā | akāle kālikī tṛptiḥ pitṝṇāṃ ca yato matā || 62 ||
analyzed: tila udaka pradānena piṃḍa dānena kāritā akāle kālikī tṛptiḥ pitṝṇām ca yatas matā

original: sarvatra durlabhā siprā somaṃ somagrahastathā | someśvaraḥ somavāraḥ sakārāḥ paṃca durlabhāḥ || 63 ||
analyzed: sarvatra durlabhā siprā somam soma grahaḥ tathā someśvaraḥ somavāraḥ sakārāḥ paṃca durlabhāḥ  /

original: śiprāsomajalaṃ vyāsa koṭitīrthaphalapradam | amāsomasamāyoge pitṛtīrthasamaṃ smṛtam || 64 ||
analyzed: śiprā soma jalam vyāsa koṭi tīrtha phala pradam amā soma samāyoge pitṛtīrtha samam smṛtam

original: amāyāṃ somavāraścedvyatīpāto yadā bhavet | śataguṇaṃ gayāyāstu somavatyāṃ prakīrtitam || 65 ||
analyzed: amāyām somavāraḥ ced vyatīpātaḥ yadā bhavet śataguṇam gayāyāḥ tu somavatyām prakīrtitam

original: evaṃ somavatītīrthaṃ jātamatra mahāmune | somaṃ dṛṣṭvātha patitaṃ kṣitau brahmā jagadguruḥ || 66 ||
analyzed: evam somavatī tīrtham jātam atra mahā mune somam dṛṣṭvā atha patitam kṣitau brahmā jagadguruḥ  /

original: rathe taṃ sthāpayāmāsa lokānāṃ hitakāmyayā | saṃ tu vedamayo vyāsa dharmākṣaḥ satyasaṃgrahaḥ || 67 ||
analyzed: rathe tam sthāpayāmāsa lokānām hita kāmyayā sam tu veda mayaḥ vyāsa dharmākṣaḥ satya saṃgrahaḥ

original: yukto vājisahasreṇa brahmaṇā preritastadā | dṛṣṭvā somaṃ tato devā rathe taṃ brahmaṇā yutam || 68 ||
analyzed: yuktaḥ vāji sahasreṇa brahmaṇā preritaḥ tadā dṛṣṭvā somam tatas devāḥ rathe tam brahmaṇā yutam

original: tuṣṭuvuḥ sarvabhāvena hṛṣṭāḥ sarve samāhitāḥ | tasya saṃstūyamānasya tejaḥ somasya bhāsvaram || 69 ||
analyzed: tuṣṭuvuḥ sarva bhāvena hṛṣṭāḥ sarve samāhitāḥ tasya saṃstūyamānasya tejaḥ somasya bhāsvaram

original: āpyāyamānaṃ trīṃllokānpapāta dharaṇītale | brahmā tena rathenātha sāgarāṃtāṃ vasundharām || 70 ||
analyzed: āpyāyamānam trīn lokān papāta dharaṇī tale  brahmā tena rathena atha sāgara aṃtām vasundharām

original: triḥsaptakṛtvo'tiśayāccakārābdhipradakṣiṇam | tasya tatpatitaṃ tejo vyāsa somasya śītalam || 71 ||
analyzed: tris sapta kṛtvas atiśayāt cakāra abdhi pradakṣiṇam  tasya tat patitam tejaḥ vyāsa somasya śītalam

original: tadevauṣadhayo divyā jātā bhuvi sunirmalāḥ | yābhirdhāryo hyayaṃ lokaḥ prajāścaiva caturvidhāḥ || 72 ||
analyzed: tat eva oṣadhayaḥ divyāḥ jātāḥ bhuvi su nirmalāḥ yābhiḥ dhāryaḥ hi ayam lokaḥ prajāḥ ca eva caturvidhāḥ  /

original: tuṣṭo'tha bhagavānsomo jagateḥ sarvadā mune | daśavarṣasahasrāṇi tepe'tiduḥsahaṃ tapaḥ || 73 ||
analyzed: tuṣṭaḥ atha bhagavān somaḥ jagateḥ sarvadā mune daśa varṣa sahasrāṇi tepe ati duḥsaham tapaḥ

original: na yāti narakaṃ śuddhaḥ saṃkṣīṇākhilapātakaḥ | kārtikasyāsite pakṣe kṛṣṇā yā ca caturdaśī | tasyāṃ dīpaḥ pradātavyo devadevasya cāgrataḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: na yāti narakam śuddhaḥ saṃkṣīṇa akhila pātakaḥ kārtikasya asite pakṣe kṛṣṇā yā ca caturdaśī tasyām dīpaḥ pradātavyaḥ devadevasya ca agratas  /

original: | vyāsa uvāca | dīpe'sminyatphalaṃ cāsti vidhinā yena dīyate | tatsarvaṃ brūhi me tāta dīpotpattiṃ ca śobhanām || 1 ||

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | purā kṛtayuge vyāsa pārvatīṃ śaṃkaro'grataḥ | abhiprayācituṃ yātastayāpi so'bhiyācitaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca purā kṛta yuge vyāsa pārvatīm śaṃkaraḥ agratas abhiprayācitum yātaḥ tayā api saḥ abhiyācitaḥ  /

original: pārvatyuvāca | śarīre kṛṣṇatā śaṃbho mamāsti rūpahāriṇī | tasmādyāce bhṛśaṃ śaṃbho prasīda divya locana || 3 ||
analyzed: pārvatī uvāca śarīre kṛṣṇa tā śaṃbho mama asti rūpa hāriṇī tasmāt yāce bhṛśam śaṃbho prasīda divya locana

original: bhavena varṇitā sā vai atīva śobhanā mama | locane pakṣmamālāyāḥ śobhase'titarāṃ sadā || 4 ||
analyzed: bhavena varṇitā sā vai atīva śobhanā mama locane pakṣma mālāyāḥ śobhase atitarām sadā

original: sitābjasaṃsthito bhṛṃgo yathā śobhayate ca tam | tayā tathā yācitosau dhūrjaṭirvṛṣabhāsanaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: sita abja saṃsthitaḥ bhṛṃgaḥ yathā śobhayate ca tam tayā tathā yācitaḥ asau dhūrjaṭiḥ vṛṣabhāsanaḥ  /

original: virūparūpakartāsi na śṛṇoṣi vaco yadā | tadā tvahaṃ savai rāgyā careyaṃ duṣkaraṃ tapaḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: virūpa rūpa kartā asi na śṛṇoṣi vacaḥ yadā tadā tu aham rāgyā careyam duṣkaram tapaḥ  /

original: bhavastayeti coktastu tasyā vai pāṇimagrahīt | kadācicchaṃkaro devo ratiṃ yācitavānpriyām || 7 ||
analyzed: bhavaḥ tayā iti ca uktaḥ tu tasyāḥ vai pāṇim agrahīt kadācid śaṃkaraḥ devaḥ ratim yācitavān priyām

original: ratiṃ dattavatī sā tu jahāsa nāma kīrtayan | suduḥkhitā'bhavatsā tu parāṅmukhī vihāya tam || 8 ||
analyzed: ratim dattavatī sā tu jahāsa nāma kīrtayan su duḥkhitā abhavat sā tu parāṅmukhī vihāya tam

original: uvāca roṣasaṃyuktā saṃsmṛtya devabhāṣitam | tapovanaṃ vrajāmyadya sugauratvopalabdhaye || 9 ||
analyzed: uvāca roṣa saṃyuktā saṃsmṛtya deva bhāṣitam tapovanam vrajāmi adya su gaura tva upalabdhaye

original: suvarṇarūparūpā ca yadā punarbhavāmi ca | tadā tava sānurāgā bhavāmi caiva nānyathā || 10 ||
analyzed: suvarṇa rūpa rūpā ca yadā punar bhavāmi ca tadā tava sa anurāgā bhavāmi ca eva na anyathā

original: itīdameva jalpaṃtī jagāma viṃdhyaparvatam | haraḥ śuśoca tatastāṃ kva gatā sā vihāya mām || 11 ||
analyzed: iti idam eva jalpaṃtī jagāma viṃdhya parvatam haraḥ śuśoca tatas tām kva gatā sā vihāya mām

original: smaraṃstadeva ceṣṭitaṃ tadeva pūrvabhāṣitam | tadaiva me vṛthā matirmudā yadā na mānitā || 12 ||
analyzed: smaran tat eva ceṣṭitam tat eva pūrva bhāṣitam tadā eva me vṛthā matiḥ mudā yadā na mānitā  /

original: yato mayā himādrijā samastalokasundarī | puraiva nābhinaṃditā gatā vihāya māmiti || 13 ||
analyzed: yatas mayā himādrijā samasta loka sundarī purā eva na abhinaṃditā gatā vihāya mām iti  /

original: itīdameva so'vadadgatastvaddarśanaṃ tataḥ | priyāviyogamīdṛśaṃ guruṃ na soḍhumutsahe || 14 ||
analyzed: iti idam eva saḥ avadat gataḥ tvad darśanam tatas priyā viyogam īdṛśam gurum na soḍhum utsahe  /

original: tato jagaddhi saṃkulaṃ mahābhayena saṃyutam | surāsurā maharṣayaḥ paraṃ viṣādamabhyaguḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: tatas jagat hi saṃkulam mahā bhayena saṃyutam sura asurāḥ mahā ṛṣayaḥ param viṣādam abhyaguḥ

original: vihāya maṃdirāṇi te paraṃ viṣādamāgatāḥ | harastutiṃ parāṃ ca te pracakruradbhutopamāḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: vihāya maṃdirāṇi te param viṣādam āgatāḥ hara stutim parām ca te pracakruḥ adbhuta upamāḥ

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | na dṛśyate yadā devo rudro bāleṃduśekharaḥ | naṣṭālokaṃ jagatsarvaṃ kāṃtāramabhavattadā || 17 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca  na dṛśyate yadā devaḥ rudraḥ bāla iṃdu śekharaḥ naṣṭa ālokam jagat sarvam kāntāram abhavat tadā  /

original: trīṇi netrāṇi rudrasya yataḥ sūryeṃduva hnayaḥ | gate rudre na te bhāṃti jagatyasmiṃścarācare || 18 ||
analyzed: trīṇi netrāṇi rudrasya yatas sūrya iṃdu va hnayaḥ  gate rudre na te bhānti jagati asmin carācare

original: tatastamasi dustāre saṃbhūte lomaharṣaṇe | anyonyaṃ hi na paśyaṃti surāsurāstamovṛtāḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: tatas tamasi dustāre saṃbhūte loma harṣaṇe anyonyam hi na paśyaṃti sura asurāḥ tamaḥ vṛtāḥ

original: eṣā buddhistatasteṣāmutpannā kāryasiddhaye | yayā buddhyā jagannātho jñāyate pārvatīpatiḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: eṣā buddhiḥ tatas teṣām utpannā kārya siddhaye yayā buddhyā jagannāthaḥ jñāyate pārvatīpatiḥ

original: na hyāloko vinā tena śaśisūryāgnica kṣuṣā | parasparaṃ bruvaṃti sma duḥkhitāste visaṃjñayā || 21 ||
analyzed: na hi ālokaḥ vinā tena śaśi sūrya agni ca kṣuṣā parasparam bruvaṃti sma duḥkhitāḥ te visaṃjñayā

original: he deva he mune siddhe he ṛṣe he niśācara | he daitya he danuśreṣṭha he manuṣyanideśaka || 22 ||
analyzed: he deva he mune siddhe he ṛṣe he niśācara he daitya he danu śreṣṭha he manuṣya nideśaka  /

original: gato'si kāṃ diśaṃ tāta ko vā labdhastvayā vibho | kvacidviśrāmabhūmiste kvacidālaṃbane'pi vā || 23 ||
analyzed: gataḥ asi kām diśam tāta kaḥ vā labdhaḥ tvayā vibho kvacid viśrāma bhūmiḥ te kvacid ālaṃbane api vā

original: pātheyamasti kiṃcitte diśi kiṃ vātha kutracit | prakāśaṃ vāhanaṃ chatramaśanaṃ śayanaṃ gṛham || 24 ||
analyzed: pātheyam asti kiṃcid te diśi kim vā atha kutracid prakāśam vāhanam chatram aśanam śayanam gṛham

original: kvacidvāsi kathaṃ toyamathavā cittanirvṛtiḥ | bandhuḥ putro'si vā tāta vṛkṣa cchāyā suśītalā || 25 ||
analyzed: kvacid vā asi katham toyam athavā citta nirvṛtiḥ bandhuḥ putraḥ asi vā tāta vṛkṣa chāyā su śītalā

original: evaṃ prakāraṃ karuṇaṃ samābhāṣya parasparam | bhūyaścintāparāḥ sarve devāśceṃdrapurogamāḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: evam prakāram karuṇam samābhāṣya parasparam bhūyas cintā parāḥ sarve devāḥ ca iṃdra purogamāḥ

original: bhūmervivaramāśritya prāṇino ye vasaṃtyapi | rasātale ca daiteyāḥ saṃsthitāḥ pannagāśca ye || 27 ||
analyzed: bhūmeḥ vivaram āśritya prāṇinaḥ ye vasaṃti api rasātale ca daiteyāḥ saṃsthitāḥ pannagāḥ ca ye  /

original: na teṣāṃ vidyate sūryo nendurnānye mahāgrahāḥ | nāgnirdevamukhaṃ vidyunnaiva tārakako ṭayaḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: na teṣām vidyate sūryaḥ na induḥ na anye mahā grahāḥ na agniḥ deva mukham vidyut na eva tārakakaḥ ṭayaḥ

original: kenālokena paśyaṃti samāni viṣamāṇi ca | narakasthā narā loke na paśyaṃtyanyalokagāḥ || 29 ||
analyzed: kena ālokena paśyaṃti samāni viṣamāṇi ca naraka sthāḥ narāḥ loke na paśyaṃti anya loka gāḥ

original: vicarantaḥ samaṃ ko vā mano rathaśatapradaḥ | tṛṣṇāṃbhaḥ kṣudhitānnaṃ ca śrāṃtānāmatha vāhanam || 30 ||
analyzed: vicarantaḥ samam kaḥ vā manaḥ ratha śata pradaḥ tṛṣṇā aṃbhaḥ kṣudhita annam ca śrāṃtānām atha vāhanam

original: same śayyā jale nauśca roge satparicārakaḥ | śreṣṭhauṣadhībhiḥ sanmaṃtraiḥ saṃpado vyādhisaṃkaṭe || 31 ||
analyzed: same śayyā jale nauḥ ca roge sat paricārakaḥ śreṣṭha oṣadhībhiḥ sat maṃtraiḥ saṃpadaḥ vyādhi saṃkaṭe

original: suhṛdvideśe cchāyoṣṇe nirdhūmaḥ śiśire śikhī | mahābhaye paritrāṇaṃ prakāśaśca mahāniśi || 32 ||
analyzed: suhṛd videśe chāyā uṣṇe nirdhūmaḥ śiśire śikhī mahā bhaye paritrāṇam prakāśaḥ ca mahā niśi  /

original: sarvadaścaiva sarveṣāṃ manorathaśatapradaḥ | eka eva bhavāndyotastvāṃ ca jānīmahe vayam || 33 ||
analyzed: sarva daḥ ca eva sarveṣām manoratha śata pradaḥ ekaḥ eva bhavān dyotaḥ tvām ca jānīmahe vayam

original: bruvaṃta iti te vyāsa śuśruvurmadhurāṃ giram | śrutapūrvāṃ tamomadhyādviṣṇora tulakarmaṇaḥ || 34 ||
analyzed: bruvantaḥ iti te vyāsa śuśruvuḥ madhurām giram śruta pūrvām tamaḥ madhyāt viṣṇoḥ a tula karmaṇaḥ

original: na jānaṃti sthitaḥ kutra bhāṣate keśavo vibhuḥ | śṛṇudhvamiti me vākyaṃ sarve caiva samāhitāḥ || 35 ||
analyzed: na jānaṃti sthitaḥ kutra bhāṣate keśavaḥ vibhuḥ śṛṇudhvam iti me vākyam sarve ca eva samāhitāḥ

original: dānamekaṃ sadā samya kciṃtāmaṇisamaṃ smṛtam | sarveṣāmeva dānānāṃ dīpadānaṃ praśasyate || 36 ||
analyzed: dānam ekam sadā samyak ciṃtāmaṇi samam smṛtam sarveṣām eva dānānām dīpa dānam praśasyate

original: tacca deyamataḥ sarvaiḥ śṛṇudhvaṃ tattvato bhṛśam | mayā rasātale pūrvaṃ nāgā nāmanukaṃpayā || 37 ||
analyzed: tat ca deyam atas sarvaiḥ śṛṇudhvam tattvataḥ bhṛśam mayā rasātale pūrvam nāgāḥ nām anukaṃpayā  /

original: utpādito dīpavaro yena dhvastamidaṃ tamaḥ | evaṃbhūtastu vāyūnāmapradhṛṣyo mahāprabhaḥ || 38 ||
analyzed: utpāditaḥ dīpa varaḥ yena dhvastam idam tamaḥ evaṃbhūtaḥ tu vāyūnām apradhṛṣyaḥ mahā prabhaḥ

original: niṣkaṃpo nirmalo hṛdyaḥ susthiro bhāskaraprabhaḥ | nātyuṣṇo nātiśītaśca devyā yogasamudbhavaḥ | tena dīpaprakāśena gokarṇo nirvṛtiṃ yayau || 39 ||
analyzed: niṣkaṃpaḥ nirmalaḥ hṛdyaḥ susthiraḥ bhāskara prabhaḥ na ati uṣṇaḥ na ati śītaḥ ca devyāḥ yoga samudbhavaḥ tena dīpa prakāśena gokarṇaḥ nirvṛtim yayau  /

original: nāgāḥ śeṣādayaḥ sarve nodyamānāśca saṃghaśaḥ | dīpāddīpasahasrāṇi daduste vai śivāgrataḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: nāgāḥ śeṣa ādayaḥ sarve nodyamānāḥ ca saṃghaśas  dīpāt dīpa sahasrāṇi daduḥ te vai śiva agratas

analyzed: vasaṃti sukhinaḥ tatra svargāt aṣṭaguṇaiḥ sukhaiḥ  evam aṃdham tamaḥ devāḥ pātālāt dīpataḥ gatam   /

original: etadguhyaṃ mayā khyātaṃ bhavatāṃ cānukampayā | dīpadānamatoyūyaṃ kurudhvaṃ susamāhitāḥ || 50 ||

analyzed: papracchuḥ te punar sarve hṛṣṭāḥ dāmodaram vibhum brūhi nā ugnim jagannātha sa dīpaḥ yena jāyate

analyzed: ghore tamasi vai magnāḥ na agnim jānīmahe vayam  devānām mānasaḥ vahniḥ atha kṛṣṇena kīrtitaḥ  /

original: tena dīpaṃ pratijvālya devāḥ śivaparāyaṇāḥ | daduste śivamuddiśya sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradam || 54 ||

original: datte dīpe tato devairdṛṣṭo hṛṣṭo maheśvaraḥ | timiraṃ tadgataṃ cāpi jagadyena jaḍīkṛtam || 55 ||

original: dīpadānaphalaṃ jñātvā daiteyāścāpi vismitāḥ | tathaiva tatphalaṃ jñātvā vyāsa yakṣāśca vismitāḥ || 57 ||
analyzed: dīpa dāna phalam jñātvā daiteyāḥ ca api vismitāḥ tathā eva tad phalam jñātvā vyāsa yakṣāḥ ca vismitāḥ  /

original: pūjayitvā mahādevaṃ puṣpaiśca nirmalairjalaiḥ | dadurdīpa sahasrāṇi sarve śivaparāyaṇāḥ || 58 ||

original: nirāhārāstato vyāsa piśācā vai nirāśrayāḥ | dīpadānaphalaṃ jñātvā sarve te'tīva vismitāḥ || 60 ||

original: caṃḍālādagnimānīya dadurdīpaṃ śive ratāḥ || | dīpadānaphalaṃ te vai putradārasamanvitāḥ || 61 ||

analyzed: līḍham annam gata rasam pūti paryuṣitam tathā ucchiṣṭam sūtikā spṛṣṭam na medhyam ca atilaṃghitam  /

original: anaṃgalagnaṃ dhavalaṃ ca vastraṃ navaṃ suraktaṃ hyathavā suśuklam | vartyāṃ pradeyaṃ ca svake ca dadyātsnigdhe tvakhaṇḍe susame praśaste || 92 ||
analyzed: anaṃga lagnam dhavalam ca vastram navam su raktam hi athavā su śuklam vartyām pradeyam ca svake ca dadyāt snigdhe tu akhaṇḍe su same praśaste  /

original: tacchālipiṣṭopari saṃnidhāya yathā na niryāti na kaṃpate ca | sarvaṃ prakuryāttriguṇapramāṇaṃ madhyasthitastasya ca dīparājaḥ || 93 ||

original: daleṣu śobhārthamatīva kuryānmanorathapratyupalabdhaye ca | ghaṃṭāṣṭakaṃ laṃbitapuṣpadāma savastraśobhānvitamaṃtra kāryam || 94 ||
analyzed: daleṣu śobhā artham atīva kuryāt manoratha pratyupalabdhaye ca ghaṃṭā aṣṭakam laṃbita puṣpa dāma kāryam  /

original: saṃlipya bhūmiṃ tvatha gomayena punaḥ sugaṃdhena jalena liptvā | kuryādvicitraṃ tvatha maṃḍale ca dalāṣṭakaṃ vai kamalaṃ ca ramyam || 95 ||
analyzed: saṃlipya bhūmim tu atha gomayena punar sugaṃdhena jalena liptvā  kuryāt vicitram tu atha maṃḍale ca dala aṣṭakam vai kamalam ca ramyam  /

original: tato jalaṃ śītalamānayitvā āpūrya cāṣṭau kalaśāṃstu ramyān | nidhāya mūrdhni kramaśo hi dhīmānphalāni mūlāni tathekṣukāni || 96 ||

original: madhvājyayuktā dadhidugdhapūrṇā nairṛtyakoṇādatha dakṣiṇāṃtam | dharmāya dadyādatha śaṃkarāya dāmodarāyāpyatha vedhase ca || 97 ||
analyzed: madhu ājya yuktā dadhi dugdha pūrṇā nairṛtya koṇāt atha dakṣiṇa aṃtam dharmāya dadyāt atha śaṃkarāya dāmodarāya api atha vedhase ca  /

original: prajāpatibhyaḥ kramaśo hi bhaktyā pretebhya iṃdrāya tathā pitṛbhyaḥ | homādipātraṃ tilacūrṇameva dadyāddvijānāṃ ca sadakṣiṇaṃ ca || 98 ||

original: gāvo hiraṇyaṃ rajataṃ ca vastraṃ phalāni mūlāni yavāśca dhānyam | gṛhaṃ rathaṃ kuṃjaramaśvameva manojñamanyaṃ hṛdayapriyaṃ yat || 99 ||
analyzed: gāvaḥ hiraṇyam rajatam ca vastram phalāni mūlāni yavāḥ ca dhānyam gṛham ratham kuṃjaram aśvam eva manojñam anyam hṛdaya priyam yat  /

original: vidyādhikebhyo dvijasattamebhyaḥ paurāṇikebhyaśca tathā dvijebhyaḥ | ekaikasu prīṇanamatra kuryāddīpairdalasthaiśca yamādikānām || 100 ||
analyzed: vidyā adhikebhyaḥ dvijasattamebhyaḥ paurāṇikebhyaḥ ca tathā dvijebhyaḥ ekaikasu prīṇanam atra kuryāt dīpaiḥ dala sthaiḥ ca yama ādikānām

original: etatsamagraṃ vidhivacca kuryātsaśaktimādau svadhanaṃ samīkṣya | āhūya viprāñchubhabhāvayuktānvadecca dhīmānparayā ca bhaktyā || 2 ||

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | athānyatsaṃpravakṣyāmi kedāreśvaramuttamam | pravaraṃ sarvatīrthānāṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam || 1 ||

analyzed: mahātapanam ādau ca kṛtvā gacchet śivam prati mātṛkam pitṛkam ca eva kulānām tārayet śatam  /

analyzed: citrakūṭāt purā rāmaḥ maithilyā lakṣmaṇena ca samanvitaḥ samāgatya papraccha muni sattamam

analyzed: rāmaḥ uvāca kāni tīrthāni puṇyāni kim vā kṣetram mahā mune yatra gatvā na ca āpnoti viyogam saha bāṃdhavaiḥ

analyzed: sādhu pṛṣṭam tvayā vīra raghūṇām vaṃśa vardhana mama pitrā kṛtam kṣetram prayācya śivam ādarāta

original: udyaṃtamaṃbaratale surasiddhasaṃghāḥ sabrahmadaityamunikinnaranāgayakṣāḥ | tvāmarcayaṃti vibudhāḥ praṇataiḥ śirobhiścañcatkirīṭamaṇibhābhiranuttamābhiḥ || 60 ||
analyzed: udyaṃtam aṃbara tale sura siddha saṃghāḥ sa brahma daitya muni kinnara nāga yakṣāḥ tvām arcayanti vibudhāḥ praṇataiḥ śirobhiḥ cañcat kirīṭa maṇi bhābhiḥ anuttamābhiḥ   /

original: astaṃ gate tvayi jagadbhavati prasuptaṃ bhūyastvayi pratapati pratibodhameti | evaṃ sadā varada lokahitārthahetorekastvameva bhagavaṃstimirasya haṃtā || 61 ||
analyzed: astam gate tvayi jagat bhavati prasuptam bhūyas tvayi pratapati pratibodham eti  evam sadā vara da loka hita artha hetoḥ ekaḥ tvam eva bhagavan timirasya haṃtā  /

original: utsāhaśaktinayaśauryasamanvitānāṃ sevāprayogaracanāvidhitatparāṇām | kāryāṇi yanna phaladāni bhavaṃti puṃsāṃ hetustvabhaktiriha nātha veti nūnam || 6262 ||
analyzed: utsāha śakti naya śaurya samanvitānām sevā prayoga racanā vidhi tatparāṇām kāryāṇi yat na phala dāni bhavanti puṃsām hetuḥ tu abhaktiḥ iha nātha vā iti nūnam  /

original: yatsaṃyugeṣu rathakuñjarakuntaśaktinārācacakraśaratomarabhīmakhaḍgaiḥ | kṣipraṃ narāḥ samupayāṃti vijitya śatrūnsarvaṃ sadā praṇatavatsala veṣṭitaṃ te || 63 ||
analyzed: yat saṃyugeṣu ratha kuñjara kunta śakti nārāca cakra śara tomara bhīma khaḍgaiḥ kṣipram narāḥ samupayānti vijitya śatrūn sarvam sadā praṇata vatsala veṣṭitam te  /

original: kāṃtāradurgaviṣameṣvapi vartamānā ṛkṣebhasiṃhabahukaṇṭakataskareṣu | tṛṣṇānvitāśca bahuśokavimūḍhacittāstvatkīrtanāddhi gatamṛtyu bhayā bhavaṃti || 64 ||
analyzed: kāṃtāra durga viṣameṣu api vartamānāḥ ṛkṣa ibha siṃha bahu kaṇṭaka taskareṣu tṛṣṇā anvitāḥ ca bahu śoka vimūḍha cittāḥ tvad kīrtanāt hi gata mṛtyu bhayāḥ bhavanti  /

original: tejorāśistvamiha śaraṇaṃ sarvatoduḥkhitānāṃ | tvattulyo'nyo jagati sakale nāsti kaściddayāluḥ | tvayyekasminbhavati sakalā bhaktiranviṣyamāṇā | tvāmāsādya prabhavati kuto vyādhiduḥkhaṃ narāṇām || 65 ||
analyzed: tejaḥ rāśiḥ tvam iha śaraṇam sarvatas duḥkhitānām  tvad tulyaḥ anyaḥ jagati sakale na asti kaścid dayāluḥ tvayi ekasmin bhavati sakalā bhaktiḥ anviṣyamāṇā tvām āsādya prabhavati kutas vyādhi duḥkham narāṇām

original: kaḥ kuṣṭhābhihataḥ kva cāribhiratho ko vyādhibhiḥ pīḍitaḥ | ke paṃgvaṃdhajaḍāḥ kva śīrṇacaraṇaḥ ko vā vipannakriyaḥ | ityevaṃ prasamīkṣya deva kṛpayā doṣātparitrāyase | kasyānyasya paropakāraniratā ceṣṭā yathaiṣā tava || 66 ||
analyzed: kaḥ kuṣṭha abhihataḥ kva ca aribhiḥ atho kaḥ vyādhibhiḥ pīḍitaḥ ke paṃgu aṃdha jaḍāḥ kva śīrṇa caraṇaḥ kaḥ vā vipanna kriyaḥ iti evam prasamīkṣya deva kṛpayā doṣāt paritrāyase  kasya anyasya para upakāra niratā ceṣṭā yathā eṣā tava  /

original: dharmaḥ paratra kila tiṣṭhati sevito'sau | kālāṃtareṇa vibudhā varadā bhavaṃti | tvaṃ sevitaḥ praṇatavatsala bhūtikāmaiḥ | sadyaḥ prayacchasi phalaṃ yadabhīpsitaṃ taiḥ || 67 ||
analyzed: dharmaḥ paratra kila tiṣṭhati sevitaḥ asau kāla aṃtareṇa vibudhāḥ vara dāḥ bhavanti tvam sevitaḥ praṇata vatsala bhūti kāmaiḥ sadyas prayacchasi phalam yat abhīpsitam taiḥ  /

original: vibhrāṃtakāṃtahariṇīsadṛśekṣaṇābhiḥ | kāṃtoruhāramaṇikuṇḍalamekhalābhiḥ | teṣāṃ bhavaṃti bhavanāni vilāsinībhiryeṣāṃ nṛṇāṃ tvamasi vai varadaḥ prasannaḥ || 68 ||
analyzed: vibhrāṃta kāṃta hariṇī sadṛśa īkṣaṇābhiḥ kānta uru hāra maṇi kuṇḍala mekhalābhiḥ teṣām bhavanti bhavanāni vilāsinībhiḥ yeṣām nṛṇām tvam asi vai vara daḥ prasannaḥ  /

original: yaistvaṃ naraiḥ sakṛdapi praṇataḥ kathaṃciddhyāto'thavā bhuvananātha tathāṃtakāle | niṣkalmaṣā jagati duṣkṛtino bhavaṃti te nirmalāḥ sukṛtino gatimāpnuvaṃti || 69 ||
analyzed: yaiḥ tvam naraiḥ sakṛt api praṇataḥ kathaṃcid dhyātaḥ athavā bhuvananātha tathā aṃtakāle niṣkalmaṣāḥ jagati duṣkṛtinaḥ bhavanti te nirmalāḥ sukṛtinaḥ gatim āpnuvaṃti  /

original: ye tvāṃ kutarkamatibhirna namaṃti bhaktyā romāṃcakaṃcukaśatākulitaiḥ śarīraiḥ | te nirdhanāḥ paragṛheṣvavabhūtamannaṃ kṣutkṣāmakaṇṭhavadanāḥ paritarkayaṃti || 70 ||
analyzed: ye tvām ku tarka matibhiḥ na namaṃti bhaktyā romāṃca kaṃcuka śata ākulitaiḥ śarīraiḥ te nirdhanāḥ para gṛheṣu avabhūtam annam kṣudh kṣāma kaṇṭha vadanāḥ paritarkayaṃti  /

original: udadhijalataraṃgakṣobhalolākṣiyugmaiḥ saphaṇimaṇimayūkhodbhāsitairlelihadbhiḥ | praṇipatitaśirobhirnāgamukhyairajasraṃ śrutibhiranupamābhiḥ stūyase puṣkalābhiḥ || 71 ||
analyzed: udadhi jala taraṃga kṣobha lola akṣi yugmaiḥ sa phaṇi maṇi mayūkha udbhāsitaiḥ lelihadbhiḥ praṇipatita śirobhiḥ nāga mukhyaiḥ ajasram śrutibhiḥ anupamābhiḥ stūyase puṣkalābhiḥ  /

original: tava suravara gacchato'nusaraṃti tridaśanadīkamalodga tāni vātaiḥ | kanakakamalareṇupiṃjaritāni bhramarakulāni pataṃga cāmarāṇi || 72 ||
analyzed: tava suravara gacchataḥ anusaraṃti tridaśa nadī kamala udga tāni vātaiḥ kanaka kamala reṇu piṃjaritāni bhramara kulāni pataṃga cāmarāṇi  /

original: tattvadhyānaṃ jalanidhinivahe sthitvā sthitvā caraṇanivahaiḥ | ājīvārthaṃ pratapasi bhagavankaste tulyastribhuvanasamaye || 73 ||
analyzed: tattva dhyānam jalanidhi nivahe sthitvā sthitvā caraṇa nivahaiḥ ājīva artham pratapasi bhagavan kaḥ te tulyaḥ tribhuvana samaye  /

original: udayādrinitaṃbasaṃsthitasya hyudayeṣvastamayeṣu cāvṛtasya | kiraṇāstapanīyasaprabhāste vilasantastaḍito viḍaṃbayaṃti || 74 ||
analyzed: udaya adri nitaṃba saṃsthitasya hi udayeṣu astamayeṣu ca āvṛtasya kiraṇāḥ tapanīya saprabhāḥ te vilasantaḥ taḍitaḥ viḍaṃbayaṃti  /

original: yathāyathā vrajati rathastavāṃbare vipāṭayandhanatimiraughasaṃcayān | tathātathā kṣubhitamahānilāsṛtaṃ pratīyate muhuriva dundubhiryathā || 75 ||
analyzed: yathā yathā vrajati rathaḥ tava aṃbare vipāṭayan dhana timira ogha saṃcayān tathā tathā kṣubhita mahā anila asṛtam pratīyate muhur iva dundubhiḥ yathā  /

original: cārupadmavinimīlitekṣaṇāṃ cakravākakalahaṃsamekhalām | kāminīmiva ratiśramālasāṃ tāṃ vibodhayasi padminīṃ karaiḥ || 76 ||
analyzed: cāru padma vinimīlita īkṣaṇām cakravāka kalahaṃsa mekhalām kāminīm iva rati śrama alasām tām vibodhayasi padminīm karaiḥ  /

original: nīlalolamatikāntamutpalaṃ bhṛṃgatuṃgacaraṇākulīkṛtam | tvatprabhābhiranurāgaraṃjitaṃ padmarāgamiva śobhate bhṛśam || 77 ||
analyzed: nīla lolam ati kāntam utpalam bhṛṃga tuṃga caraṇa ākulīkṛtam tvad prabhābhiḥ anurāga raṃjitam padmarāgam iva śobhate bhṛśam  /

original: sphuracchaśāṃkahāranirmalaṃ khaga tvadaṃkeṣvacaṃcalam | vibhātyatīva kāṃtamaṃbaraṃ samaṃ bṛhaccaika pāṭalam || 78 ||
analyzed: sphurat śaśāṃka hāra nirmalam khaga tvad aṃkeṣu acaṃcalam vibhāti atīva kāntam aṃbaram samam pāṭalam

original: hariti ca tāvanmuhirniṣevitatamasyaśubhaṃ bhavati ca yāvadaiva kiraṇaistava pūjitataram | ṛṣibhirmunibhirudāradhībhiḥ śāśva tamārgaparairvarada na śakyate tava guṇastutirāśrayitum || 79 ||
analyzed: hariti ca tāvat muhiḥ niṣevita tamasi aśubham bhavati ca yāvat ā eva kiraṇaiḥ tava pūjitataram ṛṣibhiḥ munibhiḥ udāra dhībhiḥ śāśva ta mārga paraiḥ vara da na śakyate tava guṇa stutiḥ āśrayitum  /

original: tvaṃ viṣṇustvaṃ śaśāṃkastvamasuramathanaḥ śaṇmukhastvaṃ dhaneśastvaṃ kālastvaṃ ca dhātā kṣitidharamalayāpāśrayastvaṃ hutāśaḥ | oṃkārastvaṃ dvijānāṃ tvamiha jalanidhitvaṃ śarastvaṃ ca rudrastvaṃ mukhyastvaṃ payodo vratayamaniyamāstvaṃ jagatsarvameva || 80 ||
analyzed: tvam viṣṇuḥ tvam śaśāṃkaḥ tvam asura mathanaḥ śaṇmukhaḥ tvam dhaneśaḥ tvam kālaḥ tvam ca dhātā kṣitidhara malaya apāśrayaḥ tvam hutāśaḥ oṃkāraḥ tvam dvijānām tvam iha jalanidhi tvam śaraḥ tvam ca rudraḥ tvam mukhyaḥ tvam payodaḥ vrata yama niyamāḥ tvam jagat sarvam eva  /

original: tvamaniṃdya gopate tripuramathana manmathadāhakarastvamasurabhīmadarpahā pāhi mām | tridaśādhipakamalavarānanastvamiha devagururbhagavāṃ stribhuvanamaṇḍale'sti katamastava tulyaguṇaḥ || 81 ||
analyzed: tvam aniṃdya gopate tripura mathana manmatha dāha karaḥ tvam asura bhīma darpa hā pāhi mām tridaśādhipa kamala vara ānanaḥ tvam iha devaguruḥ bhagavān tribhuvana maṇḍale asti katamaḥ tava tulya guṇaḥ  /

original: āditya bhāskara divākara saptasapte mārtaṃḍa sūrya haridaśvapate ca bhāno | aśrāṃtavāhana kharūpa gabhastimāliṃstvāṃ lokanātha śaraṇaṃ pratipadyate'sau || 82 ||
analyzed: āditya bhāskara divākara sapta sapte mārtaṃḍa sūrya harit aśva pate ca bhāno aśrāṃta vāhana kha rūpa gabhastim ālin tvām lokanātha śaraṇam pratipadyate asau  /

original: prāgdigvadhūtilakabhāsurakarṇapūra maṃdākinīdayitanātha jagatpradīpa | hemādritāpana nabhastalahāriratna sandhyāṃganāvadanarāga namonamaste || 83 ||
analyzed: prāc diś vadhū tilaka bhāsura karṇapūra maṃdākinī dayita nātha jagat pradīpa hemādri tāpana nabhas tala hāri ratna sandhyā aṃganā vadana rāga namaḥ namaḥ te  /

original: brahmaiva satya śubhamaṃgala lokanātha vyomāṃgaṇeśa munisaṃstuta viśvamūrte | ārtasya śokahara kiṃkarapālakaśca tvaṃ me prasīda bhagavañcharaṇāgatasya || 84 ||
analyzed: brahmā eva satya śubha maṃgala lokanātha vyoma aṃgaṇa īśa muni saṃstuta viśvamūrte ārtasya śoka hara kiṃkara pālakaḥ ca tvam me prasīda bhagavan śaraṇa āgatasya  /

original: kṛtvāṃjaliṃ śirasi paṃkajakuḍmalābhaṃ yatsaṃstutastvamiha deva mayādya bhaktyā | tena prabho bhava mamopari saumyamūrtirdharme matiṃ kuru sadā śriyamūrjitāṃ ca || 85 ||
analyzed: kṛtvā aṃjalim śirasi paṃkaja kuḍmala ābham yat saṃstutaḥ tvam iha deva mayā adya bhaktyā tena prabho bhava mama upari saumya mūrtiḥ dharme matim kuru sadā śriyam ūrjitām ca  /

original: namaḥ savitre jagadekacakṣuṣe jagatprasūtisthitināśahe tave | trayīmayāya triguṇātmadhāraṇe viraṃcinārāyaṇaśaṃkarātmane || 86 ||
analyzed: namaḥ savitre jagadekacakṣuṣe jagat prasūti sthiti nāśa he tave trayī mayāya triguṇa ātma dhāraṇe viraṃci nārāyaṇa śaṃkara ātmane

original: sūrya uvāca | tuṣṭohamadhunā pārtha stotreṇānena suvrata | varaṃ dāsyāmi yatnena yatte manasi vartate || 87 ||
analyzed: sūryaḥ uvāca tuṣṭaḥ ham adhunā pārtha stotreṇa anena suvrata varam dāsyāmi yatnena yat te manasi vartate  /

original: arjuna uvāca | eṣa eva varo mahyaṃ varāṇāmuttamottamaḥ | atra saṃnihito deva sarvakālaṃ bhava prabho || 89 ||
analyzed: arjunaḥ uvāca eṣaḥ eva varaḥ mahyam varāṇām uttama uttamaḥ atra saṃnihitaḥ deva sarvakālam bhava prabho

original: ye ca tvāṃ mānavā bhaktyā sto ṣyaṃti praṇatāḥ sadā | teṣāṃ dhanaṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca putradārādikaṃ vasu || 90 ||
analyzed: ye ca tvām mānavāḥ bhaktyā stoṣyanti praṇatāḥ sadā teṣām dhanam ca dhānyam ca putra dāra ādikam vasu  /

original: manasaścepsitaṃ sarva dātavyaṃ hi varo mama | sanatkumāra uvāca | ādityo 'smai varaṃ dattvā hyuvāca vacanaṃ śubham || 91 ||
analyzed: manasaḥ ca īpsitam sarva dātavyam hi varaḥ mama  sanatkumāraḥ uvāca ādityaḥ asmai varam dattvā hi uvāca vacanam śubham

original: yastvatkṛtena stotreṇa māṃ stoṣyati narottamaḥ | śriyā na vicyutistasya bhavedeṣa varo mama || 92 ||
analyzed: yaḥ tvad kṛtena stotreṇa mām stoṣyati nara uttamaḥ śriyāḥ na vicyutiḥ tasya bhavet eṣa varaḥ mama

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | nārāyaṇo'pi saṃsthāpya śaṃkhaṃ dadhmau prayatnataḥ | tuṣṭāva prayato bhūtvā stotreṇā nena bhāskaram || 1 ||

original: śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca | ādityaṃ bhāskaraṃ bhānuṃ raviṃ sūryaṃ divākaram | divākaraṃ divānāthaṃ tapanaṃ tapatāṃ varam || 2 ||
analyzed: śrī kṛṣṇaḥ uvāca ādityam bhāskaram bhānum ravim sūryam divākaram divākaram divānātham tapanam tapatām varam  /

original: vareṇyaṃ varadaṃ viṣṇumanaghaṃ vāsavānujam | balavīryaṃ sahasrāṃśuṃ sahasrakiraṇadyutim || 3 ||
analyzed: vareṇyam vara dam viṣṇum anagham vāsava anujam bala vīryam sahasrāṃśum sahasrakiraṇa dyutim  /

original: mayūkhamālinaṃ viśvaṃ mārtaṃḍaṃ caṃḍarociṣam | sadātītaṃ subhāsvaṃtaṃ saptasaptiṃ sukhodayam || 4 ||
analyzed: mayūkhamālinam viśvam mārtaṃḍam caṃḍa rociṣam sadā atītam su bhāsvaṃtam saptasaptim sukha udayam

original: devadevamahirbudhnyaṃ dhāmnāṃ nidhimanuttamam | tapobrahmamayālokaṃ lokapālamapāṃpatim || 5 ||
analyzed: devadevam ahirbudhnyam dhāmnām nidhim anuttamam tapaḥ brahma maya ālokam lokapālam apāṃpatim

original: jagatprabodhajanakaṃ jagadbījaṃ jagatprabhum | arkaṃ niḥśreyasaparaṃ kāraṇaṃ śreyasāṃ param || 6 ||
analyzed: jagat prabodha janakam jagadbījam jagatprabhum  arkam niḥśreyasa param kāraṇam śreyasām param

original: inaṃ prabhāviṇaṃ puṇyaṃ pataṃgaṃ pavageśvaram | dātāraṃ vāṃchitārthānāṃ dṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalapradam || 7 ||
analyzed: inam prabhāviṇam puṇyam pataṃgam pavaga īśvaram dātāram vāṃchita arthānām dṛṣṭa adṛṣṭa phala pradam  /

original: gṛhaṃ gṛhakaraṃ haṃsaṃ haridaśvaṃ hutāśanam | maṃgalyaṃ maṃgalaṃ geyaṃ dhruvaṃ dharmaprabodhanam || 8 ||
analyzed: gṛham gṛhakaram haṃsam haridaśvam hutāśanam maṃgalyam maṃgalam geyam dhruvam dharma prabodhanam

original: bhavasaṃbhāvita bhāvaṃ bhūtabhavyabhavātmakam | durgamaṃ durgatiharaṃ haranetraṃ trayīmayam || 9 ||
analyzed: bhava saṃbhāvita bhāvam bhūta bhavya bhava ātmakam durgamam durgati haram hara netram trayī mayam

original: trailokyatilakaṃ tīrthaṃ taraṇiṃ sarvatomukham | tejorāśisunirvāṇaṃ viśveśaṃ dhāma sāṃpratam || 10 ||
analyzed: trailokya tilakam tīrtham taraṇim sarvatomukham tejaḥ rāśi su nirvāṇam viśveśam dhāma sāṃpratam

original: kalpaṃ kalpānalaṃ kālaṃ kālacakraṃ kratupriyam | bhūṣaṇaṃ marutaṃ sūryaṃ maṇiratnaṃ sulocanam || 11 ||
analyzed: kalpam kalpānalam kālam kālacakram kratupriyam bhūṣaṇam marutam sūryam maṇiratnam sulocanam

original: tvaṣṭāraṃ viṣṭaraṃ viśvaṃ sadasatkarmasākṣikam | savitāraṃ sahasrākṣaṃ prajāpālamadhokṣajam || 12 ||
analyzed: tvaṣṭāram viṣṭaram viśvam sat asat karma sākṣikam  savitāram sahasrākṣam prajāpālam adhokṣajam

original: brahmāṇaṃ vāsarāraṃbhe raktavarṇaṃ mahādyutim | śuklaṃ madhyaṃdine rudraṃ śyāmaṃ viṣṇuṃ dinakṣaye || 13 ||
analyzed: brahmāṇam vāsara āraṃbhe rakta varṇam mahā dyutim śuklam madhyaṃdine rudram śyāmam viṣṇum dinakṣaye

original: nāmnāmaṣṭaśataṃ divyaṃ viṣṇunā samudāhṛtam | ya idaṃ prayato bhūtvā paṭhedbhaktyā samāhitaḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: nāmnām aṣṭaśatam divyam viṣṇunā samudāhṛtam  yaḥ idam prayataḥ bhūtvā paṭhet bhaktyā samāhitaḥ

original: na tasya vipadaḥ kvāpi sarvatrāpi śubhā gatiḥ | dhanadhānyasukhāvāptiḥ putralābhaśca jāyate || 15 ||

analyzed: bhūta preta piśāca ādyaiḥ na asau kena api bādhyate  dvādaśīm samupoṣya eva snātvā devam janārdanam

original: yaḥ paśyecchaṃkhinaṃ devaṃ so'cyutaṃ sthānamāpnuyāt || 81 ||
analyzed: yaḥ paśyet śaṃkhinam devam saḥ acyutam sthānam āpnuyāt

original: yaḥ sthūlasūkṣmaprakaṭaprakāśo yaḥ sarvabhūto na ca sarvabhūtaḥ | viśva yataścaiva hi viśvaheturnamostu tasmai puruṣottamāya || 82 ||
analyzed: yaḥ sthūla sūkṣma prakaṭa prakāśaḥ yaḥ sarva bhūtaḥ na ca sarva bhūtaḥ yatas ca eva hi viśva hetuḥ namaḥ astu tasmai puruṣottamāya

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | bhinneṃ'dhake triśūlena dhvanī rudrasya nirgataḥ | tatroṃkāraḥ samutpanno devadevo maheśvaraḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca bhinna iṃ'dhake triśūlena dhvaniḥ rudrasya nirgataḥ tatra oṃkāraḥ samutpannaḥ devadevaḥ maheśvaraḥ

original: tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā samādhiniyamena ca | dṛṣṭvoṃkāraṃ mahādevaṃ mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: tatra snātvā śuciḥ bhūtvā samādhi niyamena ca  dṛṣṭvā oṃkāram mahādevam mucyate sarva pātakaiḥ  /

original: hatvāṃdhake triśūlaśca bhogavatyā jale yayau | dṛṣṭvā śūlaṃ sutejaskaṃ hāṭako vismayaṃ gataḥ | papraccha kena kāryeṇa bhavāniha samāgataḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: hatvā aṃdhake triśūlaḥ ca bhogavatyāḥ jale yayau  dṛṣṭvā śūlam su tejaskam hāṭakaḥ vismayam gataḥ papraccha kena kāryeṇa bhavān iha samāgataḥ   /

original: kathayāmāsa śūlosau śaṃkareṇāhamīritaḥ | aṃdhakasya vadhārthāya pāpavṛtteḥ sudu rmateḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: kathayāmāsa śūlā usau śaṃkareṇa aham īritaḥ aṃdhakasya vadha arthāya pāpa vṛtteḥ su du rmateḥ

original: bhittvā tamahamāyāto bhogavatyā jale śubhe | gamiṣyāmi punastatra yatra tiṣṭhati śaṃkaraḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: bhittvā tam aham āyātaḥ bhogavatyāḥ jale śubhe gamiṣyāmi punar tatra yatra tiṣṭhati śaṃkaraḥ

original: śūloktaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā parameśadidṛkṣayā | hāṭakaḥ śūlamārgeṇa nirjagāma javena saḥ | bahuvaktrasamākīrṇaṃ suprabhaṃ sumanoramam || 6 ||
analyzed: śūla uktam vacanam śrutvā parameśa didṛkṣayā hāṭakaḥ śūla mārgeṇa nirjagāma javena saḥ bahu vaktra samākīrṇam su prabham su manoramam

original: taṃ dṛṣṭvā tridaśāḥ sarve śūleśaṃ hāṭakeśvaram || | praṇamya hṛṣṭaromāṇo yathā protphullapaṃkajam || 7 ||
analyzed: tam dṛṣṭvā tridaśāḥ sarve śūla īśam hāṭakeśvaram   praṇamya hṛṣṭa romāṇaḥ yathā protphulla paṃkajam

original: tuṣṭuvurvividhaiḥ stotrairbrahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ | hāṭakeśvaranāmāsītpātāle yo vyavasthitaḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: tuṣṭuvuḥ vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ brahma viṣṇu purogamāḥ hāṭakeśvara nāmā āsīt pātāle yaḥ vyavasthitaḥ

original: nirgataḥ śūlamārgeṇa tena śūleśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ | dhūtapāpaṃ ca yattīrthaṃ devadevasya cottare || 9 ||
analyzed: nirgataḥ śūla mārgeṇa tena śūleśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ dhūta pāpam ca yat tīrtham devadevasya ca uttare

original: tatra pāpaḥ sa daityeṃdro dhūtaḥ śūlena vīryavān | tena tīrthamidaṃ vyāsa dhūtapāpaṃ nigadyate || 10 ||
analyzed: tatra pāpaḥ sa daitya iṃdraḥ dhūtaḥ śūlena vīryavān  tena tīrtham idam vyāsa dhūta pāpam nigadyate

original: aṣṭamyāṃ vā paurṇamāsyāṃ caturdaśyāṃ śanau tathā | upoṣya rajanīmekāṃ śivabhakto jiteṃdriyaḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: aṣṭamyām vā paurṇamāsyām caturdaśyām śanau tathā upoṣya rajanīm ekām śiva bhaktaḥ jita iṃdriyaḥ   /

original: dhūtapāpaṃ tu yaḥ paśyeddevadevaṃ maheśvaram | vimuktaḥ sarvapāpaiḥ sa saptajanmakṛtairapi || 12 ||
analyzed: dhūta pāpam tu yaḥ paśyet devadevam maheśvaram vimuktaḥ sarva pāpaiḥ sa sapta janma kṛtaiḥ api  /

original: kulānāṃ śatamuddhṛtya śivalokaṃ ca gacchati | kṛtābhiṣekaṃ yaḥ paśyetpauṣe māsi sa vai naraḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: kulānām śatam uddhṛtya śiva lokam ca gacchati kṛta abhiṣekam yaḥ paśyet pauṣe māsi sa vai naraḥ  /

original: śūleśvaraprabhāvena mucyate brahmahatyayā | vimānānāṃ sahasreṇa mṛto yāti paraṃ padam || 14 ||
analyzed: śūleśvara prabhāvena mucyate brahmahatyayā vimānānām sahasreṇa mṛtaḥ yāti param padam

original: iti cāṃdhakaśūloyaṃ yāvadbhogavatīṃ gataḥ | tāvatsamutthitā ghorā asurā rudhirodbhavāḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: iti ca aṃdhaka śūlaḥ yam yāvat bhogavatīm gataḥ tāvat samutthitāḥ ghorāḥ asurāḥ rudhira udbhavāḥ  /

original: khaḍgahastā mahāvīryā anekaśatasaṃkhyayā | caturdikṣu sthitairghorairhanya māno maheśvaraḥ | siṃhanādaṃ mumocātha pīḍitastairdurātmabhiḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: khaḍga hastāḥ mahā vīryāḥ aneka śata saṃkhyayā catur dikṣu sthitaiḥ ghoraiḥ hanya mānaḥ maheśvaraḥ siṃha nādam mumoca atha pīḍitaḥ taiḥ durātmabhiḥ  /

original: siṃhanādena te pāpā mūrchitāḥ patitā bhuvi | punaḥ samutthitā jagmurdevadevaṃ maheśvaram | vitrastāśca tato devā brahmaviṣṇupurogamāḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: siṃhanādena te pāpāḥ mūrchitāḥ patitāḥ bhuvi  punar samutthitāḥ jagmuḥ devadevam maheśvaram vitrastāḥ ca tatas devāḥ brahma viṣṇu purogamāḥ

original: asādhyāṃstāṃstathā matvā maṃtraṃ kṛtvā hitaiṣiṇaḥ | tato devā vicāryātha strīṃ sṛjāma iti svayam || 18 ||
analyzed: asādhyān tān tathā matvā maṃtram kṛtvā hita eṣiṇaḥ tatas devāḥ vicārya atha strīm sṛjāmaḥ iti svayam

original: ityuktvotpādayāmāsa brahmā haṃsāsanāṃ śubhām | caturvaktrāṃ caturhastāṃ brahmāṇīṃ rūpadhāriṇīm || 19 ||
analyzed: iti uktvā utpādayāmāsa brahmā haṃsa āsanām śubhām catur vaktrām catur hastām brahmāṇīm rūpa dhāriṇīm

original: kumāraścaiva kaumārīṃ mayūravaravāhanām | raktamālyābaradharāṃ śaktikukkuṭadhāriṇīm || 20 ||
analyzed: kumāraḥ ca eva kaumārīm mayūra vara vāhanām rakta mālya abara dharām śakti kukkuṭa dhāriṇīm  /

original: punaḥ kumāraḥ kaumārīṃ pakṣīṃdravaravāhanām | kṛṣṇāṃ karāladaśanāṃ dharmarājasya vāhanīm || 21 ||
analyzed: punar kumāraḥ kaumārīm pakṣi iṃdra vara vāhanām kṛṣṇām karāla daśanām dharmarājasya vāhanīm   /

original: daityadehapramathanīṃ daṃḍamudgaradhāriṇīm | lalāṭalocanāṃ nīlāṃ kapālakarabhūṣitām || 22 ||
analyzed: daitya deha pramathanīm daṃḍa mudgara dhāriṇīm  lalāṭa locanām nīlām kapāla kara bhūṣitām

original: siṃhājinadharāṃ kṛṣṇāṃ sarvabhūṣaṇabhūṣitām | kartrīhastāṃ khaḍgahastāṃ kheṭakhaṭvāṃgadhāriṇīm | carmāsthikeśavapuṣaṃ cāmuṃḍāmamṛjatprabhuḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: siṃha ajina dharām kṛṣṇām sarva bhūṣaṇa bhūṣitām kartrī hastām khaḍga hastām kheṭa khaṭvāṃga dhāriṇīm carma asthi keśa vapuṣam cāmuṃḍām amṛjat prabhuḥ

original: vaṭasya nikaṭe pūrvaṃ nirmitā lokamātaraḥ | tato loke suvikhyātāḥ pratyakṣā vaṭamātaraḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: vaṭasya nikaṭe pūrvam nirmitāḥ loka mātaraḥ tatas loke su vikhyātāḥ pratyakṣāḥ vaṭa mātaraḥ  /

original: tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā mātṝḥ paśyati yo naraḥ | sa muktaḥ sarvapāpebhyo mātṛloke mahīyate || 25 ||
analyzed: tatra snātvā śuciḥ bhūtvā mātṝḥ paśyati yaḥ naraḥ sa muktaḥ sarva pāpebhyaḥ mātṛ loke mahīyate

original: siṃhanādo'pi devena kṛto yatra mahāmune | tatra siṃheśvaro devaḥ sarvaduṣkṛtanāśanaḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: siṃhanādaḥ api devena kṛtaḥ yatra mahā mune tatra siṃheśvaraḥ devaḥ sarva duṣkṛta nāśanaḥ

original: darśanāttasya devasya siṃhavatsa balī bhavet | siṃhanāde kṛte yatra jātaṃ kaṇṭakitaṃ vapuḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: darśanāt tasya devasya siṃha vat sa balī bhavet siṃha nāde kṛte yatra jātam kaṇṭakitam vapuḥ  /

original: tatra kaṇṭeśvaro devo bhaktānāṃ sarvadaḥ sadā | tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā kaṇṭeśvaraṃ śivam || 28 ||
analyzed: tatra kaṇṭeśvaraḥ devaḥ bhaktānām sarva daḥ sadā tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā kaṇṭeśvaram śivam

original: grahabhūtapiśācebhyo na bhayaṃ prāpnuyātkvacit | tatastā mātaraḥ sarvā ādiṣṭāstu hareṇa vai || 29 ||
analyzed: graha bhūta piśācebhyaḥ na bhayam prāpnuyāt kvacid tatas tāḥ mātaraḥ sarvāḥ ādiṣṭāḥ tu hareṇa vai

original: andhāsurasya raudrasya pibadhvaṃ rudhiraṃ drutam | etasminnantare vyāsa prajvalajjvalanopamaḥ || 30 ||
analyzed: andha asurasya raudrasya pibadhvam rudhiram drutam etasmin antare vyāsa prajvalat jvalana upamaḥ

original: abhayaṃ śakra mā bhaistvaṃ yatrovāceti śaṃkaraḥ | tatra liṃgaṃ samudbhūtamabhayeśvaramuttamam || 31 ||
analyzed: abhayam śakra mā bhaiḥ tvam yatra uvāca iti śaṃkaraḥ tatra liṃgam samudbhūtam abhayeśvaram uttamam

original: vaṃditaṃ devagaṃdharvaiḥ siddhavidyādharoragaiḥ | tatra snātvā śucirbhūtvā sopavāso jitendriyaḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: vaṃditam deva gaṃdharvaiḥ siddha vidyādhara uragaiḥ tatra snātvā śuciḥ bhūtvā sa upavāsaḥ jita indriyaḥ

original: arcaye ddevadeveśamaśvamedhaphalaṃ labhet | bhūtapretapiśācebhyo bhayaṃ tasya na vidyate || 33 ||
analyzed: arcaye ddevadeveśam aśvamedha phalam labhet bhūta preta piśācebhyaḥ bhayam tasya na vidyate

original: siṃhayuktena yānena śivalokaṃ sa gacchati | andhakasya tu yā māyā raktāsurasamudbhavā || 34 ||
analyzed: siṃha yuktena yānena śiva lokam sa gacchati andhakasya tu yā māyā rakta asura samudbhavā

original: mātṛbhiryudhyamānābhiḥ kṣayamāśu jagāma sā | devyaḥ pibantyo raktaughaṃ daiteyatanutaścyutam || 35 ||
analyzed: mātṛbhiḥ yudhyamānābhiḥ kṣayam āśu jagāma sā devyaḥ pibantyaḥ rakta ogham daiteya tanutaḥ cyutam  /

original: ṣaṭtṛptiṃ paramā jagmurna tu tṛptā lalāṭajā | hatamāyaḥ śiṣṭakastu bhinnaśūlatanucchadaḥ || 36 ||
analyzed: ṣaṣ tṛptim paramāḥ jagmuḥ na tu tṛptāḥ lalāṭa jāḥ hata māyaḥ śiṣṭakaḥ tu bhinna śūla tanucchadaḥ

original: uttarābhimukhaṃ śūlamaṃdhako'karṣayadbalī | saṃniruddho mahādeho vārito gaṇapena saḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: uttara abhimukham śūlam aṃdhakaḥ akarṣayat balī saṃniruddhaḥ mahā dehaḥ vāritaḥ gaṇapena saḥ  /

original: mahāvināyakaḥ khyātastasmālloke'bhavanmune | darśanāttasya devasya na vighnaiḥ pīḍyate naraḥ || 38 ||
analyzed: mahāvināyakaḥ khyātaḥ tasmāt loke abhavat mune darśanāt tasya devasya na vighnaiḥ pīḍyate naraḥ  /

original: māsemāse caturthyāṃ yo gaṇeśaṃ pūjayeddvija | na tasya vighnaṃ jāyeta iha loke paratra ca || 39 ||
analyzed: māse māse caturthyām yaḥ gaṇeśam pūjayet dvija  na tasya vighnam jāyeta iha loke paratra ca  /

original: svedabiṃduratho tasya lalāṭādapatadbhuvi | tasmādaṃgārako jāto raktamālyānulepanaḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: sveda biṃduḥ atho tasya lalāṭāt apatat bhuvi tasmāt aṃgārakaḥ jātaḥ rakta mālya anulepanaḥ

original: āvantye viṣaye jāto lohitāṃgo dharāsutaḥ | aṃgārakastu raktākṣo mahādevasutastathā || 41 ||
analyzed: āvantye viṣaye jātaḥ lohitāṃgaḥ dharā sutaḥ aṃgārakaḥ tu raktākṣaḥ mahādeva sutaḥ tathā

original: nāmabhirbrahmaṇā stutvā grahamadhye'dhiropitaḥ | tatra tīrthamathotpannamaṃgāreśvaramuttamam || 42 ||
analyzed: nāmabhiḥ brahmaṇā stutvā graha madhye adhiropitaḥ tatra tīrtham atha utpannam aṃgāreśvaram uttamam

original: brahmaṇā sthāpitaṃ liṃgaṃ gaṇagaṃdharvasevitam | śucistatra ca yaḥ snāti naro hyaṃgāravāsare || 43 ||
analyzed: brahmaṇā sthāpitam liṃgam gaṇa gaṃdharva sevitam  śuciḥ tatra ca yaḥ snāti naraḥ hi aṃgāra vāsare

original: dṛṣṭvāṃgāreśvaraṃ sotha mucyate sarvapātakaiḥ | caturthyāṃ maṃgaladine nakte cārghyaṃ nivedayet || 44 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā aṃgāreśvaram saḥ utha mucyate sarva pātakaiḥ caturthyām maṃgala dine nakte ca arghyam nivedayet  /

original: yāvatpūrṇāścatasraḥ syustāvatkāryāḥ prayatnataḥ | pañca vai karakāḥ kāryāstāmrapātreṇa saṃyutāḥ || 45 ||
analyzed: yāvat pūrṇāḥ catasraḥ syuḥ tāvat kāryāḥ prayatnataḥ pañca vai karakāḥ kāryāḥ tāmra pātreṇa saṃyutāḥ  /

original: guḍapīṭhamayāḥ kāryā raktavastrasamanvitāḥ | raktacaṃdanasaṃyuktā raktapuṣpaiśca pūjitāḥ || 46 ||
analyzed: guḍa pīṭha mayāḥ kāryāḥ rakta vastra samanvitāḥ rakta caṃdana saṃyuktāḥ rakta puṣpaiḥ ca pūjitāḥ  /

original: tilataṇḍulasaṃpūrṇamekaṃ tatraiva kārayet | dvitīyaṃ laḍḍukaiścaiva tṛtīyaṃ payasā tathā || 47 ||
analyzed: tila taṇḍula saṃpūrṇam ekam tatra eva kārayet dvitīyam laḍḍukaiḥ ca eva tṛtīyam payasā tathā

original: uttarībhiścaturthaṃ ca pañcamaṃ mūlakaistathā | kṛtvā hyevaṃ vidhānena maṃtreṇārghyaṃ nivedayet || 48 ||
analyzed: uttarībhiḥ caturtham ca pañcamam mūlakaiḥ tathā kṛtvā hi evam vidhānena maṃtreṇa arghyam nivedayet

original: kujāya lohitāṃgāya grahamaghyasthitāya ca | kārtikeyānurūpāya surūpāya namo namaḥ || 49 ||
analyzed: kujāya lohita aṃgāya graha maghya sthitāya ca kārtikeya anurūpāya surūpāya namaḥ namaḥ  /

original: śivalalāṭasaṃbhūta dharaṇīgarbhasaṃbhava | rūpārthaṃ tvāṃ prapannosmi gṛhāṇārghyaṃ namo'stu te || 50 ||
analyzed: śiva lalāṭa saṃbhūta dharaṇī garbha saṃbhava rūpa artham tvām prapannaḥ asmi gṛhāṇa arghyam namaḥ astu te  /

original: jvalitāṃgāravarṇābha snigdhavidrumabhā sura | putrārthī tvāṃ prapannosmi gṛhāṇārghyaṃ dharātmaja || 51 ||
analyzed: jvalita aṃgāra varṇa ābha snigdha vidruma bhā sura putra arthī tvām prapannaḥ asmi gṛhāṇa arghyam dharā ātmaja

original: āvantyamaṇḍale jāto dharaṇyāṃ ca śivena vai | putraṃ dehi dhanaṃ dehi yaśo dehi namo'stu te || 52 ||
analyzed: āvantya maṇḍale jātaḥ dharaṇyām ca śivena vai putram dehi dhanam dehi yaśaḥ dehi namaḥ astu te  /

original: evaṃ saṃpūjito bhaumaścaturthyāṃ munisattama | bhuktvā bhogāṃstathā putrānprāpya vai kṣitimaṃḍale || 53 ||
analyzed: evam saṃpūjitaḥ bhaumaḥ caturthyām muni sattama bhuktvā bhogān tathā putrān prāpya vai kṣiti maṃḍale

original: mṛtaḥ svargamavāpnoti yāvadindrāścaturdaśa || 54 ||
analyzed: mṛtaḥ svargam avāpnoti yāvat indrāḥ caturdaśa

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | nāsti śeṣaṃ yadā raktaṃ pīyamānaṃ ca rakṣasaḥ | cāmuṃḍāyāstato raktamabhūdāsyaṃ ca bhāsuram || 1 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca na asti śeṣam yadā raktam pīyamānam ca rakṣasaḥ cāmuṃḍāyāḥ tatas raktam abhūt āsyam ca bhāsuram

analyzed: kṛṣṇam kṛtāṃta kalpa antam karāla daśana adharam prajvalati aṃdhake śāṃtam jvalat kesara locanam

analyzed: ghora gharghara nirghoṣa sphīta phetkāra visvaram tārkṣya pakṣa kṛta āpīḍam tīkṣṇa daṃṣṭra ākura ujjvalam  /

original: tasminmukhe kapālāgraṃ nidhāya ruṣitānanā | apibadrudhiraṃ caṃḍī caṇḍa dordaṃḍamaṃḍitā || 4 ||
analyzed: tasmin mukhe kapāla agram nidhāya ruṣita ānanā apibat rudhiram caṃḍī caṇḍa dos daṃḍa maṃḍitā  /

original: tayā pibaṃtyā daityeṃdraḥ śarīre kṛśatāṃ gataḥ | kṣayaṃ ninye'tha saṃkṣīṇakṣudrakṣubhitavīkṣaṇaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: tayā pibaṃtyā daitya iṃdraḥ śarīre kṛśa tām gataḥ kṣayam ninye atha saṃkṣīṇa kṣudra kṣubhita vīkṣaṇaḥ

original: itthaṃ nirvīryadeho'sau babhūvāṃdha kadānavaḥ | sarvāṃ saṃhṛtya māyāṃ yo balaṃ kṣīṇamathākarot || 6 ||
analyzed: ittham nirvīrya dehaḥ asau babhūva aṃdha kadānavaḥ sarvām saṃhṛtya māyām yaḥ balam kṣīṇam atha akarot

original: tīvraṃ bhayaṃ samāsādya prāṇatrāṇaparāyaṇaḥ | dṛṣṭvā nānyāṃ gatiṃ loke daityastuṣṭāva śaṃkaram || 7 ||
analyzed: tīvram bhayam samāsādya prāṇa trāṇa parāyaṇaḥ dṛṣṭvā na anyām gatim loke daityaḥ tuṣṭāva śaṃkaram

original: kṛtāṃjalipuṭo bhūtvā romāṃcitaśarīrakaḥ | sāttvikaṃ bhāvamāpannastyaktvā caiva rajastamaḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: kṛta aṃjali puṭaḥ bhūtvā romāṃcita śarīrakaḥ sāttvikam bhāvam āpannaḥ tyaktvā ca eva rajaḥ tamaḥ

original: lokānāṃ kāraṇaṃ devaṃ vibudhādhi patiṃ prabhum | śaśvadbuddhyānvito bhaktyā nirmalenāṃtarātmanā || 9 ||
analyzed: lokānām kāraṇam devam vibudha adhi patim prabhum  śaśvat buddhyā anvitaḥ bhaktyā nirmalena antarātmanā

original: ślāghyaṃ śivaṃ ca tuṣṭāva devaṃ caṃdrārdhaśekharam || 10 ||
analyzed: ślāghyam śivam ca tuṣṭāva devam caṃdra ardha śekharam

original: aṃdhaka uvāca | kṛtsnasya yo'sya jagataḥ sacarācarasya kartā kṛtasya ca tathā sukhaduḥkhadātā | saṃsāraheturapi yaḥ punaraṃtakāle taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 11 ||
analyzed: aṃdhakaḥ uvāca kṛtsnasya yaḥ asya jagataḥ sacarācarasya kartā kṛtasya ca tathā sukha duḥkha dātā saṃsāra hetuḥ api yaḥ punar anta kāle tam śaṃkaram śaraṇa dam śaraṇam vrajāmi  /

original: yaṃ yogino vigatamohatamorajaskā bhaktyaikatānamanaso vinivṛttakāmāḥ | dhyāyaṃti ye'khiladhiyo'mitadivyabhūtiṃ taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 12 ||
analyzed: yam yoginaḥ vigata moha tamaḥ rajaskāḥ bhaktyā ekatāna manasaḥ vinivṛtta kāmāḥ dhyāyaṃti ye akhila dhiyaḥ amita divya bhūtim tam śaṃkaram śaraṇa dam śaraṇam vrajāmi  /

original: yaścaṃdrakhaṃḍamamalaṃ vilasanmayūkhaṃ baddhvā sadā surasaricchirasā bibharti | yasyārdhadehamabhajadgirirājaputrī taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 13 ||
analyzed: yaḥ caṃdra khaṃḍam amalam vilasat mayūkham baddhvā sadā surasarit śirasā bibharti yasya ardha deham abhajat girirāja putrī tam śaṃkaram śaraṇa dam śaraṇam vrajāmi  /

original: yaḥ siddhacāraṇaniṣevitapādapadmo gaṃgāṃ mahormiviṣamāṃ gaganātpataṃtīm | mūrdhnā dadhe srajamiva trijagatpunaṃtīṃ taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 14 ||
analyzed: yaḥ siddha cāraṇa niṣevita pāda padmaḥ gaṃgām mahā ūrmi viṣamām gaganāt patantīm mūrdhnā dadhe srajam iva trijagat punaṃtīm tam śaṃkaram śaraṇa dam śaraṇam vrajāmi  /

original: kailāsaśailaśikharaṃ pravikaṃpyamānaṃ kailāsaśṛṃgasadṛśena daśānanena | yaḥ pādapadmaparipīḍanasevyamānastaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 15 ||
analyzed: kailāsa śaila śikharam pravikaṃpyamānam kailāsa śṛṃga sadṛśena daśānanena yaḥ pāda padma paripīḍana sevyamānaḥ tam śaṃkaram śaraṇa dam śaraṇam vrajāmi  /
