original: dakṣādhvare ca nayane ca tathā bhagasya pūṣṇastathā daśanapaṃktimaśātayadyaḥ | vyaṣṭaṃbhayatkuliśahastamatheṃdramīśaṃ taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 16 ||
analyzed: dakṣa adhvare ca nayane ca tathā bhagasya pūṣṇaḥ tathā daśana paṃktim aśātayat yaḥ vyaṣṭaṃbhayat kuliśa hastam atha iṃdram īśam tam śaṃkaram śaraṇa dam śaraṇam vrajāmi  /

original: yenāsakṛdditisutāśca danoḥ sutāśca vidyādharoragagaṇāśca varaiḥ samagraiḥ | saṃyojitā munivarāḥ phalamūlabhakṣāstaṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 17 ||
analyzed: yena asakṛt diti sutāḥ ca danoḥ sutāḥ ca vidyādhara uraga gaṇāḥ ca varaiḥ samagraiḥ saṃyojitāḥ muni varāḥ phala mūla bhakṣāḥ tam śaṃkaram śaraṇa dam śaraṇam vrajāmi  /

original: evaṃ kṛtepi viṣayeṣvapi saktabhāvā jñānena ca śrutaguṇairapi tena yuktāḥ | yaṃ saṃśritāḥ sukhabhujaḥ puruṣā bhavaṃti taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajā mi || 18 ||
analyzed: evam kṛte api viṣayeṣu api sakta bhāvāḥ jñānena ca śruta guṇaiḥ api tena yuktāḥ yam saṃśritāḥ sukha bhujaḥ puruṣāḥ bhavanti tam śaṃkaram śaraṇa dam śaraṇam vraja mi  /

original: brahmeṃdraviṣṇumarutāṃ ca saṣaṇmukhānāṃ yo'dādvarānsubahuśo bhagavānmaheśaḥ | sūtaṃ ca mṛtyuvadanātpunarujjahāra taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 19 ||
analyzed: brahma iṃdra viṣṇu marutām ca sa ṣaṇmukhānām yaḥ adāt varān su bahuśas bhagavān maheśaḥ sūtam ca mṛtyu vadanāt punar ujjahāra tam śaṃkaram śaraṇa dam śaraṇam vrajāmi  /

original: ārādhitastu tapasā himavannikuṃje dhūmravratena tapasā ca parairagamyaḥ | saṃjīvanīṃ samadadādbhṛgave mahātmā taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 20 ||
analyzed: ārādhitaḥ tu tapasā himavat nikuṃje dhūmravratena tapasā ca paraiḥ agamyaḥ saṃjīvanīm samadadāt bhṛgave mahātmā tam śaṃkaram śaraṇa dam śaraṇam vrajāmi  /

original: krīḍārthameva bhagavānbhuvanāni sapta nānānadīvihagapādapamaṃḍitāni | sabrahmakāni sasṛje sukṛtābhidhāni taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 21 ||
analyzed: krīḍā artham eva bhagavān bhuvanāni sapta nānā nadī vihaga pādapa maṃḍitāni sa brahmakāni sasṛje sukṛta abhidhāni tam śaṃkaram śaraṇa dam śaraṇam vrajāmi  /

original: yaḥ savyapāṇikamalāgranakhena devastatpaṃcamaṃ prasabhameva karālaraṃdhram | brāhmyaṃ śirastaraṇipadmanibhaṃ cakarta taṃ śaṃkaraṃ śaraṇadaṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajāmi || 22 ||
analyzed: yaḥ savya pāṇi kamala agra nakhena devaḥ tat paṃcamam prasabham eva karāla raṃdhram brāhmyam śiraḥ taraṇi padma nibham cakarta tam śaṃkaram śaraṇa dam śaraṇam vrajāmi  /

original: ye tvāṃ surottamaguruṃ puruṣā vimūḍhā jānaṃti nāsya jagataḥ sacarācarasya | aiśvaryamānavigame'nuśayena paścātte yātanāmanubhavaṃti yathāhameva || 23 ||
analyzed: ye tvām sura uttama gurum puruṣāḥ vimūḍhāḥ jānaṃti na asya jagataḥ sacarācarasya aiśvarya māna vigame anuśayena paścāt te yātanām anubhavanti yathā aham eva  /

original: yaḥ paṭhetstutimimāṃ śucikarmā yaḥ śṛṇoti satataṃ śivabhaktaḥ | viprasaṃsadi sadā śubhakarmā sa prayāti śivaloka makhaṃḍam || 24 ||
analyzed: yaḥ paṭhet stutim imām śuci karmā yaḥ śṛṇoti satatam śiva bhaktaḥ vipra saṃsadi sadā śubha karmā sa prayāti śiva loka makhaṃḍam

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | tasyaivaṃ stuvato devaḥ śūlapāṇirvṛṣadhvajaḥ | pūrṇe varṣaśatasyāṃte prītaḥ provāca śaṃkaraḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca tasya evam stuvataḥ devaḥ śūlapāṇiḥ vṛṣadhvajaḥ pūrṇe varṣa śatasya aṃte prītaḥ provāca śaṃkaraḥ

original: putra tuṣṭo'smi bhadraṃ te jātastvaṃ nirmalo'dhunā | divyaṃ dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya māṃ vigatajvaraḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: putra tuṣṭaḥ asmi bhadram te jātaḥ tvam nirmalaḥ adhunā divyam dadāmi te cakṣuḥ paśya mām vigata jvaraḥ  /

original: yacca te manasā vāpi kiṃcicca kāṃkṣitaṃ phalam | tattatsarvaṃ pradāsyāmi brūhi dānavasattama || 27 ||
analyzed: yat ca te manasā vā api kiṃcid ca kāṃkṣitam phalam tat tat sarvam pradāsyāmi brūhi dānava sattama

original: dānava uvāca | brāhmyaṃ vaiṣṇavameṃdraṃ vā padamāvṛttilakṣaṇam | viditaṃ mama tatsarvaṃ manāgapi na kāṃkṣaye || 28 ||
analyzed: dānavaḥ uvāca brāhmyam vaiṣṇavam eṃdram vā padam āvṛtti lakṣaṇam viditam mama tat sarvam manāk api na kāṃkṣaye  /

original: yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa gāṇapatyaṃ dadasva me | saviśeṣaṃ viśuddhaṃ ca tadakṣayyaṃ ca sarvadā || 29 ||
analyzed: yadi tuṣṭaḥ asi deveśa gāṇapatyam dadasva me sa viśeṣam viśuddham ca tat akṣayyam ca sarvadā

original: mahādeva uvāca | amaro jarayā tyaktaḥ sarvaduḥkhavivarjitaḥ | bhaviṣyasi gaṇādhyakṣaḥ sarvalokanamaskṛtaḥ || 30 ||
analyzed: mahādevaḥ uvāca amaraḥ jarayā tyaktaḥ sarva duḥkha vivarjitaḥ bhaviṣyasi gaṇādhyakṣaḥ sarva loka namaskṛtaḥ   /

original: kāmarūpo mahāyogī mahāsattvo mahābalaḥ | aṇimādiguṇairyuktaḥ priyaśca mama sarvadā || 31 ||
analyzed: kāmarūpaḥ mahā yogī mahā sattvaḥ mahā balaḥ aṇima ādi guṇaiḥ yuktaḥ priyaḥ ca mama sarvadā  /

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | tataśca soṃ'dhakaḥ śrīmānvarāṃllabdhvā sudurlabhān | mahādevagaṇo bhūtvā tatraivāṃtaradhīyata || 32 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca tatas ca saḥ adhakaḥ śrīmān varān labdhvā su durlabhān mahādeva gaṇaḥ bhūtvā tatra eva aṃtaradhīyata

original: gateṃ'dhake tato devyo brahmāṇyādyāḥ samāgatāḥ | sa devo yatra bhagavānaṃdhakasya varapradaḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: gate iṃdhake tatas devyaḥ brahmāṇī ādyāḥ samāgatāḥ sa devaḥ yatra bhagavān aṃdhakasya vara pradaḥ

original: tāstaṣṭuvurmahādevamatha tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ | cāmuṃḍā ca maheśena samāśvastā śivā'bhavat || 34 ||
analyzed: tāḥ taṣṭuvuḥ mahādevam atha tuṣṭaḥ maheśvaraḥ cāmuṃḍā ca maheśena samāśvastā śivā abhavat

original: śaṃkaraṃ praṇataṃ dṛṣṭvā tāsāmagre vyavasthitam | brahmādayo'pi te hṛṣṭāstuṣṭuburvividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || 35 ||
analyzed: śaṃkaram praṇatam dṛṣṭvā tāsām agre vyavasthitam  brahma ādayaḥ api te hṛṣṭāḥ tuṣṭubuḥ vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ

original: praśāṃtāstā yadā hṛṣṭāḥ śaṃbhunā rudhirāśanāḥ | tadā vocadidaṃ vākyaṃ tāsāṃ sthityarthamuttamam || 36 ||
analyzed: praśāṃtāḥ tāḥ yadā hṛṣṭāḥ śaṃbhunā rudhira aśanāḥ tadā vocat idam vākyam tāsām sthiti artham uttamam

original: āvaṃtye viṣaye sarvā yasmājātā mahābalāḥ | āvaṃtyamātarastasmātkhyātā loke bhaviṣyatha || 37 ||
analyzed: āvaṃtye viṣaye sarvāḥ yasmāt jātāḥ mahā balāḥ āvaṃtya mātaraḥ tasmāt khyātāḥ loke bhaviṣyatha  /

original: avaṃtyāṃ prītisaṃpannāḥ sarvapāpapraṇāśinīḥ | sthirā vasaṃtyo lokānāṃ varadāśca bhaviṣyatha || 38 ||
analyzed: prīti saṃpannāḥ sarva pāpa praṇāśinīḥ sthirāḥ vasaṃtyaḥ lokānām vara dāḥ ca bhaviṣyatha  /

original: śrāvaṇasya tu māsasya amāvāsyāṃ samāhitāḥ | ye drakṣyaṃti sadā bhaktyā teṣāṃ lokā mahodayāḥ || 39 ||
analyzed: śrāvaṇasya tu māsasya amāvāsyām samāhitāḥ ye drakṣyaṃti sadā bhaktyā teṣām lokāḥ mahā udayāḥ  /

original: aputro labhate putrāndhanārthī labhate dhanam | rūpavānsubhago bhogī sarvaśāstraviśāradaḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: aputraḥ labhate putrān dhana arthī labhate dhanam rūpavān subhagaḥ bhogī sarva śāstra viśāradaḥ

original: haṃsayuktena yānena pitṛloke mahīyate | purīmimāṃ ca rakṣadhvaṃ kalpekalpe krameṇa tu || 41 ||
analyzed: haṃsa yuktena yānena pitṛ loke mahīyate purīm imām ca rakṣadhvam kalpe kalpe krameṇa tu

original: evamuktvā tu deveśo gataḥ kailāsa parvatam | stūyamāno gaṇai raudrairdaityāmaragaṇeśvaraiḥ || 42 ||
analyzed: evam uktvā tu deveśaḥ gataḥ kailāsa parvatam stūyamānaḥ gaṇaiḥ raudraiḥ daitya amara gaṇa īśvaraiḥ

original: asurasuragaṇānāṃ nāyakasyānukīrtiṃ kathayati kathanīyāṃ śraddhayā yaḥ śṛṇoti | sakala sukhanidhānaṃ rudralokaṃ sa kāṃtaṃ suragaṇadanunāthairarcitaṃ yātyanaṃtam || 43 ||
analyzed: asura sura gaṇānām nāyakasya anukīrtim kathayati kathanīyām śraddhayā yaḥ śṛṇoti sakala sukha nidhānam rudra lokam sa kāṃtam sura gaṇa danu nāthaiḥ arcitam yāti anaṃtam  /

original: | vyāsa uvāca | bhagavankṣetramāhātmyaṃ kathitaṃ ca yathātatham | tīrthānāmuttamaṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyānāṃ puṇyavardhanam || 1 ||
analyzed: vyāsaḥ uvāca bhagavan kṣetra māhātmyam kathitam ca yathātatham tīrthānām uttamam tīrtham puṇyānām puṇya vardhanam

original: kati saṃtyatra tīrthāni liṃgāni ca tathā kati | kathayasva prasādena pṛcchato mama sāṃpratam || 2 ||
analyzed: kati saṃti atra tīrthāni liṃgāni ca tathā kati kathayasva prasādena pṛcchataḥ mama sāṃpratam  /

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca | mahākālavane vyāsa liṃgasaṃkhyā na vidyate || 3 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca ṣaṣṭi koṭi sahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭi koṭi śatāni ca mahākāla vane vyāsa liṃga saṃkhyā na vidyate  /

original: akāmo vā sakāmo vā jāyate yo'tra mānavaḥ | mahākālavane ramye śivaloke mahīyate || 4 ||
analyzed: akāmaḥ vā sa kāmaḥ vā jāyate yaḥ atra mānavaḥ mahākāla vane ramye śiva loke mahīyate  /

original: kṛtakāmāni tīrthāni prāsādāyatanāni ca | teṣu snātvā śucirbhūtvā śivaloke mahīyate || 5 ||
analyzed: kṛta kāmāni tīrthāni prāsāda āyatanāni ca  teṣu snātvā śuciḥ bhūtvā śiva loke mahīyate

original: puṇyāni sarvatīrthāni siddhikṣetrāṇi sarvataḥ | teṣāṃ mukhyatamaṃ viddhi kṣetraṃ tīrthaṃ tathottamam || 6 ||
analyzed: puṇyāni sarva tīrthāni siddhikṣetrāṇi sarvatas teṣām mukhyatamam viddhi kṣetram tīrtham tathā uttamam

original: yaḥ śṛṇoti mahābhaktyā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 7 ||
analyzed: yaḥ śṛṇoti mahā bhaktyā sa yāti paramām gatim

original: | vyāsa uvāca | bhagavanbhavatā sarvaṃ bhavabhītivināśakam | īśvarasthānamākhyātaṃ samaṃtātsāgrayojanam || 1 ||
analyzed: vyāsaḥ uvāca bhagavan bhavatā sarvam bhava bhīti vināśakam īśvara sthānam ākhyātam samaṃtāt sāgra yojanam

original: yatra kṣetre mṛtā martyāḥ sadācārāstathottamāḥ | vimānasthā pure nūnamaiśvare te vasaṃti ca || 2 ||
analyzed: yatra kṣetre mṛtāḥ martyāḥ sat ācārāḥ tathā uttamāḥ vimāna sthā pure nūnam aiśvare te vasaṃti ca  /

original: yatra kīṭapataṃgādyā mṛtā yāṃti parāṃ gatim | kiṃ tīrthaṃ puṇyamanyacca mahākālavanādṛte || 3 ||
analyzed: yatra kīṭa pataṃga ādyāḥ mṛtāḥ yānti parām gatim  kim tīrtham puṇyam anyat ca mahākāla vanāt ṛte

original: tasmādbrūhi mamaikaṃ tu praśnaṃ tathyena sāṃpratam | kathaṃ kanakaśṛṃgeti khyātā hyeṣā purā mune || 4 ||
analyzed: tasmāt brūhi mama ekam tu praśnam tathyena sāṃpratam  katham kanakaśṛṃgā iti khyātā hi eṣā purā mune

original: kuśasthalī kathaṃ nāma tathāvaṃtī kathaṃ smṛtā | padmāvatī kathaṃ sādho kathamujjayinī tathā || 5 ||
analyzed: kuśasthalī katham nāma tathā avaṃtī katham smṛtā padmāvatī katham sādho katham ujjayinī tathā

original: nāmnāṃ hetumatho teṣāṃ brūhi tvaṃ munisattama || 6 ||
analyzed: nāmnām hetum atho teṣām brūhi tvam muni sattama

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | śṛṇu vyāsa pravakṣyāmi yathā pūrvaṃ viraṃcinā | kathitaṃ vāmadevāya gaurakalpe purātane || 7 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca śṛṇu vyāsa pravakṣyāmi yathā pūrvam viraṃcinā kathitam vāmadevāya gaura kalpe purātane  /

original: maheśena bhagavatā vidhiścaivātra hetutaḥ | pṛṣṭastu svaścyutānāṃ ca kuto nivasatāṃ sukham || 8 ||
analyzed: maheśena bhagavatā vidhiḥ ca eva atra hetutaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ tu svaḥ cyutānām ca kutas nivasatām sukham

original: svargaprāptiśca bhavati svecchācāravihāriṇām | ko'tipuṇyatamaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pradeśaḥ pāpadārakaḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: svarga prāptiḥ ca bhavati svecchā ācāra vihāriṇām kaḥ ati puṇyatamaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ pradeśaḥ pāpa dārakaḥ

original: kuto nivartitaṃ cittaṃ jāyate vasatāṃ kvacit | vasatāmapi loke śamaihikaṃ pāralaukikam | etanme bhagavanbrūhi hitārthaṃ sarvadehinām || 10 ||
analyzed: kutas nivartitam cittam jāyate vasatām kvacid vasatām api loke śama aihikam pāralaukikam etat me bhagavan brūhi hita artham sarva dehinām

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | evamādau purā kalpe proktaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sa śaṃbhunā || 11 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca evamādau purā kalpe proktaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sa śaṃbhunā

original: provāca pārvatīkāṃtaṃ prabhuḥ prītaḥ pitāmahaḥ | bhagavansarvakartā tvaṃ sarvadarśī sadāśivaḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: provāca pārvatī kāntam prabhuḥ prītaḥ pitāmahaḥ bhagavan sarva kartā tvam sarva darśī sadāśivaḥ

original: ajānanniva tvaṃ sarvaṃ māṃ pṛcchasi sanātana | yatra kalpāṃtako vahniradhijvālaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: a jānan iva tvam sarvam mām pṛcchasi sanātana yatra kalpa aṃtakaḥ vahniḥ adhijvālaḥ pratiṣṭhitaḥ  /

original: tvameva ca mahākālaḥ sarvaṃ vai jñāyate tvayā | nātha ye mānavāstatra sadācārāstathā pare || 14 ||
analyzed: tvam eva ca mahākālaḥ sarvam vai jñāyate tvayā nātha ye mānavāḥ tatra sat ācārāḥ tathā pare

original: nivasaṃti na te martyāḥ surāste vai na saṃśayaḥ | labhaṃte ca punaḥ svargaṃ mṛtā vai kālaparyaye || 15 ||
analyzed: nivasaṃti na te martyāḥ surāḥ te vai na saṃśayaḥ labhaṃte ca punar svargam mṛtāḥ vai kāla paryaye

original: vartate ca purī tatra ramyaharmyā suśobhanā | yasyāṃ bhāṃti vicitrāṇi harmyāṇi vividhāni ca || 16 ||
analyzed: vartate ca purī tatra ramya harmyā su śobhanā yasyām bhānti vicitrāṇi harmyāṇi vividhāni ca  /

original: svarṇaśṛṅgāśca prāsādā vihitā viśvakarmaṇā | devāḥ saṃti sadā tatra tīrthāni vividhāni ca || 17 ||
analyzed: svarṇa śṛṅgāḥ ca prāsādāḥ vihitāḥ viśvakarmaṇā devāḥ saṃti sadā tatra tīrthāni vividhāni ca  /

original: pūrvakalpe sthito'haṃ ca yatra tvaṃ keśavastathā | tāmeva ca purīṃ draṣṭuṃ sarve lokā hyavaṃtikām || 18 ||
analyzed: pūrva kalpe sthitaḥ aham ca yatra tvam keśavaḥ tathā  tām eva ca purīm draṣṭum sarve lokāḥ hi avaṃtikām

original: tathā devarṣayaḥ siddhā yakṣakiṃnaradānavāḥ | ājagmuḥ sthāṇunā sārdhaṃ vedhasā brahmayoninā || 19 ||
analyzed: tathā devarṣayaḥ siddhāḥ yakṣa kiṃnara dānavāḥ ājagmuḥ sthāṇunā sārdham vedhasā brahma yoninā  /

original: tathaiva ca varā nāryo devānāmativallabhāḥ | samāpetuḥ sahasrāṇi draṣṭumatyadbhutāṃ purīm || 20 ||
analyzed: tathā eva ca varāḥ nāryaḥ devānām ati vallabhāḥ samāpetuḥ sahasrāṇi draṣṭum ati adbhutām purīm  /

original: āgatya ca yadā devaḥ saha devairmaheśvaraḥ | vīkṣate nagarīṃ ramyāmapaśyadāvṛtāṃ tathā || 21 ||
analyzed: āgatya ca yadā devaḥ saha devaiḥ maheśvaraḥ vīkṣate nagarīm ramyām apaśyat āvṛtām tathā

original: prāsādaiḥ svarṇaśṛṃgāḍhyairmaṇiratnavibhūṣitaiḥ | viśvarūpo hi bhagavānrājā viśvaika nāyakaḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: prāsādaiḥ svarṇa śṛṃga āḍhyaiḥ maṇi ratna vibhūṣitaiḥ viśva rūpaḥ hi bhagavān rājā viśva eka nāyakaḥ

original: tatrāste śobhane divye prāsāde maṇibhūṣite | sevyamānaḥ suraiḥ siddhairmunividyādharoragaiḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: tatra āste śobhane divye prāsāde maṇi bhūṣite sevyamānaḥ suraiḥ siddhaiḥ muni vidyādhara uragaiḥ

original: tato maheśaśca pitāmahaśca sametya taṃ viśvapatiṃ nanaṃdatuḥ | samarcitau tena yathārhamādarātsahānugāvāgamanaṃ tvapṛcchat || 24 ||
analyzed: tatas maheśaḥ ca pitāmahaḥ ca sametya tam viśvapatim nanaṃdatuḥ samarcitau tena yathārham ādarāt saha anugau āgamanam tu apṛcchat  /

original: kimāgatau vā tridivānmahītalaṃ sahānugāvāśa yakaśca kathyatām | tatastu tāvūcaturabjajeśvarau bhavāntare yatra ca tatra nau ratiḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: kim āgatau vā tridivāt mahī talam saha anugau āśa yakaḥ ca kathyatām tatas tu tau ūcatuḥ abjaja īśvarau bhava antare yatra ca tatra nau ratiḥ  /

original: tvayā vinā naiva surālaye sukhaṃ mahītale vātha rasātale' sti naḥ | kadā tvayā kāṃcanaśekharā purī niveśitā veśmavatī vicitritā || 26 ||
analyzed: tvayā vinā nā eva surālaye sukham mahī tale vā atha rasātale asti naḥ kadā tvayā kāṃcanaśekharā purī niveśitā veśmavatī vicitritā  /

original: hariruvāca | tvadarthameveśa viśeṣaśālinī sṛṣṭā hi vai sarvaguṇākarā mayā | prayaccha viśveśvara cāvayoriha sthānaṃ ca tīrthaṃ pralaye'kṣayaṃ ca || 27 ||
analyzed: hariḥ uvāca tvad artham eva īśa viśeṣa śālinī sṛṣṭā hi vai sarva guṇa ākarā mayā prayaccha viśveśvara ca āvayoḥ iha sthānam ca tīrtham pralaye akṣayam ca  /

original: dadāmyabhīṣṭaṃ yuvayorihālayaṃ prajāpate hyuttaratastava sthitiḥ | maheśvara tvaṃ vraja dakṣiṇālayaṃ sthānaṃ sudattaṃ yuvayoḥ suśobhanam || 28 ||
analyzed: dadāmi abhīṣṭam yuvayoḥ iha ālayam prajāpate hi uttaratas tava sthitiḥ maheśvara tvam vraja dakṣiṇa ālayam sthānam su dattam yuvayoḥ su śobhanam

original: mahākālo hyadhojvālo jagadātmā prabhuḥ sthitaḥ | gaṇairaneka sāhasrairādṛtaḥ parameśvaraḥ || 29 ||
analyzed: mahākālaḥ hi adhas jvālaḥ jagadātmā prabhuḥ sthitaḥ gaṇaiḥ aneka sāhasraiḥ ādṛtaḥ parameśvaraḥ

original: krīḍārthaṃ nagarī sṛṣṭā sarvabhūtahitaiṣiṇā | mayādya yuvayordattā vihāyā'calamātmanaḥ || 30 ||
analyzed: krīḍā artham nagarī sṛṣṭā sarva bhūta hita eṣiṇā mayā adya yuvayoḥ dattā vihāya acalam ātmanaḥ

original: bhavadbhyāṃ hemaśṛṃ geti yasmācca samudīritā | purī kanakaśṛṃgeti loke khyātā bhaviṣyati || 31 ||
analyzed: bhavadbhyām gā iti yasmāt ca samudīritā purī kanakaśṛṃgā iti loke khyātā bhaviṣyati  /

original: evaṃ kanakaśṛṅgeti prathamaṃ nāma kathyate || 32 ||
analyzed: evam kanakaśṛṅgā iti prathamam nāma kathyate

original: japaṃtaśca sthitā yatra brahmaviṣṇumaheśvarāḥ | nityaṃ ramaṃti bhaktānāṃ sarvābhīṣṭaphalapradāḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: japantaḥ ca sthitāḥ yatra brahma viṣṇu maheśvarāḥ nityam ramaṃti bhaktānām sarva abhīṣṭa phala pradāḥ   /

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | śṛṇu vyāsa yatheyaṃ tu procyate hi kuśasthalī | kalpe tatpuruṣe pūrvaṃ vedavidbhirmanīṣibhiḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca śṛṇu vyāsa yathā iyam tu procyate hi kuśasthalī kalpe tatpuruṣe pūrvam veda vidbhiḥ manīṣibhiḥ  /

original: vedhasā sṛjitaṃ viśvaṃ daityadānavarā kṣasam | anyonyamadasaṃmattamanyonyadveṣi vai raṇe || 2 ||
analyzed: vedhasā sṛjitam viśvam daitya dānava rā kṣasam anyonya mada saṃmattam anyonya dveṣi vai raṇe

original: devāśca dānavāḥ saṃkhye nityaṃ spardhāsamanvitāḥ | manuṣyā manujaiḥ sārdhaṃ siddhavidyādharaiḥ saha || 3 ||
analyzed: devāḥ ca dānavāḥ saṃkhye nityam spardhā samanvitāḥ manuṣyāḥ manujaiḥ sārdham siddha vidyādharaiḥ saha

original: cāraṇāḥ kiṃnaraiḥ sārdhamevaṃ te dveṣatatparāḥ | yuddhaṃ kurvaṃti satatamavispaṣṭārthayā girā || 4 ||
analyzed: cāraṇāḥ kiṃnaraiḥ sārdham evam te dveṣa tatparāḥ yuddham kurvaṃti satatam avispaṣṭa arthayā girā

original: sarve caiva ca balino durbalairmanujaiḥ saha | paśavaḥ paśubhiḥ sārdhaṃ pakṣiṇaḥ saha pakṣibhiḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: sarve ca eva ca balinaḥ durbalaiḥ manujaiḥ saha paśavaḥ paśubhiḥ sārdham pakṣiṇaḥ saha pakṣibhiḥ

original: evamanyonyamanyaiśca nirmaryādamidaṃ jagat | dṛṣṭvā viśvasya kartāraṃ viṣṇuṃ viśveśvaraṃ param || 6 ||
analyzed: evam anyonyam anyaiḥ ca nirmaryādam idam jagat dṛṣṭvā viśvasya kartāram viṣṇum viśveśvaram param

original: vrajāmi śaraṇaṃ devaṃ śaraṇārttiharaṃ harim | evaṃ manasi saṃdhāya dadhyau dhyānena mādhavam || 7 ||
analyzed: vrajāmi śaraṇam devam śaraṇa ārtti haram harim  evam manasi saṃdhāya dadhyau dhyānena mādhavam

original: tato dhyāto mahāyogī viśvarūpadharo hariḥ | lohadaṇḍadharaḥ śrīmānidamāha pitāmaham || 8 ||
analyzed: tatas dhyātaḥ mahā yogī viśva rūpa dharaḥ hariḥ loha daṇḍa dharaḥ śrīmān idam āha pitāmaham

original: brahmandhyātastvayā samyagdhyānayogena paśya mām | samāyāṃtaṃ tathā dhyātaṃ jagatāṃ pātumudyatam || 9 ||
analyzed: brahman dhyātaḥ tvayā samyak dhyāna yogena paśya mām samāyāntam tathā dhyātam jagatām pātum udyatam

original: tato dhātā niśamyaitattyaktvā dhyānamavekṣya tam | samutthāyaikamanasā namaścakre'rcayatpunaḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: tatas dhātā niśamya etat tyaktvā dhyānam avekṣya tam samutthāya eka manasā namaḥ cakre arcayat punar

original: pādyenācamanīyena madhuparkeṇa keśavam | pūjayitvā punarvākyamuvācācyutamabjajaḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: pādyena ācamanīyena madhuparkeṇa keśavam pūjayitvā punar vākyam uvāca acyutam abjajaḥ

original: brahmovāca | devadeva jagannātha jagatsṛṣṭamidaṃ tvayā | ṛte tvayā jagadviṣṇo naivāvasthātu marhati || 12 ||
analyzed: brahmā uvāca devadeva jagannātha jagat sṛṣṭam idam tvayā ṛte tvayā jagat viṣṇo na eva avasthātu marhati

original: śāstā tvamasya viśvasya viśuddhasya ca nāparaḥ | tvattostīdaṃ jagatsarvaṃ tasmāttvamanuśāsaya || 13 ||
analyzed: śāstā tvam asya viśvasya viśuddhasya ca na aparaḥ tvattaḥ asti idam jagat sarvam tasmāt tvam anuśāsaya  /

original: devadānavagaṃdharvāḥ sayakṣo ragarākṣasāḥ | tvāmṛte puṇḍarīkākṣaṃ vyāpitāśeṣavigrahāḥ | parasparaṃ vinighnaṃti tāṃśca tvaṃ rakṣituṃ kṣamaḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: deva dānava gaṃdharvāḥ sa yakṣaḥ raga rākṣasāḥ tvām ṛte puṇḍarīkākṣam vyāpita aśeṣa vigrahāḥ parasparam vinighnanti tān ca tvam rakṣitum kṣamaḥ  /

original: tvamasya viśvasya carācarasya sthiteḥ sadā prāṇabhṛdātmarūpiṇī || 15 ||
analyzed: tvam asya viśvasya carācarasya sthiteḥ sadā prāṇabhṛt ātma rūpiṇī

original: tvayā dhṛtaṃ sarvamidaṃ jagadvai yatastato'si tvamupendrasaṃjñaḥ | praveśanaṃ vyāptamidaṃ svadhāma yattvamucyase viṣṇurato munīṃdraiḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: tvayā dhṛtam sarvam idam jagat vai yatas tatas asi tvam upendra saṃjñaḥ praveśanam vyāptam idam sva dhāma yat tvam ucyase viṣṇuḥ atas muni iṃdraiḥ

original: nivāsitaṃ viśvamidaṃ tvayādya vāsaśca dhātoriti vāsudevaḥ | tavānugaṃ viśvamidaṃ vibhustvamaśeṣaviśvasya vibhāsi rājā || 17 ||
analyzed: nivāsitam viśvam idam tvayā adya vāsaḥ ca dhātoḥ iti vāsudevaḥ tava anugam viśvam idam vibhuḥ tvam aśeṣa viśvasya vibhāsi rājā

original: senānurūpaṃ jagadeva yasmādataḥ smṛtastvaṃ kila viśvasenaḥ | vilekhanādasya carācarasya kṛteśca dhātostvamato'si kṛṣṇaḥ || 18 ||
analyzed: senā anurūpam jagat eva yasmāt atas smṛtaḥ tvam kila viśvasenaḥ vilekhanāt asya carācarasya kṛteḥ ca dhātoḥ tvam atas asi kṛṣṇaḥ  /

original: jitaṃ tvayā deva jagattrayaṃ yajjiteśca dhātostvamato'si jiṣṇuḥ | tasmātsamastagrahalokapālaṃ jagadvibho pālaya sarvakālam || 19 ||
analyzed: jitam tvayā deva jagattrayam yat jiteḥ ca dhātoḥ tvam atas asi jiṣṇuḥ tasmāt samasta graha lokapālam jagat vibho pālaya sarvakālam

original: tvamasya sarvasya bhavādirājastavāstu bhadrāsanamadvitīyama | pradakṣiṇāvartanakastu śaṃkhaḥ karasthitaḥ śobhati pūruṣasya || 20 ||
analyzed: tvam asya sarvasya bhava ādirājaḥ tava astu bhadrāsanam advitīyam  pradakṣiṇa āvartanakaḥ tu śaṃkhaḥ kara sthitaḥ śobhati pūruṣasya  /

original: sudarśanaṃ nāma tavāsti cakramato hi gītaḥ kavibhi stu cakrī | dhvajo'sti te deva suparṇasevitastathāsuparṇaśca tavāsti vāhanam || 21 ||
analyzed: sudarśanam nāma tava asti cakram atas hi gītaḥ kavibhiḥ tu cakrī  dhvajaḥ asti te deva suparṇa sevitaḥ tathā a suparṇaḥ ca tava asti vāhanam

original: turaṃgamāḥ saṃtu tavārisaṃhare tathā hṛṣīkeśa sudantadantinaḥ | kirīṭaniṣkāṃgadakarṇapūrakeyūrahārottamahemasūtraiḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: turaṃgamāḥ saṃtu tava ari saṃhare tathā hṛṣīkeśa sudanta dantinaḥ kirīṭa niṣka aṃgada karṇapūra keyūra hāra uttama hema sūtraiḥ

original: vicitravastrottamaraktamālyairvibhūṣitastvaṃ bhava bhīmasenaḥ | śriyā kadācicca na mucyate bhavānbhavaṃ ti te nityamanaṃtasaṃpadaḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: vicitra vastra uttama rakta mālyaiḥ vibhūṣitaḥ tvam bhava bhīmasenaḥ śriyā kadācid ca na mucyate bhavān bhavam ti te nityam ananta saṃpadaḥ

original: tavānugā bhaktirihāstu vai satī mukunda bhakte tvamataḥ prasīda me || 24 ||
analyzed: tava anugā bhaktiḥ iha astu vai satī mukunda bhakte tvam atas prasīda me

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | sa evamuktastu puro divaukasāṃ vibhuḥ prasannastvidamabravīddharaḥ | viriṃca me darśaya tasya maṃḍalaṃ tvayā vimuktaṃ ca sadāśivaṃ vibho || 25 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca saḥ evam uktaḥ tu puras divaukasām vibhuḥ prasannaḥ tu idam abravīt haraḥ viriṃca me darśaya tasya maṃḍalam tvayā vimuktam ca sadāśivam vibho

original: sthiraṃ sthi yatra jagatkaromyahaṃ tato viraṃciḥ kuśamuṣṭimādade | pavitradeśasya nidarśanāya jagāma puṇyaṃ cyavanāśramaṃ tadā || 26 ||
analyzed: sthiram yatra jagat karomi aham tatas viraṃciḥ kuśa muṣṭim ādade pavitra deśasya nidarśanāya jagāma puṇyam cyavana āśramam tadā  /

original: tataḥ sthalīmuccatarāmavāpya pitāmahaḥ keśavamāha cādarāt | tvadudbhavaṃ cātra pavitramaṃḍalaṃ tvayā vimuktaṃ ca sadā śivaṃ vibho || 27 ||
analyzed: tatas sthalīm uccatarām avāpya pitāmahaḥ keśavam āha ca ādarāt tvad udbhavam ca atra pavitra maṃḍalam tvayā vimuktam ca sadā śivam vibho

original: tvameva viṣṇurvibudhārcitaḥ sadā smṛto munīṃdraiḥ sa ca viṣṭaraśravāḥ | niṣīda viśveśa kuśasthalaṃ yadā tadāśrito mādhavamāsarūpavān || 28 ||
analyzed: tvam eva viṣṇuḥ vibudha arcitaḥ sadā smṛtaḥ muni iṃdraiḥ sa ca viṣṭaraśravāḥ niṣīda viśveśa kuśasthalam yadā tad āśritaḥ mādhava māsa rūpavān

original: kuśasthalīṃ saṃsthita eva deva itthaṃ vidhātrā puruṣottamaḥ stutaḥ | sthalīṃ kuśairāstaritāmupāviśatkuśasthalīṃ devamunīndrasevitām || 29 ||
analyzed: kuśa sthalīm saṃsthitaḥ eva devaḥ ittham vidhātrā puruṣottamaḥ stutaḥ sthalīm kuśaiḥ āstaritām upāviśat kuśa sthalīm deva muni indra sevitām

original: samaṃtato yojanasaṃ khyayāvṛtāṃ tato vidhātā puruṣottamastathā | kuśasthalīti prathitaṃ jagattraye pracakraturnāma ca tāvubhāvapi || 30 ||
analyzed: samaṃtataḥ yojana sam khyayā āvṛtām tatas vidhātā puruṣottamaḥ tathā kuśasthalī iti prathitam jagattraye pracakratuḥ nāma ca tau ubhau api  /

original: tatra viśvapatiḥ śrīmānviśveśo viśvakṛdvibhuḥ | viśvaṃ śaśāsa viśvātmā sarvaviśvasya nāyakaḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: tatra viśvapatiḥ śrīmān viśveśaḥ viśva kṛt vibhuḥ viśvam śaśāsa viśvātmā sarva viśvasya nāyakaḥ

original: evaṃ kuśasthalī khyātā hemaśṛṅgeti yā purā | stīrṇā kuśairyato dhātrā kuśasthalī tataḥ smṛtā || 32 ||
analyzed: evam kuśasthalī khyātā hemaśṛṅgā iti yā purā stīrṇā kuśaiḥ yatas dhātrā kuśasthalī tatas smṛtā

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | purā caiśānakalpe tu smṛtāvaṃtī yathā purī | tathā śṛṇu suraiḥ pūrvaṃ daityasainyaparājitaiḥ || 1 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca purā ca aiśāna kalpe tu smṛtā avaṃtī yathā purī tathā śṛṇu suraiḥ pūrvam daitya sainya parājitaiḥ  /

original: āśritaṃ meruśikharaṃ vanakaṃdaguhāvṛtam | tatra gatvā dvijaśreṣṭha maṃtraṃ ca cakrurudyatāḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: āśritam meru śikharam vana kaṃda guhā āvṛtam tatra gatvā dvijaśreṣṭha maṃtram ca cakruḥ udyatāḥ  /

original: anyonyaṃ ca samāsādya samabhyarcya parasparam | jagmuḥ sarve suragaṇā yatra brahmā prajāpatiḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: anyonyam ca samāsādya samabhyarcya parasparam  jagmuḥ sarve sura gaṇāḥ yatra brahmā prajāpatiḥ

original: nivedayāṃcakrire sarvaṃ tatrāgamanakāraṇam | teṣāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā devānāṃ sa prajeśvaraḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: nivedayāṃcakrire sarvam tatra āgamana kāraṇam  teṣām tat vacanam śrutvā devānām sa prajeśvaraḥ

original: jagāma tridaśaiḥ sākaṃ devadevaṃ maheśvaram | sa cāpi hyagamattatra vaikuṭhaṃ dhāma yatra vai || 5 ||
analyzed: jagāma tridaśaiḥ sākam devadevam maheśvaram  sa ca api hi agamat tatra vaikuṭham dhāma yatra vai

original: ṛddhisiddhipradaṃ nityaṃ municāraṇasevitam | kinnarairgīyamānaṃ ca apsarogaṇasevitam || 6 ||
analyzed: ṛddhi siddhi pradam nityam muni cāraṇa sevitam kinnaraiḥ gīyamānam ca apsaraḥ gaṇa sevitam

original: ṛṣibhirbhārgavādibhirdevarṣināradottamaiḥ | siddhagaṃdharvamukhyaiśca kumāraiḥ sanakādibhiḥ || 7 ||

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | śṛṇu vyāsa mahābhāga purī hyeṣāmarāvatī | viśālā ca samākhyātā sarvalokeṣu gīyate || 1 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca śṛṇu vyāsa mahābhāga purī hi eṣā amarāvatī  viśālā ca samākhyātā sarva lokeṣu gīyate  /

original: tathāhaṃ saṃpravakṣyāmi brahmaṇā kathitaṃ purā | guhyādguhyataraṃ kṣetraṃ sarvapāpapraṇāśanam || 2 ||
analyzed: tathā aham saṃpravakṣyāmi brahmaṇā kathitam purā guhyāt guhyataram kṣetram sarva pāpa praṇāśanam

original: viṣṇurdaśākṛtiryatra devyo vai lokamātaraḥ | vināyakāśca vaitālāḥ kūṣmāṃḍā bhairavādayaḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: viṣṇuḥ daśa ākṛtiḥ yatra devyaḥ vai lokamātaraḥ vināyakāḥ ca vaitālāḥ kūṣmāṃḍāḥ bhairava ādayaḥ

original: kalpodbhedāśca liṃgāśca caturāśītisaṃkhyakāḥ | kṣetrāṇi kṣetrapālāśca ṛddhiḥ siddhistathaiva ca || 5 ||
analyzed: kalpa udbhedāḥ ca liṃgāḥ ca catura aśīti saṃkhyakāḥ kṣetrāṇi kṣetrapālāḥ ca ṛddhiḥ siddhiḥ tathā eva ca  /

original: pitaro lokapālāśca siddhāḥ siddhipradāśca ye | ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgā ṛṣipatnyo'malāśayāḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: pitaraḥ lokapālāḥ ca siddhāḥ siddhi pradāḥ ca ye ṛṣayaḥ ca mahābhāgāḥ ṛṣi patnyaḥ amala āśayāḥ

original: kiṃnarā devagandharvā hyapsarāśca varāṃganāḥ | marudgaṇāśca ye sarve sādhakānāṃ gaṇāśca ye || 7 ||
analyzed: kiṃnarāḥ deva gandharvāḥ hi apsarāḥ ca vara aṃganāḥ marut gaṇāḥ ca ye sarve sādhakānām gaṇāḥ ca ye

original: yakṣā guhyakasaṃghāśca piśācoragarākṣasāḥ | sthāvarā jaṃgamāḥ sarve dhyānaṃ mānasamāśritāḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: yakṣāḥ guhyaka saṃghāḥ ca piśāca uraga rākṣasāḥ sthāvarāḥ jaṃgamāḥ sarve dhyānam mānasam āśritāḥ  /

original: upāsāṃcakrire tatra devadevamumāpatim | tāndṛṣṭvā sā tadā devī pārvatī girijā tadā | uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā śaṃkaraṃ jagadāśrayam || 9 ||
analyzed: upāsāṃcakrire tatra devadevam umāpatim  tān dṛṣṭvā sā tadā devī pārvatī girijā tadā  uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā śaṃkaram jagat āśrayam

original: pārvatyuvāca | devadeva jagannātha jagadādhāratatpara | paśya etānmahābhāgāndhyāyamānāṃstavāśritān || 10 ||
analyzed: pārvatī uvāca devadeva jagannātha jagat ādhāra tatpara paśya etān mahābhāgān dhyāyamānān tava āśritān

original: nānupekṣyāśca tānsarvānvātavarṣātapārditān | kalpaya tvaṃ mahā bhāga eteṣāmātmano hitam || 11 ||
analyzed: na anupekṣyāḥ ca tān sarvān vāta varṣa ātapa arditān kalpaya tvam mahā bhāgaḥ eteṣām ātmanaḥ hitam  /

original: yathāyogyaṃ vāsanārthaṃ sthānaṃ paramaśobhanam | purīṃ kalpaya me nātha vāsārthaṃ sarvakāmadām || 12 ||
analyzed: yathāyogyam vāsanā artham sthānam parama śobhanam purīm kalpaya me nātha vāsa artham sarva kāma dām   /

original: eṣā me vāsanā svāminbhavatāṃ yadi rocate | iti śrutvā vacastasyāḥ pārvatyāḥ parameśvaraḥ | kalpayāmāsa purīṃ ramyāṃ sarvabhūtamanoramām || 13 ||
analyzed: eṣā me vāsanā svāmin bhavatām yadi rocate iti śrutvā vacaḥ tasyāḥ pārvatyāḥ parameśvaraḥ kalpayāmāsa purīm ramyām sarva bhūta manoramām

original: ātmanopi hitāṃ puṇyāṃ śaṃbhuḥ sarvātmanā tadā | bahuyojanavistīrṇāṃ divyāṃ divyajanapriyām || 14 ||
analyzed: ātmanaḥ upi hitām puṇyām śaṃbhuḥ sarva ātmanā tadā bahu yojana vistīrṇām divyām divya jana priyām  /

original: divyābhiprāyasaṃyuktāṃ divyasthānamanoramām | divyasarvaguṇopetā viśālāṃ virajāṃ śubhām || 15 ||
analyzed: divya abhiprāya saṃyuktām divya sthāna manoramām  divya sarva guṇa upetā viśālām virajām śubhām

original: krayavikrayasaṃpannahaṭṭāṭṭālakacatvarām | bahuharmyagṛhākīrṇāṃ saudhapaṃktivirājitām || 16 ||
analyzed: kraya vikraya saṃpanna haṭṭa aṭṭālaka catvarām bahu harmya gṛha ākīrṇām saudha paṃkti virājitām

original: sphāṭikābhittiracitāṃ vaiḍūryamaṇibhūmikām | pravālastaṃbhapravarāṃ hemābharaṇasaṃbharām || 17 ||
analyzed: sphāṭikā bhitti racitām vaiḍūrya maṇi bhūmikām pravāla staṃbha pravarām hema ābharaṇa saṃbharām

original: āraktamaṇidehalyāṃ dvāraśākhābhimaṃḍitām | jāṃbūnadakapāṭāḍhyāṃ vajrārgalasusaṃskṛtām || 18 ||
analyzed: ārakta maṇi dehalyām dvāra śākhā abhimaṃḍitām jāṃbūnada kapāṭa āḍhyām vajra argala susaṃskṛtām

original: maṇiratnasamābhūmidvārājiragṛhāṃtarām | ghoṣajālātiramyāṃ ca muktādāmavilaṃbinīm || 19 ||
analyzed: maṇi ratna samā bhūmi dvāra ajira gṛha aṃtarām ghoṣa jāla ati ramyām ca muktā dāma vilaṃbinīm  /

original: hemastaṃ bhadhvajopetāḥ patākāśca gṛhegṛhe | kalaśāśca virājaṃte maṇihemācitā gṛhe || 20 ||
analyzed: hema stam bha dhvaja upetāḥ patākāḥ ca gṛhe gṛhe kalaśāḥ ca virājaṃte maṇi hema ācitāḥ gṛhe

original: vāpīkūpataḍāgāni sarāṃsi vimalāni ca | padmakiṃjalkagaṃdhīni jalayaṃtropaśobhitām || 21 ||
analyzed: vāpī kūpa taḍāgāni sarāṃsi vimalāni ca padma kiṃjalka gaṃdhīni jalayaṃtra upaśobhitām

original: haṃsakāraṃḍavākīrṇāṃ śikhaṃḍigaṇaśobhitām | jalayaṃtrakṛtādhārāṃ gṛhavāpīvanākarām || 22 ||
analyzed: haṃsa kāraṃḍava ākīrṇām śikhaṃḍi gaṇa śobhitām jalayaṃtra kṛta ādhārām gṛha vāpī vana ākarām

original: kvacinnṛtyaṃti mayūrāḥ kvacitkūjaṃti kokilāḥ | bhramarāvalīḍhapuṣpāḍhyastabakā vanarājayaḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: kvacid nṛtyaṃti mayūrāḥ kvacid kūjaṃti kokilāḥ bhramara avalīḍha puṣpa āḍhya stabakāḥ vana rājayaḥ

original: naranārīgaṇākīrṇāṃ varṇāśramaniṣevitām | harmyāṃtarāgatā nāryo vilokanaparā babhuḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: nara nārī gaṇa ākīrṇām varṇa āśrama niṣevitām harmya antara āgatāḥ nāryaḥ vilokana parāḥ babhuḥ  /

original: caṃdramālākṛtaśreṇītoraṇānīva ca śobhate | evaṃ vyāsa purī ramyā ātmayogena vāsitā || 25 ||
analyzed: caṃdra mālā kṛta śreṇī toraṇāni iva ca śobhate evam vyāsa purī ramyā ātma yogena vāsitā   /

original: yatrālakāpurī ramyā kuberabhavanāṃkitā | dhavalā puṇyajanaiḥ kīrṇā pakṣibhiścopaśobhitā || 26 ||
analyzed: yatra alakā purī ramyā kubera bhavana aṃkitā dhavalā puṇya janaiḥ kīrṇā pakṣibhiḥ ca upaśobhitā  /

original: tatra bhogavatī divyā varuṇālaya uttamaḥ | nāgakanyābhirugrābhi rnāgapatnībhiḥ saṃkulā || 27 ||
analyzed: tatra bhogavatī divyā varuṇālayaḥ uttamaḥ nāga kanyābhiḥ ugrābhiḥ nāga patnībhiḥ saṃkulā  /

original: saṃyamanīpurī śreṣṭhā dharmarājena pālitā | sadācārajanaiḥ pūrṇā kṛtā kṛtavicakṣaṇaiḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: saṃyamanī purī śreṣṭhā dharmarājena pālitā sat ācāra janaiḥ pūrṇā kṛtā kṛta vicakṣaṇaiḥ

original: devatānāṃ purī ramyā vāsavenābhirakṣitā | puṇyastrīṇāṃ gaṇākīrṇā kinnarodgītamaṃḍitā || 29 ||
analyzed: devatānām purī ramyā vāsavena abhirakṣitā puṇya strīṇām gaṇa ākīrṇā kinnara udgīta maṃḍitā

original: evaṃvidhāni ramyāṇi purā bahutarāṇi ca | bahuvistīrṇamānāni śubhrā ṇyatitarāṇi ca || 30 ||
analyzed: evaṃvidhāni ramyāṇi purā bahutarāṇi ca bahu vistīrṇa mānāni śubhrāṇi atitarāṇi ca

original: kvacidraṃbhākṛtadvārā yavāṃkuraghaṭāḥ śubhāḥ | kvacidgāyanti gandharvāḥ kvacinnṛtyaṃti nartakāḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: kvacid raṃbhā kṛta dvārāḥ yava aṃkura ghaṭāḥ śubhāḥ kvacid gāyanti gandharvāḥ kvacid nṛtyaṃti nartakāḥ   /

original: kvacidbālāḥ paṭhaṃti sma vedādhyayanakā dvijāḥ | kvacidyajñānyajaṃti sma yajamānāḥ saṛtvijaḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: kvacid bālāḥ paṭhaṃti sma veda adhyayanakāḥ dvijāḥ kvacid yajñān yajaṃti sma yajamānāḥ sa ṛtvijaḥ

original: kvaciccāvabhṛthasnātāḥ kvaciddānānyakurvata | kvacitkvacittūpanayanaṃ vivāhāgniparigraham || 33 ||
analyzed: kvacid ca avabhṛtha snātāḥ kvacid dānāni akurvata kvacid kvacid tu upanayanam vivāha agni parigraham

original: kvacidārāmapūrtaṃ vai kvacidyātrāvadhāraṇam | vāpīkūpataḍāgānāṃ tathaiva vidhipūrvakam || 34 ||
analyzed: kvacid ārāma pūrtam vai kvacid yātrā avadhāraṇam vāpī kūpa taḍāgānām tathā eva vidhi pūrvakam

original: kvacitkathāprasaṃgāṃśca pariśaṃsaṃti vācakāḥ | kvacidgāthāḥ prakurvaṃti kavayaḥ pura uttame || 35 ||
analyzed: kvacid kathā prasaṃgān ca pariśaṃsaṃti vācakāḥ kvacid gāthāḥ prakurvaṃti kavayaḥ pure uttame

original: kvacinmallā niyudhyaṃte naṭā nāṭyaparāḥ kvacit | taḍāgāni virājaṃte maṇisopānapaṃktibhiḥ || 36 ||
analyzed: kvacid mallāḥ niyudhyaṃte naṭāḥ nāṭya parāḥ kvacid taḍāgāni virājaṃte maṇi sopāna paṃktibhiḥ

original: caṃcalāścapalā bālāḥ śyāmāḥ ṣoḍaśavārṣikāḥ | vārihāraparāstatra maṇihemaghaṭotkaṭāḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: caṃcalāḥ capalāḥ bālāḥ śyāmāḥ ṣoḍaśa vārṣikāḥ vāri hāra parāḥ tatra maṇi hema ghaṭa utkaṭāḥ

original: evaṃ vyāsa purī ramyā nirmitā yogamāyayā | śaṃbhunā sarvapāpaghnī priyāpriyacikīrṣayā || 38 ||
analyzed: evam vyāsa purī ramyā nirmitā yoga māyayā śaṃbhunā sarva pāpa ghnī priya apriya cikīrṣayā  /

original: viśālā bahuvistīrṇā puṇyā puṇyajanāśrayā | tasmātsarveṣu kāleṣu sarvalokeṣu gīyate || 39 ||
analyzed: viśālā bahu vistīrṇā puṇyā puṇya jana āśrayā tasmāt sarveṣu kāleṣu sarva lokeṣu gīyate

original: viśāleti samākhyātā purī ramyā sanātanī | yatratatra sthito vāpi sarvāvasthāṃ gato'pi vā || 40 ||
analyzed: viśālā iti samākhyātā purī ramyā sanātanī yatra tatra sthitaḥ vā api sarva avasthām gataḥ api vā

original: viśāleti vadennityaṃ śivaloke mahīyate | īdṛśī na purīvyāsa bhuvi brahmāṃḍagolake || 41 ||
analyzed: viśālā iti vadet nityam śiva loke mahīyate īdṛśī na purī vyāsa bhuvi brahmāṃḍa golake

original: viśālā sadṛśī cānyā bhuktimuktipradā nṛṇām | pitṝnuddiśya kurvaṃti śrāddhaṃ kāle narā yadi || 42 ||
analyzed: viśālā sadṛśī ca anyā bhukti mukti pradā nṛṇām pitṝn uddiśya kurvaṃti śrāddham kāle narāḥ yadi

original: tadakṣayaṃ bhavetteṣāṃ pitṛkalpe ca gīyate | snānadānādikaṃ yaistu viśālāyāṃ prasaṃgataḥ || 43 ||
analyzed: tat akṣayam bhavet teṣām pitṛkalpe ca gīyate snāna dāna ādikam yaiḥ tu viśālāyām prasaṃgataḥ

original: yatra kutra gatāste vai mṛtā yāṃti śivālayam | dhanyāḥ puṇyatamā loke prītiryeṣāṃ sadācalā || 44 ||
analyzed: yatra kutra gatāḥ te vai mṛtāḥ yānti śiva ālayam  dhanyāḥ puṇyatamāḥ loke prītiḥ yeṣām sadā acalā

original: viśālāyāṃ phalaṃ śaśvaccheṣaḥ śakto na varṇitum | kathāśravaṇamātreṇa vācyamānena tatkṣaṇāt | mahāpāpodbhavātpāpānmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 45 ||
analyzed: viśālāyām phalam śaśvat śeṣaḥ śaktaḥ na varṇitum kathā śravaṇa mātreṇa vācyamānena tad kṣaṇāt mahā pāpa udbhavāt pāpāt mucyate na atra saṃśayaḥ

original: evaṃ vyāsa purī jātā viśālā ca kuśasthalī | pratikalpā yathā jātā tathā me śṛṇu bhāṣataḥ || 46 ||
analyzed: evam vyāsa purī jātā viśālā ca kuśasthalī pratikalpā yathā jātā tathā me śṛṇu bhāṣataḥ  /

original: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetra māhātmye viśālābhidhānakathanaṃnāma saptacatvāriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 47 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skānde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe avantī kṣetra māhātmye viśālābhidhānakathanam nāma saptacatvāriṃśaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | śṛṇuṣvāvahito vyāsa sthitimekāgramānasaḥ | mayā vyāsamukhātprāptā kalpabhede kathā śubhā || 1 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca śṛṇuṣva avahitaḥ vyāsa sthitim ekāgra mānasaḥ mayā vyāsa mukhāt prāptā kalpabhede kathā śubhā   /

original: guhyādguhyatarā śreṣṭhā na deyā yasya kasyacit | nāstikāya kṛtaghnāya nāśiṣyāya kadācana || 2 ||
analyzed: guhyāt guhyatarā śreṣṭhā na deyā yasya kasyacid nāstikāya kṛtaghnāya na a śiṣyāya kadācana

original: eṣā puṇyatamā vyāsa kathā pāpaharā parā | yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa kalpadoṣo na bādhate || 3 ||
analyzed: eṣā puṇyatamā vyāsa kathā pāpa harā parā yasyāḥ śravaṇa mātreṇa kalpa doṣaḥ na bādhate  /

original: pramāṇaṃ kalpaparyaṃtaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ | manvaṃtareṣu sarveṣu kalpakalpāṃtareṣu ca || 4 ||
analyzed: pramāṇam kalpa paryaṃtam brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ manvaṃtareṣu sarveṣu kalpa kalpa aṃtareṣu ca

original: yāvatsaṃkhyā parimitā tāvatī śṛṇu sattama | ahorātraṃ ca bhajate sūryo mānuṣadaivatam || 5 ||
analyzed: yāvat saṃkhyā parimitā tāvatī śṛṇu sattama ahorātram ca bhajate sūryaḥ mānuṣa daivatam

original: tāmupādāya gaṇanāṃ śṛṇu saṃkhyā dvijottama | nimeṣaiḥ paṃcadaśabhiḥ kāṣṭhā triṃśattu tāḥ kalā || 6 ||
analyzed: tām upādāya gaṇanām śṛṇu saṃkhyā dvijottama nimeṣaiḥ paṃcadaśabhiḥ kāṣṭhā triṃśat tu tāḥ kalā  /

original: triṃśatkalā muhūrtastu triṃśatā tairmanīṣiṇaḥ | ahorātra miti prāhuścaṃdrādityagatistadā || 7 ||
analyzed: triṃśat kalāḥ muhūrtaḥ tu triṃśatā taiḥ manīṣiṇaḥ ahorātra m iti prāhuḥ caṃdra āditya gatiḥ tadā

original: ravirgativiśeṣeṇa sandhyāyāṃ yāti nityaśaḥ | tadahastu manuṣyāṇāṃ rātriścaiva tu tādṛśī || 8 ||
analyzed: raviḥ gati viśeṣeṇa sandhyāyām yāti nityaśas tat ahar tu manuṣyāṇām rātriḥ ca eva tu tādṛśī

original: pakṣau māsā ṛtuścābdamayane ca prakīrtite | pitṝṇāṃ caiva devānāṃ brahmaṇaśca yathātatham || 9 ||
analyzed: pakṣau māsāḥ ṛtuḥ ca abdam ayane ca prakīrtite pitṝṇām ca eva devānām brahmaṇaḥ ca yathātatham

original: yāvatsaṃkhyā samākhyātā āyuraṃtaśca tādṛśaḥ | ahorātrāḥ paṃcadaśa pakṣa ityabhiśabditaḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: yāvat saṃkhyā samākhyātā āyuḥ aṃtaḥ ca tādṛśaḥ ahorātrāḥ paṃcadaśa pakṣaḥ iti abhiśabditaḥ   /

original: pakṣau dvau tau kṛtau māsau māsau dvāvṛturucyate | ayanaṃ cartubhistribhirabdaṃ dve ayane smṛtam || 11 ||
analyzed: pakṣau dvau tau kṛtau māsau māsau dvau ṛtuḥ ucyate ayanam ca ṛtubhiḥ tribhiḥ abdam dve ayane smṛtam

original: dakṣiṇaṃ cottaraṃ caiva saṃkhyātattvaviśāradaiḥ | mānenānena yo māsaḥ pakṣadvayasamanvitaḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: dakṣiṇam ca uttaram ca eva saṃkhyā tattva viśāradaiḥ mānena anena yaḥ māsaḥ pakṣa dvaya samanvitaḥ

original: pitṝṇāṃ tadahorātramiti kālavido viduḥ | śukla pakṣastvahasteṣāṃ kṛṣṇapakṣastu śarvarī || 13 ||
analyzed: pitṝṇām tat ahorātram iti kāla vidaḥ viduḥ śukla pakṣaḥ tu ahar teṣām kṛṣṇa pakṣaḥ tu śarvarī  /

original: kṛṣṇapakṣe tviha śrāddhaṃ pitṝṇāṃ vartate dvija | mānuṣeṇa tu mānena yo vai saṃvatsaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 14 ||

original: kṛtaprāṃjalayaḥ sarve devā iṃdrapurogamāḥ | stutiṃ kṛtvā mahāviṣṇoḥ satataṃ purataḥ sthitāḥ || 62 ||
analyzed: kṛta prāṃjalayaḥ sarve devāḥ iṃdra purogamāḥ stutim kṛtvā mahā viṣṇoḥ satatam puratas sthitāḥ

original: devadeva jagannātha puṇyaśravaṇakīrtana | kiṃ dānaṃ kiṃ tapaḥ puṇyaṃ kiṃ tīrthaṃ kā ca devatā || 63 ||
analyzed: devadeva jagannātha puṇya śravaṇa kīrtana kim dānam kim tapaḥ puṇyam kim tīrtham kā ca devatā  /

original: yena puṇyaprabhāvena punaḥ svargo hyavāpsyate | etanniścitya no brūhi sarvaṃ guhyataraṃ vibho || 64 ||
analyzed: yena puṇya prabhāvena punar svargaḥ hi avāpsyate etat niścitya naḥ brūhi sarvam guhyataram vibho

original: viṣṇuruvāca | śṛṇudhvaṃ bhoḥ surāḥ sarve yuṣmākaṃ siddhikāraṇam | guhyādguhyataraṃ puṇyaṃ mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 65 ||
analyzed: viṣṇuḥ uvāca śṛṇudhvam bhoḥ surāḥ sarve yuṣmākam siddhi kāraṇam guhyāt guhyataram puṇyam mahākāla vanam śubham

original: mama dehodbhavā śiprā yatra līnā payasvinī | nīlagaṃgā saricchreṣṭhā yatra prācī sarasvatī || 66 ||
analyzed: mama deha udbhavā śiprā yatra līnā payasvinī  nīlagaṃgā sarit śreṣṭhā yatra prācī sarasvatī

original: puṣkaraṃ ca gayātīrthaṃ puruṣottamasaraḥ śubham | tatraiva gacchata kṣipra punarlokānavāpsyatha || 67 ||
analyzed: puṣkaram ca gayā tīrtham puruṣottama saraḥ śubham tatra eva gacchata kṣipra punar lokān avāpsyatha  /

original: iti śrutvā paraṃ vākyaṃ devadevajagadguroḥ | tatra devagaṇāḥ sarve brahmaśakrapurogamāḥ || 68 ||
analyzed: iti śrutvā param vākyam devadeva jagadguroḥ  tatra deva gaṇāḥ sarve brahma śakra purogamāḥ

original: mahākālavane ramye yatra śiprā saridvarā | snānadānādikaṃ kṛtvā śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathocitam || 69 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vane ramye yatra śiprā sarit varā snāna dāna ādikam kṛtvā śrāddham kṛtvā yathocitam  /

original: tena puṇyaprabhāvena svakāṃllokāngatāḥ surāḥ | evaṃ vyāsa samākhyātā śiprā vai lokapāvanī || 70 ||
analyzed: tena puṇya prabhāvena svakān lokān gatāḥ surāḥ  evam vyāsa samākhyātā śiprā vai loka pāvanī  /

original: jātaṃ saro varāhasya viṣṇoratulatejasaḥ | yasya darśanamātreṇa brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 71 ||
analyzed: jātam saraḥ varāhasya viṣṇoḥ atula tejasaḥ yasya darśana mātreṇa brahmahatyām vyapohati  /

original: atra snātvā payaḥ pītvā śrāddhaṃ kṛtvā yathocitam | payasvinīṃ ca gāṃ dattvā viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 72 ||
analyzed: atra snātvā payaḥ pītvā śrāddham kṛtvā yathocitam payasvinīm ca gām dattvā viṣṇu loke mahīyate

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni tāni sarvāṇi suvrata | avaṃtyāṃ sundare tīrthe tiṣṭhaṃti sarvadā bhuvi || 1 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca pṛthivyām yāni tīrthāni tāni sarvāṇi suvrata avantyām sundare tīrthe tiṣṭhaṃti sarvadā bhuvi

original: vyāsa uvāca | kimidaṃ sundaraṃ kuṇḍaṃ kadākāle'bhavatkṣitau | nirmitaṃ kena ko devaḥ kiṃ vā tasya phalaṃ smṛtam || 2 ||
analyzed: vyāsaḥ uvāca kim idam sundaram kuṇḍam kadā kāle abhavat kṣitau nirmitam kena kaḥ devaḥ kim vā tasya phalam smṛtam

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | śṛṇu puṇyatame kṣetre sundarākhyaṃ yadā 'bhavat | sarvapāpapraśamanaṃ vāṃchitārthaphalapradam || 3 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca śṛṇu puṇyatame kṣetre sundara ākhyam yadā abhavat sarva pāpa praśamanam vāṃchita artha phala pradam   /

original: yasya śravaṇamātreṇa brahmahatyā vyapohati | aśvamedhādikaṃ puṇyaṃ vājapeyaśa tādhikam || 4 ||
analyzed: yasya śravaṇa mātreṇa brahmahatyā vyapohati aśvamedha ādikam puṇyam vājapeya śa ta adhikam

original: purā kalpakṣaye vyāsa naṣṭakalpā ca medinī | pracaṇḍavātavarṣābhyāṃ cūrṇito meruparvataḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: purā kalpa kṣaye vyāsa naṣṭa kalpā ca medinī pracaṇḍa vāta varṣābhyām cūrṇitaḥ meru parvataḥ  /

original: tadātra patitaṃ vyāsa vaikuṇṭhaśikharottamam | mahākālavane ghore guhye cāvyayake dhruve || 6 ||
analyzed: tadā atra patitam vyāsa vaikuṇṭha śikhara uttamam mahākāla vane ghore guhye ca avyayake dhruve

original: tatkṣaṇātpatite śṛṃge kuṇḍaṃ jātaṃ suniścitam | ratnasopānamacchodaṃ muktāsaikatapūritam || 7 ||
analyzed: tad kṣaṇāt patite śṛṃge kuṇḍam jātam su niścitam ratna sopānam accha udam muktā saikata pūritam

original: jāṃbūnadakarārohaṃ hemapadmavirājitam | kalpadrumakṛtacchāyaṃ ciṃtāmaṇisamucchritam || 8 ||
analyzed: jāṃbūnada kara āroham hema padma virājitam kalpadruma kṛta chāyam ciṃtāmaṇi samucchritam  /

original: haṃsakāraṃḍavākīrṇaṃ cakravākopaśobhitam | bījauṣadhigaṇākīrṇaṃ sarvatattvābhisaṃyutam || 9 ||
analyzed: haṃsa kāraṃḍava ākīrṇam cakravāka upaśobhitam bīja oṣadhi gaṇa ākīrṇam sarva tattva abhisaṃyutam

original: kalpakṣaye na kṣīyaṃte yāni tattvāni sarvaśaḥ | tāni tatra pratiṣṭhaṃti mūrtimaṃti parāṇi ca || 10 ||
analyzed: kalpa kṣaye na kṣīyaṃte yāni tattvāni sarvaśas tāni tatra pratiṣṭhaṃti mūrtimaṃti parāṇi ca  /

original: vedaśāstrapurāṇāni gāthāgītikṣarākṣarāḥ | oṃkāraśca vaṣaṭkāro gāyatrī tripadā parā || 11 ||
analyzed: veda śāstra purāṇāni gāthā gīti kṣara akṣarāḥ oṃkāraḥ ca vaṣaṭkāraḥ gāyatrī tripadā parā

original: kalāḥ kāṣṭhā muhūrtāśca lavatruṭipalaṃ ghaṭiḥ | aharniśaśca yāmāśca pakṣamāsāvṛtustathā || 12 ||
analyzed: kalāḥ kāṣṭhāḥ muhūrtāḥ ca lava truṭi palam ghaṭiḥ ahar niśaḥ ca yāmāḥ ca pakṣa māsau ṛtuḥ tathā

original: saṃvatsarayugāścaiva kuṇḍe tiṣṭhaṃti mūrtitaḥ | devā yakṣāśca nāgāśca guhyakāḥ kinnarāstathā || 13 ||
analyzed: saṃvatsara yugāḥ ca eva kuṇḍe tiṣṭhanti mūrtitaḥ devāḥ yakṣāḥ ca nāgāḥ ca guhyakāḥ kinnarāḥ tathā

original: gaṃdharvāpsaraso yakṣāḥ siddhāḥ kiṃpuruṣāstathā | upāsāṃcakrire tasya kalpadoṣabhayāturāḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: gaṃdharva apsarasaḥ yakṣāḥ siddhāḥ kiṃpuruṣāḥ tathā upāsāṃcakrire tasya kalpa doṣa bhaya āturāḥ

original: brahmā rudraśca kālaśca lokapālā mahaujasaḥ | keciddhyānaparāḥ siddhāstāpasāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: brahmā rudraḥ ca kālaḥ ca lokapālāḥ mahā ojasaḥ kecid dhyāna parāḥ siddhāḥ tāpasāḥ śaṃsita vratāḥ

original: tiṣṭhaṃti bahuyuga vyāsa yāvatkalpaḥ samāpyate | sudarśanasamākāraṃ pūritaṃ cāmṛtāṃbubhiḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: tiṣṭhanti bahu yuga vyāsa yāvat kalpaḥ samāpyate sudarśana sama ākāram pūritam ca amṛta aṃbubhiḥ   /

original: divyapādapasaṃyuktaṃ pārijātaguṇānvitam | divyastrīsnānagaṃdhodairvāsitodgārisaurabham || 17 ||
analyzed: divya pādapa saṃyuktam pārijāta guṇa anvitam  divya strī snāna gaṃdha udaiḥ vāsita udgāri saurabham

original: kvacinmayūrā nṛtyaṃti kvacitkūjaṃti kokilāḥ | kvacitkekāravāḥ kvāpi meghaghoṣasamākulam || 18 ||
analyzed: kvacid mayūrāḥ nṛtyaṃti kvacid kūjaṃti kokilāḥ kvacid kekā ravāḥ kvāpi megha ghoṣa samākulam

original: sundaraṃ sundarākāraṃ sundaraṃ tena cocyate | bahupuṇyakaraṃ vyāsa sarvapāpaharaṃ param || 19 ||
analyzed: sundaram sundara ākāram sundaram tena ca ucyate bahu puṇya karam vyāsa sarva pāpa haram param

original: yatra saṃnihito viṣṇuḥ śivaḥ śaktyā yuto vaśī | upāsāṃcakrire śaśvatsarvakāleṣu sarvadā || 20 ||
analyzed: yatra saṃnihitaḥ viṣṇuḥ śivaḥ śaktyā yutaḥ vaśī  upāsāṃcakrire śaśvat sarva kāleṣu sarvadā

original: pakṣārdhaṃ pakṣamekaṃ ca sundarakuṇḍe naro vaset | vaikuṇṭhe niyataṃ vāso yāvatkalpaśataṃ bhavet || 21 ||
analyzed: pakṣa ardham pakṣam ekam ca sundara kuṇḍe naraḥ vaset vaikuṇṭhe niyatam vāsaḥ yāvat kalpa śatam bhavet

original: pakṣikīṭapataṃgāśca mṛtā yāṃti śivālayam | kiṃ punarmānavā loke snānapūtāśca tatra vai || 22 ||
analyzed: pakṣi kīṭa pataṃgāḥ ca mṛtāḥ yānti śiva ālayam  kim punar mānavāḥ loke snāna pūtāḥ ca tatra vai  /

original: ye dadati tilāndhenuṃ gajavā jirathāvanīḥ | dāsīrdāsānsuvarṇaṃ ca ratnāni vividhāni ca || 23 ||
analyzed: ye dadati tilān dhenum dāsīḥ dāsān suvarṇam ca ratnāni vividhāni ca

original: śayyādānavimānāni dānāni vividhāni ca | na teṣāṃ dānajaṃ vedmi kīdṛgvyāsa phalaṃ bhavet || 24 ||
analyzed: śayyā dāna vimānāni dānāni vividhāni ca  na teṣām dāna jam vedmi kīdṛś vyāsa phalam bhavet  /

original: bhūyaḥ śṛṇu paraṃ vyāsa sundarakuṇḍaphalaṃ smṛtam | ekadā bahupāpena patitaḥ pāpayoniṣu || 25 ||
analyzed: bhūyas śṛṇu param vyāsa sundara kuṇḍa phalam smṛtam ekadā bahu pāpena patitaḥ pāpa yoniṣu

original: piśāco mokṣamāpannaḥ śiva rūpadharo gataḥ | piśācamocane snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram || 26 ||
analyzed: piśācaḥ mokṣam āpannaḥ śiva rūpa dharaḥ gataḥ piśācamocane snātvā dṛṣṭvā devam maheśvaram

original: mucyate sarvapāpebhyo yadyapi brahmahā bhavet || 27 ||
analyzed: mucyate sarva pāpebhyaḥ yadi api brahma hā bhavet

original: vyāsa uvāca | ko'sau piśāca iti khyātaḥ kiṃ tena duṣkṛtaṃ kṛtam | yena pāpaprasaṃgena piśācatvamupāgataḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: vyāsaḥ uvāca kaḥ asau piśācaḥ iti khyātaḥ kim tena duṣkṛtam kṛtam yena pāpa prasaṃgena piśāca tvam upāgataḥ   /

original: kathaṃ tīrthaprasaṃgo'sya jāto vai dvija sattama | etadveditumicchāmi tvatto brahmavidāṃvara || 29 ||
analyzed: katham tīrtha prasaṃgaḥ asya jātaḥ vai dvija sattama etat veditum icchāmi tvattaḥ brahma vidām vara

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | śṛṇu vyāsa mahākhyānaṃ tīrthamāhātmyamuttamam | yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpakṣayo bhavet || 30 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca śṛṇu vyāsa mahā ākhyānam tīrtha māhātmyam uttamam yasya śravaṇa mātreṇa sarva pāpa kṣayaḥ bhavet

original: brāhmaṇo devalo nāma dākṣiṇātyo dvijādhamaḥ | sadā pāparato lobhī kūṭasākṣī ca laṃpaṭaḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ devalaḥ nāma dākṣiṇātyaḥ dvija adhamaḥ sadā pāpa rataḥ lobhī kūṭa sākṣī ca laṃpaṭaḥ  /

original: gurudrohī kitavo dhūrto guruhā gurutalpagaḥ | hemahārī surāpī ca brahmahā svāmidrohakaḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: guru drohī kitavaḥ dhūrtaḥ guru hā guru talpa gaḥ hema hārī surāpī ca brahma hā svāmi drohakaḥ

original: abhakṣyabhakṣakaścaiva vedaśāstravivarjitaḥ | anekajanmārjitapāpī sarvadharmabahiṣkṛtaḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: abhakṣya bhakṣakaḥ ca eva veda śāstra vivarjitaḥ aneka janma arjita pāpī sarva dharma bahiṣkṛtaḥ  /

original: viśvāsaghātako mānī corasaṃgarataḥ khalaḥ | deśāṃtaragato maṃdaścaurakāryārthasādhakaḥ || 34 ||
analyzed: viśvāsa ghātakaḥ mānī cora saṃgarataḥ khalaḥ deśa aṃtara gataḥ maṃdaḥ caura kārya artha sādhakaḥ   /

original: bahavo nihatā mārge pāpācāreṇa jaṃtavaḥ | magadhe sa gato duṣṭaḥ prasaṃgātpāpakāriṇām || 35 ||
analyzed: bahavaḥ nihatāḥ mārge pāpa ācāreṇa jaṃtavaḥ magadhe sa gataḥ duṣṭaḥ prasaṃgāt pāpa kāriṇām   /

original: tatraiko brāhmaṇo dāṃto vedavedāṃgapāragaḥ | sāgnikaḥ śuddhasattvastho brahmakarmarataḥ sadā || 36 ||
analyzed: tatra ekaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ dāṃtaḥ veda vedāṃga pāragaḥ sa agnikaḥ śuddha sattva sthaḥ brahma karma rataḥ sadā

original: śvaśuragṛhe sthitā bhāryā tāmādāya yaśasvinīm | calito yānamāruhya tena pāpena ghātitaḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: śvaśura gṛhe sthitā bhāryā tām ādāya yaśasvinīm calitaḥ yānam āruhya tena pāpena ghātitaḥ  /

original: tasya strī ca varārohā rūpalāvaṇyaśālinī | pativratā mahābhāgā dṛḍhacittā śucismitā || 38 ||
analyzed: tasya strī ca varārohā rūpa lāvaṇya śālinī pativratā mahābhāgā dṛḍha cittā śuci smitā

original: hate bhartari duḥkhārtā pativirahakātarā | vane ghore paribhraṣṭā kāṣṭhānyādāya bhāminī || 39 ||
analyzed: hate bhartari duḥkha ārtā pati viraha kātarā vane ghore paribhraṣṭā kāṣṭhāni ādāya bhāminī

original: āruroha citāṃ dīptāṃ patinā hṛṣṭamānasā | sa ca duṣṭataraḥ sarvaṃ tasya viprasya jīvanam || 40 ||
analyzed: āruroha citām dīptām patinā hṛṣṭa mānasā sa ca duṣṭataraḥ sarvam tasya viprasya jīvanam  /

original: gṛhītvā calito mārge gṛhīto rājakiṃkaraiḥ | baṃdhayitvā ca taiḥ sarvaistena vittena vai saha | nīto'sau rājabhavanaṃ nivedito rājasaṃnidhau || 41 ||
analyzed: gṛhītvā calitaḥ mārge gṛhītaḥ rāja kiṃkaraiḥ baṃdhayitvā ca taiḥ sarvaiḥ tena vittena vai saha nītaḥ asau rāja bhavanam niveditaḥ rāja saṃnidhau  /

original: pātito vai gale baddhvā rajjunā vṛkṣakoṭare | cāṃḍālairghṛṣṭito bhūmāvitastataḥ śvapākibhiḥ || 42 ||
analyzed: pātitaḥ vai gale baddhvā rajjunā vṛkṣa koṭare cāṃḍālaiḥ ghṛṣṭitaḥ bhūmau itas tatas śvapākibhiḥ

original: tena karmavipākena rauravaṃ narakaṃ gataḥ | ṣaṣṭivarṣasahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyāṃ kṛmitāṃ gataḥ || 43 ||
analyzed: tena karma vipākena rauravam narakam gataḥ ṣaṣṭi varṣa sahasrāṇi viṣṭhāyām kṛmi tām gataḥ

original: tato'nyaṃ narakaṃ prāpto yamaśāsanakārakaiḥ | asipatravanaṃ ghoramāyasaṃ taptasāyakam || 44 ||
analyzed: tatas anyam narakam prāptaḥ yama śāsana kārakaiḥ asipatravanam ghoram āyasam tapta sāyakam

original: mudgaraistāḍyamāno hi śṛṃkhalābhiśca kiṃkaraiḥ | kuṃbhīpākagatau rauti vaitaraṇyāṃ supīḍitaḥ || 45 ||
analyzed: mudgaraiḥ tāḍyamānaḥ hi śṛṃkhalābhiḥ ca kiṃkaraiḥ kuṃbhīpāka gatau rauti vaitaraṇyām su pīḍitaḥ  /

original: evaṃ bahuvidhānkuṇḍānbhuktvā pāpī navānnavān | tataḥ pretatvamāpanno yugānāṃ paṃcasaptatim || 46 ||
analyzed: evam bahuvidhān kuṇḍān bhuktvā pāpī navān navān tatas preta tvam āpannaḥ yugānām paṃca saptatim

original: mahākāyo mahārāvo mahodaraḥ sūcīmukhaḥ | kṣuttṛḍbhyāṃ ca parākrāṃto marudeśaṃ samāśritaḥ || 47 ||
analyzed: mahākāyaḥ mahārāvaḥ mahodaraḥ sūcīmukhaḥ kṣudh tṛḍbhyām ca parākrāṃtaḥ maru deśam samāśritaḥ  /

original: tataḥ kaṣṭatarāṃ prāpya paiśācīṃ tanumāśritaḥ | kuṭilo duṣṭabhāvaśca duṣṭacārī digaṃbaraḥ || 48 ||
analyzed: tatas kaṣṭatarām prāpya paiśācīm tanum āśritaḥ kuṭilaḥ duṣṭa bhāvaḥ ca duṣṭa cārī digaṃbaraḥ

original: viṇmūtradūṣitocchiṣṭapūtiparyuṣṭabhojanaḥ | śmaśānocchiṣṭabhojī ca kṛttivāsā vilocanaḥ || 49 ||
analyzed: viṣ mūtra dūṣita ucchiṣṭa pūti paryuṣṭa bhojanaḥ śmaśāna ucchiṣṭa bhojī ca kṛttivāsāḥ vilocanaḥ

original: bhagnavāpītaḍāge ca śuṣkavṛkṣe nirūdake | prākāraparikhāgāre śūnyāgāre nadītaṭe || 50 ||
analyzed: bhagna vāpī taḍāge ca śuṣka vṛkṣe nirūdake prākāra parikhā āgāre śūnya āgāre nadī taṭe

original: nivāso rocate tasya sarvadā sarvasaṃdhiṣu | evaṃ bahuyuge yāte mahākālavane gataḥ || 51 ||
analyzed: nivāsaḥ rocate tasya sarvadā sarva saṃdhiṣu  evam bahu yuge yāte mahākāla vane gataḥ  /

original: yatra māheśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ sundaraṃ kuṃḍamuttamam | tatroṣitatvamātreṇa siṃhena vinipātitaḥ || 52 ||
analyzed: yatra māheśvaram liṃgam sundaram kuṃḍam uttamam tatra uṣita tva mātreṇa siṃhena vinipātitaḥ  /

analyzed: striyaḥ vā rajaḥ doṣa ārtāḥ vaṃdhyāḥ kāka baka ādikāḥ durbhagāḥ śīla hīnāḥ ca sarva kāma vivarjitāḥ

original: kathāṃ puṇyavatīmetāṃ sarvakāmavarapradām | paṭhanvāpyathavā śṛṇvangosahasraphalaṃ labhet || 33 ||

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | tīrthamanyataraṃ vyāsa kṣātāsaṃgamasaṃbhavam | yatra tu snānamātreṇa mahāpāpaiḥ pramucyate || 1 ||

original: amā vai śanivāreṇa yadāyāti samāhitaḥ | pitṝnuddiśya yaḥ kuryācchrāddhaṃ caiva tilodakam || 2 ||

original: puṇyāḥ puṇyajalā ramyāḥ pavitrāḥ pāpahārakāḥ | punaṃtyaḥ sarvalokānāṃ snānātpānāttathāpagāḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: puṇyāḥ puṇya jalāḥ ramyāḥ pavitrāḥ pāpa hārakāḥ punaṃtyaḥ sarva lokānām snānāt pānāt tathā āpagāḥ

original: vyāsa uvāca | kathaṃ sūryastvayā prokto virajo hyabhavatpurā | etadveditumicchāmi tvatto brahmavidāṃvara || 13 ||

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | purānusūryāṃ sāvitrīṃ tvaṣṭā svatanayāṃ dadau || 14 ||

analyzed: pati dharma ratā nityam siṣeve loka cakṣuṣe tasyām vai mithunam jajñe loka sākṣi vibhāvasoḥ

analyzed: mithunam me tava utsaṃge dhṛtam tvam paripālaya tāvat evam iha chāye yāvat pituḥ gṛhecarī  /

original: tadā padāhatā tena cchāyā taṃ ca śaśāpa ha | yatastvaṃ me padāghātaṃ kṛtavānbālabhāvanāt || 22 ||
analyzed: tadā pada āhatā tena chāyā tam ca śaśāpa ha yatas tvam me pada āghātam kṛtavān bāla bhāvanāt

original: tasmāttvaṃ ca padā khaṃjo bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ | evaṃ śapto rujākrāṃto vilalāpa śucārditaḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: tasmāt tvam ca padā khaṃjaḥ bhaviṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ evam śaptaḥ rujā ākrāṃtaḥ vilalāpa śucā arditaḥ  /

original: etasminnaṃtare vyāsa paribhūya vasuṃdharām | bhāvayansakalāṃllokāngrahacārī vibhāvasuḥ || 24 ||

analyzed: pādau me galitau sadyas mātuḥ śāpa parābhavau tat śrutvā moham āpannaḥ raviḥ dhyāna parāyaṇaḥ

analyzed: vicitram idam ākhyātam mātuḥ śāpasya kāraṇam  evam dhyātvā ciram kālam jñātavān raviḥ aṃśumān

analyzed: chāyā uvāca na anusūryā mahā rāja chāyā tasyāḥ sva saṃbhavā gatā vai sā pituḥ gehe vāritā aham tayā anagha  /

analyzed: tam dṛṣṭvā sahasā utthāya tvaṣṭā lokapitāmahaḥ pādya arghya ācamanīyam ca madhuparkaiḥ apūjayat  /

analyzed: natvā pādau parikramya bahu māna puraḥsaram  uvāca madhurayā vācā priyam te karavāma kim  /

analyzed: kim karomi kva gacchāmi kva ca priyatarā mama  iti saṃbhāṣamāṇe tu tvaṣṭā vākyam atha abravīt

analyzed: tava tejaḥ paribhraṣṭā bhagnā kvāpi gatā abalā yadi te vallabhā bhāryā tejaḥ tvam pariśāmaya  /

analyzed: sūryaḥ uvāca yadi evam dussaham tejaḥ mama pūrva pitāmaha tadā te rocate samyak yathā syāt vai tathā kuru  /

original: iti sūryavacaḥ śrutvā śāṇaṃ kṛtvā sudarśanam | ghṛṣṭitaḥ kṣuradhāreṇa laghīyānnirmalo'bhavat || 41 ||
analyzed: iti sūrya vacaḥ śrutvā śāṇam kṛtvā sudarśanam  ghṛṣṭitaḥ kṣura dhāreṇa laghīyān nirmalaḥ abhavat  /

original: tasya ghṛṣṭitamātreṇa tvaṣṭā cakre vivasvataḥ | śāṇaṃ sudarśanaṃ cakraṃ saikatā maṇijātayaḥ || 42 ||

original: ubhayoḥ saṃgamo yatra tatra muktirna saṃśayaḥ | tatra tāṃ subhagāṃ patnīṃ prāpsyasi tvaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 45 ||

analyzed: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā savitā sarva tāpanaḥ tatra agamat vanam yatra mahākālasya pāvanam

analyzed: kṣātā saṃgama saṃyuktā yatra śiprā payasvinī tatra bhuktiḥ ca muktiḥ ca dhana dhānya samāgamaḥ

analyzed: tatra āgatya priyām bhāryām vaḍavā rūpa dhāriṇīm  dadarśa tām punar śyāmām hari rūpa dharaḥ hariḥ

analyzed: chāyā ca suṣuve tatra mithunam dvijasattama tāpīm śanaiścaram ca eva sarva loka pratāpanam

analyzed: tasya hasta gatā lakṣmīḥ jāyate sarvadā bhuvi  kṣātā saṃgame naraḥ snātvā dānam dattvā ca śaktitaḥ

original: tasya śānaiścarī pīḍā na bhavettu kadācana | yamadharmo'pi cātraiva tapastepe sudustaram || 55 ||

analyzed: tāsām ca priyam anvicchan samāyātaḥ vana aṃtare tābhiḥ ca satkṛtaḥ nityam samāsīnaḥ dhṛta vrataḥ

original: uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā deśakālocitaṃ vacaḥ | kimidaṃ vikṛtaṃ jātaṃ bhavatīnāṃ parābhavaḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: uvāca ślakṣṇayā vācā deśa kāla ucitam vacaḥ kim idam vikṛtam jātam bhavatīnām parābhavaḥ

original: kasmācca ṛṣibhistyaktā lokamātaraḥ pativratāḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: kasmāt ca ṛṣibhiḥ tyaktāḥ loka mātaraḥ pativratāḥ

original: ṛṣipatnya ūcuḥ | na jānīmo vayaṃ tāta yena doṣeṇa tāpasaiḥ | vimuktāḥ sāgnikaiḥ kṣipraṃ kārtikeyaprasaṃgataḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: ṛṣi patnyaḥ ūcuḥ na jānīmaḥ vayam tāta yena doṣeṇa tāpasaiḥ vimuktāḥ sa agnikaiḥ kṣipram kārtikeya prasaṃgataḥ

original: lokāpavādajaṃ kiṃcijjātaṃ diṣṭavaśādadham | kiṃ kurmo vā kva gacchāmaḥ kiṃ tapaḥ kā ca devatā || 25 ||
analyzed: loka apavāda jam kiṃcid jātam diṣṭa vaśāt adham kim kurmaḥ vā kva gacchāmaḥ kim tapaḥ kā ca devatā

original: yasyārādhanapuṇyena patisāṃnidhyamāpnuyuḥ | etanniścitya bho brahmanbrūhi tvaṃ vedatattvataḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: yasya ārādhana puṇyena pati sāṃnidhyam āpnuyuḥ etat niścitya bho brahman brūhi tvam veda tattvataḥ

original: iti pṛṣṭastadā tābhirṛṣipatnībhirnāradaḥ | uvāca suciraṃ dhyātvā tāsāṃ sa śarmahetave || 27 ||
analyzed: iti pṛṣṭaḥ tadā tābhiḥ ṛṣi patnībhiḥ nāradaḥ uvāca su ciram dhyātvā tāsām sa śarma hetave

original: nārada uvāca | śrūyatāṃ bhostapaḥśreṣṭhā bhavatīnāṃ ca kāraṇam | mahākālavane ramye gayātīrthamanuttamam || 28 ||
analyzed: nāradaḥ uvāca śrūyatām bhoḥ tapaḥ śreṣṭhāḥ bhavatīnām ca kāraṇam mahākāla vane ramye gayā tīrtham anuttamam

original: tatraiva cākṣayo nāma nyagrodhaḥ śākhināṃ varaḥ | tatrāgamanamātreṇa dhūtadoṣā bhaviṣyatha || 29 ||
analyzed: tatra eva ca akṣayaḥ nāma nyagrodhaḥ śākhinām varaḥ tatra āgamana mātreṇa dhūta doṣāḥ bhaviṣyatha  /

original: sarvadoṣaharaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvakāmavarapradam | sarvasaukhyakaraṃ puṇyaṃ tatra gacchata mā ciram || 30 ||
analyzed: sarva doṣa haram tīrtham sarva kāma vara pradam sarva saukhya karam puṇyam tatra gacchata mā ciram

original: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣipantyaḥ sucoditāḥ | mahākālavane vyāsa icchaṃtyaḥ priyamātmanaḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā ṛṣipantyaḥ su coditāḥ mahākāla vane vyāse icchaṃtyaḥ priyam ātmanaḥ

original: ājagmustadvanaṃ tatra yatra tīrthaṃ gayābhidham | tatra gatvā śucībhūya snānadānādikāḥ kriyāḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: ājagmuḥ tat vanam tatra yatra tīrtham gayā abhidham tatra gatvā śucībhūya snāna dāna ādikāḥ kriyāḥ  /

original: kṛtāstābhiśca puṇyābhirnabhasyasyāsitetare | pañcamyāmṛṣisaṃjñāyāṃ tābhiḥ sucaritaṃ vratam || 33 ||
analyzed: kṛtāḥ tābhiḥ ca puṇyābhiḥ nabhasyasya asitetare  pañcamyām ṛṣi saṃjñāyām tābhiḥ su caritam vratam  /

original: upoṣya caikarātraṃ tu jāgaraṃ caiva yogataḥ | kṛtamātre vrate vyāsa dhūtapāpā babhuḥ kṣaṇāt || 34 ||
analyzed: upoṣya ca eka rātram tu jāgaram ca eva yogataḥ kṛta mātre vrate vyāsa dhūta pāpāḥ babhuḥ kṣaṇāt

original: bhartṛkopaparibhraṣṭāḥ sadyaḥ prāptā gṛhāśramam | ṛṣibhiḥ sāgnikaṃ dattaṃ pūrvavadṛṣisattama || 35 ||
analyzed: bhartṛ kopa paribhraṣṭāḥ sadyas prāptāḥ gṛha āśramam ṛṣibhiḥ sa agnikam dattam pūrvavat ṛṣi sattama

original: tadāprabhṛti lokesminpaṃcamī ṛṣisaṃjñitā | ye narāścātha nāryo yāstāṃ kurvanti tu bhaktiḥ || 36 ||
analyzed: tadā prabhṛti loke smin paṃcamī ṛṣi saṃjñitā ye narāḥ ca atha nāryaḥ yāḥ tām kurvanti tu bhaktiḥ  /

original: nīvārāhārakaṃ kṛtvā śucībhūya samāhitāḥ | na teṣāṃ jāyate kiṃcidāpadduḥkhaṃ kadācana | durbhagatvaṃ ca nārīṇāṃ na viyogaśca mātṛbhiḥ || 38 ||
analyzed: nīvāra āhārakam kṛtvā śucībhūya samāhitāḥ na teṣām jāyate kiṃcid āpad duḥkham kadācana  durbhaga tvam ca nārīṇām na viyogaḥ ca mātṛbhiḥ  /

original: putrato dhanato vāpi kadācitsaṃbhaviṣyati | evaṃ vyāsa samākhyātaṃ yattvayā paripṛcchitam || 39 ||
analyzed: putrataḥ dhanataḥ vā api kadācid saṃbhaviṣyati  / evam vyāsa samākhyātam yat tvayā paripṛcchitam

original: avaṃtyāmīdṛśaṃ tīrthaṃ vartate bhuvi sattama | tādṛśaṃ puṇyadaṃ kiṃcinnāsti brahmāṃḍagolake || 40 ||
analyzed: avaṃtyām īdṛśam tīrtham vartate bhuvi sattama tādṛśam puṇya dam kiṃcid na asti brahmāṃḍa golake

original: asmiṃstīrthe naraḥ kaścinmahā dānāni ceccaret | akṣayāṇi bhavaṃtyasya viṣṇuloke mahīyate || 41 ||
analyzed: asmin tīrthe naraḥ kaścid mahā dānāni ced caret akṣayāṇi bhavanti asya viṣṇu loke mahīyate

original: yo vai niyamavānbhūtvā kathāmetāṃ śṛṇoti vā | paṭhecca satataṃ vyāsa haya medhaphalaṃ labhet || 42 ||
analyzed: yaḥ vai niyamavān bhūtvā kathām etām śṛṇoti vā paṭhet ca satatam vyāsa haya medha phalam labhet  /

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye gayātīrthamāhātmya varṇanaṃnāmaikonaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 59 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām paṃcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe avantī kṣetra māhātmye gayātīrtha māhātmya varṇanam nāma ekonaṣaṣṭitamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: | vyāsa uvāca | puruṣottamaṃ paraṃ tīrthaṃ tvayā proktaṃ purānagha | māhātmyaṃ tasya tīrthasya vistarādvada me prabho | etattu śrotumicchāmi tvatto brahmavidāṃ vara || 1 ||
analyzed: vyāsaḥ uvāca puruṣottamam param tīrtham tvayā proktam purā anagha māhātmyam tasya tīrthasya vistarāt vada me prabho etat tu śrotum icchāmi tvattaḥ brahma vidām vara

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | śṛṇuṣva bho dvijaśreṣṭha kathāṃ pāpaharāṃ parām || 2 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca śṛṇuṣva bho dvijaśreṣṭha kathām pāpa harām parām

original: yasyāḥ śravaṇamātreṇa mahāpāpakṣayo bhavet | purākalpeṣu vai brahmanvaikuṇṭhe vimale śubhe || 3 ||
analyzed: yasyāḥ śravaṇa mātreṇa mahā pāpa kṣayaḥ bhavet purākalpeṣu vai brahman vaikuṇṭhe vimale śubhe

original: samāsīno ramānāthaḥ pārṣadaiḥ sanakādibhiḥ | maharṣibhiḥ sadācāraiḥ pitāmahapurogamaiḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: samāsīnaḥ ramānāthaḥ pārṣadaiḥ sanaka ādibhiḥ mahā ṛṣibhiḥ sat ācāraiḥ pitāmaha purogamaiḥ

original: ṛdisiddhiguṇopetaistattvaistairmahadādibhiḥ | gaṇagaṃdharvasaṃghaiśca sevyamānaḥ samaṃ tataḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: ṛdi siddhi guṇa upetaiḥ tattvaiḥ taiḥ mahat ādibhiḥ gaṇa gaṃdharva saṃghaiḥ ca sevyamānaḥ samam tatas  /

original: kinnarodgānasanmānairnṛtyadbhirapsarogaṇaiḥ | ciṃtāmaṇigṛhodgāralalitāṃgaṇabhūmiṣu || 6 ||
analyzed: kinnara udgāna sanmānaiḥ nṛtyadbhiḥ apsaraḥ gaṇaiḥ ciṃtāmaṇi gṛha udgāra lalita aṃgaṇa bhūmiṣu

original: kalpadrumakṛtacchāya āsīno hi murudviṣaḥ | dharmavādaratāḥ sarve brahmamārgasuniścitāḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: kalpadruma kṛta chāyaḥ āsīnaḥ hi murudviṣaḥ dharma vāda ratāḥ sarve brahmamārga su niścitāḥ

original: teṣāṃ madhye parā bhāṣā hyapṛcchatkamalāpatim || 8 ||
analyzed: teṣām madhye parā bhāṣā hi apṛcchat kamalāpatim

original: lakṣmīruvāca | puṇyakānāṃ vidhiṃ nātha śrotumicchāmi tattvataḥ | sarvajñosi mahāprājña vācyatāṃ yadi rocate || 9 ||
analyzed: lakṣmīḥ uvāca puṇyakānām vidhim nātha śrotum icchāmi tattvataḥ sarva jñaḥ asi mahā prājña vācyatām yadi rocate

original: śrībhagavānuvāca | dānaṃ snānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddhaṃ sadā śastaṃ hi śobhane | tathāpi vidhinā prāptaṃ tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet || 10 ||
analyzed: śrī bhagavān uvāca  dānam snānam tapaḥ śrāddham sadā śastam hi śobhane tathā api vidhinā prāptam tat sarvam ca akṣayam bhavet

original: deśe kāle parvaṇi ca tīrthe cāyatane pade | dānaṃ snānaṃ tapaḥ śrāddhaṃ munibhiḥ parikīrtitam || 11 ||
analyzed: deśe kāle parvaṇi ca tīrthe ca āyatane pade  dānam snānam tapaḥ śrāddham munibhiḥ parikīrtitam

original: pūrṇamāsyāmamāvāsyāṃ saṃkrāṃtau grahaṇe tathā | vaidhṛtau ca vyatīpāte dānavṛddhiḥ parā smṛtā || 12 ||
analyzed: pūrṇamāsyām amāvāsyām saṃkrāṃtau grahaṇe tathā vaidhṛtau ca vyatīpāte dāna vṛddhiḥ parā smṛtā

original: gaṃgāyāṃ bhāskarakṣetre kurukṣetre ca puṣkare | godāvaryāṃ gayāyāṃ ca tīrthe cāmarakaṃṭake || 13 ||
analyzed: gaṃgāyām bhāskarakṣetre kurukṣetre ca puṣkare godāvaryām gayāyām ca tīrthe ca amarakaṃṭake

original: avaṃtyāṃ ca hutaṃ dattaṃ tatsarvaṃ cākṣayaṃ bhavet | tasmātsarvaprayatnena parve tīrthaṃ samācaret || 14 ||
analyzed: avaṃtyām ca hutam dattam tat sarvam ca akṣayam bhavet tasmāt sarva prayatnena parve tīrtham samācaret

original: kucailo durbhago mūrkho jaḍo rogasamanvitaḥ | tīrthaparvaparibhraṣṭo naro bhavati niścitam || 15 ||
analyzed: kucailaḥ durbhagaḥ mūrkhaḥ jaḍaḥ roga samanvitaḥ tīrtha parva paribhraṣṭaḥ naraḥ bhavati niścitam

original: ke yogāḥ sukṛtānāṃ ca kartavyāśca viśeṣataḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: ke yogāḥ su kṛtānām ca kartavyāḥ ca viśeṣataḥ

original: śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca | sādhu pṛṣṭaḥ priye praśraḥ puṇyakānāṃ tvayā'naghe | malamāse samāyāte ye narā vratavarjitāḥ | janmajanmani dāridryaṃ teṣāṃ bhavati śobhane || 17 ||
analyzed: śrī kṛṣṇaḥ uvāca sādhu pṛṣṭaḥ priye praśraḥ puṇyakānām tvayā anaghe malamāse samāyāte ye narāḥ vrata varjitāḥ janma janmani dāridryam teṣām bhavati śobhane

original: śrīrukmiṇyuvāca | kīdṛśo hi malo māsaḥ kena yogena jāyate | kadā kāle samāyāti etanno vada vistarāt || 18 ||
analyzed: śrī rukmiṇī uvāca kīdṛśaḥ hi malaḥ māsaḥ kena yogena jāyate kadā kāle samāyāti etat naḥ vada vistarāt  /

original: śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca | yuktamuktaṃ tvayā devi praśnaḥ kāle'yamīdṛśaḥ | devatāpitṛkāryāṇi vidhinā hi malimluce || 19 ||
analyzed: śrī kṛṣṇaḥ uvāca yuktam uktam tvayā devi praśnaḥ kāle ayam īdṛśaḥ devatā pitṛ kāryāṇi vidhinā hi malimluce

original: kṣauraṃ mauṃjī vivāhaśca vratopavāsakaṃ tathā | viśeṣeṇa gṛhasthānāṃ varjyaṃ munivarottamaiḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: kṣauram mauṃjī vivāhaḥ ca vrata upavāsakam tathā viśeṣeṇa gṛhasthānām varjyam muni vara uttamaiḥ

original: saṃvatsaratrayāṃte ca māso'yamadhigacchati | asaṃkrame raverasmiṃstasmādadhikamāsakaḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: saṃvatsara traya ante ca māsaḥ ayam adhigacchati asaṃkrame raveḥ asmin tasmāt adhika māsakaḥ   /

original: adhimāsādhipatyo'haṃ sadaiva puruṣottamaḥ | mamābhidhānaṃ tīrthaṃ ca mahākālavane śubham || 22 ||
analyzed: adhimāsa ādhipatyaḥ aham sadā eva puruṣottamaḥ mama abhidhānam tīrtham ca mahākāla vane śubham

original: puruṣottamākhyaṃ me dhāma sadaivātra prati ṣṭhati | tasmātsarvaprayatnena gaṃtavyaṃ hi tvayā saha || 23 ||
analyzed: puruṣottama ākhyam me dhāma sadā eva atra prati sthati tasmāt sarva prayatnena gaṃtavyam hi tvayā saha

original: mahākālavane tatra yatra tīrthaṃ mamābhidham | prāṇino ye samāyāṃti majjanārthaṃ priye dhruvam || 24 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vane tatra yatra tīrtham mama abhidham prāṇinaḥ ye samāyāṃti majjana artham priye dhruvam

original: teṣāmiha mamādeyaṃ na kadāpi bhaviṣyati | dhanadhānyakalatrādi putrasaukhyaṃ sadaiva hi || 25 ||
analyzed: teṣām iha mama ādeyam na kadāpi bhaviṣyati dhana dhānya kalatra ādi putra saukhyam sadā eva hi  /

original: asaṃkrāṃte'pi saṃprāpte māmuddiśya vrataṃ caret | adhimāsādhipatyo'haṃ sadā vai puruṣottamaḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: asaṃkrāṃte api saṃprāpte mām uddiśya vratam caret adhimāsa ādhipatyaḥ aham sadā vai puruṣottamaḥ

original: snānaṃ dānaṃ japo homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛtarpaṇam | devatārcāṃ ca madhyāhne ye kurvaṃti narottamāḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: snānam dānam japaḥ homaḥ svādhyāyaḥ pitṛ tarpaṇam devatā arcām ca madhyāhne ye kurvaṃti nara uttamāḥ

original: akṣayaṃ ca bhavetsarvaṃ teṣāṃ vai kamale dhuvam | malamāso gataḥ śūnyo yeṣāṃ devi pramādataḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: akṣayam ca bhavet sarvam teṣām vai kamale dhuvam mala māsaḥ gataḥ śūnyaḥ yeṣām devi pramādataḥ

original: dāridryaṃ ca sadā teṣāṃ śokarogavivardhanam | adhimāse samāyāte avaṃtyāṃ vratamācaret || 29 ||
analyzed: dāridryam ca sadā teṣām śoka roga vivardhanam adhimāse samāyāte avantyām vratam ācaret  /

original: teṣāṃ dadāmyahaṃ prītyā tvāmeva ca na saṃśayaḥ | svalpaṃ dānamalaṃ kāryaṃ yatkiṃ cidiha yatkṛtam | tatsarvaṃ matprasādena hyanaṃtaṃ priyadarśane || 30 ||
analyzed: teṣām dadāmi aham prītyā tvām eva ca na saṃśayaḥ svalpam dānam alam kāryam yat kiṃcid iha yat kṛtam  tat sarvam mad prasādena hi anaṃtam priyadarśane

original: śrīruvāca | īdṛśo hi tvayā prokto hyadhimāsasya suvrata || 31 ||
analyzed: śrīḥ uvāca īdṛśaḥ hi tvayā proktaḥ hi adhimāsasya suvrata

original: mahimā hyapi lokānāṃ sarvakāmavarapradaḥ | adhimāsavrataṃ puṇyaṃ kathayasva prasādataḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: mahimā hi api lokānām sarva kāma vara pradaḥ adhimāsa vratam puṇyam kathayasva prasādataḥ  /

original: śrīkṛṣṇa uvāca | asaṃkrāto yadā māsaḥ prāpyate mānavaiḥ priye | mahotsavastadā kārya ātmano hitakāṃkṣibhiḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: śrī kṛṣṇaḥ uvāca  asaṃkrātaḥ yadā māsaḥ prāpyate mānavaiḥ priye  mahā utsavaḥ tadā kāryaḥ ātmanaḥ hita kāṃkṣibhiḥ  /

original: kṛṣṇapakṣe caturdaśyāṃ navamyāṃ vā sureśvari | aṣṭamyāṃ cātha kartavyaṃ vrataṃ śokavināśanam || 34 ||
analyzed: kṛṣṇa pakṣe caturdaśyām navamyām vā sureśvari aṣṭamyām ca atha kartavyam vratam śoka vināśanam  /

original: yathālābhopahāreṇa māse cāpi malimluce | puṇyāhe prātarutthāya kṛtvā paurvāhṇikīṃ kriyām || 35 ||
analyzed: yathā lābha upahāreṇa māse ca api malimluce puṇya ahe prātar utthāya kṛtvā paurvāhṇikīm kriyām  /

original: gṛhītvā niyamaṃ paścādvāsudevaṃ hṛdi smaran | upavāsaṃ ca naktaṃ ca ekabhuktaṃ ca mānini || 36 ||
analyzed: gṛhītvā niyamam paścāt vāsudevam hṛdi smaran upavāsam ca naktam ca eka bhuktam ca mānini  /

original: ekasya niścayaṃ kṛtvā tato viprānnimaṃtrayet | sapatnīkā nsadācārānkulīnāñjñātisaṃbhavān || 37 ||
analyzed: ekasya niścayam kṛtvā tatas viprān nimaṃtrayet sa patnīkān sat ācārān kulīnān jñāti saṃbhavān

original: tato madhyāhnasamaye lakṣmīyuktaṃ sanātanam | sthāpayedavraṇe kuṃbhe vedamaṃtrairdvijātibhiḥ || 38 ||
analyzed: tatas madhyāhna samaye lakṣmī yuktam sanātanam sthāpayet avraṇe kuṃbhe veda maṃtraiḥ dvijātibhiḥ  /

original: pūjayetparayā bhaktyā gotribhiḥ sapitāmaham | gaṃdhatoyena saṃsthāpya paṃcāmṛtaistathaiva ca || 39 ||
analyzed: pūjayet parayā bhaktyā gotribhiḥ sa pitāmaham gaṃdha toyena saṃsthāpya paṃcāmṛtaiḥ tathā eva ca  /

original: miṣṭānnairnavabhiścaiva naivedyairdhūpadīpakaiḥ | ācchādanaiśca vastraiśca pītakauśeyakaistathā || 40 ||
analyzed: miṣṭānnaiḥ navabhiḥ ca eva naivedyaiḥ dhūpa dīpakaiḥ  ācchādanaiḥ ca vastraiḥ ca pīta kauśeyakaiḥ tathā

original: ghaṃṭāmṛdaṃganirhrādairghoṣadhvanisamanvitaiḥ | ārārtikaṃ vratī kuryātkarpūrāgarucaṃdanaiḥ || 41 ||
analyzed: ghaṃṭā mṛdaṃga nirhrādaiḥ ghoṣa dhvani samanvitaiḥ ārārtikam vratī kuryāt karpūra agaru caṃdanaiḥ

analyzed: tatra snātvā naraḥ nityam rātrau jāgaraṇam caret  upoṣya vidhivat vyāsa sa śiṣyam vyāsam arcayet

original: vaiṣṇavāṃśca narāṃścaiva kṛṣṇajanmotsukānvarān | nānāsugaṃdhapuṣpādyairvastrālaṃkārasaṃyutaiḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: vaiṣṇavān ca narān ca eva kṛṣṇa janma utsukān varān nānā su gaṃdha puṣpa ādyaiḥ vastra alaṃkāra saṃyutaiḥ

original: gobrāhmaṇānāṃ pūjāśca kriyate yaiḥ samāhitaiḥ | na teṣāṃ durlabhaṃ kiṃcitsarvalokeṣu vidyate || 34 ||
analyzed: go brāhmaṇānām pūjāḥ ca kriyate yaiḥ samāhitaiḥ na teṣām durlabham kiṃcid sarva lokeṣu vidyate  /

original: gomatīsnānajātpuṇyādvāsudevasamāgamāt | manorathaphalaprāptirjāyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ || 35 ||
analyzed: gomatī snāna jāt puṇyāt vāsudeva samāgamāt  manoratha phala prāptiḥ jāyate na a atra saṃśayaḥ

original: tathā caitrasite pakṣe yāvaccaikādaśī bhavet | taddine ca naraḥ snātvā gomatyāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ || 36 ||
analyzed: tathā caitra site pakṣe yāvat ca ekādaśī bhavet tad dine ca naraḥ snātvā gomatyām ca viśeṣataḥ

original: rātrau jāgaraṇaṃ kṛtvā viṣṇupūjāṃ tathaiva ca | āmalakīṃ tato gatvā pradakṣiṇātpadepade || 37 ||
analyzed: rātrau jāgaraṇam kṛtvā viṣṇu pūjām tathā eva ca  āmalakīm tatas gatvā pradakṣiṇāt pade pade

original: gosahasraphalaṃ teṣāṃ prāpyate nā'tra saṃśayaḥ | ye śṛṇvaṃti kathāṃ puṇyāṃ pavitrāṃ pāpahāriṇīm || 38 ||
analyzed: go sahasra phalam teṣām prāpyate na a atra saṃśayaḥ ye śṛṇvaṃti kathām puṇyām pavitrām pāpa hāriṇīm  /

original: sarvapāpavinirmuktā viṣṇulokaṃ prayāṃti te || 39 ||
analyzed: sarva pāpa vinirmuktāḥ viṣṇu lokam prayānti te

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe'vantīkṣetramāhātmye gomatītīrthakuṇḍamāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dviṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 62 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe avantī kṣetra māhātmye gomatītīrtha kuṇḍa māhātmya varṇanam nāma dviṣaṣṭitamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: | sanatkumāra uvāca | kaṃthaḍeśvara iti khyātaṃ tatra tīrthamanuttamam | tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā devaṃ maheśvaram || 1 ||
analyzed: sanatkumāraḥ uvāca kaṃthaḍeśvaraḥ iti khyātam tatra tīrtham anuttamam tatra tīrthe naraḥ snātvā dṛṣṭvā devam maheśvaram

original: mucyate sarvapāpebhyaḥ śuciḥ prayatamānasaḥ | vimānaśatasaṃyuktaḥ śivaloke mahīyate || 2 ||
analyzed: mucyate sarva pāpebhyaḥ śuciḥ prayata mānasaḥ vimāna śata saṃyuktaḥ śiva loke mahīyate  /

original: bhuvi puṇyatamaṃ tīrthaṃ sarvapāpaharaṃ param | khagartāsaṃgamo yatra gaṃgeśvarasamīpataḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: bhuvi puṇyatamam tīrtham sarva pāpa haram param khagartā saṃgamaḥ yatra gaṃgeśvara samīpatas  /

original: mahāpāpaharaṃ puṇyaṃ mahāpuṇyaphalapradam | ākāśātpatitā yatra gaṃgā trailokya pāvanī || 4 ||
analyzed: mahā pāpa haram puṇyam mahā puṇya phala pradam ākāśāt patitā yatra gaṃgā trailokya pāvanī  /

original: vidhṛtā śirasi sadyo mahādevena śaṃbhunā | tasmiṃstīrthe naraḥ snātvā gaṃgeśamavalokayet || 5 ||
analyzed: vidhṛtā śirasi sadyas mahādevena śaṃbhunā tasmin tīrthe naraḥ snātvā gaṃgeśam avalokayet

original: gaṃgāsnānaphalaṃ prāpya viṣṇu loke mahīyate | vīreśvaramanuprāpya tasmiṃstīrthe naro vaset || 6 ||
analyzed: gaṃgā snāna phalam prāpya viṣṇu loke mahīyate vīreśvaram anuprāpya tasmin tīrthe naraḥ vaset

original: sarvapāpaviśuddhātmā vīralokamavāpnuyāt | tīrthamanyanmahāpuṇyaṃ bhuvi khyātaṃ maharṣibhiḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: sarva pāpa viśuddha ātmā vīra lokam avāpnuyāt tīrtham anyat mahā puṇyam bhuvi khyātam mahā ṛṣibhiḥ

original: vāmanakuṇḍeti vikhyātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam | yasya darśanamātreṇa brahmahatyāṃ vyapohati || 8 ||
analyzed: vāmanakuṇḍa iti vikhyātam triṣu lokeṣu viśrutam yasya darśana mātreṇa brahmahatyām vyapohati  /

original: manorathaśataṃ prāpya paścādviṣṇu puraṃ vrajet | vyāsa uvāca | kadā kāle samutpannaṃ vāmanākhyaṃ purā'nagha || 9 ||
analyzed: manoratha śatam prāpya paścāt viṣṇu puram vrajet  vyāsaḥ uvāca kadā kāle samutpannam vāmana ākhyam purā anagha

original: tatsarvaṃ śrotumicchāmi tvatto brahmavidāṃ vara | sanatkumāra uvāca | śṛṇuṣva bho dvijaśreṣṭha kathāṃ pāpaharāṃ parām || 10 ||
analyzed: tat sarvam śrotum icchāmi tvattaḥ brahma vidām vara sanatkumāraḥ uvāca śṛṇuṣva bho dvijaśreṣṭha kathām pāpa harām parām  /

original: yasya śravaṇamātreṇa sarvapāpātpramucyate | daityeṃdrastu purā prokto viṣṇubhaktiparāyaṇaḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: yasya śravaṇa mātreṇa sarva pāpāt pramucyate daitya iṃdraḥ tu purā proktaḥ viṣṇu bhakti parāyaṇaḥ

original: prahrāda iti vikhyātaḥ sarvadharmabhṛtāṃ varaḥ | ācāravijito dharmaḥ satyena vijitā ramā || 12 ||
analyzed: prahrādaḥ iti vikhyātaḥ sarva dharma bhṛtām varaḥ ācāra vijitaḥ dharmaḥ satyena vijitā ramā

original: dhairyeṇa ca dhṛtā lokāḥ kṣamayā vidhṛtā mahī | gāṃbhīryeṇā'rṇavā divyāḥ śauryeṇa śatruṇā gaṇāḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: dhairyeṇa ca dhṛtāḥ lokāḥ kṣamayā vidhṛtā mahī gāṃbhīryeṇa arṇavāḥ divyāḥ śauryeṇa śatruṇā gaṇāḥ

original: praśrayeṇābhyāgatāśca jitāstena mahātmanā || | dakṣiṇābhirjito yajño haviṣā havyavāhanaḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: praśrayeṇa abhyāgatāḥ ca jitāḥ tena mahātmanā    dakṣiṇābhiḥ jitaḥ yajñaḥ haviṣā havyavāhanaḥ

original: śaucā'cāraviśuddhātmā tapasā ca hatā'śubhaḥ | dānamānajitā viprā bhojanācchādanā dibhiḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: śauca ācāra viśuddha ātmā tapasā ca hata aśubhaḥ dāna māna jitāḥ viprāḥ bhojana ācchādana ā dibhiḥ

original: saṃskāreṇa jitaṃ janma damenā'tmā sanātanaḥ | prāṇāyāmajito vāyuryogadhyānajito hariḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: saṃskāreṇa jitam janma damena ātmā sanātanaḥ prāṇāyāma jitaḥ vāyuḥ yoga dhyāna jitaḥ hariḥ

original: īdṛśaśca mahāyogī satyadharma parāyaṇaḥ | prahlādena samo dhīro na bhūto na bhaviṣyati || 17 ||
analyzed: īdṛśaḥ ca mahā yogī satya dharma parāyaṇaḥ prahlādena samaḥ dhīraḥ na bhūtaḥ na bhaviṣyati  /

original: tasya pautraḥ sadācārī balirityabhidhīyate | tasya pālayataḥ samyakprajāḥ samyagvivardhitāḥ || 18 ||
analyzed: tasya pautraḥ sat ācārī baliḥ iti abhidhīyate tasya pālayataḥ samyak prajāḥ samyak vivardhitāḥ

original: nālpāyurna jaḍo mūrkho na rogī na ca matsarī | aputro dravyahīnaśca ko'pi nā'sti mahītale || 19 ||
analyzed: na alpa āyuḥ na jaḍaḥ mūrkhaḥ na rogī na ca matsarī aputraḥ dravya hīnaḥ ca kaḥ api nā asti mahī tale

original: mahārājo mahīpālo yajvā vipuladakṣiṇaḥ | saptadvīpavatī tena pālitā vasudhā sadā || 20 ||
analyzed: mahā rājaḥ mahīpālaḥ yajvā vipula dakṣiṇaḥ sapta dvīpavatī tena pālitā vasudhā sadā  /

original: ekadā ca samāsīne sabhāmadhye varāsane | jaya śabde vartamāne gaṃdharvā lalitaṃ jaguḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: ekadā ca samāsīne sabhā madhye varāsane jaya śabde vartamāne gaṃdharvāḥ lalitam jaguḥ  /

original: vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu nanṛtuścā'psarogaṇāḥ | kathāyāṃ kathyamānāyāṃ śubhāyāṃ ca vicakṣaṇaiḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: vādyamāneṣu vādyeṣu nanṛtuḥ ca apsaraḥ gaṇāḥ kathāyām kathyamānāyām śubhāyām ca vicakṣaṇaiḥ
