original: sūtā vaitālikāḥ siddhāścāraṇāśca bahuśrutāḥ | ṛṣayaśca samāyātāstatraiva dvijasattama || 23 ||
analyzed: sūtāḥ vaitālikāḥ siddhāḥ cāraṇāḥ ca bahu śrutāḥ ṛṣayaḥ ca samāyātāḥ tatra eva dvijasattama

original: sundopasundatuhuṃḍādyā mahiṣāsurakolbaṇāḥ | śumbhaniśumbhadhūmrākṣakālakeyāśca dānavāḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: sunda upasunda tuhuṃḍa ādyāḥ mahiṣa asuraka ulbaṇāḥ śumbha niśumbha dhūmrākṣa kālakeyāḥ ca dānavāḥ  /

original: kālanemiśca vikrāṃto daurhṛdo mūṣako yamaḥ | nikumbhaḥ kumbhaviśaṭho hyandhakaśca mahābalaḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: kālanemiḥ ca vikrāṃtaḥ daurhṛdaḥ mūṣakaḥ yamaḥ nikumbhaḥ kumbha viśaṭhaḥ hi andhakaḥ ca mahā balaḥ

original: śaṃkho jalaṃdharo raudro vātāpī ca balādhikaḥ | sarvajidviśvahaṃtā ca kāmacārī halāyudhaḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: śaṃkhaḥ jalaṃdharaḥ raudraḥ vātāpī ca bala adhikaḥ sarvajit viśvahaṃtā ca kāmacārī halāyudhaḥ

original: ete cā'nye ca bahavo danuvaṃśavi vardhanāḥ | upāsāṃcakrire tatra balirājamakalmaṣam || 27 ||
analyzed: ete ca a anye ca bahavaḥ vardhanāḥ  upāsāṃcakrire tatra bali rājam akalmaṣam

original: siddhā nāgāśca yakṣāśca kinnarāḥ kiṃpuruṣāstathā | khecarā bhūcarā bālā rākṣasāścaiva dāruṇāḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: siddhāḥ nāgāḥ ca yakṣāḥ ca kinnarāḥ kiṃpuruṣāḥ tathā khecarāḥ bhū carāḥ bālāḥ rākṣasāḥ ca eva dāruṇāḥ  /

original: ete cā'nye ca bahavo rājānaṃ paryupāsata | tatra sabhā mahādivyā śuśubhe ca dvijottama || 29 ||
analyzed: ete ca a anye ca bahavaḥ rājānam paryupāsata tatra sabhā mahā divyā śuśubhe ca dvijottama

original: grahairujvalitaiḥ kīrṇo śaradīva nabhaḥsthalam | tatsabhāyāṃ samāsīno rarāja balirāṭ tathā || 30 ||
analyzed: grahaiḥ ujvalitaiḥ śaradi iva nabhaḥ sthalam  tad sabhāyām samāsīnaḥ rarāja bali rāj tathā

original: marudbhiriva saṃvīto vāsavo divi devataiḥ | ekadā ca sabhāmadhye nārado devadarśanaḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: marudbhiḥ iva saṃvītaḥ vāsavaḥ divi devataiḥ ekadā ca sabhā madhye nāradaḥ devadarśanaḥ  /

original: āgatasteṣu sarveṣu dānaveṣu sthiteṣu ca | dṛṣṭvā tamāgataṃ sarve hyuttasthurditinaṃdanāḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: āgataḥ teṣu sarveṣu dānaveṣu sthiteṣu ca  dṛṣṭvā tam āgatam sarve hi uttasthuḥ diti naṃdanāḥ

original: vavandire sarvaśastu balinā kiṃnarotta mam | sakṛtya cāsanaṃ dattvā papraccha kuśalaṃ nṛpaḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: vavandire sarvaśas tu balinā kiṃnara utta mam  ca āsanam dattvā papraccha kuśalam nṛpaḥ

original: kṛtvā'tithyaṃ samāsīno nāradaḥ prāha sattamaḥ | meghagaṃbhīrayā vācā baliṃ prāharṣisa ttamaḥ || 34 ||
analyzed: kṛtvā ātithyam samāsīnaḥ nāradaḥ prāha sattamaḥ megha gaṃbhīrayā vācā balim prāha ṛṣi sa ttamaḥ

original: nārada uvāca | śrūyatāṃ ditijaśreṣṭha gato'haṃ vṛṣamaṃdire | tatra devasabhā ramyā divyā'bhiprāyasaṃyutā | tatra devāḥ sagaṃdharvāḥ puraṃdarapurogamāḥ || 35 ||
analyzed: nāradaḥ uvāca  śrūyatām ditija śreṣṭha gataḥ aham vṛṣa maṃdire tatra deva sabhā ramyā divyā abhiprāya saṃyutā tatra devāḥ sa gaṃdharvāḥ puraṃdara purogamāḥ

original: samāsīnāḥ kathāṃ puṇyāṃ kathayaṃti parasparam | tatra daityakathāṃ śubhrāṃ mayā khyātāṃ na sehire || 36 ||
analyzed: samāsīnāḥ kathām puṇyām kathayaṃti parasparam  tatra daitya kathām śubhrām mayā khyātām na sehire

original: hiraṇyakaśipurdaityaḥ purā'sīcca prajāpatiḥ | trailokyavijayī netā yeneyaṃ vasudhā jitā || 37 ||
analyzed: hiraṇyakaśipuḥ daityaḥ purā āsīt ca prajāpatiḥ trailokya vijayī netā yena iyam vasudhā jitā  /

original: sarvalokaṃ vaśīkṛtya bubhuje ca vasundharām | atīva tejaḥsaṃpanno mahābalaparākramaḥ || 38 ||
analyzed: sarva lokam vaśīkṛtya bubhuje ca vasundharām atīva tejaḥ saṃpannaḥ mahā bala parākramaḥ

original: vaśī sarvatragaḥ kāmī nṛsiṃhena nipātitaḥ | baliṃ kiyadbalaṃ loke nārada tva praśaṃsasi || 39 ||
analyzed: vaśī sarvatragaḥ kāmī nṛsiṃhena nipātitaḥ balim kiyat balam loke nārada praśaṃsasi  /

original: iti māṃ dharṣayitvā ca biḍaujā lokasaṃgrahī | bahudhā vādayanvādānkaṭukāndānavottama || 40 ||
analyzed: iti mām dharṣayitvā ca biḍaujāḥ loka saṃgrahī bahudhā vādayan vādān kaṭukān dānava uttama

original: tasmāttvaṃ dānavaśreṣṭha pitṛparyāgatāṃ mahīm | vijitya sārvabhaumatvaṃ labhasva vasudhādhipa || 41 ||
analyzed: tasmāt tvam dānava śreṣṭha pitṛ paryāgatām mahīm vijitya sārvabhauma tvam labhasva vasudhādhipa  /

original: kiyadbaladhṛtā nūnaṃ devāśca danujottama | palāyanaparā dāṃtā sadaiva raṇabhīravaḥ || 42 ||
analyzed: kiyat bala dhṛtāḥ nūnam devāḥ ca danuja uttama palāyana parāḥ sadā eva raṇa bhīravaḥ

original: mama vākyaparo bhūtvā trailokyādhipatirbhava | nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā valirvairocanistadā || 43 ||
analyzed: mama vākya paraḥ bhūtvā trailokya adhipatiḥ bhava nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā valiḥ vairocaniḥ tadā

original: cakāra kopamatulaṃ trailokyavijaye dvija | maṃtrayitvā'surānsarvānsarvadaityajaneśvaraḥ || 44 ||
analyzed: cakāra kopam atulam trailokya vijaye dvija maṃtrayitvā asurān sarvān sarva daitya janeśvaraḥ

original: saṃgrāmamakarottīvraṃ vāsavena balīyasā | jitvā ca sakalāldevānvaśīcakre savāsavān || 45 ||
analyzed: saṃgrāmam akarot tīvram vāsavena balīyasā  jitvā ca sakalān devān vaśīcakre sa vāsavān

original: sarvalokeśvaro jāto balirvairocano'suraḥ | hatādhikārāstridaśā bhraṣṭarājyāḥ parājitāḥ || 46 ||
analyzed: sarva loka īśvaraḥ jātaḥ baliḥ vairocanaḥ asuraḥ hata adhikārāḥ tridaśāḥ bhraṣṭa rājyāḥ parājitāḥ  /

original: vicaraṃti yathā martyāstena devagaṇā bhuvi | kiṃcitkālaṃ samāsādya brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ yayuḥ || 47 ||
analyzed: vicaranti yathā martyāḥ tena deva gaṇāḥ bhuvi kiṃcid kālam samāsādya brahmāṇam śaraṇam yayuḥ

original: bho brahmanbalinā bhraṣṭā devalokātparaṃtapa | kiṃ kurmaḥ kva ca gacchāmaḥ kamupā yaṃ carāmahe || 48 ||
analyzed: bho brahman balinā bhraṣṭāḥ deva lokāt paraṃtapa kim kurmaḥ kva ca gacchāmaḥ kam upa ā yam carāmahe

original: brahmovāca | śrūyatāṃ bhoḥ suraśreṣṭhā yuṣmākaṃ sādhanaṃ param | yūyaṃ yāta purīṃ ramyāṃ padmāvatīmama rottamāḥ || 49 ||
analyzed: brahmā uvāca śrūyatām bhoḥ sura śreṣṭhāḥ yuṣmākam sādhanam param yūyam yāta purīm ramyām padmāvatīm ama raiḥ uttamāḥ

original: tatra tīrthavaraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nāmnā cottaramānasam | yatrā'ṣṭasiddhidā khyātā mahāsiddhipradā nṛṇām || 50 ||
analyzed: tatra tīrtha varam śreṣṭham nāmnā ca uttaramānasam  yatrā aṣṭa siddhi dā khyātā mahā siddhi pradā nṛṇām

original: nidhayaśca navaivāpi tatra tiṣṭhaṃti sattama | tasyaiva dakṣiṇe bhāge viṣṇutīrthamanuttamam || 51 ||
analyzed: nidhayaḥ ca nava eva api tatra tiṣṭhanti sattama tasya eva dakṣiṇe bhāge viṣṇutīrtham anuttamam

original: tatra snātvā naraḥ paśyetsiddheśvarīṃ susiddhidām | ṛddhisiddhiparobhūtvā viṣṇu loke mahīyate || 52 ||
analyzed: tatra snātvā naraḥ paśyet siddheśvarīm su siddhi dām ṛddhi siddhi paraḥ bhūtvā viṣṇu loke mahīyate

original: āśvinasya site pakṣe daśamyāṃ divase tathā | aṣṭasiddhiśamīdeśe gaṇeśvaraṃ prapūjayet || 53 ||
analyzed: āśvinasya site pakṣe daśamyām divase tathā aṣṭa siddhi śamī deśe gaṇeśvaram prapūjayet

original: vijayī sarvalokeṣu jāya te nātra saṃśayaḥ | śamīmūlasthitaṃ nityamṛddhisiddhivarapradam || 54 ||
analyzed: vijayī sarva lokeṣu te na atra saṃśayaḥ śamī mūla sthitam nityam ṛddhi siddhi vara pradam

original: pūjayedvai naro nityaṃ gaṇeśaṃ sarvakāmadam | sarvakāmavaraṃ labdhvā putravāndhanavānbhavet || 55 ||
analyzed: pūjayet vai naraḥ nityam gaṇeśam sarva kāma dam sarva kāma varam labdhvā putravān dhanavān bhavet  /

original: tasmātsarvaprayatnena mahākālavanaṃ vrajet | yatra viṣṇusarastīrthaṃ tatra gacchata māciram || 6 ||
analyzed: tasmāt sarva prayatnena mahākāla vanam vrajet  yatra viṣṇusaraḥ tīrtham tatra gacchata māciram

original: sanatkumāra uvāca | bhūyaḥ śṛṇu paraṃ tīrthaṃ sarvatīrthaphalapradam | kīrtitaṃ brahmaṇā pūrvaṃ mārkaṃḍeyasya pṛcchataḥ || 1 ||

original: etasminnaṃtare devi vāguvācāśarīriṇī | āśvāsayaṃtī gaṇapaṃ mahākālāyane vraja || 16 ||
analyzed: etasmin aṃtare devi vāc uvāca aśarīriṇī āśvāsayaṃtī gaṇapam mahākālāyane vraja  /

original: prayāgādyāni tīrthāni pṛthivyāṃ yāni saṃti vai | sadā siddhikaraṃ teṣāṃ mahākālaṃ viśiṣyate || 17 ||
analyzed: prayāga ādyāni tīrthāni pṛthivyām yāni saṃti vai sadā siddhi karam teṣām mahākālam viśiṣyate  /

original: tatrāste sumahāpuṇyaṃ liṃgaṃ sarvārthasādhakam | piśāceśvarasāṃnidhye tamārādhaya satvaram || 18 ||
analyzed: tatra āste su mahā puṇyam liṃgam sarva artha sādhakam piśāca īśvara sāṃnidhye tam ārādhaya satvaram

original: prasādāttasya liṃgasya punaryāsyasi śāṃkaram | lokaṃ tejasvināṃ gamyaṃ durlabhaṃ pāpināṃ sadā || 19 ||
analyzed: prasādāt tasya liṃgasya punar yāsyasi śāṃkaram lokam tejasvinām gamyam durlabham pāpinām sadā

original: iti śrutvā tato vāṇīmākāśasthāṃ gaṇastadā | ājagāma mudā yukto mahākālavanottame || 20 ||
analyzed: iti śrutvā tatas vāṇīm ākāśa sthām gaṇaḥ tadā ājagāma mudā yuktaḥ mahākāla vana uttame

original: dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ śubham | pūjayāmāsa deveśaṃ bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: dadarśa tatra tat liṃgam sarva saṃpad karam śubham pūjayāmāsa deveśam bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ

original: liṃgamadhyāttato vāṇī niḥsṛtā parva tātmaje | aho tuṣṭosmi te vatsa kiṃ kāmaṃ pradadāmyaham || 22 ||
analyzed: liṃga madhyāt tatas vāṇī niḥsṛtā aho tuṣṭaḥ asmi te vatsa kim kāmam pradadāmi aham

original: ḍhuṃḍha uvāca | yadi tuṣṭo'si deveśa śaraṇāgatavatsala | tvatpādapaṃkaje bhūyādbhaktirme'vicalā sadā || 23 ||
analyzed: ḍhuṃḍhaḥ uvāca yadi tuṣṭaḥ asi deveśa śaraṇa āgata vatsala tvad pāda paṃkaje bhūyāt bhaktiḥ me avicalā sadā  /

original: varamenaṃ prayacchāśu yadi tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: varam enam prayaccha āśu yadi tuṣṭaḥ maheśvaraḥ

original: ye ca tvāṃ mānavā deva paśyaṃti parameśvara | pāpātsadyo vinirmuktāste bhavaṃtu mahītale || 25 ||
analyzed: ye ca tvām mānavāḥ deva paśyaṃti parameśvara pāpāt sadyas vinirmuktāḥ te bhavantu mahī tale

original: ḍhuṃḍhasya bhāṣitaṃ śrutvā liṃgenoktaṃ yaśasvini | ye ca māṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti śraddhayā parayā punaḥ | te bhaviṣyaṃti satataṃ sadā pātakavarjitāḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: ḍhuṃḍhasya bhāṣitam śrutvā liṃgena uktam yaśasvini ye ca mām pūjayiṣyaṃti śraddhayā parayā punar te bhaviṣyanti satatam sadā pātaka varjitāḥ  /

original: lapsyaṃti te parānkāmānbhaviṣyaṃti gaṇottamāḥ | pūjyāḥ sarveṣu lokeṣu sarvālaṃkārabhūṣitāḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: lapsyaṃti te parān kāmān bhaviṣyaṃti gaṇa uttamāḥ pūjyāḥ sarveṣu lokeṣu sarva alaṃkāra bhūṣitāḥ   /

original: evaṃ labdhavaro ḍhuṃḍhaḥ prāṃjaliḥ punarabravīt | mannāmnā prathitaṃ liṃgaṃ saṃbhūyādbhuvane sadā || 28 ||
analyzed: evam labdha varaḥ ḍhuṃḍhaḥ prāṃjaliḥ punar abravīt mad nāmnā prathitam liṃgam saṃbhūyāt bhuvane sadā

original: evamastviti liṃgena proktaṃ tuṣṭena pārvati | tadāprabhṛti vikhyāto devo ḍhuṃḍhe śvaraḥ paraḥ || 29 ||
analyzed: evam astu iti liṃgena proktam tuṣṭena pārvati tadā prabhṛti vikhyātaḥ devaḥ ḍhuṃḍhe śvaraḥ paraḥ  /

original: yasya darśanamātreṇa sadā siddhirbhavennṛṇām || 30 ||
analyzed: yasya darśana mātreṇa sadā siddhiḥ bhavet nṛṇām

original: bhaktyā ye pūjayiṣyaṃti devaṃ ḍhuṃḍheśvaraṃ param | ājanmaprabhavaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāṃ yāsya ti tatkṣaṇāt || 31 ||
analyzed: bhaktyā ye pūjayiṣyaṃti devam ḍhuṃḍheśvaram param  ājanma prabhavam pāpam teṣām tad kṣaṇāt

original: sa eva sukṛtī loke sa eva mama vallabhaḥ | yaḥ paśyati naro bhaktyā liṃgaṃ ḍhuṃḍheśvaraṃ param || 32 ||
analyzed: saḥ eva sukṛtī loke saḥ eva mama vallabhaḥ yaḥ paśyati naraḥ bhaktyā liṃgam ḍhuṃḍheśvaram param   /

original: rājasūyaśatenaiva yatpuṇyaṃ ca bhaviṣyati | tato bhaviṣyatyadhikaṃ ḍhuṃḍheśvaranirīkṣaṇāt || 33 ||
analyzed: rājasūya śatena eva yat puṇyam ca bhaviṣyati tatas bhaviṣyati adhikam ḍhuṃḍheśvara nirīkṣaṇāt

original: mānasaṃ vācikaṃ vāpi kāyikaṃ guhyasaṃbhavam | prakāśaṃ vā'prakāśaṃ ca prasaṃgādapi yatkṛ tam | tatsarvaṃ yāsyati kṣipraṃ ḍhuṃḍheśvarasya darśanāt || 34 ||
analyzed: mānasam vācikam vā api kāyikam guhya saṃbhavam prakāśam vā aprakāśam ca prasaṃgāt api yat kṛ tam  tat sarvam yāsyati kṣipram ḍhuṃḍheśvarasya darśanāt

original: ityuktastu mayā devi sa ḍhuṃḍho gaṇanāyakaḥ | kṛto liṃgasya māhātmyādgato loke madīyake | reje ca gaṇapaiḥ sārddhaṃ mamābhīṣṭataro'bhavat || 35 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ tu mayā devi sa ḍhuṃḍhaḥ gaṇanāyakaḥ kṛtaḥ liṃgasya māhātmyāt gataḥ loke madīyake  reje ca gaṇapaiḥ sārddham mama abhīṣṭataraḥ abhavat  /

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | śravaṇātkīrttanādvāpi mama loke mahīyate || 36 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ śravaṇāt kīrttanāt vā api mama loke mahīyate  /

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye ḍhuṃḍheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma tṛtīyo'dhyāyaḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṃga māhātmye ḍhuṃḍheśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma tṛtīyaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: śrīmahādeva uvāca | khyāto'vaṃtyāṃ caturtho'sau devo ḍamarukeśvaraḥ | dṛṣṭe yasmiñjagannāthe yāti pāpaṃ ca saṃkṣayam || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī mahādevaḥ uvāca khyātaḥ avantyām caturthaḥ asau devaḥ ḍamarukeśvaraḥ dṛṣṭe yasmin jagannāthe yāti pāpam ca saṃkṣayam

original: purā vaivasvate kalpe rururnāma mahāsuraḥ | tasya putro mahābāhurvajronāma mahābalaḥ | babhūva sumahākāyastīkṣṇadaṃṣṭro bhayaṃkaraḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: purā vaivasvate kalpe ruruḥ nāma mahā asuraḥ tasya putraḥ mahā bāhuḥ vajraḥ nāma mahā balaḥ babhūva su mahā kāyaḥ tīkṣṇa daṃṣṭraḥ bhayaṃkaraḥ  /

original: tena devāḥ svādhikārāccālitāstridaśāla yāt || 3 ||
analyzed: tena devāḥ sva adhikārāt cālitāḥ tridaśāla yāt

original: tato nītaṃ dhanaṃ teṣāṃ brahmāṇaṃ te tato yayuḥ | brahmāpi bhayasaṃvigno babhūvākuliteṃdriyaḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: tatas nītam dhanam teṣām brahmāṇam te tatas yayuḥ brahmā api bhaya saṃvignaḥ babhūva ākulita iṃdriyaḥ

original: jñātvāvadhyaṃ suraiḥ sārdhaṃ sarvaiḥ so'thamahā balaḥ | teṣu naṣṭeṣu ye viprā yajvāno'tha tapasvinaḥ | tāñjaghāna sa duṣṭātmā ye cānye dharmacāriṇaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: jñātvā avadhyam suraiḥ sārdham sarvaiḥ saḥ atha mahā balaḥ teṣu naṣṭeṣu ye viprāḥ yajvānaḥ atha tapasvinaḥ tān jaghāna sa duṣṭa ātmā ye ca anye dharma cāriṇaḥ  /

original: niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāraṃ tadāsīddharaṇīta talam | naṣṭayajñotsavaṃ devi hāhābhūtamacetanam || 6 ||
analyzed: niḥsvādhyāyavaṣaṭkāram tadā āsīt haraṇī ita talam naṣṭa yajña utsavam devi hāhā bhūtam acetanam

original: tataḥ pravyathitā devāstathā sarve maharṣayaḥ | sametyāmaṃtrayanmaṃtraṃ vadhārthaṃ tasya durmateḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: tatas pravyathitāḥ devāḥ tathā sarve mahā ṛṣayaḥ sametya amaṃtrayat maṃtram vadha artham tasya durmateḥ

original: tataḥ kāyo'bhavatsadyaḥ sarveṣāṃ puratastadā | teṣāṃ ciṃtayatāṃ devi tejaḥpuṃjena cāvṛtaḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: tatas kāyaḥ abhavat sadyas sarveṣām puratas tadā teṣām ciṃtayatām devi tejaḥ puṃjena ca āvṛtaḥ  /

original: tasmātkṛtyā samutpannā divyā kamalalocanā | dyotayaṃtī diśaḥ sarvāḥ svatejobhiḥ samaṃtataḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: tasmāt kṛtyā samutpannā divyā kamala locanā dyotayaṃtī diśaḥ sarvāḥ sva tejobhiḥ samaṃtataḥ  /

original: sābravīttridaśānsarvānkasmātsṛṣṭā hyahaṃ surāḥ | yatkartavyaṃ mayā karma tacchīghraṃ saṃnivedyatām || 10 ||
analyzed: sā bravīt tridaśān sarvān kasmāt sṛṣṭāḥ hi aham surāḥ yat kartavyam mayā karma tat śīghram saṃnivedyatām

original: tatastu tridaśāḥ sarve śrutvā tasyāḥ śubhā giraḥ | ācakhyuḥ sakalaṃ tasyai tadā vajrasya ceṣṭitam || 11 ||
analyzed: tatas tu tridaśāḥ sarve śrutvā tasyāḥ śubhāḥ giraḥ ācakhyuḥ sakalam tasyai tadā vajrasya ceṣṭitam  /

original: śrutvā jahāsa sā devī sāṭṭahāsaṃ muhur muhuḥ | tasyā hasaṃtyā niḥsasruḥ kanyāḥ kamalalocanāḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: śrutvā jahāsa sā devī sa aṭṭahāsam muhur muhur tasyāḥ hasaṃtyāḥ niḥsasruḥ kanyāḥ kamala locanāḥ

original: pāśāṃkuśadharā raudrā jvālāmālāvṛtānanāḥ | phetkāreṇa ca saṃnādaiścālayaṃtyaścarācaram || 13 ||
analyzed: pāśa aṃkuśa dharāḥ raudrāḥ jvālā mālā vṛta ānanāḥ phetkāreṇa ca saṃnādaiḥ cālayantyaḥ carācaram

original: gatāḥ sarvā mahādevi yatra vajro mahāsuraḥ | yuddhaṃ tu tumulaṃ jātaṃ tābhistasya bhayāvaham || 14 ||
analyzed: gatāḥ sarvāḥ mahādevi yatra vajraḥ mahā asuraḥ yuddham tu tumulam jātam tābhiḥ tasya bhaya āvaham

original: śastrāstrairbahudhā muktairvyāptaṃ caiva digaṃtaram | saṃnaddhākhilasainyāste yuyudhuḥ samare bhṛśam || 15 ||
analyzed: śastra astraiḥ bahudhā muktaiḥ vyāptam ca eva digaṃtaram  saṃnaddha akhila sainyāḥ te yuyudhuḥ samare bhṛśam

original: tataḥ pravavṛte yuddhaṃ tayā devyā suradviṣām | tato mātṛgaṇaṃ kruddhaṃ marddayantaṃ mahāsu rān | parāṅmukhaṃ balaṃ dṛṣṭvā vajro māyāmathāsṛjat || 16 ||
analyzed: tatas pravavṛte yuddham tayā devyā suradviṣām  tatas mātṛ gaṇam kruddham marddayantam mahāsu rān  parāṅmukham balam dṛṣṭvā vajraḥ māyām atha asṛjat

original: tāmasīṃnāma duḥsādhyāṃ yayā muhyati kanyakāḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: tāmasīm nāma duḥsādhyām yayā muhyati kanyakāḥ

original: tamobhūte tatastasminsā devī bhayavihvalā | tābhiḥ sārddhaṃ samāyātā mahākālavanottamam || 18 ||
analyzed: tamaḥ bhūte tatas tasmin sā devī bhaya vihvalā tābhiḥ sārddham samāyātā mahākāla vana uttamam

original: kapālavānharo yatra liṃgākāreṇa saṃsthitaḥ | jñātvā mātṛgaṇaṃ naṣṭaṃ tato māyāprabhāvataḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: kapālavān haraḥ yatra liṃga ākāreṇa saṃsthitaḥ jñātvā mātṛ gaṇam naṣṭam tatas māyā prabhāvataḥ

original: vajro'pi tridaśāñjñātvā devyā sārddhamathopi tān | ājagāma tamuddeśaṃ svasainyaparivāritaḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: vajraḥ api tridaśān jñātvā devyā sārddham atha u pi tān  ājagāma tam uddeśam sva sainya parivāritaḥ  /

original: mahākālavane divye rathakoṭiśatairvṛtaḥ | samaṃtācca vanaṃ devi tatkruddho vākyamabravīt || 21 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vane divye ratha koṭi śataiḥ vṛtaḥ samaṃtāt ca vanam devi tat kruddhaḥ vākyam abravīt

original: adya devānhaniṣyāmi tayā sākaṃ suduṣṭayā | kanyābhiḥ saha yā naṣṭā tamomāyābalena tu || 22 ||
analyzed: adya devān haniṣyāmi tayā sākam su duṣṭayā kanyābhiḥ saha yā naṣṭā tamaḥ māyā balena tu  /

original: etasminnaṃtare kāle nārado munisattamaḥ | sotsukastu samāyāto maṃdare cārukaṃdare || 23 ||
analyzed: etasmin aṃtare kāle nāradaḥ muni sattamaḥ sa utsukaḥ tu samāyātaḥ maṃdare cāru kaṃdare  /

original: kathayāmāsa devanāṃ vajrāddevaparābhavam || 24 ||
analyzed: kathayāmāsa devanām vajrāt deva parābhavam

original: mahākālavane deva tāḍitāsttridaśāḥ prabho | vajreṇa ruruputreṇa tasmādyāhi maheśvara || 25 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vane deva tāḍitāḥ tridaśāḥ prabho vajreṇa ruru putreṇa tasmāt yāhi maheśvara

original: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā tato'haṃ parameśvari | maṃdarādāgatastūrṇaṃ kṛtvā rūpaṃ subhairavam || 26 ||
analyzed: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā tatas aham parameśvari maṃdarāt āgataḥ tūrṇam kṛtvā rūpam su bhairavam

original: sarpairlasadbhiratyugrairbhīṣaṇairgaṇasaṃvṛtaḥ | agre dṛṣṭaṃ mahatsainyaṃ dānavānāṃ bhayāvaham || 27 ||
analyzed: sarpaiḥ lasadbhiḥ ati ugraiḥ bhīṣaṇaiḥ gaṇa saṃvṛtaḥ agre dṛṣṭam mahat sainyam dānavānām bhaya āvaham

original: mahākālavanaṃ ruddhaṃ samaṃtādasureṇa tu | vajreṇa ruruputreṇa duḥsahena yaśasvini || 28 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vanam ruddham samaṃtāt asureṇa tu vajreṇa ruru putreṇa duḥsahena yaśasvini

original: tadāgatya mayā tāḍya raudraṃ ḍamarukaṃ tathā | mohitaṃ sahasā sainyaṃ vajrasyaiva durātmanaḥ || 29 ||
analyzed: tadā āgatya mayā tāḍya raudram ḍamarukam tathā mohitam sahasā sainyam vajrasya eva durātmanaḥ

original: ḍamarukasya nādena hyutthitaṃ liṃgamuttamam | vidārya vasudhāṃ devi jvālāmālākulaṃ tadā || 30 ||
analyzed: ḍamarukasya nādena hi utthitam liṃgam uttamam vidārya vasudhām devi jvālā mālā ākulam tadā  /

original: tasya liṃgasya ca tadā mahājvālā vinirgatā | ekadeśādvarārohe brahmāṃḍavyāpinī tathā || 31 ||
analyzed: tasya liṃgasya ca tadā mahā jvālā vinirgatā eka deśāt varārohe brahmāṃḍa vyāpinī tathā

original: liṃgasyānyapradeśāttu vāyuḥ samabhavanmahān || 32 ||
analyzed: liṃgasya anya pradeśāt tu vāyuḥ samabhavat mahān

original: tejojvālāsamūhena vātena preritena ca | saha cakreṇa tatsainyaṃ dagdhaṃ bhasmatvamāgatam || 33 ||
analyzed: tejaḥ jvālā samūhena vātena preritena ca saha cakreṇa tat sainyam dagdham bhasma tvam āgatam  /

original: tato devagaṇāḥ sarve harṣanirbharamānasāḥ | namaścakrurha te tasminruruputre mahābale || 34 ||
analyzed: tatas deva gaṇāḥ sarve harṣa nirbhara mānasāḥ namaścakruḥ ha te tasmin ruru putre mahā bale

original: asya devasya māhātmyāddagdho vajro mahābalaḥ | sasainyobhūttatastasmādeṣa ḍamarukeśvaraḥ | khyātiṃ yāsyati lokesminsarvakāmaphalapradaḥ || 35 ||
analyzed: asya devasya māhātmyāt dagdhaḥ vajraḥ mahā balaḥ sa sainyaḥ bhūt tatas tasmāt eṣa ḍamaruka īśvaraḥ khyātim yāsyati loke smin sarva kāma phala pradaḥ

original: ḍamarukasya tu nādena jāto yasmānmahītale | ataḥ pūjyavaro devo bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 36 ||
analyzed: ḍamarukasya tu nādena jātaḥ yasmāt mahī tale  atas pūjya varaḥ devaḥ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ

original: dṛṣṭvā ye pūjayiṣyaṃti devaṃ ḍamarukeśvaram | te sarve duḥkhanirmuktā bhaviṣyaṃti gatajvarāḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā ye pūjayiṣyaṃti devam ḍamaruka īśvaram te sarve duḥkha nirmuktāḥ bhaviṣyaṃti gata jvarāḥ

original: cāṃdrāyaṇānāṃ vidhivacchatānāmatha yatphalam | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti ḍamarukeśvarapūjanāt || 38 ||
analyzed: cāṃdrāyaṇānām vidhivat śatānām atha yat phalam tat phalam samavāpnoti ḍamarukeśvara pūjanāt  /

original: asminsthāne sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ bhaktyā ḍamarukeśvaram | prasaṃgādapi paśyaṃti hyapi pāpaparā narāḥ || 39 ||
analyzed: asmin sthāne sthitam liṃgam bhaktyā ḍamarukeśvaram prasaṃgāt api paśyaṃti hi api pāpa parāḥ narāḥ  /

original: te'pyavaśyaṃ tu yāsyaṃti rudralokaṃ sanātanam | bhaktāḥ stoṣyaṃti ye liṃgaṃ khyātaṃ ḍamarukeśvaram || 40 ||
analyzed: te api avaśyam tu yāsyanti rudra lokam sanātanam bhaktāḥ stoṣyaṃti ye liṃgam khyātam ḍamarukeśvaram

original: etasminnaṃtare vahnirdṛṣṭvā putrasya ceṣṭitam | jñātvā krodhaṃ madīyaṃ tu bhīto vai putrakāra ṇāt || 35 ||

analyzed: tvayi tuṣṭe mahādeva prāpyaḥ ayam na atra saṃśayaḥ icchayā dīyatām devi yasya kasya janasya ca  /

analyzed: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā pitṛ deva mukhasya ca tathā iti ca pratijñātam mayā lobhāt yaśasvini

original: snehānmayā vahniputra utsaṃge ca kṛtastadā | snehādvai cuṃbito mūrdhni pariṣvaktaḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: snehāt mayā vahni putraḥ utsaṃge ca kṛtaḥ tadā snehāt vai cuṃbitaḥ mūrdhni pariṣvaktaḥ punar punar

original: puṇyaścaiva pavitreṇa durlabhaśca bhaviṣyati | akulīnaḥ kulīnastu samalo nirmalo naraḥ || 45 ||
analyzed: puṇyaḥ ca eva pavitreṇa durlabhaḥ ca bhaviṣyati akulīnaḥ kulīnaḥ tu sa malaḥ nirmalaḥ naraḥ

analyzed: yajñāḥ ca eva upavāsāḥ ca tīrtham piṃḍa ādikam tvayā su saṃpūrṇāḥ bhaviṣyaṃti tava dānena suvrata

original: sarveṣāṃ caiva ratnānāmādhipatyaṃ kariṣyasi | priyābhīṣṭo hi devānāṃ lokānāṃ ca bhaviṣyasi || 48 ||
analyzed: sarveṣām ca eva ratnānām ādhipatyam kariṣyasi priya abhīṣṭaḥ hi devānām lokānām ca bhaviṣyasi  /

original: ityukto'sau mahādevi divyarūpo varānane | jvālāmālā vṛtaḥ puṇyo nirmalo hi babhūva ha || 49 ||

original: liṃgenoktaḥ suvarṇastu diṣṭyādiṣṭyeti kāṃcanam | adyaprabhṛti nāmnā vai khyātiṃ yāsyasi bhūtale || 50 ||

analyzed: iti uktaḥ devi liṃgena vahni putraḥ ati nirmalaḥ jvālā vṛta tanuḥ jātaḥ sūrya koṭi sama prabhaḥ

original: yastamarcayate bhaktyā svarṇajvāleśvaraṃ śivam | tasya saṃjāyate devi vijayo rājyamūrjitam | aiśvaryaṃ dānaśaktiśca putrapautramanaṃtakam || 54 ||

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye svarṇajvāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣaṣṭho'dhyāyaḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām paṃcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye svarṇajvāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣaṣṭhaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: śrīmahādeva uvāca | triviṣṭapeśvaraṃ devi saptamaṃ parvatātmaje | yasya darśanamātreṇa labhyate tattriviṣṭapam || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī mahādevaḥ uvāca triviṣṭapeśvaram devi saptamam parvatātmaje  yasya darśana mātreṇa labhyate tat triviṣṭapam   /

analyzed: vīṇā veṇu ravaiḥ ghuṣṭe deva gaṃdharva sevite vajra iṃdra nīla vaidūrya caṃdrakānta ādi dīpite

original: brahmalokādibhirlokairanaupamyaguṇe śubhe | dadarśa tatra deveśamupaviṣṭaṃ śatakratum | stūyamānaṃ mudā devaiḥ si ddhacāraṇakinnaraiḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: brahma loka ādibhiḥ lokaiḥ anaupamya guṇe śubhe  dadarśa tatra deveśam upaviṣṭam śatakratum stūyamānam mudā devaiḥ si ddha cāraṇa kinnaraiḥ

original: liṃgaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ tadā taistu kapālairbahubhivṛtam | kṛtārthāste tadā jātāstasya liṃgasya darśanāt || 42 ||

original: ato'sau bhuvi vikhyātaḥ kapāleśvarasaṃjñakaḥ | ye'rcayanti mahādevi kapāleśvarasaṃjñakam || 43 ||
analyzed: atas asau bhuvi vikhyātaḥ kapāleśvara saṃjñakaḥ ye arcayanti mahādevi kapāleśvara saṃjñakam

original: kṛtapuṇyā narā devi te yāṃti paramaṃ padam | kṛtvāpi pātakaṃ ghoraṃ brahmahatyādikaṃ naraḥ || 44 ||
analyzed: kṛta puṇyāḥ narāḥ devi te yāṃti paramam padam  kṛtvā api pātakam ghoram brahmahatyā ādikam naraḥ

original: tatpāpaṃ vilayaṃ yāti liṃgasyāsya ca darśanāt | karmaṇā manasā vācā yatpāpaṃ samupārjitam | tatkṣapayati devo'yaṃ caturddaśyāṃ samarcitaḥ || 45 ||
analyzed: tat pāpam vilayam yāti liṃgasya asya ca darśanāt karmaṇā manasā vācā yat pāpam samupārjitam tat kṣapayati devaḥ ayam caturddaśyām samarcitaḥ   /

original: prasaṃgādapi ye pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti varānane | te'pi kāmānavāpsyaṃti yāṃśca kāṃścitsudurlabhān | aiśvaryadharmamatulaṃ dīrghamāyurarogatām || 46 ||
analyzed: prasaṃgāt api ye pūjām kariṣyanti varānane te api kāmān avāpsyaṃti yān ca kāṃścid su durlabhān aiśvarya dharmam atulam dīrgham āyuḥ aroga tām

original: niḥsapatnatvamatulaṃ yaccānyattadavāpnuyāt | atīva pāpino ye ca krūrakarmaratā narāḥ || 47 ||
analyzed: niḥsapatna tvam atulam yat ca anyat tat avāpnuyāt atīva pāpinaḥ ye ca krūra karma ratāḥ narāḥ

original: vipāpmāno bhaviṣyaṃti gaṇeśāśca mama priye | niyamena prapaśyaṃti ye devaṃ vatsaraṃ priye | te paśyaṃti tanuṃ tyaktvā madīyaṃ bhavanaṃ priyam || 48 ||
analyzed: vipāpmānaḥ bhaviṣyanti gaṇeśāḥ ca mama priye niyamena prapaśyaṃti ye devam vatsaram priye te paśyaṃti tanum tyaktvā madīyam bhavanam priyam

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | kapāleśvaradevasya svargadvāreśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 49 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ kapāleśvara devasya svargadvāra īśvaram śṛṇu  /

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye kapāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmāṣṭamo'dhyāyaḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṃga māhātmye kapāleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma aṣṭamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: | śrīrudra uvāca | svargadvāreśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ navamaṃ viddhi pārvati | sarvapāpaharaṃ devi svargamokṣaphalapradam || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī rudraḥ uvāca svargadvāra īśvaram liṃgam navamam viddhi pārvati sarva pāpa haram devi svarga mokṣa phala pradam  /

original: yadā devi samāyātāḥ kailāse parvatottame | aśvinyādyā bhaginyastāstvāṃ dṛṣṭvā vismayānvitāḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: yadā devi samāyātāḥ kailāse parvata uttame  aśvinī ādyāḥ bhaginyaḥ tāḥ tvām dṛṣṭvā vismaya anvitāḥ

original: nimaṃtritā vayaṃ yajñe sakāṃtāḥ saparigrahāḥ | snehena devi tātena bahumānapuraḥ saram || 3 ||
analyzed: nimaṃtritāḥ vayam yajñe sa kāṃtāḥ sa parigrahāḥ snehena devi tātena bahu māna puras saram  /

original: kaccitsmṛtā viśālākṣi kiṃ vā tātasya vismṛtiḥ | kāraṇaṃ kiṃ samuddiśya tātena na nimaṃtritā || 4 ||
analyzed: kaccit smṛtā viśāla akṣi kim vā tātasya vismṛtiḥ kāraṇam kim samuddiśya tātena na nimaṃtritā  /

original: tāsāṃ tadvacanaṃ śrutvā avamā nāttadā tvayā | prāṇā muktāstu yogena puratastāsu pārvati || 5 ||
analyzed: tāsām tat vacanam śrutvā avamā nā at tadā tvayā prāṇāḥ muktāḥ tu yogena puratas tāsu pārvati

original: atha tāḥ śokasaṃtaptā gatā yatra prajāpatiḥ | ācakhyuḥ sakalaṃ vṛttaṃ dakṣasyāgre yathā tatham || 6 ||
analyzed: atha tāḥ śoka saṃtaptāḥ gatāḥ yatra prajāpatiḥ ācakhyuḥ sakalam vṛttam dakṣasya agre yathā tatham  /

original: tacchutvā dāruṇaṃ vākyaṃ dakṣo novāca kiṃcana || 7 ||
analyzed: tat śutvā dāruṇam vākyam dakṣaḥ na uvāca kiṃcana

original: mayā dṛṣṭā yadā devi bhūmau paṃcatvamāgatā | yajñapradhvaṃsanārthāya tadā vai preritā gaṇāḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: mayā dṛṣṭā yadā devi bhūmau paṃcatvam āgatā yajña pradhvaṃsana arthāya tadā vai preritāḥ gaṇāḥ  /

original: te gatvātha gaṇā raudrāḥ śataśo'tha sahasraśaḥ | virūpā bhīṣaṇā raudrā nānāśastrā mahābalāḥ | mumucuḥ śaravarṣāṇi kurvaṃto bhairavānravān || 9 ||
analyzed: te gatvā atha gaṇāḥ raudrāḥ śataśas atha sahasraśas virūpāḥ bhīṣaṇāḥ raudrāḥ nānā śastrāḥ mahā balāḥ mumucuḥ śara varṣāṇi kurvaṃtaḥ bhairavān ravān

original: tato devagaṇāḥ sarve vasavaḥ saha bhāskaraiḥ | viśvedevāśca sādhyāśca dhanurhastā mahābalāḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: tatas deva gaṇāḥ sarve vasavaḥ saha bhāskaraiḥ viśvedevāḥ ca sādhyāḥ ca dhanuḥ hastāḥ mahā balāḥ

original: yuddhāya ca viniṣkrāṃtā mumucuḥ sāyakānsitān | te sametyātha yuyudhuḥ pramathā vibudhaiḥ saha | mumucuḥ śaravarṣāṇi vāridhārā yathā ghanāḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: yuddhāya ca viniṣkrāṃtāḥ mumucuḥ sāyakān sitān  te sametya atha yuyudhuḥ pramathāḥ vibudhaiḥ saha mumucuḥ śara varṣāṇi vāri dhārāḥ yathā ghanāḥ

original: teṣāṃ madhye gaṇo nāma vīrabhadro mahābalaḥ | sa śakraṃ tāḍayāmāsa śūlena hṛdaye tathā || 12 ||
analyzed: teṣām madhye gaṇaḥ nāma vīrabhadraḥ mahā balaḥ sa śakram tāḍayāmāsa śūlena hṛdaye tathā

original: sa tu tena prahāreṇa visaṃjño niṣasāda ha | atha muṣṭyā hataḥ kumbhe nāga airāvatastathā || 13 ||
analyzed: sa tu tena prahāreṇa visaṃjñaḥ niṣasāda ha  atha muṣṭyā hataḥ kumbhe nāgaḥ airāvataḥ tathā

original: sa hataḥ sahasā tena gajeṃdro bheravānravān | vinadanbhayamāsthāya yajñavāṭamupādravat || 14 ||
analyzed: sa hataḥ sahasā tena gaja iṃdraḥ bheravān ravān vinadan bhayam āsthāya yajñavāṭam upādravat

original: etasminnaṃtare devā kṛtāstena parāṅmukhāḥ | tataste śaraṇaṃ jagmurviṣṇuṃ viśvaikanāyakam || 15 ||
analyzed: etasmin antare kṛtāḥ tena parāṅmukhāḥ tatas te śaraṇam jagmuḥ viṣṇum viśva eka nāyakam

original: tataḥ kopasamāviṣṭo viṣṇurdṛṣṭvā divālayān | gaṇairvidrāvitānsarvānmumocāśu sudarśanam || 16 ||
analyzed: tatas kopa samāviṣṭaḥ viṣṇuḥ dṛṣṭvā divā ālayān gaṇaiḥ vidrāvitān sarvān mumoca āśu sudarśanam

original: tadāpatattu vegena cakraṃ viṣṇoḥ sudarśanam | prasārya vaktraṃ sahasā hyudarasthaṃ cakāra ha || 17 ||
analyzed: tadā apatat tu vegena cakram viṣṇoḥ sudarśanam prasārya vaktram sahasā hi udara stham cakāra ha  /

original: tasmiṃścakre tadā graste hyamoghe daityasūdane | kruddho nārāyaṇo devi vīrabhadramupādravat || 18 ||
analyzed: tasmin cakre tadā graste hi amoghe daitya sūdane  kruddhaḥ nārāyaṇaḥ devi vīrabhadram upādravat

original: gṛhītvā pādayorbhūmau nijaghānātidūrataḥ | hanyamānasyātha bhūmau gadayā ca sudarśanam || 19 ||
analyzed: gṛhītvā pādayoḥ bhūmau nijaghāna ati dūrataḥ hanyamānasya atha bhūmau gadayā ca sudarśanam

original: rudhirodgārasaṃyuktaṃ vaktrāttacca vinirgatam | matto labdhavaro devi vīrabhadro gaṇottamaḥ | na tu paṃcatvamāpanno gadayā tāḍito'pi saḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: rudhira udgāra saṃyuktam vaktrāt tat ca vinirgatam mattaḥ labdha varaḥ devi vīrabhadraḥ gaṇa uttamaḥ na tu paṃcatvam āpannaḥ gadayā tāḍitaḥ api saḥ  /

original: tatastu pramathāḥ sarve viṣṇuvīryabalārdditāḥ | kṛcchreṇa sahasā prāptā yatrāhaṃ devi saṃsthitaḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: tatas tu pramathāḥ sarve viṣṇu vīrya bala ardditāḥ kṛcchreṇa sahasā prāptāḥ yatra aham devi saṃsthitaḥ

original: māṃ dṛṣṭvā śūlahastaṃ tu viṣṇuścāṃtaradhīyata | iṃdro'pi tridaśaiḥ sārddhaṃ pitṛbhirbrāhmaṇaiḥ saha || 22 ||
analyzed: mām dṛṣṭvā śūla hastam tu viṣṇuḥ ca aṃtaradhīyata iṃdraḥ api tridaśaiḥ sārddham pitṛbhiḥ brāhmaṇaiḥ saha  /

original: mattastrāsaparītātmā tataścādarśanaṃ gataḥ | evaṃ vidhvaṃsite yajñe naṣṭo devagaṇo yadā || 23 ||
analyzed: mattaḥ trāsa parīta ātmā tatas ca adarśanam gataḥ evam vidhvaṃsite yajñe naṣṭaḥ deva gaṇaḥ yadā

original: mayā nirūpito devi svargadvāre gaṇastadā | praveśo naiva dātavyastridaśānāṃ gaṇeśvara || 24 ||
analyzed: mayā nirūpitaḥ devi svargadvāre gaṇaḥ tadā praveśaḥ nā eva dātavyaḥ tridaśānām gaṇeśvara

original: dvārāvarodhaḥ karttavyo yatnataḥ śāsanānmama | yaḥ kopi dṛśyate devaḥ sa haṃtavyo na saṃśayaḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: dvāra avarodhaḥ karttavyaḥ yatnataḥ śāsanāt mama  yaḥ kaḥ api dṛśyate devaḥ sa haṃtavyaḥ na saṃśayaḥ

original: udvasaśca tato jātaḥ svargo devā vinirjitāḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: udvasaḥ ca tatas jātaḥ svargaḥ devāḥ vinirjitāḥ

original: svargadvāre niruddhe tu śakrādyā bhayavihvalāḥ | brahmalokaṃ gatā devā maṃtrayitvā punaḥpunaḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: svargadvāre niruddhe tu śakra ādyāḥ bhaya vihvalāḥ brahma lokam gatāḥ devāḥ maṃtrayitvā punar punar

original: tasyāgre kathitaṃ sarvaṃ svargadvārāvarodhanam | maheśvaragaṇairvyāptaṃ svargadvāraṃ pitāmaha || 28 ||
analyzed: tasya agre kathitam sarvam svargadvāra avarodhanam maheśvara gaṇaiḥ vyāptam svargadvāram pitāmaha  /

original: praveśo durlabho jātaḥ kṛte dvārāvarodhane | kenopāyena yāsyāmaḥ svargalokaṃ tathāvidham || 29 ||
analyzed: praveśaḥ durlabhaḥ jātaḥ kṛte dvāra avarodhane kena upāyena yāsyāmaḥ svarga lokam tathāvidham  /

original: nāsmākaṃ jāyate prītirvinā svargaṃ pitāmaha || 30 ||
analyzed: na asmākam jāyate prītiḥ vinā svargam pitāmaha

original: iti teṣāṃ vacaḥ śrutvā proktaṃ tu brahmaṇā tadā | ārādhyaḥ śaṃkaro devo mahādevo jagatpatiḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: iti teṣām vacaḥ śrutvā proktam tu brahmaṇā tadā  ārādhyaḥ śaṃkaraḥ devaḥ mahādevaḥ jagatpatiḥ   /

original: stutyo vaṃdyo namaskāryaḥ sṛṣṭi saṃhārakārakaḥ | durlabhastu surāḥ svargo vinā tasya prasādataḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: stutyaḥ vaṃdyaḥ namaskāryaḥ sṛṣṭi saṃhāra kārakaḥ durlabhaḥ tu surāḥ svargaḥ vinā tasya prasādataḥ

original: goptā sraṣṭā samarthaśca sa cāsmākaṃ parā gatiḥ | sa evārādhanīyastu sa ca pūjyatamo mataḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: goptā sraṣṭā samarthaḥ ca sa ca asmākam parā gatiḥ saḥ eva ārādhanīyaḥ tu sa ca pūjyatamaḥ mataḥ  /

original: tasmātsarvaprayatnena gamyatāṃ śaraṇaṃ śivaḥ | upāyaṃ kathayiṣyāmi śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānataḥ || 34 ||
analyzed: tasmāt sarva prayatnena gamyatām śaraṇam śivaḥ  upāyam kathayiṣyāmi śrūyatām sāvadhānataḥ

original: tridaśaiḥ sahitaḥ śakra tūrṇaṃ gaccha mamājñayā | mahākālavane ramye kapāleśvarapūrvataḥ || 35 ||
analyzed: tridaśaiḥ sahitaḥ śakra tūrṇam gaccha mama ājñayā mahākāla vane ramye kapāleśvara pūrvatas  /

original: svargadvāra paraṃ liṃgaṃ vidyate tattu vāsava | lokānāmanukaṃpārthaṃ mahādevena nirmitam | tamārādhayata kṣipraṃ sa vaḥ kāmaṃ pradāsyati || 36 ||
analyzed: svargadvāra param liṃgam vidyate tat tu vāsava lokānām anukaṃpā artham mahādevena nirmitam tam ārādhayata kṣipram sa vaḥ kāmam pradāsyati  /

original: brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā tridaśā muditā bhṛśam | samāyātā mahādevi mahākālavanaṃ tadā || 37 ||
analyzed: brahmaṇaḥ vacanam śrutvā tridaśāḥ muditāḥ bhṛśam samāyātāḥ mahādevi mahākāla vanam tadā

original: svargadvārapradaṃ puṇyaṃ dadṛśurliṃgamuttamam | tasya darśanamātreṇa svargadvāramapāvṛtam || 38 ||
analyzed: svarga dvāra pradam puṇyam dadṛśuḥ liṃgam uttamam tasya darśana mātreṇa svarga dvāram apāvṛtam   /

original: svargalokaṃ gatāḥ sarve yathāpūrvaṃ yaśasvini | niḥśaṃkāṃstridaśāndṛṣṭvā vijñaptohaṃ gaṇaistadā || 39 ||
analyzed: svarga lokam gatāḥ sarve yathāpūrvam yaśasvini niḥśaṃkān tridaśān dṛṣṭvā vijñaptaḥ uham gaṇaiḥ tadā

original: mayājñaptāśca te sarve nivarttadhvaṃ gaṇottamāḥ | svayameva pratijñātaṃ kathaṃ mithyā bhaviṣyati || 40 ||
analyzed: mayā ājñaptāḥ ca te sarve nivarttadhvam gaṇa uttamāḥ svayam eva pratijñātam katham mithyā bhaviṣyati  /

original: svargadvāraprado devo dṛṣṭo devairna saṃśayaḥ | mahākālavane ramye kathito hi viraṃcinā || 41 ||
analyzed: svarga dvāra pradaḥ devaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ devaiḥ na saṃśayaḥ mahākāla vane ramye kathitaḥ hi viraṃcinā  /

original: svargadvāraṃ gatāḥ sadyaḥ śakrādyāstridaśā gaṇāḥ | ataḥ prabhṛti vikhyātaḥ svargadvāreśvaraḥ śivaḥ || 42 ||
analyzed: svargadvāram gatāḥ sadyas śakra ādyāḥ tridaśāḥ gaṇāḥ atas prabhṛti vikhyātaḥ svargadvāra īśvaraḥ śivaḥ

original: khyātiṃ yāsyati bhūloke svargalokapradāyakaḥ || 43 ||
analyzed: khyātim yāsyati bhū loke svarga loka pradāyakaḥ

original: ye paśyaṃti narā loke svargadvāreśvaraṃ śivam | te yāṃti svargalokaṃ hi svargadvāreśvarārcanāt || 44 ||
analyzed: ye paśyaṃti narāḥ loke svargadvāra īśvaram śivam te yāṃti svarga lokam hi svargadvāra īśvara arcanāt  /

original: svargadvāreśvaraṃ devaṃ ye paśyaṃti prasaṃgataḥ | na teṣāṃ bhayamastīti kalpa koṭiśatairapi || 45 ||
analyzed: svargadvāra īśvaram devam ye paśyaṃti prasaṃgataḥ na teṣām bhayam asti iti kalpa koṭi śataiḥ api  /

original: aśvamedhasahasreṇa yatpuṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam | tatpuṇyamadhikaṃ devi svargadvāreśvarārcanāt || 46 ||
analyzed: aśvamedha sahasreṇa yat puṇyam samudāhṛtam tat puṇyam adhikam devi svargadvāra īśvara arcanāt  /

original: janmāṃtarasahasreṇa yatpāpaṃ pūrva saṃcitam | yatpāpaṃ vilayaṃ yāṃti liṃgasyāsya ca kīrtanāt || 47 ||
analyzed: janma aṃtara sahasreṇa yat pāpam saṃcitam  yat pāpam vilayam yānti liṃgasya asya ca kīrtanāt  /

original: aṣṭamyāṃ vā caturdaśyāmathavā caṃdravāsare | ye paśyaṃti narā bhaktyā svargadvāreśvaraṃ śivam | te devi me śarīraṃ tu praviṣṭāstvapunarbhavāḥ || 48 ||
analyzed: aṣṭamyām vā caturdaśyām athavā caṃdra vāsare ye paśyaṃti narāḥ bhaktyā svargadvāra īśvaram śivam te devi me śarīram tu praviṣṭāḥ tu apunarbhavāḥ

original: daśakoṭisahasrāṇi tasmiṃlliṃge tu pūjite | pūjitāni bhavaṃ tīha liṃgānyaṃtaḥsthitāni tu || 49 ||
analyzed: daśa koṭi sahasrāṇi tasmin liṃge tu pūjite pūjitāni liṃgāni antar sthitāni tu

original: sparśanāttasya liṃgasya kīrttanādyajanāttathā | sukhena svargamāyāṃti yathā kāmānavāpnuyāt || 50 ||
analyzed: sparśanāt tasya liṃgasya kīrttanāt yajanāt tathā sukhena svargam āyāṃti yathā kāmān avāpnuyāt  /

original: akāmāvā sakāmā vā ye paśyaṃti dine dine | te'pi puṇyā mahābhāgāḥ svargalokaṃ prayāṃti vai || 51 ||
analyzed: sa kāmāḥ vā ye paśyaṃti dine dine te api puṇyāḥ mahābhāgāḥ svarga lokam prayāṃti vai

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye svargadvāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma navamo'dhyāyaḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye svargadvāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam nāma navamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: śrīmahādeva uvāca | karkoṭeśvarasaṃjñaṃ ca daśamaṃ viddhi pārvati | yasya darśanamātreṇa viṣairnaivābhibhūyate || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī mahādevaḥ uvāca  karkoṭeśvara saṃjñam ca daśamam viddhi pārvati yasya darśana mātreṇa viṣaiḥ na eva abhibhūyate  /

original: mātrā ca bhujagāḥ śaptāḥ svavacobhaṃgakāraṇāt | madvaco na kṛtaṃ yasmādbhavadbhiḥ pāpakarmaṇi || 2 ||

original: atha svargaṃ gatāḥ kāṃte jitaḥ śakro marutpatiḥ | tathaiva dakṣiṇāmāśāṃ dharmarājo jitastataḥ || 12 ||

original: kathayāmāsuratyugraṃ yathā ruddhaṃ jagattrayam | nārāyaṇena te proktā lokapālāḥ punaḥ punaḥ || 19 ||

original: tatra dṛṣṭaṃ mahalliṃgaṃ tejasāṃ rāśimadbhutam | stutaṃ ca vividhaiḥ stotrairlokapālaiḥ punaḥpunaḥ || 23 ||

original: lokapāleśvaronāma khyātiṃ yāsyati bhūtale | ityuktvā tridaśāḥ sarve lokapālaiḥ samāvṛtāḥ | svasvasthānaṃ gatā divyaṃ yathāpūrvaṃ mudānvitāḥ || 26 ||

original: ye paśyaṃti narā devi lokapāleśvaraṃ śivam | samṛddhibhiḥ susaṃpannā bhaveyurjanmajanmasu || 27 ||

original: na dāridryaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ tathā | aiśvaryaṃ cātulaṃ teṣāṃ jāyate darśanātsadā || 28 ||

original: prasaṃgenāpi yaḥ paśyellokapāleśvaraṃ śivam | modate svargaloke sa lokapālaiḥ samaṃ sadā || 31 ||

original: te durddharṣā bhavaṃtīha śatrūṇāṃ saṃgare tathā | mṛtā yāṃti vimānena śakralokaṃ sudurlabham || 33 ||
analyzed: te durddharṣāḥ bhavanti iha śatrūṇām saṃgare tathā mṛtāḥ yānti vimānena śakra lokam su durlabham

original: hara uvāca | viddhi kāmeśvaraṃ devi tatra liṃgaṃ trayodaśam | yasya darśanamātreṇa saubhāgyaṃ jāyate śubham || 1 ||
analyzed: haraḥ uvāca  viddhi kāmeśvaram devi tatra liṃgam trayodaśam yasya darśana mātreṇa saubhāgyam jāyate śubham

original: brahmaṇo dhyāyamānasya prajākāmasya pārvati | utpanno'rkaprabhākāro lāvaṇyanicayo mahān | alaṃkārāvṛtaḥ kāṃto divyamaṃḍanamaṃḍitaḥ || 2 ||

original: dṛṣṭvā so'tha bahūnyajñānbhūmau pracuradakṣiṇān | gataḥ svargaṃ mahātmā vai sarvakāmaphalapradam || 3 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā saḥ atha bahūn yajñān bhūmau pracura dakṣiṇān gataḥ svargam mahātmā vai sarva kāma phala pradam

original: sa cātha pratyutaḥ svargānnaṣṭakīrtiryadā kṣitau | papāta bhūmau sahasā gatapuṇyo narā dhipaḥ | patitaściṃtayāmāsa bhraśaṃ śokapariplutaḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: sa ca atha pratyutaḥ svargāt naṣṭa kīrtiḥ yadā kṣitau papāta bhūmau sahasā gata puṇyaḥ narāḥ dhipaḥ patitaḥ ciṃtayāmāsa bhraśam śoka pariplutaḥ

original: kṛtasya karmaṇastvatra bhujyate yatphalaṃ divi | na cānyatkriyate tadyadbhūtalasthena bhujyate || 5 ||
analyzed: kṛtasya karmaṇaḥ tu atra bhujyate yat phalam divi  na ca anyat kriyate tat yat bhū tala sthena bhujyate  /

original: so'tra doṣo matastasyāmatastatpatanaṃ ca yat | patanāttu mahadduḥkhaṃ paritāpaśca jāyate || 6 ||
analyzed: saḥ atra doṣaḥ mataḥ tasyām atas tad patanam ca yat patanāt tu mahat duḥkham paritāpaḥ ca jāyate

original: svargabhājo bhavaṃtīha yāvatkīrtiśca jāyate | divaṃ spṛśati bhūmiṃ ca śabdaḥ puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ | yāvatsa śabdo bhavati tāvatpuruṣa ucyate || 7 ||
analyzed: svarga bhājaḥ bhavanti iha yāvat kīrtiḥ ca jāyate  divam spṛśati bhūmim ca śabdaḥ puṇyasya karmaṇaḥ yāvat sa śabdaḥ bhavati tāvat puruṣaḥ ucyate

original: akīrtiḥ kīrttyate yasya loke bhūtasya kasyacit | sa patatyadhamāṃllokānyāvacchabdo'sya kīrttitaḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: akīrtiḥ kīrttyate yasya loke bhūtasya kasyacid  sa patati adhamān lokān yāvat śabdaḥ asya kīrttitaḥ  /

original: tasmātkalyāṇavṛttaḥ syādanyathā patanaṃ bhuvi | vidhāya vṛttaṃ pāpiṣṭhaṃ kīrtimevābhivarddhayet || 9 ||
analyzed: tasmāt kalyāṇa vṛttaḥ syāt anyathā patanam bhuvi vidhāya vṛttam pāpiṣṭham kīrtim eva abhivarddhayet

original: atyaṃtaṃ ślāghayāmyatra kīrttiṃ svargakarāṃ parām | devairapi hi sā kīrtiḥ kāṃkṣyate paramā yataḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: atyaṃtam ślāghayāmi atra kīrttim svarga karām parām devaiḥ api hi sā kīrtiḥ kāṃkṣyate paramā yatas

original: yāvatkīrttirmanuṣyāṇāṃ varttate bhuvi cākṣayā | tejaḥ puṃjena yuktāni śarīrāṇi bhavaṃti hi || 11 ||
analyzed: yāvat kīrttiḥ manuṣyāṇām varttate bhuvi ca akṣayā tejaḥ puṃjena yuktāni śarīrāṇi bhavanti hi  /

original: na svedo na ca daurgaṃdhyaṃ purīṣaṃ mūtrameva vā | teṣāṃ nirvacanaṃ rājā vidhātā ca triviṣṭape | uhyaṃte te vimānaiśca nānābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: na svedaḥ na ca daurgaṃdhyam purīṣam mūtram eva vā teṣām nirvacanam rājā vidhātā ca triviṣṭape  uhyaṃte te vimānaiḥ ca nānā ābharaṇa bhūṣitāḥ  /

original: evaṃ vimṛśya nṛpatiriṃdradyumno varānane | svargakāmo jagāmātha himavaṃtaṃ nagottamam || 13 ||
analyzed: evam vimṛśya nṛpatiḥ iṃdradyumnaḥ varānane svarga kāmaḥ jagāma atha himavaṃtam naga uttamam

original: yatra tepe tapastīvraṃ mārkaṇḍeyo mahāmuniḥ | dṛṣṭvā praṇamya śirasā sāṣṭāṃgaṃ ca punaḥpunaḥ | papraccha vinayopetastamṛṣiṃ śaṃsitavratam || 14 ||
analyzed: yatra tepe tapaḥ tīvram mārkaṇḍeyaḥ mahā muniḥ dṛṣṭvā praṇamya śirasā sa aṣṭāṃgam ca punar punar  papraccha vinaya upetaḥ tam ṛṣim śaṃsita vratam

original: viditāstava dharmajña devadānavarākṣasāḥ | rājavaṃśāśca vividhā ṛṣivaṃśāśca śāśvatāḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: viditāḥ tava dharma jña deva dānava rākṣasāḥ rāja vaṃśāḥ ca vividhāḥ ṛṣi vaṃśāḥ ca śāśvatāḥ

original: na te'styaviditaṃ kiñcidasmiṃlloke dvijottama | etadicchāmyahaṃ śrotuṃ tattvena kathyatāṃ tvayā | kathaṃ kīrttirdhruvā loke jāyate kiṃ tapaḥphalāt || 16 ||
analyzed: na te asti aviditam kiñcid asmin loke dvijottama etat icchāmi aham śrotum tattvena kathyatām tvayā  katham kīrttiḥ dhruvā loke jāyate kim tapaḥ phalāt  /

original: mārkaṇḍeya uvāca | haṃta te kathayiṣyāmi yataḥ kīrtiṃ samīhase | yāvatkīrtirbhūmisaṃsthā tāvadvasa suraiḥ saha | tadgaccha śīghraṃ dharmajña mahākālavanottamam || 17 ||
analyzed: mārkaṇḍeyaḥ uvāca haṃta te kathayiṣyāmi yatas kīrtim samīhase yāvat kīrtiḥ bhūmi saṃsthā tāvat vasa suraiḥ saha  tat gaccha śīghram dharma jña mahākāla vana uttamam

original: kalkaleśvaradevasya samīpe vāma bhāgataḥ | liṃgaṃ pāpaharaṃ tatra samārādhaya yatnataḥ || 18 ||
analyzed: kalkaleśvara devasya samīpe vāma bhāgataḥ liṃgam pāpa haram tatra samārādhaya yatnataḥ  /

original: tasyābhyarcanamātreṇa lapsyase kīrtimuttamām | svargaṃ sanātanaṃ caiva yatsurairapi durllabham || 19 ||
analyzed: tasya abhyarcana mātreṇa lapsyase kīrtim uttamām svargam sanātanam ca eva yat suraiḥ api durllabham

original: gatvā sa pūjayāmāsa talliṃgaṃ kīrtitaṃ tvidam | tato devāḥ sagandharvāḥ praśasya ca mudānvitāḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: gatvā sa pūjayāmāsa tat liṃgam kīrtitam tu idam tatas devāḥ sa gandharvāḥ praśasya ca mudā anvitāḥ

original: antarikṣe vimānasthā procurvācaṃ narādhipam | tvatkīrttirnirmalā jātā liṃgasyāsya samarcanāt || 21 ||
analyzed: antarikṣe vimāna sthā procuḥ vācam narādhipam tvad kīrttiḥ nirmalā jātā liṃgasya asya samarcanāt

original: adyaprabhṛti rājeṃdra liṃgaṃ tvannāma nāmataḥ | khyātiṃ yāsyati loke'sminniṃdradyumneti niścitam || 22 ||
analyzed: adya prabhṛti rāja iṃdra liṃgam tvad nāma nāmataḥ khyātim yāsyati loke asmin iṃdradyumna iti niścitam  /

original: indradyumneśvaraṃ devaṃ pūjayiṣyaṃti ye narāḥ | sarvapāpavinirmuktā vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: indradyumna īśvaram devam pūjayiṣyaṃti ye narāḥ sarva pāpa vinirmuktāḥ vimānaiḥ sarvakāmikaiḥ  /

original: svargaṃ yāsyaṃti te hṛṣṭāḥ stūyamānāḥ surarṣibhiḥ | kiṃcicca durlabhaṃ loke teṣāṃ naiva bhaviṣyati || 24 ||
analyzed: svargam yāsyaṃti te hṛṣṭāḥ stūyamānāḥ sura ṛṣibhiḥ  kiṃcid ca durlabham loke teṣām na eva bhaviṣyati  /

original: darśanaṃ ye kariṣyaṃti lobhādvāpi prasaṃgataḥ | teṣāṃ kīrtiryaśaḥ puṇyaṃ dharmaścaivaṃ bhaviṣyati || 25 ||
analyzed: darśanam ye kariṣyaṃti lobhāt vā api prasaṃgataḥ teṣām kīrtiḥ yaśaḥ puṇyam dharmaḥ ca evam bhaviṣyati  /

original: na svargātpatanaṃ teṣāṃ yāvadiṃdrāścaturddaśa | ye ca pūjāṃ kariṣyaṃti caturdaśyāṃ viśeṣataḥ | te kulaṃ tārayiṣyaṃti mātṛkaṃ paitṛkaṃ sadā || 26 ||
analyzed: na svargāt patanam teṣām yāvat iṃdrāḥ caturddaśa  ye ca pūjām kariṣyaṃti caturdaśyām viśeṣataḥ te kulam tārayiṣyaṃti mātṛkam paitṛkam sadā  /

original: ityuktā tridaśāḥ sarve liṃgaṃ saṃpūjya yatnataḥ | iṃdradyumnena sahitāḥ punaḥ svargaṃ gatāḥ priye || 27 ||
analyzed: iti uktā tridaśāḥ sarve liṃgam saṃpūjya yatnatas iṃdradyumnena sahitāḥ punar svargam gatāḥ priye

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | indradyumneśadevasya śrūyatāmaparaḥ priye || 28 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ indradyumna īśa devasya śrūyatām aparaḥ priye

original: īśvara uvāca | īśāneśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu ṣoḍaśaṃ viddhi pārvati | yasya darśanamātreṇa aiśvaryaṃ jāyate nṛṇām || 1 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca īśāneśvara saṃjñam tu ṣoḍaśam viddhi pārvati yasya darśana mātreṇa aiśvaryam jāyate nṛṇām  /

original: tuhuṃḍena purā devi sarve hyupadrutāḥ surāḥ | ṛṣayaśca mahābhāgā yakṣagandharvaki nnarāḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: tuhuṃḍena purā devi sarve hi upadrutāḥ surāḥ ṛṣayaḥ ca mahābhāgāḥ yakṣa gandharvaki nnarāḥ

original: naṃdanākhyaṃ vanaṃ sarvaṃ tadadhīnamabhūtkila | airāvaṇaṃ dvipendraṃ ca jitvā dvāri samādadhat || 3 ||
analyzed: naṃdana ākhyam vanam sarvam tad adhīnam abhūt kila airāvaṇam dvipa indram ca jitvā dvāri samādadhat  /

original: uccaiḥśravasasaṃjñaṃ tu hṛtavāndānaveśvaraḥ | devāṃganānāṃ sarvāsāṃ vidhvaṃsaṃ kartumudyataḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: uccaiḥśravasa saṃjñam tu hṛtavān dānava īśvaraḥ deva aṃganānām sarvāsām vidhvaṃsam kartum udyataḥ  /

original: svargamārgaḥ khilībhūtastadbhayena hyabhūtsati | hṛtādhikārā devāśca maṃtraṃ samupacakramuḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: svarga mārgaḥ khilībhūtaḥ tad bhayena hi abhūt sati hṛta adhikārāḥ devāḥ ca maṃtram samupacakramuḥ  /

original: tasminkāle ca kālajño nārado'tha mahāmuniḥ | ājagāma mahātejā bhramamāṇaśca maṃtribhiḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: tasmin kāle ca kāla jñaḥ nāradaḥ atha mahā muniḥ ājagāma mahā tejāḥ bhramamāṇaḥ ca maṃtribhiḥ  /

original: devairnamaskṛtaḥ so'tha pūjitaśca yathāvidhi | niveditaṃ yathāvṛttaṃ tuhuṇḍasya viceṣṭitam || 7 ||
analyzed: devaiḥ namaskṛtaḥ saḥ atha pūjitaḥ ca yathāvidhi niveditam yathāvṛttam tuhuṇḍasya viceṣṭitam  /

original: papracchuratha te maṃtraṃ nāradaṃ munisattamam | kathayasva mahābuddhe sarvaṃ jānāsi sarvvataḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: papracchuḥ atha te maṃtram nāradam muni sattamam kathayasva mahābuddhe sarvam jānāsi sarvatas

original: īdṛkkāle samāyāte kiṃ karttavyaṃ mahāmune | nājñātaṃ triṣu lokeṣu kiṃciddevarṣisattama || 9 ||
analyzed: īdṛś kāle samāyāte kim karttavyam mahā mune na ajñātam triṣu lokeṣu kiṃcid deva ṛṣi sattama

original: muhūrtaṃ dhyānamālaṃbya kiṃcinmīlya ca locane | upāyaṃ kathayāmāsa sarvaduḥkhavināśanam || 10 ||
analyzed: muhūrtam dhyānam ālaṃbya kiṃcid mīlya ca locane upāyam kathayāmāsa sarva duḥkha vināśanam  /

original: mahākālavane ramye śīghraṃ gacchaṃtu vihvalāḥ | indradyumneśvarasyaiva paścādbhāge vyavasthitāḥ | sevadhvaṃ paramaṃ liṃgamīśāneśvarasaṃjñakam || 11 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vane ramye śīghram gacchantu vihvalāḥ indradyumneśvarasya eva paścāt bhāge vyavasthitāḥ sevadhvam paramam liṃgam īśāneśvara saṃjñakam

original: purā ceśānakalpe tu īśānena sukhena hi | muninā śrotriyeṇaiva vedābhyāsaratena vai | uttamāṃgapadaṃ labdhaṃ śaṃkarasya ca mūrddhani || 12 ||
analyzed: purā ca īśāna kalpe tu īśānena sukhena hi muninā śrotriyeṇa eva veda abhyāsa ratena vai uttamāṃga padam labdham śaṃkarasya ca mūrddhani  /

original: tasyārādhanamātreṇa mano'bhīṣṭaṃ hi labhyate || 13 ||
analyzed: tasya ārādhana mātreṇa manaḥ abhīṣṭam hi labhyate

original: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā devā muditamānasāḥ | jagmuryatra mahalliṃgaṃ stutiṃ sarve'pyakurvata || 14 ||
analyzed: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā devāḥ mudita mānasāḥ jagmuḥ yatra mahat liṃgam stutim sarve api akurvata  /

original: īśāneśāna īśāna tatpuruṣa namo'stu te | namo vāma mahāghora sadyomukha namonamaḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: īśāna īśāna īśāna tatpuruṣa namaḥ astu te namaḥ vāma mahā ghora sadyomukha namaḥ namaḥ

original: tryakṣa bharga mahādeva umākāṃta namonamaḥ | namaḥ śiva namo bhīma namaḥ sarva namonamaḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: tryakṣa bharga mahādeva umā kānta namaḥ namaḥ namaḥ śiva namaḥ bhīma namaḥ sarva namaḥ namaḥ

original: namaḥ śaṃbho namo rudra virūpākṣa namonamaḥ | tvayā deva prajāḥ sarvāḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: namaḥ śaṃbho namaḥ rudra virūpākṣa namaḥ namaḥ tvayā deva prajāḥ sarvāḥ sa deva asura mānuṣāḥ   /

original: sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni jaṃgamāni carāṇi ca | brahma vedāśca vedyaṃ ca tvayā sṛṣṭaṃ maheśvara || 18 ||
analyzed: sthāvarāṇi ca bhūtāni jaṃgamāni carāṇi ca brahma vedāḥ ca vedyam ca tvayā sṛṣṭam maheśvara

original: śiraste gaganaṃ devā netre śaśidivākarau | niḥśvāsaḥ pavanaścāpi tejo'gniśca tavācyutaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: śiraḥ te gaganam devāḥ netre śaśi divākarau niḥśvāsaḥ pavanaḥ ca api tejaḥ agniḥ ca tava acyutaḥ

original: bāhavaste diśaḥ sarvāḥ kukṣiścaiva mahārṇavaḥ | urū te parvatā deva caraṇau pṛthivī matā || 20 ||
analyzed: bāhavaḥ te diśaḥ sarvāḥ kukṣiḥ ca eva mahā arṇavaḥ urū te parvatāḥ deva caraṇau pṛthivī matā  /

original: iṃdrasomāgnivaruṇā devāsuramahoragāḥ | prahvāstvāmanutiṣṭhaṃti stuvaṃto vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: iṃdra soma agni varuṇāḥ deva asura mahā uragāḥ prahvāḥ tvām anutiṣṭhaṃti stuvaṃtaḥ vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ   /

original: tvayā vyāptāni bhūtāni sarvāṇi bhuvaneśvara | tvayi tuṣṭe jagattuṣṭaṃ tvayi kruddhe mahadbhayam || 22 ||
analyzed: tvayā vyāptāni bhūtāni sarvāṇi bhuvana īśvara tvayi tuṣṭe jagat tuṣṭam tvayi kruddhe mahat bhayam

original: bhayānāmapanetāsi tvamekaḥ śatrusūdanaḥ | asurāṇāṃ samarthānāṃ vināśaśca tvayā kṛtaḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: bhayānām apanetā asi tvam ekaḥ śatru sūdanaḥ asurāṇām samarthānām vināśaḥ ca tvayā kṛtaḥ  /

original: na ca vikramaṇairdeva nirvāṇamagamatparam | tvaṃ hi karttā vikarttā ca bhūtānāmiha sarvaśaḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: na ca vikramaṇaiḥ deva nirvāṇam agamat param  tvam hi karttā vikarttā ca bhūtānām iha sarvaśas

original: ārādhayitvā sarve te namasyaṃti ca sarvaśaḥ | etasminnaṃtare devi liṃgamadhyātsamutthitā || 25 ||
analyzed: ārādhayitvā sarve te namasyaṃti ca sarvaśas etasmin aṃtare devi liṃga madhyāt samutthitā

original: dhūmāvṛtā mahā jvālā yayā dagdhaḥ sa dānavaḥ | tuhuṇḍo muṃḍaputrastu sasainyaparivāritaḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: dhūma āvṛtā mahā jvālā yayā dagdhaḥ sa dānavaḥ tuhuṇḍaḥ muṃḍa putraḥ tu sa sainya parivāritaḥ

original: svādhikārāṃśca saṃprāpurliṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ | suraiścākhyā samādiṣṭā liṃgasyāsyaiva harṣitaḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: sva adhikārān ca saṃprāpuḥ liṃgasya asya prabhāvataḥ suraiḥ ca ākhyā samādiṣṭā liṃgasya asya eva harṣitaḥ

original: aiśvaryaśīlamasyāstītyasmākaṃ ca viniścitam | īśāna iti vikhyātastrailokye ca bhaviṣyati || 28 ||
analyzed: aiśvarya śīlam asya asti iti asmākam ca viniścitam īśānaḥ iti vikhyātaḥ trailokye ca bhaviṣyati  /

original: īśāneśvarasaṃjñaṃ tu ye samārādhayaṃti ca | kīrtirlakṣmīrdhruvā teṣāṃ siddhiḥ prītirbhaviṣyati || 29 ||
analyzed: īśāneśvara saṃjñam tu ye samārādhayaṃti ca kīrtiḥ lakṣmīḥ dhruvā teṣām siddhiḥ prītiḥ bhaviṣyati  /

original: pūjyamānaḥ sadā devairgaṃdharvāpsarasāṃgaṇaiḥ | svargalokaṃ gamiṣyaṃti vimānairujjvalairmudā || 30 ||
analyzed: pūjyamānaḥ sadā devaiḥ gaṃdharva apsarasā aṃgaṇaiḥ  svarga lokam gamiṣyaṃti vimānaiḥ ujjvalaiḥ mudā

analyzed: tasya prabhāvam subhagam kathayāmi atha vistarāt  śṛṇu ekāgra manāḥ devi sarva pāpa praṇāśanam

original: purā devarṣigaṃdharvāścāraṇā guhyakāstathā | upaviṣṭāḥ sudharmāyāṃ kathayaṃtaḥ śubhāṃ kathām || 3 ||
analyzed: purā deva ṛṣi gaṃdharvāḥ cāraṇāḥ guhyakāḥ tathā upaviṣṭāḥ sudharmāyām kathayaṃtaḥ śubhām kathām  /

original: etasminnaṃtare śakro devarṣiṃ nāradaṃ munim | papraccha sādaraṃ devi samāyātaṃ śucivratam || 4 ||
analyzed: etasmin antare śakraḥ deva ṛṣim nāradam munim papraccha sa ādaram devi samāyātam śuci vratam

original: dṛṣṭvā vinayasaṃpannaṃ brahmacaryaparāyaṇam | mekhalājinakaupīnaṃ vīṇādaṇḍavibhūṣitam || 5 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā vinaya saṃpannam brahmacarya parāyaṇam mekhalā ajina kaupīnam vīṇā daṇḍa vibhūṣitam  /

original: tvayā dṛṣṭamidaṃ sarvaṃ trailokyaṃ bhūrbhuvādikam | utpādyamānamutpannaṃ pralayacca sahasraśaḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: tvayā dṛṣṭam idam sarvam trailokyam bhūrbhuva ādikam utpādyamānam utpannam pralayat ca sahasraśas

original: tvattulyo nāsti loke'sminmu ktvaikaṃ parameṣṭhinam | jagatkāraṇamavyaktaṃ nityaṃ sadasadātmakam || 7 ||
analyzed: tvad tulyaḥ nā asti loke asmin mu ktvā ekam parameṣṭhinam  jagat kāraṇam avyaktam nityam sat asat ātmakam

original: yogena tapasā bhaktyā yattvayā paritoṣitaḥ | trailokyamabhijānāsi tatsarvaṃ sarvataḥ sphuṭam || 8 ||
analyzed: yogena tapasā bhaktyā yat tvayā paritoṣitaḥ trailokyam abhijānāsi tat sarvam sarvatas sphuṭam

original: ato'haṃ praṣṭumicchāmi kathyatāṃ mama niścayam | pṛthivyāṃ pravaraṃ kṣetraṃ pāvanaṃ bhuktimuktidam || 9 ||
analyzed: atas aham praṣṭum icchāmi kathyatām mama niścayam pṛthivyām pravaram kṣetram pāvanam bhukti mukti dam  /

original: evaṃ śrutvā tadā dhyātvā ciṃtayāmāsa nāradaḥ | ciṃtayitvā ciraṃ kālamidaṃ vacanamabravīt || 10 ||
analyzed: evam śrutvā tadā dhyātvā ciṃtayāmāsa nāradaḥ ciṃtayitvā ciram kālam idam vacanam abravīt

original: devarāja smṛtaṃ puṇyaṃ kṣetrarājamanuttamam | kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ kṣetraṃ prayāgaṃ ca praśa syate || 11 ||
analyzed: devarāja smṛtam puṇyam kṣetrarājam anuttamam kṣetrāṇām uttamam kṣetram prayāgam ca praśa syate  /

original: tasmāddaśaguṇaṃ kṣetraṃ mahākālasya kathyate | bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ tacca darśanādapi vāsava || 12 ||
analyzed: tasmāt daśaguṇam kṣetram mahākālasya kathyate bhukti dam mukti dam tat ca darśanāt api vāsava

original: etacchrutvā sahasrākṣo varṇayitvā ca taṃ munim | sarvairdevagaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ vimānasthastvarānvitaḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: etat śrutvā sahasrākṣaḥ varṇayitvā ca tam munim sarvaiḥ deva gaṇaiḥ sārddham vimāna sthaḥ tvarā anvitaḥ  /

original: aṃtarikṣasthito jiṣṇuradrākṣīcca suraiḥ saha | kṣetraṃ liṃgaiḥ samākīrṇamaṃgulasyāṃtaraṃ na hi || 14 ||
analyzed: aṃtarikṣa sthitaḥ jiṣṇuḥ adrākṣīt ca suraiḥ saha kṣetram liṃgaiḥ samākīrṇam aṃgulasya aṃtaram na hi  /

original: ṣaṣṭikoṭisahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭikoṭiśatāni ca | mahākālavane ramye nirmālyaṃ laṃghyate katham || 15 ||
analyzed: ṣaṣṭi koṭi sahasrāṇi ṣaṣṭi koṭi śatāni ca mahākāla vane ramye nirmālyam laṃghyate katham  /

original: nirmālyalaṃghanāddoṣo mahānbhavati niścitam | ityālocya punardevi jagmuḥ svarge manoramāḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: nirmālya laṃghanāt doṣaḥ mahān bhavati niścitam iti ālocya punar devi jagmuḥ svarge manoramāḥ  /

original: nirmālyadoṣabhītāste kṣetre na viviśuḥ surāḥ | etasminnaṃtare devi vimānasthā gaṇottamāḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: nirmālya doṣa bhītāḥ te kṣetre na viviśuḥ surāḥ etasmin antare devi vimāna sthāḥ gaṇa uttamāḥ

original: gaṇairnānāvidhaiḥ geyairgīyamānaśca kiṃnaraiḥ | cāraṇaiḥ stūyamānastu svargalokaṃ vrajansuraiḥ || 18 ||
analyzed: gaṇaiḥ nānāvidhaiḥ geyaiḥ gīyamānaḥ ca kiṃnaraiḥ cāraṇaiḥ stūyamānaḥ tu svarga lokam vrajan suraiḥ  /

original: papracchuramarāḥ sarve ko'yaṃ rudranibho gaṇaḥ | yāti kutra mahābāho hṛṣṭātmā prahasanmukhaḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: papracchuḥ amarāḥ sarve kaḥ ayam rudra nibhaḥ gaṇaḥ yāti kutra mahā bāho hṛṣṭa ātmā prahasat mukhaḥ

original: pṛṣṭastadā suraiḥ sarvairvismayāviṣṭamānasaiḥ | kastvaṃ puruṣaśārdūla kiṃ tvayā sukṛtaṃ kṛtam || 21 ||
analyzed: pṛṣṭaḥ tadā suraiḥ sarvaiḥ vismaya āviṣṭa mānasaiḥ kaḥ tvam puruṣa śārdūla kim tvayā sukṛtam kṛtam  /

original: devānāṃ purato devi niḥśeṣaṃ kathitaṃ tadā | mahākālo mahādevaḥ pūjito bhaktitaḥ stutaḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: devānām puratas devi niḥśeṣam kathitam tadā mahākālaḥ mahādevaḥ pūjitaḥ bhaktitaḥ stutaḥ  /

original: hṛṣṭena tena me dattaṃ gaṇatvaṃ yatsudurlabham | nāma dattaṃ ca subhagaṃ nāgacaṃḍa iti dhruvam || 23 ||
analyzed: hṛṣṭena tena me dattam gaṇa tvam yat su durlabham nāma dattam ca subhagam nāgacaṃḍaḥ iti dhruvam

original: papracchuramarāstacca sādaraṃ gaṇasattama | nāgacaṃḍa tvayā tatra nirmālyaṃ patitaṃ tvatha || 24 ||
analyzed: papracchuḥ amarāḥ tat ca sa ādaram gaṇa sattama nāgacaṃḍa tvayā tatra nirmālyam patitam tu atha  /

original: mahākālavane puṇye laṃghitaṃ caratā tvayā | saṃcāro nāsti tatraiva liṃgasaṃkīrṇatā yataḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vane puṇye laṃghitam caratā tvayā saṃcāraḥ na asti tatra eva liṃga saṃkīrṇa tā yatas

original: upāyastena kathito devānāṃ puratastadā | tatra tiṣṭhati deveśā liṃgaṃ sarvaphalapradam || 26 ||
analyzed: upāyaḥ tena kathitaḥ devānām puratas tadā tatra tiṣṭhati deva īśāḥ liṃgam sarva phala pradam

original: īśāneśvaradevasya tiṣṭhatīśānabhāgataḥ | tasya darśanamātreṇa na sa gacchati duṣkṛtam || 27 ||
analyzed: īśāna īśvara devasya tiṣṭhati īśāna bhāgataḥ tasya darśana mātreṇa na sa gacchati duṣkṛtam

original: nirmālyalaṃghanodbhūtaṃ yatpāpaṃ jāyate mahat | tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti tasya liṃgasya darśanāt || 28 ||
analyzed: nirmālya laṃghana udbhūtam yat pāpam jāyate mahat tat sarvam nāśam āyāti tasya liṃgasya darśanāt  /

original: tato devagaṇāḥ sarve mahākālavane punaḥ | samāyātā mahābhāgā mahākālaśca pūjitaḥ || 29 ||
analyzed: tatas deva gaṇāḥ sarve mahākāla vane punar samāyātāḥ mahābhāgāḥ mahākālaḥ ca pūjitaḥ  /

original: yathā liṃgaṃ ca taddṛṣṭaṃ sarvadoṣakṣayaṃkaram | tasya darśanamātreṇa nirmālyalaṃghanādibhiḥ | doṣo naṣṭaḥ surāṇāṃ ca tato nāmāsya cakrire || 30 ||
analyzed: yathā liṃgam ca tat dṛṣṭam sarva doṣa kṣayaṃkaram  tasya darśana mātreṇa nirmālya laṃghana ādibhiḥ doṣaḥ naṣṭaḥ surāṇām ca tatas nāma asya cakrire  /

original: asmākaṃ tena kathitaṃ nāgacaṃḍena dhīmatā | nāgacaṃḍeśvarākhyānamato loke bhaviṣyati || 31 ||
analyzed: asmākam tena kathitam nāgacaṃḍena dhīmatā nāgacaṃḍeśvara ākhyānam atas loke bhaviṣyati  /

original: kṛtvāsya nāma te devā jagmuḥ svargehamuttamam |  pūjayiṣyaṃti ye kecinnāgacaṃḍeśvaraṃ śivam | nirmālyalaṃghanodbhūtaṃ teṣāṃ naśyati pātakam || 32 ||
analyzed: kṛtvā asya nāma te devāḥ jagmuḥ svar geham uttamam   pūjayiṣyaṃti ye kecid nāgacaṃḍeśvaram śivam nirmālya laṃghana udbhūtam teṣām naśyati pātakam

original: nāgacaṃḍeśvaraṃ devaṃ ye paśyaṃti dinedine | ajñānājjñānataḥ pāpaṃ teṣāṃ naśyati nānyathā || 33 ||
analyzed: nāgacaṃḍeśvaram devam ye paśyaṃti dine dine ajñānāt jñānataḥ pāpam teṣām naśyati na anyathā  /

original: āhlādaṃ nirvṛtiṃ svāsthyamārogyaṃ cārurūpatām | sapta janmānyavāpnoti darśanena na saṃśayaḥ || 34 ||
analyzed: āhlādam nirvṛtim svāsthyam ārogyam cāru rūpa tām sapta janmāni avāpnoti darśanena na saṃśayaḥ

original: prāpnotyabhimatānkāmāndevānāmapi durlabhān | kīrttanānnātra saṃdeho nāgacaṃḍeśvarasya ca || 35 ||
analyzed: prāpnoti abhimatān kāmān devānām api durlabhān kīrttanāt na atra saṃdehaḥ nāgacaṃḍeśvarasya ca  /

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | nāgacaṃḍeśvarasyaiva pratīhāreśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 36 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ nāgacaṃḍeśvarasya eva pratīhāreśvaram śṛṇu  /

original: īśvara uvāca | pratīhāreśvaraṃ devi viddhi viṃśatimaṃ priye | yasya darśanamātreṇa dhanavāniha jāyate || 1 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca pratīhāreśvaram devi viddhi viṃśatimam priye yasya darśana mātreṇa dhanavān iha jāyate

original: dakṣakopāttvaṃ ca devi purā prāṇairvisarjitaiḥ | himācale tathā jātā mayā prāptā punaḥ priye || 2 ||
analyzed: dakṣa kopāt tvam ca devi purā prāṇaiḥ visarjitaiḥ himācale tathā jātā mayā prāptā punar priye

original: prārabdhā ca mayā devi tvayā sārddhaṃ ratistadā | divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ jātaṃ sāgraṃ devi pramodataḥ | anurāgavaśāccaiva manmathena prapīḍitā || 3 ||
analyzed: prārabdhā ca mayā devi tvayā sārddham ratiḥ tadā  divyam varṣa śatam jātam sāgram devi pramodataḥ anurāga vaśāt ca eva manmathena prapīḍitā  /

original: mahāratiṃ samīkṣyātha devāḥ saṃkṣubdhamānasāḥ | cakrurmaṃtraṃ yathākālaṃ vāsavādyā yathocitam || 4 ||
analyzed: mahā ratim samīkṣya atha devāḥ saṃkṣubdha mānasāḥ cakruḥ maṃtram yathākālam vāsava ādyāḥ yathocitam

original: divyaṃ varṣaśataṃ rudro gauryā saha sadā ratim | kurvaṃstiṣṭhati devo'sau maṃdare cārukaṃdare || 5 ||
analyzed: divyam varṣa śatam rudraḥ gauryā saha sadā ratim kurvan tiṣṭhati devaḥ asau maṃdare cāru kaṃdare

original: anayorbījasaṃpatyoḥ putro yo hi bhavettadā | vinaśyettena trailokyamakhilaṃ ca na saṃśayaḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: anayoḥ bīja saṃpatyoḥ putraḥ yaḥ hi bhavet tadā vinaśyet tena trailokyam akhilam ca na saṃśayaḥ

original: tasya tejopi no voḍhuṃ samarthā niścitaṃ vayam | tasmāttatkriyatāṃ karma ratiryeno paśāmyati || 7 ||
analyzed: tasya tejaḥ api naḥ voḍhum samarthāḥ niścitam vayam tasmāt tat kriyatām karma ratiḥ yena u paśāmyati  /

original: upāyaṃ dṛṣṭavāṃstatra devānāṃ gururagraṇīḥ | bṛhaspatirmahātejā vedaśāstrārthapāragaḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: upāyam dṛṣṭavān tatra devānām guruḥ agraṇīḥ bṛhaspatiḥ mahā tejāḥ veda śāstra artha pāragaḥ

original: gacchaṃtu tridaśāḥ sarve śivasya tu samīpataḥ | svayaṃ vijñāpyatāṃ devastatkarma na kariṣyati || 9 ||
analyzed: gacchantu tridaśāḥ sarve śivasya tu samīpatas svayam vijñāpyatām devaḥ tat karma na kariṣyati  /

original: iti niścitya te devi jagmuḥ śīghraṃ surāstadā | maṃdarādreḥ śubhe dvāri sthitāste vismayānvitāḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: iti niścitya te devi jagmuḥ śīghram surāḥ tadā maṃdara adreḥ śubhe dvāri sthitāḥ te vismaya anvitāḥ

original: gaṇānāmadhipo naṃdī dvāri tiṣṭhati yatnataḥ | tvayā sārddhamahaṃ devi kurvaṃstiṣṭhāmi tāṃ ratim || 11 ||
analyzed: gaṇānām adhipaḥ naṃdī dvāri tiṣṭhati yatnataḥ tvayā sārddham aham devi kurvan tiṣṭhāmi tām ratim  /

original: atha praveśo devānāṃ duṣkaro mama pārśvataḥ | tadā ciṃtayamānāśca tatra tiṣṭhaṃti te surāḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: atha praveśaḥ devānām duṣkaraḥ mama pārśvatas tadā ciṃtayamānāḥ ca tatra tiṣṭhanti te surāḥ  /

original: agninā taddhitaṃ vākyamuktaṃ teṣāṃ puraḥ śubham | haṃsarūpaṃ samāsthāya yāsyāmi śivasannidhau || 13 ||
analyzed: agninā tat hitam vākyam uktam teṣām puras śubham haṃsa rūpam samāsthāya yāsyāmi śiva sannidhau

original: vaṃcayitvā pratīhāraṃ kṛtaṃ tena tathaiva ca | haṃsarūpeṇa kathitaṃ karṇe mama śucismite || 14 ||
analyzed: vaṃcayitvā pratīhāram kṛtam tena tathā eva ca haṃsa rūpeṇa kathitam karṇe mama śuci smite

original: indrādyā amarā devā dvāri tiṣṭhaṃti saṃyatāḥ | śrutvā tasya ca tadvākyaṃ tatohaṃ dvāramāgataḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: indra ādyāḥ amarāḥ devāḥ dvāri tiṣṭhanti saṃyatāḥ  śrutvā tasya ca tat vākyam tatas ham dvāram āgataḥ

original: tataśca taikuto mahyaṃ praṇāmaśca yathākramam | mayā dṛṣṭāśca te devā yuṣmākaṃ kiṃ karomyaham || 16 ||
analyzed: tatas ca taikutaḥ mahyam praṇāmaḥ ca yathākramam mayā dṛṣṭāḥ ca te devāḥ yuṣmākam kim karomi aham

original: tairuktaṃ tyajyatāṃ caiva saṃbhogastu sudāruṇaḥ | tathā mayā kṛtaṃ devi gatāste tridivaṃ punaḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: taiḥ uktam tyajyatām ca eva saṃbhogaḥ tu su dāruṇaḥ tathā mayā kṛtam devi gatāḥ te tridivam punar

original: tataḥ śapto mayā naṃdī bhūlokaṃ gaccha satvaram | tataḥ śāpaparibhraṣṭaḥ pṛthivyāṃ patitastadā || 18 ||
analyzed: tatas śaptaḥ mayā naṃdī bhū lokam gaccha satvaram tatas śāpa paribhraṣṭaḥ pṛthivyām patitaḥ tadā

original: socchvāsahṛdayo dīno duḥkhavyākulalocanaḥ | vilapaṃśca tathā naṃdī viluṭhañchokato bhuvi || 19 ||
analyzed: sa ucchvāsa hṛdayaḥ dīnaḥ duḥkha vyākula locanaḥ vilapan ca tathā naṃdī viluṭhan śokataḥ bhuvi

original: vaṃcitaścāgninā bāḍhaṃ vāsavena viśeṣataḥ | kiṃ mayā duṣkṛtaṃ karma kṛtaṃ kiṃ citpurātanam || 20 ||
analyzed: vaṃcitaḥ ca agninā bāḍham vāsavena viśeṣataḥ kim mayā duṣkṛtam karma kṛtam kim cit purātanam

original: sa dṛṣṭo lokapālaistu tāmavasthāṃ gato gaṇaḥ | pṛṣṭaśca taiḥ kuto nadinvilāpaṃ kuruṣe mahat || 21 ||
analyzed: sa dṛṣṭaḥ lokapālaiḥ tu tām avasthām gataḥ gaṇaḥ pṛṣṭaḥ ca taiḥ kutas nadin vilāpam kuruṣe mahat

original: sarvaṃ niveditaṃ tena teṣāmagre ca naṃdinā | upāyaḥ kathitastaiśca mahākālavanaṃ tataḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: sarvam niveditam tena teṣām agre ca naṃdinā upāyaḥ kathitaḥ taiḥ ca mahākāla vanam tatas

original: tataśca vacanaṃ śrutvā naṃdī romāṃcakaṃcukaḥ | mahākālavane devi jagāma sa tadā gaṇaḥ | pūjayāmāsa vidhivaddhṛtvā kapālikīṃ tanum || 23 ||
analyzed: tatas ca vacanam śrutvā naṃdī romāṃca kaṃcukaḥ mahākāla vane devi jagāma sa tadā gaṇaḥ pūjayāmāsa vidhivat hṛtvā kapālikīm tanum

original: aśarīrasamutpannā vāṇī liṃgāttadā priye | saṃjātā śāpamokṣaste pratīhāra subhaktitaḥ | pūjito'sau mahābhaktyā pratīhāreṇa naṃdinā || 24 ||
analyzed: aśarīra samutpannā vāṇī liṃgāt tadā priye saṃjātā śāpa mokṣaḥ te pratīhāra su bhaktitaḥ pūjitaḥ asau mahā bhaktyā pratīhāreṇa naṃdinā   /

original: tadāprabhṛti lokesminpratīhāreśvareśvaraḥ | mayā te kathito devi pratīhāreśvarasya ca | prabhāvaḥ sarvalokānāmatyabhīṣṭaphalapradaḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: tadā prabhṛti loke smin pratīhāreśvara īśvaraḥ mayā te kathitaḥ devi pratīhāreśvarasya ca prabhāvaḥ sarva lokānām ati abhīṣṭa phala pradaḥ  /

original: pūjayiṣyaṃti ye bhaktyā pratīhāreśvaraṃ śivam | sthānabhraṃśo viyogaśca teṣāṃ svapne'pi no bhavet || 26 ||
analyzed: pūjayiṣyaṃti ye bhaktyā pratīhāreśvaram śivam sthāna bhraṃśaḥ viyogaḥ ca teṣām svapne api no bhavet  /

original: saptajanmakṛtaṃ pāpaṃ svalpaṃ vā yadi vā bahu | tatsarvaṃ nāśamāyāti pratīhāreśvarārcanāt || 27 ||
analyzed: sapta janma kṛtam pāpam su alpam vā yadi vā bahu tat sarvam nāśam āyāti pratīhāreśvara arcanāt  /

original: manasā ye smariṣyati pratīhāreśvaraṃ śivam | evaṃ tasya kulaṃ sarvaṃ yāti svargaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: manasā ye smariṣyati pratīhāreśvaram śivam  evam tasya kulam sarvam yāti svargam na saṃśayaḥ

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtya khaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye rāmeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmaikonatriṃśodhyāyaḥ || 29 ||

original: śrīviśvanātha uvāca | triṃśattamaṃ vijānīhi tvaṃ devi cyavaneśvaram | yasya darśanamātreṇa svargabhraṃśo na jāyate || 1 ||

original: bhṛgormaharṣeḥ putraśca cyavano nāma pārvati | sthāṇubhūtastapastepe nirāhāro mahāmuniḥ || 2 ||

original: sā sakhībhiḥ parivṛtā sarvābharaṇabhūṣitā | sā bhramyamāṇā valmīke dṛṣṭvā bhārgavacakṣuṣī || 7 ||
analyzed: sā sakhībhiḥ parivṛtā sarva ābharaṇa bhūṣitā sā bhramyamāṇā valmīke dṛṣṭvā bhārgava cakṣuṣī  /

original: tvamapāsyeha kalyāṇi kāmabhogabahiṣkṛtā | vṛddhaṃ cyavanamutsṛjya varayasvaikamāvayoḥ || 26 ||

original: patyarthaṃ devagarbhābhe mā vṛthā yauvanaṃ kṛthāḥ | evamuktā sukanyā tu dasrau tāvidamabravīt || 27 ||
analyzed: pati artham deva garbha ābhe mā vṛthā yauvanam kṛthāḥ  evam uktā sukanyā tu dasrau tau idam abravīt

original: ratāhaṃ cyavane deve maivaṃ mā paryaśaṃkatam | tato'brūtāṃ punastvenāmāvāṃ devabhiṣagvarau || 28 ||
analyzed: ratā aham cyavane deve mā evam mā paryaśaṃkatam tatas abrūtām punar tu enām āvām deva bhiṣagvarau

original: yuvānaṃ rūpasaṃpannaṃ kariṣyāvaḥ patiṃ tava | etena samayenāvāmāmaṃtraya sumadhyame || 27 ||
analyzed: yuvānam rūpa saṃpannam kariṣyāvaḥ patim tava   etena samayena āvām āmaṃtraya sumadhyame

original: sā tayorvacanaṃ śrutvā kathayāmāsa bhārgave | tacchrutvā cyavano bhāryāṃ kriyatāmityabhā ṣata || 30 ||
analyzed: sā tayoḥ vacanam śrutvā kathayāmāsa bhārgave tat śrutvā cyavanaḥ bhāryām kriyatām iti abhā sata

original: ūcatū rājaputrīṃ tāṃ patistava viśatvapaḥ | tato'psu cyavanaḥ śīghraṃ rūpārthī praviveśa ha || 31 ||
analyzed: ūcatuḥ rāja putrīm tām patiḥ tava viśatu apaḥ tatas apsu cyavanaḥ śīghram rūpa arthī praviveśa ha

original: aśvināvapi tatkāle saraḥ prāviśatāṃ priye | tato muhūrttāduttīrṇā sarve te sarasastadā || 32 ||
analyzed: aśvinau api tad kāle saraḥ prāviśatām priye tatas muhūrttāt uttīrṇā sarve te sarasaḥ tadā

original: divyarūpadharāḥ sarve yuvāno divyakuṃḍalāḥ | tulyaveṣadharāścaiva manasaḥ prītivarddhanāḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: divya rūpa dharāḥ sarve yuvānaḥ divya kuṃḍalāḥ tulya veṣa dharāḥ ca eva manasaḥ prīti varddhanāḥ

original: te'bruvansahitāḥ sarve vṛṇīṣvānyatamaṃ śubham | asmākamīpsitaṃ bhadre patitve varavarṇini || 34 ||
analyzed: te abruvan sahitāḥ sarve vṛṇīṣva anyatamam śubham asmākam īpsitam bhadre pati tve varavarṇini  /

original: sā samīkṣya tu tānsarvāṃstulyarūpadharā nsthitān | niścitya manasā buddhyā devī vavre svakaṃ patim || 35 ||
analyzed: sā samīkṣya tu tān sarvān tulya rūpa dharān sthitān niścitya manasā buddhyā devī vavre svakam patim

original: labdhvā tu cyavano bhāryāṃ vayo rūpaṃ tu vāṃchitam | hṛṣṭo'bravīnmahātejāstau nāsatyāvidaṃ vacaḥ || 36 ||
analyzed: labdhvā tu cyavanaḥ bhāryām vayaḥ rūpam tu vāṃchitam hṛṣṭaḥ abravīt mahā tejāḥ tau nāsatyau idam vacaḥ

original: yadahaṃ rūpasaṃpanno vayasā ca samanvitaḥ | kṛto bhavadbhyāṃ vṛddhaḥ sanbhāryāṃ ca prāptavānimām || 37 ||
analyzed: yat aham rūpa saṃpannaḥ vayasā ca samanvitaḥ kṛtaḥ bhavadbhyām vṛddhaḥ san bhāryām ca prāptavān imām

original: tasmādyuvāṃ kari ṣyāmi prītyāhaṃ somapāyinau | satyametanna saṃdeho devarājasya paśyataḥ || 38 ||
analyzed: tasmāt yuvām prītyā aham soma pāyinau satyam etat na saṃdehaḥ devarājasya paśyataḥ  /

original: tacchrutvā hṛṣṭamanasau divaṃ devau prajagmatuḥ | yājayāmāsa somārhau nāsatyāvaśvināviti || 39 ||
analyzed: tat śrutvā hṛṣṭa manasau divam devau prajagmatuḥ yājayāmāsa soma arhau nāsatyau aśvinau iti

original: bhiṣajau devatānāṃ hi karmaṇā tena garhitau | ābhyāmarthāya somaṃ tvaṃ pradāsyasi yadi svayam || 40 ||
analyzed: bhiṣajau devatānām hi karmaṇā tena garhitau ābhyām arthāya somam tvam pradāsyasi yadi svayam

original: vajraṃ te prahariṣyāmi ghorarūpaṃ sudāruṇam | evamuktaḥ smayannindramabhivīkṣya sa bhārgavaḥ | balinaṃ vāsavaṃ jñātvā ciṃtayāmāsa satvaram || 41 ||
analyzed: vajram te prahariṣyāmi ghora rūpam su dāruṇam evam uktaḥ smayan indram abhivīkṣya sa bhārgavaḥ balinam vāsavam jñātvā ciṃtayāmāsa sa tvaram

original: devamārādhayiṣyāmi mahādevaṃ maheśvaram | yasya karmakaraḥ śakro yasya devā vaśānugāḥ | yaḥ samartho jagadgoptā sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ || 42 ||
analyzed: devam ārādhayiṣyāmi mahādevam maheśvaram  yasya karmakaraḥ śakraḥ yasya devāḥ vaśa anugāḥ  yaḥ samarthaḥ jagat goptā sṛṣṭi saṃhāra kārakaḥ   /

original: ityuktvā cyavano devi mahākālavanaṃ gataḥ | rāmeśvarasya devasya liṃgamīśānataḥ sthitam | śraddhayārādhitaṃ tena cyavanena mahātmanā || 43 ||
analyzed: iti uktvā cyavanaḥ devi mahākāla vanam gataḥ rāmeśvarasya devasya liṃgam īśānataḥ sthitam śraddhayā ārādhitam tena cyavanena mahātmanā

original: tasya prasanno rudrastu sa vajrādabhayaṃ dadau | tasya praharato bāhuṃ staṃbhayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ || 44 ||
analyzed: tasya prasannaḥ rudraḥ tu sa vajrāt abhayam dadau tasya praharataḥ bāhum staṃbhayāmāsa bhārgavaḥ  /

original: samārādhanatuṣṭasya liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ | etasminnaṃtare jvālā niḥsṛtā liṃgamadhyataḥ || 46 ||
analyzed: samārādhana tuṣṭasya liṃgasya asya prabhāvataḥ etasmin aṃtare jvālā niḥsṛtā liṃga madhyataḥ  /

original: tayā devagaṇāḥ sarve dahyamānā vicetasaḥ | procurgadgadayā vācā dhūmenāṃdhīkṛte kṣaṇāḥ || 46 ||
analyzed: tayā deva gaṇāḥ sarve dahyamānāḥ vicetasaḥ procuḥ gadgadayā vācā dhūmena aṃdhīkṛte kṣaṇāḥ
