original: kriyetāṃ somapāvetāvaśvinau balasūdana | devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā cyavanaṃ bhayapīḍitaḥ | pratyuvāca tataḥ śakraḥ praṇāmānatakaṃdharaḥ || 47 ||
analyzed: kriyetām soma pau etau aśvinau balasūdana  devānām vacanam śrutvā cyavanam bhaya pīḍitaḥ pratyuvāca tatas śakraḥ praṇāma ānata kaṃdharaḥ

original: somapāvaśvināvetāvadyaprabhṛti bhārgava | bhaviṣyatastataḥ sarvametatsatyaṃ bravīmi te || 48 ||
analyzed: somapau aśvinau etau adya prabhṛti bhārgava bhaviṣyataḥ tatas sarvam etat satyam bravīmi te  /

original: mā te'tithyābhisaṃraṃbho bhaviṣyati tapodhana || | liṃgasyāsya prabhāvo'yaṃ yadahaṃ niṣprabhīkṛtaḥ || 49 ||
analyzed: mā te atithya abhisaṃraṃbhaḥ bhaviṣyati tapodhana liṃgasya asya prabhāvaḥ ayam yat aham niṣprabhīkṛtaḥ

original: tatastvannāmadheyena prasiddhirbhuvi yāsyati | ārādhitaṃ yato devi cyavanena mahātmanā || 50 ||
analyzed: tatas tvad nāmadheyena prasiddhiḥ bhuvi yāsyati ārādhitam yatas devi cyavanena mahātmanā

original: cyavaneśvarametadvai khyātaṃ tribhuvane'bhavat | bhaktā ye pūjayiṣyaṃti deveśaṃ cyavaneśvaram | ājanmaprabhavaṃ pāpaṃ teṣāṃ naśyati tatkṣaṇāt || 51 ||
analyzed: cyavaneśvaram etat vai khyātam tribhuvane abhavat bhaktāḥ ye pūjayiṣyaṃti deveśam cyavaneśvaram  ājanma prabhavam pāpam teṣām naśyati tad kṣaṇāt

original: yaḥ paśyati naro nityaṃ cyavaneśvarasaṃjñakam | janmaduḥkhajarārogairmukto muktimavāpnuyāt || 52 ||
analyzed: yaḥ paśyati naraḥ nityam cyavaneśvara saṃjñakam janma duḥkha jarā rogaiḥ muktaḥ muktim avāpnuyāt

original: yaṃyaṃ kāmamabhidhyāyenmanasābhimataṃ naraḥ | taṃtaṃ durlabhamāpnoti cyavaneśvaradarśanāt || 53 ||
analyzed: yaṃ yam kāmam abhidhyāyet manasā abhimatam naraḥ taṃ tam durlabham āpnoti cyavaneśvara darśanāt

original: niyamena prapaśyaṃti ye devaṃ cyavaneśvaram | te prayāṃti tanuṃ tyaktvā madīye bhuvane priye || 54 ||
analyzed: niyamena prapaśyaṃti ye devam cyavana īśvaram te prayāṃti tanum tyaktvā madīye bhuvane priye

original: yaḥ śṛṇoti kathāṃ puṇyāṃ sarvapāpaharāṃ śubhām | sa puṇyātmā paraṃ sthānaṃ yāti divyaṃ na saṃśayaḥ || 55 ||
analyzed: yaḥ śṛṇoti kathām puṇyām sarva pāpa harām śubhām  sa puṇya ātmā param sthānam yāti divyam na saṃśayaḥ

original: bhaktihīnaḥ kriyāhīno yaḥ paśyati prasaṃgataḥ | sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnoti yogigamyāṃ yaśasvini || 56 ||
analyzed: bhakti hīnaḥ kriyā hīnaḥ yaḥ paśyati prasaṃgataḥ sa puṇyām gatim āpnoti yogi gamyām yaśasvini  /

original: puṣpairvicitrairye devaṃ yajaṃte cyavaneśvaram | saṃsārārṇavamullaṃghya te yāṃti paramaṃ padam || 57 ||
analyzed: puṣpaiḥ vicitraiḥ ye devam yajaṃte cyavana īśvaram  saṃsāra arṇavam ullaṃghya te yāṃti paramam padam

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | cyavaneśvaradevasya śṛṇu khaṃḍeśvaraṃ śive || 58 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ cyavaneśvara devasya śṛṇu khaṃḍeśvaram śive

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye cyavaneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 30 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṃga māhātmye cyavaneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam nāma triṃśaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: śrīmahādeva uvāca | ekatriṃśattamaṃ viddhi devaṃ khaṃḍeśvaraṃ priye | saṃpūrṇaṃ jāyate yasya darśāddānavratādikam || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī mahādevaḥ uvāca  ekatriṃśattamam viddhi devam khaṃḍeśvaram priye saṃpūrṇam jāyate yasya darśāt dāna vrata ādikam  /

original: āsīttretāyuge devi bhadrāśvonāma pārthivaḥ | yasya nāmnā'bhavadvarṣaṃ bhadrāśvaṃnāma nāmataḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: āsīt tretā yuge devi bhadrāśvaḥ nāma pārthivaḥ yasya nāmnā abhavat varṣam bhadrāśvam nāma nāmataḥ  /

original: tasyāgastyaḥ kadācittu gṛhamāgamya sattamaḥ | uvāca saptarātraṃ tu vasāmi bhavato gṛhe || 3 ||
analyzed: tasya agastyaḥ kadācid tu gṛham āgamya sattamaḥ uvāca sapta rātram tu vasāmi bhavataḥ gṛhe

original: taṃ rājā śirasā natvā svāsyatāmityabhāṣata | tasya kāṃtimatīnāma bhāryā paramaśobhanā || 4 ||
analyzed: tam rājā śirasā natvā svāsyatām iti abhāṣata tasya kāṃtimatī nāma bhāryā parama śobhanā

original: tasyāstejaḥ samabhavaddvādaśādityasaṃnibham | sapatnīnāṃ śataṃ tasyā vidyate varavarṇini || 5 ||
analyzed: tasyāḥ tejaḥ samabhavat dvādaśa āditya saṃnibham sapatnīnām śatam tasyāḥ vidyate varavarṇini  /

original: tā dāsya iva karmāṇi kurvaṃtyaharahaḥ sadā | kāṃtimatyāḥ prabhāvena bhayottra stāḥ sulocanāḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: tāḥ dāsyaḥ iva karmāṇi kurvaṃti aharahar sadā kāṃtimatyāḥ prabhāvena su locanāḥ

original: tāmagastyastathā dṛṣṭvā tanmukhāsaktalocanām | evaṃbhūtāṃ tathā dṛṣṭvā rājñīṃ paramaśobhanām | sādhusādhu jagannāthetyagastyaḥ prāha harṣitaḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: tām agastyaḥ tathā dṛṣṭvā tad mukha āsakta locanām  evaṃbhūtām tathā dṛṣṭvā rājñīm parama śobhanām sādhu sādhu jagannātha iti agastyaḥ prāha harṣitaḥ  /

original: dvitīye divasepyevaṃ rājñīṃ dṛṣṭvā mahāprabhām | aho hyaṃganayā muṣṭaṃ jagadetaccarācaram || 8 ||
analyzed: dvitīye divase api evam rājñīm dṛṣṭvā mahā prabhām aho hi aṃganayā muṣṭam jagat etat carācaram

original: ityagastyo dvitīye'hni rājñīṃ dṛṣṭetyuvāca ha | tṛtīye'hni ca tāṃ dṛṣṭvā punarevamuvāca ha || 9 ||
analyzed: iti agastyaḥ dvitīye ahni rājñīm dṛṣṭā iti uvāca ha tṛtīye ahni ca tām dṛṣṭvā punar evam uvāca ha

original: aho mūḍhā na jānaṃti liṃgamāhātmyamuttamam | mahākālavane kṣetre cyavaneśasya pūrvataḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: aho mūḍhāḥ na jānaṃti liṃga māhātmyam uttamam mahākāla vane kṣetre cyavana īśasya pūrvatas  /

original: khaṃḍavratāni jāyaṃte pūrṇāni darśanādyadaḥ | caturthe divase hastāvutkṣipya punarabravīt || 11 ||
analyzed: khaṃḍavratāni jāyaṃte pūrṇāni darśana ādya daḥ  caturthe divase hastau utkṣipya punar abravīt

original: sādhusādhu jagannātha sādhu bhadrāśva suvrata | paṃcame divase'pyevaṃ ṣaṣṭhe caiva punaḥpunaḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: sādhu sādhu jagannātha sādhu bhadrāśva suvrata paṃcame divase api evam ṣaṣṭhe ca eva punar punar

original: nṛtyaṃtaṃ saptame dṛṣṭvā dine patnyā samanvitaḥ | provāca cainaṃ rājā sa vismitenāṃtarātmanā | kiṃ harṣakāraṇaṃ brahmanyena nṛtyasamanvitaḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: nṛtyaṃtam saptame dṛṣṭvā dine patnyā samanvitaḥ provāca ca enam rājā sa vismitena aṃtarātmanā  kim harṣa kāraṇam brahman yena nṛtya samanvitaḥ

original: agastya uvāca | aho bhūpāla mūḍhastvaṃ mahāmūrkhāśca maṃtriṇaḥ | aho purohito mugdho ye na jānaṃti me matam || 14 ||
analyzed: agastyaḥ uvāca aho bhūpāla mūḍhaḥ tvam mahā mūrkhāḥ ca maṃtriṇaḥ aho purohitaḥ mugdhaḥ ye na jānaṃti me matam

original: īdṛśā api jāyaṃte rājāno yasya darśanāt | evamuktastato rājā kṛtāṃjalirabhāṣata || 15 ||
analyzed: īdṛśāḥ api jāyaṃte rājānaḥ yasya darśanāt evam uktaḥ tatas rājā kṛtāṃjaliḥ abhāṣata

original: na jānīmo vayaṃ brahmannabhiprāyaṃ tavādhunā | kathayasva mahābhāga yadyanugrahakṛdbhavān || 16 ||
analyzed: na jānīmaḥ vayam brahman abhiprāyam tava adhunā kathayasva mahābhāga yadi anugraha kṛt bhavān

original: agastya uvāca | iyaṃ rājñī tvadīyābhūddāsī vaiśyasya vaidiśe | nagare haridattasya tvamasyāḥ patireva ca | khaṃḍavrataprabhāvena jātaḥ karmakaro bhavān || 17 ||
analyzed: agastyaḥ uvāca iyam rājñī tvadīyā abhūt dāsī vaiśyasya vaidiśe nagare haridattasya tvam asyāḥ patiḥ eva ca khaṃḍavrata prabhāvena jātaḥ karmakaraḥ bhavān  /

original: sa ca vaiśyo mahākāle gatvā devaṃ maheśvaram | arcayāmāsa vivivadgaṃdhapuṣpādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ || 18 ||
analyzed: sa ca vaiśyaḥ mahākāle gatvā devam maheśvaram arcayāmāsa vivivat gaṃdha puṣpa ādibhiḥ śubhaiḥ

original: abhyarcya tu gṛhaṃ yāvadbhavaṃtau rakṣapālakau | tataḥ kālena mahatā mṛtau dvāvapi daṃpatī || 19 ||
analyzed: abhyarcya tu gṛham yāvat bhavaṃtau rakṣa pālakau tatas kālena mahatā mṛtau dvau api daṃpatī

original: tena puṇyena te janma priyavratagṛhe'bhavat | iyaṃ ca patnī te jātā purā vaiśyapradāsikā || 20 ||
analyzed: tena puṇyena te janma priyavrata gṛhe abhavat iyam ca patnī te jātā purā vaiśya pradāsikā   /

original: parakīyaprasaṃgena saṃjātā bhūbhiruttamā | rājyaṃ patnī sutā sādhurityuktaṃ vacanaṃ mayā || 21 ||
analyzed: parakīya prasaṃgena saṃjātā bhūbhiḥ uttamā rājyam patnī sutā sādhuḥ iti uktam vacanam mayā

original: tasya devasya māhātmyādyajaṃtaṃ vividhairmakhaiḥ | paśyāmi tvāṃ mahīpāla bhūpālaśataveditam || 22 ||
analyzed: tasya devasya māhātmyāt yajaṃtam vividhaiḥ makhaiḥ paśyāmi tvām mahīpāla bhūpāla śata veditam  /

original: ataḥ sādhupurā proktaṃ mayā tava mahīpate || 23 ||
analyzed: atas sādhu purā proktam mayā tava mahīpate

original: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā kuṃbhayonermahātmanaḥ | mahākālavane gaṃtuṃ matiṃ cakre mahīpatiḥ | tataḥ sāṃtaḥpuraḥ prāyāttena sārddhaṃ maharṣiṇā || 24 ||
analyzed: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā kuṃbhayoneḥ mahātmanaḥ mahākāla vane gaṃtum matim cakre mahīpatiḥ tatas sa aṃtaḥpuraḥ prāyāt tena sārddham mahā ṛṣiṇā

original: agastyakathitaṃ liṃgaṃ dadarśa śraddhayā punaḥ | pūjayāmāsa vidhivatpatnyā sārddhaṃ mahīpatiḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: agastya kathitam liṃgam dadarśa śraddhayā punar pūjayāmāsa vidhivat patnyā sārddham mahīpatiḥ

original: tatastuṣṭastadā devo nṛpaṃ prāhāmitadyutiḥ | mano'bhīṣṭaṃ tapastestu bhogamaiśvaryameva ca || 26 ||
analyzed: tatas tuṣṭaḥ tadā devaḥ nṛpam prāha amita dyutiḥ manaḥ abhīṣṭam tapaḥ teḥ tu bhogam aiśvaryam eva ca  /

original: kulaṃ prabhāvaṃ saubhāgyaṃ dīrghamāyurarogitām | niḥsapatnaṃ tato rājyaṃ kṛtvā svargamavāpsyati || 27 ||
analyzed: kulam prabhāvam saubhāgyam dīrgham āyuḥ arogi tām  niḥsapatnam tatas rājyam kṛtvā svargam avāpsyati  /

original: ityukto devadeven gato'sau viṣayaṃ svakam | niṣkaṃṭakaṃ tato rājyaṃ kṛtvā svargaṃ gataḥ priye || 28 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ devadeven gataḥ asau viṣayam svakam niṣkaṃṭakam tatas rājyam kṛtvā svargam gataḥ priye

original: anekajanmacaritaṃ khaṃḍavratakadambakam | saṃpūrṇamabhavaddevi liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 29 ||

original: sukhinaste janā loke ye bālaṃ pāṃsubhūṣitam | pariṣvajaṃti svasutamasphuṭākṣarabhāṣakam || 35 ||
analyzed: sukhinaḥ te janāḥ loke ye bālam pāṃsu bhūṣitam pariṣvajaṃti sva sutam asphuṭa akṣara bhāṣakam

original: anena kāraṇenāsmi nirvedaṃ paramaṃ gatā | upāyo hi mayā dṛṣṭaḥ putrārthe mama sāṃpratam || 36 ||
analyzed: anena kāraṇena asmi nirvedam paramam gatā  upāyaḥ hi mayā dṛṣṭaḥ putra arthe mama sāṃpratam

original: iha bhikṣuḥ samāyāto devarūpī sanātanaḥ | tasya cāvyāhatā śaktiḥ śrūyate sarvavastuṣu || 37 ||
analyzed: iha bhikṣuḥ samāyātaḥ deva rūpī sanātanaḥ tasya ca avyāhatā śaktiḥ śrūyate sarva vastuṣu

original: sastrībālo janaścātra śaraṇaṃ yasya gacchati | tasya bhikṣoḥ prasādena sutavatyo vayaṃ nṛpa | bhaviṣyāmo'tra saṃdeho na me manasi varttate || 38 ||
analyzed: sa strī bālaḥ janaḥ ca atra śaraṇam yasya gacchati tasya bhikṣoḥ prasādena sutavatyaḥ vayam nṛpa bhaviṣyāmaḥ atra saṃdehaḥ na me manasi varttate

original: tasyāḥ sa vacanaṃ śrutvā jīrṇodyānaṃ jagāma ha | priyayā sahito rājā taṃ ca bhikṣuṃ dadarśa ha || 39 ||
analyzed: tasyāḥ sa vacanam śrutvā jīrṇa udyānam jagāma ha priyayā sahitaḥ rājā tam ca bhikṣum dadarśa ha

original: dṛṣṭamātro nṛpatinā bhikṣurligatvamāgataḥ | dṛṣṭvā sumahadāścaryaṃ bhaktinamro mahīpatiḥ | pūjayāmāsa vidhivattalliṃgaṃ bhikṣu rūpakam || 40 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭa mātraḥ nṛpatinā bhikṣuḥ liga tvam āgataḥ dṛṣṭvā su mahat āścaryam bhakti namraḥ mahīpatiḥ pūjayāmāsa vidhivat tat liṃgam bhikṣu rūpakam

original: aputro'smītyuvācedaṃ dhanyeyaṃ mahiṣī mama | dehi me tanayaṃ deva śivo bhavānmaheśvaraḥ || 41 ||
analyzed: aputraḥ asmi iti uvāca idam dhanyā iyam mahiṣī mama  dehi me tanayam deva śivaḥ bhavān maheśvaraḥ

original: ityukto rājasiṃhena bhikṣurliṃgā kṛtistadā | pratyuvāca mahīpālaṃ putraste bhavitā nṛpa || 42 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ rāja siṃhena bhikṣuḥ liṃgā kṛtiḥ tadā pratyuvāca mahīpālam putraḥ te bhavitā nṛpa

original: tataḥprabhṛti rājāsau sakalatro mahāmatiḥ | sarvabhāvena taṃ devaṃ jagāma śaraṇaṃ mudā || 43 ||
analyzed: tatas prabhṛti rājā asau sa kalatraḥ mahāmatiḥ sarva bhāvena tam devam jagāma śaraṇam mudā

original: devadevasya māhātmyātputro jāto mahābalaḥ | dharmātmā ca yaśasvī ca sārvabhaumo guṇādhikaḥ || 44 ||
analyzed: devadevasya māhātmyāt putraḥ jātaḥ mahā balaḥ dharma ātmā ca yaśasvī ca sārvabhaumaḥ guṇa adhikaḥ

original: athāhaṃ mandarāddevi kautukāttu samāgataḥ | liṃgākāraṃ gaṇaṃ dṛṣṭvā rājānaṃ sevakaṃ tathā || 45 ||
analyzed: atha aham mandarāt devi kautukāt tu samāgataḥ liṃga ākāram gaṇam dṛṣṭvā rājānam sevakam tathā

original: yogaiśvaryeṇa ca mayā kṛtaṃ vai puramātmanaḥ | nānāratnaprabhoddyotaṃ nānāsiddhini ṣevitam | tacchivaṃ śāśvataṃ sthānaṃ dattaṃ devi tadā mayā || 46 ||
analyzed: yoga aiśvaryeṇa ca mayā kṛtam vai puram ātmanaḥ nānā ratna prabhā uddyotam nānā siddhini ṣevitam  tat śivam śāśvatam sthānam dattam devi tadā mayā

original: mārkaṃḍeyeśvarāddevāduttare varavarṇini | tadāprabhṛti devo'sau śiveśvara iti smṛtaḥ || 47 ||
analyzed: mārkaṃḍeyeśvarāt devāt uttare varavarṇini tadā prabhṛti devaḥ asau śiveśvaraḥ iti smṛtaḥ  /

original: ye'rcayiṣyanti satataṃ śiveśvaramanuttamam | nirdhūtasarvapāpāste bhaviṣyaṃti gaṇottamāḥ || 48 ||
analyzed: ye arcayiṣyanti satatam śiveśvaram anuttamam nirdhūta sarva pāpāḥ te bhaviṣyanti gaṇa uttamāḥ

original: viditvārbhaguruṃ lokaṃ ye drakṣyaṃti śiveśva ram | antakāle pradāsyāmi teṣāṃ jñānamanuttamam || 49 ||
analyzed: viditvā arbha gurum lokam ye drakṣyanti śiveśva antakāle pradāsyāmi teṣām jñānam anuttamam

original: mokṣaṃ sudurlabhaṃ matvā saṃsāraṃ cātibhīṣaṇam | apunarbhavahetutvātsaṃsevyo'sau śiveśvaraḥ || 50 ||
analyzed: mokṣam su durlabham matvā saṃsāram ca ati bhīṣaṇam apunarbhava hetu tvāt saṃsevyaḥ asau śiva īśvaraḥ

original: sarvāvastho'pi yo martyaḥ saṃśrayettaṃ śiveśvaram | sa tāṃ gatimavāpnoti yajñairdānairhi yā gatiḥ || 51 ||
analyzed: sarva avasthaḥ api yaḥ martyaḥ saṃśrayet tam śiva īśvaram  sa tām gatim avāpnoti yajñaiḥ dānaiḥ hi yā gatiḥ  /

original: ākhyānaṃ prayato marttyo ya idaṃ śrāvayecchuciḥ | paṭhedvā vācayedvāpi sa mucyetsarvakilviṣaiḥ || 52 ||
analyzed: ākhyānam prayataḥ marttyaḥ yaḥ idam śrāvayet śuciḥ paṭhet vā vācayet vā api sa mucyet sarva kilviṣaiḥ

original: eṣa te kathitā devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | śiveśvarasya devasya kusumeśa mataḥ śṛṇu || 53 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitā devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ śiveśvarasya devasya kusumeśa mataḥ śṛṇu

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye śiveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptatriṃśo'dhyāyaḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvantya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye śiveśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma saptatriṃśaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: īśvara uvāca | aṣṭātriṃśattamaṃ viddhi kusumeśvarasaṃjñakam | devaṃ svargapradaṃ devi mahāpātakanā śanam || 1 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca aṣṭātriṃśattamam viddhi kusumeśvara saṃjñakam devam svarga pradam devi mahāpātaka nāśanam

original: purā vaivasvate kalpe prāpte vārāhasaṃjñake | prādurbhūte viśālākṣi kailāsādahamāgataḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: purā vaivasvate kalpe prāpte vārāha saṃjñake prādurbhūte viśāla akṣi kailāsāt aham āgataḥ  /

original: mahākālavane ramye ramamāṇasya pārvati | tvayā sārddhaṃ mamākṣaiśca prādurāsīnmahāsvanaḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vane ramye ramamāṇasya pārvati tvayā sārddham mama akṣaiḥ ca prādurāsīt mahā svanaḥ  /

original: pṛṣṭo'haṃ ca tadā śrutvā śabdaṃ cātīva duḥsaham | śabdotpattirmayā devi kathitā sā tvadagrataḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: pṛṣṭaḥ aham ca tadā śrutvā śabdam ca atīva duḥsaham śabda utpattiḥ mayā devi kathitā sā tvad agratas

original: ete gaṇeśāḥ krīḍaṃti madhye vai vīrako gaṇaḥ | kusumairbhūṣito'tyarthaṃ mamātīva suvallabhaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: ete gaṇeśāḥ krīḍaṃti madhye vai vīrakaḥ gaṇaḥ kusumaiḥ bhūṣitaḥ atyartham mama atīva su vallabhaḥ   /

original: kusumairhanyate'pyarthaṃ pūjyate kusumotkaraiḥ | sa eva vīrako devi sadā me harṣadāyakaḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: kusumaiḥ hanyate api artham pūjyate kusuma utkaraiḥ  saḥ eva vīrakaḥ devi sadā me harṣa dāyakaḥ

original: nānāścaryaguṇādhāro gaṇeśvaraśatārcitaḥ | madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tvayāpyuktaṃ varānane || 7 ||
analyzed: nānā āścarya guṇa ādhāraḥ gaṇeśvara śata arcitaḥ madīyam vacanam śrutvā tvayā api uktam varānane

original: na dṛśyate vinā puṇyaiḥ putrasyānanapaṃkajam | īdṛśasya sutasyāpi mamotkaṇṭhā maheśvara || 8 ||
analyzed: na dṛśyate vinā puṇyaiḥ putrasya ānana paṃkajam  īdṛśasya sutasya api mama utkaṇṭhā maheśvara

original: kadāhamīdṛśaṃ putraṃ drakṣyāmyānandadāyakam | mayā tava vacaḥ śrutvā hasitvā ca punaḥpunaḥ | proktaṃ pārvati putro'yaṃ pradatto vīrako'dhunā || 9 ||
analyzed: kadā aham īdṛśam putram drakṣyāmi ānanda dāyakam mayā tava vacaḥ śrutvā hasitvā ca punar punar proktam pārvati putraḥ ayam pradattaḥ vīrakaḥ adhunā   /

original: eṣa eva sutastestu nayanānandadāyakaḥ | tvayā mātrā kṛtārthastu vīrakaḥ kusumārcitaḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: eṣaḥ eva sutaḥ teḥ tu nayana ānanda dāyakaḥ tvayā mātrā kṛtārthaḥ tu vīrakaḥ kusuma arcitaḥ  /

original: madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā preṣitā vijayā tvayā | datto hareṇa me putro vijaye śīghramānaya || 11 ||
analyzed: madīyam vacanam śrutvā preṣitā vijayā tvayā dattaḥ hareṇa me putraḥ vijaye śīghram ānaya

original: vijayovāca gaṇapaṃ gaṇamadhye ca varttinam | ehi vīraka cāpalyāttvayā devaḥ prakopitaḥ | kimunmattavadatyarthaṃ nṛtyarāgeṇa mohitaḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: vijayā uvāca gaṇapam gaṇa madhye ca varttinam ehi vīraka cāpalyāt tvayā devaḥ prakopitaḥ kim unmatta vat atyartham nṛtya rāgeṇa mohitaḥ   /

original: ityukto bhayasaṃtrastaḥ kusumairbhūṣitastadā | tvatsamīpaṃ samāyāto vijayānugataḥ śanaiḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ bhaya saṃtrastaḥ kusumaiḥ bhūṣitaḥ tadā tvad samīpam samāyātaḥ vijaya anugataḥ śanais

original: bhūṣitaṃ kusumairdṛṣṭvā bhayatrastaṃ ca vīrakam | tvayā cākārito devi girā madhuravarṇayā || 14 ||
analyzed: bhūṣitam kusumaiḥ dṛṣṭvā bhaya trastam ca vīrakam tvayā ca ākāritaḥ devi girā madhura varṇayā  /

original: ehyehi jāto'si me putrakastvaṃ devena datto'dhunā vīrakosi | uktavatyevamaṃke nidhāyātha taṃ paryacumbaḥ kapole kalaṃvādinam || 15 ||
analyzed: ehi ehi jātaḥ asi me putrakaḥ tvam devena dattaḥ adhunā vīrakaḥ asi  uktavatī evam aṃke nidhāya atha tam paryacumbaḥ kapole kalaṃ vādinam  /

original: mūrdhanyupāghrāya sammārjya gātrāṇi sā bhūṣayāmāsa divyaiḥ svayaṃ bhūṣaṇaiḥ | kiṃkiṇīmekhalānūpuraiḥ sanmaṇīniṣkakeyūrahārotkaraiḥ sadguṇaiḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: mūrdhani upāghrāya sammārjya gātrāṇi sā bhūṣayāmāsa divyaiḥ svayam bhūṣaṇaiḥ kiṃkiṇī mekhalā nūpuraiḥ sat maṇī niṣka keyūra hāra utkaraiḥ sat guṇaiḥ

original: komalaiḥ pallavaiścitritaiścārubhirdivya mantrodbhavaistasya śubhraistataḥ | bhūtibhiścākarormiśrasiddhārthakairaṃgarakṣāvidhīṃstasyatuṣṭā satī || 17 ||
analyzed: komalaiḥ pallavaiḥ citritaiḥ cārubhiḥ divya mantra udbhavaiḥ tasya śubhraiḥ tatas bhūtibhiḥ ca akaroḥ miśra siddhārthakaiḥ aṃga rakṣā vidhīn tasya tuṣṭā satī  /

original: evamādhāya covaktha kṛtvā srajaṃ mūrdhni gorocanāpatrabhaṃgojvalaiḥ | vatsa gacchādhunā krīḍa sārddhaṃ gaṇairapramatto yathā bālacaryāṃ śanaiḥ || 18 ||
analyzed: evam ādhāya kṛtvā srajam mūrdhni gorocanā patra bhaṃga ujvalaiḥ vatsa gaccha adhunā krīḍa sārddham gaṇaiḥ apramattaḥ yathā bāla caryām śanais  /

original: so'pi siddhyākule gaṇḍaśaile miladratnajāle vṛhacchā latālākule | kṣaṇaṃ phullamālātamālālimāle kṣaṇaṃ vṛkṣamūle vilolālimāle || 19 ||
analyzed: saḥ api siddhi ākule gaṇḍaśaile milat ratna jāle latā ālākule kṣaṇam phulla mālā tamāla ali māle kṣaṇam vṛkṣa mūle vilola ali māle

original: kṣaṇaṃ svalpapaṃke jale paṃkajāle kṣaṇaṃ vṛkṣakhaṇḍe śubhe niṣkalaṃke | parikrīḍate bālako vai vihārī gaṇeśādhipo devatānandakārī || 20 ||
analyzed: kṣaṇam su alpa paṃke jale paṃka jāle kṣaṇam vṛkṣa khaṇḍe śubhe niṣkalaṃke parikrīḍate bālakaḥ vai vihārī gaṇeśa adhipaḥ devatā ānanda kārī  /

original: evaṃ vikrīḍatastasya vīrakasya gaṇasya ca | saṃdhyā tamo mayī prāptā vijñapto'haṃ tvayā priye || 21 ||
analyzed: evam vikrīḍataḥ tasya vīrakasya gaṇasya ca saṃdhyā tamaḥ mayī prāptā vijñaptaḥ aham tvayā priye  /

original: aiśvaryaṃ dīyatāmasya mama putrasya śaṃkara | śarīrārddhaṃ gaṇeśatvaṃ lokapālatvamagrataḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: aiśvaryam dīyatām asya mama putrasya śaṃkara śarīra arddham gaṇa īśa tvam lokapāla tvam agratas  /

original: liṃgatvamakṣayatvaṃ ca sthānaṃ divyaṃ sudurllabham | vaṃdyamānaṃ yathā deva siddhagandharvakiṃnaraiḥ | brahmendravaruṇādityalokapāleśvareśvaraiḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: liṃga tvam akṣaya tvam ca sthānam divyam su durllabham vaṃdyamānam yathā deva siddha gandharva kiṃnaraiḥ brahma indra varuṇa āditya lokapāla īśvara īśvaraiḥ

original: etaireva gaṇaiḥ sārddhaṃ stūya mānaṃ mahātmabhiḥ | alaṃkṛto mayā yasmātkusumairvividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: etaiḥ eva gaṇaiḥ sārddham stūya mānam mahātmabhiḥ alaṃkṛtaḥ mayā yasmāt kusumaiḥ vividhaiḥ śubhaiḥ

original: kusumeśvarasaṃjñastu tasmātkhyāto bhavatviti | mayāpyuktaṃ viśālākṣi vīrakaṃ dayitaṃ mama || 25 ||
analyzed: kusumeśvara saṃjñaḥ tu tasmāt khyātaḥ bhavatu iti mayā api uktam viśāla akṣi vīrakam dayitam mama

original: matprabhāvasamaṃ divyaṃ sevitaṃ gaṇapaiḥ sadā | śṛṇu gandharvagītānāṃ mādhuryamamṛtopamam || 26 ||
analyzed: mad prabhāva samam divyam sevitam gaṇapaiḥ sadā śṛṇu gandharva gītānām mādhuryam amṛta upamam

original: paśya kinnaranārīṇāṃ gāyantīnāṃ manoramam | paśyāpsaraḥsamūhasyanṛtyametannirantaram || 27 ||
analyzed: paśya kinnara nārīṇām gāyantīnām manoramam paśya apsaraḥ samūhasya nṛtyam etat nirantaram

original: vidyādharaiḥ parivṛtaḥ kusumeśo varānane | viśeṣato mayā devi prathamaṃ pramathe śvaraḥ | kusumeśvaratāṃ nīto yadā kusumamaṃḍitaḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: vidyādharaiḥ parivṛtaḥ kusumeśaḥ varānane viśeṣataḥ mayā devi prathamam pramathe śvaraḥ kusumeśvara tām nītaḥ yadā kusuma maṃḍitaḥ

original: sthānaṃ dattaṃ viśālākṣi śivaliṃgasya cottare | varo datto bahumato duṣprāpyastridaśairapi || 29 ||
analyzed: sthānam dattam viśāla akṣi śiva liṃgasya ca uttare  varaḥ dattaḥ bahu mataḥ duṣprāpyaḥ tridaśaiḥ api  /

original: ye tvāṃ drakṣyaṃti gaṇapa kusumeśvarasaṃjñakam | na teṣāṃ jāyate pāpaṃ padmapatre yathā jalam || 30 ||
analyzed: ye tvām drakṣyaṃti gaṇapa kusumeśvara saṃjñakam  na teṣām jāyate pāpam padma patre yathā jalam  /

original: kusumairarcayiṣyaṃti ye narāḥ kusumeśvaram | matsthānaṃ te samāsādya modiṣyaṃti gatavyathāḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: kusumaiḥ arcayiṣyaṃti ye narāḥ kusumeśvaram mad sthānam te samāsādya modiṣyaṃti gata vyathāḥ

original: yo'pyekaṃ divasaṃ marttyastvāṃ paśyati samāhitaḥ | sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvairmama lokaṃ gamiṣyati || 32 ||
analyzed: yaḥ api ekam divasam marttyaḥ tvām paśyati samāhitaḥ sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ mama lokam gamiṣyati  /

original: yaḥ pūjayati bhāvena kusumaiḥ kusumeśvaram | sa prāpsyati paraṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttidurlabham || 33 ||
analyzed: yaḥ pūjayati bhāvena kusumaiḥ kusumeśvaram  sa prāpsyati param sthānam punarāvṛtti durlabham

original: evamādivaraiḥ puṣṭaḥ kṛtoyaṃ kusu meśvaraḥ | kṛtakṛtyo gaṇo devi liṃgeneśvaratāṃ gataḥ || 34 ||
analyzed: evamādi varaiḥ puṣṭaḥ kṛtaḥ yam mad īśvaraḥ kṛtakṛtyaḥ gaṇaḥ devi liṃgena īśvara tām gataḥ  /

original: kusumeśvaradevasya prabhāvaḥ kathitastvayam | akrūreśasya devasya śrūyatāṃ tadanantaram || 35 ||
analyzed: kusumeśvara devasya prabhāvaḥ kathitaḥ tu ayam akrūra īśasya devasya śrūyatām tat anantaram  /

original: hara uvāca | akrūreśvaramekonacatvāriṃśattamaṃ śṛṇu | yasya darśanamātreṇa subuddhirjāyate nṛṇām || 1 ||
analyzed: haraḥ uvāca akrūreśvaram ekonacatvāriṃśattamam śṛṇu yasya darśana mātreṇa su buddhiḥ jāyate nṛṇām

original: purā tvayaiva kalpādau parayā śaktirūpayā | kṛtaṃ kṛtsnaṃ varārohe trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || 2 ||
analyzed: purā tvayā eva kalpa ādau parayā śakti rūpayā kṛtam kṛtsnam varārohe trailokyam sacarācaram

original: tatastvaṃ saṃstutā devaiḥ sakiṃnaramahoragaiḥ | pradakṣiṇāṃ prakurvati gaṇā nānāvidhāstu te || 3 ||
analyzed: tatas tvam saṃstutā devaiḥ sa kiṃnara mahā uragaiḥ pradakṣiṇām prakurvati gaṇāḥ nānāvidhāḥ tu te  /

original: namaskāraṃ prakurvati stotraṃ kurvaṃti cāpare | na karoti namaskārameko bhṛṃgiriṭistadā || 4 ||
analyzed: namaskāram prakurvati stotram kurvaṃti ca apare  na karoti namaskāram ekaḥ bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ tadā

original: krūrāṃ buddhiṃ samāsādya garveṇatīva garvitaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: krūrām buddhim samāsādya garveṇa atīva garvitaḥ

original: eko devo mahādevaḥ striyā kimanayā mama | yadā nāyāti te pārśvaṃ tadā proktastvayā gataḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: ekaḥ devaḥ mahādevaḥ striyā kim anayā mama  yadā na āyāti te pārśvam tadā proktaḥ tvayā gataḥ

original: kasmānna kuruṣe pūjāṃ pradakṣiṇamatho stutim | madbhakto madadhīno'si mama putro mayā kṛtaḥ | itthaṃbhūtagaṇeśa tvaṃ kiṃ vai laulyena varttase || 7 ||
analyzed: kasmāt na kuruṣe pūjām pradakṣiṇam atho stutim  mad bhaktaḥ mad adhīnaḥ asi mama putraḥ mayā kṛtaḥ itthaṃbhūta gaṇeśa tvam kim vai laulyena varttase

original: iti bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ śrutvā kuddhastvāmāha garvitaḥ | nāhaṃ pārvati te putraḥ putro'haṃ śaṃkarasya tu || 8 ||
analyzed: iti bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ śrutvā kuddhaḥ tvām āha garvitaḥ na aham pārvati te putraḥ putraḥ aham śaṃkarasya tu  /

original: eṣa eva ca me mātā eṣa eva ca me pitā | evaṃ rātridinaṃ yāmi śaraṇaṃ parameṣṭhinam || 9 ||
analyzed: eṣaḥ eva ca me mātā eṣaḥ eva ca me pitā  / evam rātri dinam yāmi śaraṇam parameṣṭhinam

original: tvamapyasyaiva śaraṇaṃ nanu pārvati saṃsthitā | yadi ca tvāmahaṃ vaṃde tadvaṃde sakalāngaṇān || 10 ||
analyzed: tvam api asya eva śaraṇam nanu pārvati saṃsthitā yadi ca tvām aham vaṃde tat vaṃde sakalān gaṇān

original: iti bhṛṃgiriṭeḥ śrutvā vākyaṃ kupitayā tvayā | tasyoktaṃ pramatheśasya bhīru bhṛṃgiriṭeridam || 11 ||
analyzed: iti bhṛṃgiriṭeḥ śrutvā vākyam kupitayā tvayā tasya uktam pramatha īśasya bhīru bhṛṃgiriṭeḥ idam

original: suto bhūtvā bhavānkasmādadākṣiṇyaṃ bravīṣi mām | tvaṅmāṃsaśoṇitāṃtraṃ ca mātṛkaṃ tanayasya tu || 12 ||
analyzed: sutaḥ bhūtvā bhavān kasmāt adākṣiṇyam bravīṣi mām tvac māṃsa śoṇita aṃtram ca mātṛkam tanayasya tu  /

original: nakhadaṃtāsthisaṃghātaḥ śiśnaṃ vākca śirastathā | tathaiva śukraṃ gaṇapa paitṛkaṃ tu śarīrakam || 13 ||
analyzed: nakha daṃta asthi saṃghātaḥ śiśnam vāc ca śiraḥ tathā tathā eva śukram gaṇapa paitṛkam tu śarīrakam  /

original: iti bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ śrutvā sadyo yogabalena tu | māṃsādi tyaktavānsarvaṃ mātṛkaṃ bhāgameva hi || 14 ||
analyzed: iti bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ śrutvā sadyas yoga balena tu māṃsa ādi tyaktavān sarvam mātṛkam bhāgam eva hi   /

original: tataḥ prabhṛti vāmoru nakhadaṃtāsthināsikaḥ | sa ca krūrāṃ matiṃ kṛtvā krodhasaṃraktalocanaḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: tatas prabhṛti vāma ūru nakha daṃta asthi nāsikaḥ sa ca krūrām matim kṛtvā krodha saṃrakta locanaḥ   /

original: tvāṃ parityajya duḥkhārtta ājagāma mamāṃtikam | atha tvayā tadā śapto gaṇo bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ priye || 16 ||
analyzed: tvām parityajya duḥkha ārttaḥ ājagāma mama aṃtikam atha tvayā tadā śaptaḥ gaṇaḥ bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ priye

original: krūrā buddhiḥ kṛtā yasmāttvayā kumatinā bhṛśam | tasmāttvaṃ mānuṣe loke gamiṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: krūrā buddhiḥ kṛtā yasmāt tvayā kumatinā bhṛśam tasmāt tvam mānuṣe loke gamiṣyasi na saṃśayaḥ

original: ityuktastu tvayā devi gaṇo bhṛṃgiriṭistathā | papāta mānuṣaṃ lokaṃ puṇyāṃte sukṛtī yathā || 18 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ tu tvayā devi gaṇaḥ bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ tathā papāta mānuṣam lokam puṇya aṃte sukṛtī yathā

original: sa gatvā puṣkaradvīpaṃ tapase bhāvitātmavān | tatraikapādūrddhvabhujo daśapadmānyavasthitaḥ | dagdhībhūtaṃ ca tapasā jagadvai duṣkareṇa tu || 19 ||
analyzed: sa gatvā puṣkaradvīpam tapase bhāvita ātmavān tatra eka pāda ūrddhva bhujaḥ daśa padmāni avasthitaḥ dagdhībhūtam ca tapasā jagat vai duṣkareṇa tu  /

original: tato brahmā ca viṣṇuśca śakraśca tridaśaiḥ saha | vayaṃ ca cārujaghane tatsamīpaṃ samāgataḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: tatas brahmā ca viṣṇuḥ ca śakraḥ ca tridaśaiḥ saha vayam ca cāru jaghane tad samīpam samāgataḥ  /

original: upagamya tatastasya kathitaṃ purato mayā | alaṃ krūreṇa tapasā lokasyotsādanena vai || 21 ||
analyzed: upagamya tatas tasya kathitam puratas mayā alam krūreṇa tapasā lokasya utsādanena vai  /

original: trailokyamapi niḥsaṃjñaṃ jātamevaṃ sthite tvayi | saṃharasva tapo ghoraṃ lokasaṃtāpanaṃ mahat || 22 ||
analyzed: trailokyam api niḥsaṃjñam jātam evam sthite tvayi saṃharasva tapaḥ ghoram loka saṃtāpanam mahat  /

original: prārthyatāṃ pārvatī putra sā dāsyati varaṃ ca te | asyāḥ prasādānmuktiste śāpāccaiva bhaviṣyati | evamuktastadā tena prārthitā tvaṃ maheśvari | gaṇena bhṛṃgiriṭinā bhaktinamreṇa sādarāt || 24 ||
analyzed: prārthyatām pārvatī putra sā dāsyati varam ca te asyāḥ prasādāt muktiḥ te śāpāt ca eva bhaviṣyati evam uktaḥ tadā tena prārthitā tvam maheśvari gaṇena bhṛṃgiriṭinā bhakti namreṇa sa ādarāt

original: tvayā proktaṃ viśālākṣi putra gaccha mamājñayā | mahākālavane ramye tatrā'krūro bhaviṣyasi || 25 ||
analyzed: tvayā proktam viśāla akṣi putra gaccha mama ājñayā mahākāla vane ramye tatra akrūraḥ bhaviṣyasi  /

original: punaḥ prāpsyasi kailāsaṃ siddhagaṃdharvasevitam | aṃkapādāgrato liṃgaṃ saptakalpānugaṃ mahat | yasya darśanamātreṇa śubhā buddhiḥ prajāyate || 26 ||
analyzed: punar prāpsyasi kailāsam siddha gaṃdharva sevitam  aṃka pāda agratas liṃgam sapta kalpa anugam mahat yasya darśana mātreṇa śubhā buddhiḥ prajāyate

original: kṛtaghnā nāstikāḥ krūrā ye ca viśvāsaghātakāḥ | mahāpātakino ye ca ye ca śāpavaśaṃ gatāḥ | darśanāttasya liṃgasya te'pi svarga bhujo narāḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: kṛtaghnāḥ nāstikāḥ krūrāḥ ye ca viśvāsa ghātakāḥ mahāpātakinaḥ ye ca ye ca śāpa vaśam gatāḥ darśanāt tasya liṃgasya te api svarga bhujaḥ narāḥ  /

original: krūrāṃ buddhiṃ samāsādya kaṃsaṃ hatvā ca keśihā | baladevena sahitastyaktvā tāṃ mathurāṃ purīm || 28 ||
analyzed: krūrām buddhim samāsādya kaṃsam hatvā ca keśi hā baladevena sahitaḥ tyaktvā tām mathurām purīm

original: mahākālavanaṃ gatvā toṣa yitvā maheśvaram | akrūratvaṃ ca saṃprāptaṃ kīrttirlabdhā ca śāśvatī || 29 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vanam gatvā toṣa yitvā maheśvaram  akrūra tvam ca saṃprāptam kīrttiḥ labdhā ca śāśvatī

original: tvadīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā gaṇo bhṛṃgiriṭistadā | tatheti pratyayī jāto mahā kālavanaṃ gataḥ | devamārādhayāmāsa tapasā duṣkareṇa tu || 30 ||
analyzed: tvadīyam vacanam śrutvā gaṇaḥ bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ tadā tathā iti pratyayī jātaḥ mahā kālavanam gataḥ devam ārādhayāmāsa tapasā duṣkareṇa tu  /

original: etasminnaṃtare devi liṃgamadhyāttvamutthitā | arddhāṃgaṃ māmakaṃ kṛtvā svakīyāṃgamathā rddhataḥ | phaṇīṃdrabaddhajūṭārddhamarddhadhamillabhūṣitam || 31 ||
analyzed: etasmin aṃtare devi liṃga madhyāt tvam utthitā arddha aṃgam māmakam kṛtvā svakīya aṃgam atha ā rddhataḥ  phaṇīṃdra baddha jūṭa arddham arddha dhamilla bhūṣitam

original: patravallīvicitrārdhamarddhacaṃdravirājitam | muktāhāranibaddhārddhamarddhaṃ sarpaiśca veṣṭitam || 32 ||
analyzed: patra vallī vicitra ardham ardha candra virājitam muktā hāra nibaddha arddham arddham sarpaiḥ ca veṣṭitam  /

original: tato bhṛṃgiriṭirdevi dṛṣṭvā tanmahadadrutam | ciṃtayāmāsa hṛdaye mayā'jñānādanuṣṭhitam || 33 ||
analyzed: tatas bhṛṃgiriṭiḥ devi dṛṣṭvā tat mahat adrutam ciṃtayāmāsa hṛdaye mayā ajñānāt anuṣṭhitam  /

original: umā ca śaṃkaraścaiva dehamekaṃ sanātanam | ekā mūrttiranirdeśyā dvidhā bhedena dṛśyate || 34 ||
analyzed: umā ca śaṃkaraḥ ca eva deham ekam sanātanam ekā mūrttiḥ anirdeśyā dvidhā bhedena dṛśyate

original: evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya bhaktinamrasya pārvvati | proktaṃ tvayā prasannāhaṃ varaṃ varaya putraka || 35 ||
analyzed: evam ciṃtayataḥ tasya bhakti namrasya pārvvati proktam tvayā prasannā aham varam varaya putraka  /

original: tenoktaṃ yadi tuṣṭāsi mātarmama maheśvari | asya liṃgasya māhātmyātkrūrā buddhirgatā mama || 36 ||
analyzed: tena uktam yadi tuṣṭā asi mātar mama maheśvari asya liṃgasya māhātmyāt krūrā buddhiḥ gatā mama  /

original: akrūreśvaranāmāyaṃ devaḥ khyāto bhavatviti | tvaṃ devi sarvabhāvānāmekā kāraṇamucyate || 37 ||
analyzed: akrūreśvara nāmā ayam devaḥ khyātaḥ bhavatu iti tvam devi sarva bhāvānām ekā kāraṇam ucyate

original: tvaṃ mūrtā puṇyanicayā tvaṃ gatiḥ puṇyasevinām | pitā mātā suhṛdbandhustvamekā kāraṇaṃ param || 38 ||
analyzed: tvam mūrtā puṇya nicayā tvam gatiḥ puṇya sevinām pitā mātā suhṛd bandhuḥ tvam ekā kāraṇam param

original: kuru puṇyatamaṃ sthānaṃ brahmahatyādināśanam | bhuktidaṃ muktidaṃ caiva vāṃchitārthapradāyakam || 39 ||
analyzed: kuru puṇyatamam sthānam brahmahatyā ādi nāśanam bhukti dam mukti dam ca eva vāṃchita artha pradāyakam

original: tatheti ca tvayā proktaṃ girā madhurayā tadā | yatte priyatamaṃ vatsa tatpūrvaṃ prakaromyaham || 40 ||
analyzed: tathā iti ca tvayā proktam girā madhurayā tadā yat te priyatamam vatsa tat pūrvam prakaromi aham

original: na me'sti duṣkaraṃ putra tvatkṛte kanakaprabha | asminsthāne tu ye devamakūreśvarasaṃjñakam | prasaṃgādapi paśyaṃti api pāparatā narāḥ | te'pyavaśyaṃ bhaviṣyaṃti tvatsamā niyataṃ gaṇāḥ || 41 ||
analyzed: na me asti duṣkaram putra tvad kṛte kanakaprabha asmin sthāne tu ye deva makūreśvara saṃjñakam prasaṃgāt api paśyaṃti api pāpa ratāḥ narāḥ te api avaśyam bhaviṣyanti tvad samāḥ niyatam gaṇāḥ  /

original: bhaktyā stoṣyaṃti ye nāma liṃgasyāsya ca mānavāḥ | mānasaiḥ pātakairmuktā yāsyaṃti svargamakṣayam || 42 ||
analyzed: bhaktyā stoṣyaṃti ye nāma liṃgasya asya ca mānavāḥ mānasaiḥ pātakaiḥ muktāḥ yāsyaṃti svargam akṣayam

original: snātvā tu vidhivatpūjāṃ yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ | sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ prāpsyate ravimaṃḍalam || 43 ||
analyzed: snātvā tu vidhivat pūjām yaḥ kariṣyati mānavaḥ sa muktaḥ pātakaiḥ sarvaiḥ prāpsyate ravi maṃḍalam

original: āyurārogyamaiśvaryaṃ kāmamatra hi vāṃchitam | gosahasraphalaṃ cātra spṛṣṭvā prāpsyati mānavaḥ || 44 ||
analyzed: āyuḥ ārogyam aiśvaryam kāmam atra hi vāṃchitam  go sahasra phalam ca atra spṛṣṭvā prāpsyati mānavaḥ

original: snātvā maṃdākinīkuṃḍe yo'kūreśvaramīśvaram | pūjayedvividhaiḥ puṣpairmahāpāpahatopi vā || 45 ||
analyzed: snātvā maṃdākinīkuṃḍe yaḥ akūreśvaram īśvaram pūjayet vividhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ mahā pāpa hataḥ api vā

original: vimānaṃ divyamārūḍho yāvatkalpacatuṣṭayam | gaṃdharvairgīyamānastu so'pi svargaṃ gamiṣyati || 46 ||
analyzed: vimānam divyam ārūḍhaḥ yāvat kalpa catuṣṭayam  gaṃdharvaiḥ gīyamānaḥ tu saḥ api svargam gamiṣyati  /

original: īśvara uvāca | catvāriṃśattamaṃ viddhi kuṃḍeśvaramataḥ śṛṇu | yasya darśanamātreṇa labhyate sadgatiḥ parā || 1 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca catvāriṃśattamam viddhi kuṃḍeśvaram atas śṛṇu yasya darśana mātreṇa labhyate sat gatiḥ parā  /

original: vijñapto'haṃ tvayā devi maṃdare cārukaṃdare | vīrakaṃ draṣṭumicchāmi kva gato mama putrakaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: vijñaptaḥ aham tvayā devi maṃdare cāru kaṃdare vīrakam draṣṭum icchāmi kva gataḥ mama putrakaḥ  /

original: mayā proktaṃ viśālākṣi mahākālavano ttame | jalamadhye sthitastepe tapaḥ paramadāruṇam || 3 ||
analyzed: mayā proktam viśāla akṣi mahākāla vana uttame  jala madhye sthitaḥ tepe tapaḥ parama dāruṇam

analyzed: munibhiḥ sahitaḥ dhīmān bhrājamānaḥ oṃ aśumān iva  gacchāmaḥ tatra tam draṣṭum gaṇaiḥ sārddham varānane

original: madīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā tvayāhaṃ preritastadā | uttiṣṭha śambho gacchāmo vṛṣamāruha satvaram || 5 ||
analyzed: madīyam vacanam śrutvā tvayā aham preritaḥ tadā uttiṣṭha śambho gacchāmaḥ vṛṣam āruha satvaram

original: saprasnavau stanau jātau sadyaḥ saṃsmṛtya vīrakam | mayā smṛto vṛṣo devi dharmarūpī sanātanaḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: sa prasnavau stanau jātau sadyas saṃsmṛtya vīrakam mayā smṛtaḥ vṛṣaḥ devi dharma rūpī sanātanaḥ   /

original: madīyaṃ ciṃtitaṃ jñātvā mamapārśvamupāgataḥ | ārūḍho'haṃ tvayā sārddhaṃ tasminneva vṛṣe tadā || 7 ||
analyzed: madīyam ciṃtitam jñātvā mama pārśvam upāgataḥ ārūḍhaḥ aham tvayā sārddham tasmin eva vṛṣe tadā

original: prasthitastatkṣaṇācchīghraṃ gaṇairnānāvidhaiḥ saha | vegātprayāto vṛṣabhaskaṃdhālaṃbitayā tvayā || 8 ||
analyzed: prasthitaḥ tad kṣaṇāt śīghram gaṇaiḥ nānāvidhaiḥ saha vegāt prayātaḥ vṛṣabha skaṃdha ālaṃbitayā tvayā  /

original: raṇadvalayabāhubhyāṃ gāḍhamāliṃgito hyaham | tvaṃ bhītā ca tadā jātā yadātīva praṇoditaḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: raṇat valaya bāhubhyām gāḍham āliṃgitaḥ hi aham tvam bhītā ca tadā jātā yadā atīva praṇoditaḥ  /

original: vṛṣo mayā viśālākṣi sa kṛṣṭo gaṇapaistadā | kṛṣṭaṃ ca satvaraṃ dṛṣṭvā proktaṃ ca bhītayā tadā || 10 ||
analyzed: vṛṣaḥ mayā viśāla akṣi sa kṛṣṭaḥ gaṇapaiḥ tadā kṛṣṭam ca sa tvaram dṛṣṭvā proktam ca bhītayā tadā

original: śrāṃtāsmi sāṃprataṃ deva vegenānena bhīṣitā | tadviśramitumicchāmi bhūdharasya taṭe vibho || 11 ||
analyzed: śrāṃtā asmi sāṃpratam deva vegena anena bhīṣitā tat viśramitum icchāmi bhūdharasya taṭe vibho

original: kṣaṇaṃ padbhyāṃ gamiṣyāmi viṣamoyaṃ girirmahān | tvadīyaṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā bāḍhamuktaṃ priye mayā || 12 ||
analyzed: kṣaṇam padbhyām gamiṣyāmi viṣamaḥ yam giriḥ mahān tvadīyam vacanam śrutvā bāḍham uktam priye mayā

original: muhūrttaṃ cārujaghane śailapādamupāśritā | kuru śramāpanayanaṃ yāvadvegātprayāmyaham || 13 ||
analyzed: muhūrttam cāru jaghane śailapādam upāśritā kuru śrama apanayanam yāvat vegāt prayāmi aham

original: paṃthāna tvatsukhaṃ yatra taṃ vayaṃ mṛgayāvahe | eṣa kuṇḍo gaṇādhyakṣastvatsamīpe vasiṣyati | tvadājñāvaśavarttī ca kiṃkaraḥ sthāpito mayā || 14 ||
analyzed: paṃthāna tvad sukham yatra tam vayam mṛgayāvahe eṣa kuṇḍaḥ gaṇādhyakṣaḥ tvad samīpe vasiṣyati tvad ājñā vaśa varttī ca kiṃkaraḥ sthāpitaḥ mayā  /

original: evamuktvā tato devi saṃsthāpya gaṇarakṣakam | ārūḍho'haṃ gireḥ prāṃtamudayādriṃ raviryathā || 15 ||
analyzed: evam uktvā tatas devi saṃsthāpya gaṇa rakṣakam  ārūḍhaḥ aham gireḥ prāṃtam udayādrim raviḥ yathā  /

original: tato'valokito'tyarthaṃ ramaṇīyo mahā giriḥ | idaṃ ramyamidaṃ ramyamityasminvaraparvate || 16 ||
analyzed: tatas avalokitaḥ atyartham ramaṇīyaḥ mahā giriḥ idam ramyam idam ramyam iti asmin vara parvate

original: paśyato mama śaileṃdraṃ gatāḥ saṃvatsarā daśa | tvayātha ciṃtitaṃ devi kva gatastripurāṃtakaḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: paśyataḥ mama śaileṃdram gatāḥ saṃvatsarāḥ daśa tvayā atha ciṃtitam devi kva gataḥ tripurāṃtakaḥ   /

original: nūnaṃ na madanātaptāṃ vetti māṃ rativarjitām | māṃ vihāya mahādevo nirviśaṃkaḥ kva varttate || 18 ||
analyzed: nūnam na madana ātaptām vetti mām rati varjitām mām vihāya mahādevaḥ nirviśaṃkaḥ kva varttate

original: harasya kvāpi yātasya vairaṃ saṃsmṛtya cittajaḥ | bādhate māmanaṃgopi cāparopitamārgaṇaḥ | vilokayaṃtīṃ hā dṛṣṭvā vilapaṃtīṃ punaḥ punaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: harasya kvāpi yātasya vairam saṃsmṛtya cittajaḥ bādhate mām anaṃgā upi ca aparopita mārgaṇaḥ vilokayaṃtīm hā dṛṣṭvā vilapaṃtīm punar punar   /

original: tataḥ kuṇḍo gaṇādhyakṣo jñātvā bhāvaṃ tvadīyakam | utkṛṣṭena svareṇoktaṃ mā devi vimanā bhava || 20 ||
analyzed: tatas kuṇḍaḥ gaṇādhyakṣaḥ jñātvā bhāvam tvadīyakam utkṛṣṭena svareṇa uktam mā devi vimanāḥ bhava  /

original: āyāta eṣa te bharttā mā cetaḥ kaluṣaṃ kuru | etacchrutvā vacastasya kuṇḍasya kamalānane || 21 ||
analyzed: āyātaḥ eṣa te bharttā mā cetaḥ kaluṣam kuru etat śrutvā vacaḥ tasya kuṇḍasya kamala ānane

original: duḥkhārttayā tvayā proktaḥ kuṇḍa vedmi na śaṃkaram | kva gataḥ kiṃ ca kurute kālaṃ dīrghamimaṃ śivaḥ | darśayasva mahādevamityukto' sau punaḥpunaḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: duḥkha ārttayā tvayā proktaḥ kuṇḍa vedmi na śaṃkaram  kva gataḥ kim ca kurute kālam dīrgham imam śivaḥ darśayasva mahādevam iti uktaḥ a sau punar punar

original: yadā na darśitastena kuṇḍenāhaṃ varānane | tadā śaptastvayā devi kruddhayā gaṇarakṣakaḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: yadā na darśitaḥ tena kuṇḍena aham varānane tadā śaptaḥ tvayā devi kruddhayā gaṇa rakṣakaḥ

original: gaccha tvaṃ mānuṣaṃ lokaṃ yasmānna kathito haraḥ | etasminnaṃtare devi prāpto'haṃ tvatsamīpataḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: gaccha tvam mānuṣam lokam yasmāt na kathitaḥ haraḥ etasmin antare devi prāptaḥ aham tvad samīpatas

original: pṛṣṭaścāhaṃ tvayā devi vihāya kva gato'si mām | durgame parvate śūnye tasmāttya kṣyāmi jīvitam || 25 ||
analyzed: pṛṣṭaḥ ca aham tvayā devi vihāya kva gataḥ asi mām durgame parvate śūnye jīvitam

original: gatvāgre bhūdharasyāsya kiṃ kṛtaṃ ca tvayā vibho | mayā tava vacaḥ śrutvā kathitaṃ sarvameva tat || 26 ||
analyzed: gatvā agre bhūdharasya asya kim kṛtam ca tvayā vibho mayā tava vacaḥ śrutvā kathitam sarvam eva tat  /

original: durādharṣataraḥ śailaḥ samaṃtādduratikramaḥ | tvatpriyārthaṃ mahābhāge mayā mārgo'valokitaḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: durādharṣataraḥ śailaḥ samaṃtāt duratikramaḥ tvad priya artham mahābhāge mayā mārgaḥ avalokitaḥ  /

original: yena mārgeṇa viśrabdhaṃ gamiṣyāmaḥ sumadhyame | ayaṃ kuṇḍo gaṇo devi viṣaṇṇo vyākulaḥ kṛtaḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: yena mārgeṇa viśrabdham gamiṣyāmaḥ sumadhyame  ayam kuṇḍaḥ gaṇaḥ devi viṣaṇṇaḥ vyākulaḥ kṛtaḥ

original: tvayāpyuktaṃ mahādeva kuṇḍaḥ śapto mayā gaṇaḥ | mamājñā na kṛtā yasmādviphalaṃ na vaco mama | tasmādyātu mamādeśā nmahākālavanaṃ śubham || 29 ||
analyzed: tvayā api uktam mahādeva kuṇḍaḥ śaptaḥ mayā gaṇaḥ mama ājñā na kṛtā yasmāt viphalam na vacaḥ mama  tasmāt yātu mama ādeśāt mahākāla vanam śubham

original: bhairavaṃ rūpamāsthāya yatra tvaṃ cottare sthitaḥ | tasyāgrataḥ sthitaṃ liṃgaṃ varttate kāmadaṃ sadā || 30 ||
analyzed: bhairavam rūpam āsthāya yatra tvam ca uttare sthitaḥ tasya agratas sthitam liṃgam varttate kāma dam sadā

original: tasya darśana mātreṇa gaṇapo'yaṃ bhaviṣyati | kuṇḍeśvareti vikhyātaḥ sa devo vai bhaviṣyati || 31 ||
analyzed: tasya darśana mātreṇa gaṇapaḥ ayam bhaviṣyati kuṇḍeśvara iti vikhyātaḥ sa devaḥ vai bhaviṣyati  /

original: ityuktaḥ sa tvayā devi samāsādya punaḥpunaḥ | prasthāpitastvayādeśādvraja kuṇḍa mamājñayā || 32 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ sa tvayā devi samāsādya punar punar prasthāpitaḥ tvayā ādeśāt vraja kuṇḍa mama ājñayā  /

original: mahākālavanaṃ śīghraṃ liṃgamārādhya satvaram | kīrtiste bhavitā putra triṣu lokeṣu śāśvatī || 33 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vanam śīghram liṃgam ārādhya satvaram kīrtiḥ te bhavitā putra triṣu lokeṣu śāśvatī

original: ityuktastatkṣaṇātprāpto dṛṣṭvā liṅgaṃ tu śāśvatam | uttarasya śivasyāgre pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ || 34 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ tad kṣaṇāt prāptaḥ dṛṣṭvā liṅgam tu śāśvatam uttarasya śivasya agre pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ

original: tato devāḥ sagaṃdharvāḥ siddhāśca paramarṣayaḥ | yakṣāścāpsarasaścaiva samājagmuḥ sahasraśaḥ || 35 ||
analyzed: tatas devāḥ sa gaṃdharvāḥ siddhāḥ ca parama ṛṣayaḥ yakṣāḥ ca apsarasaḥ ca eva samājagmuḥ sahasraśas

original: athāhaṃ tatkṣaṇātprāptastvayā sārddhaṃ gaṇairvṛtaḥ | dṛṣṭvā kuṇḍaṃ gaṇeśaṃ tu liṃgārādhanatatparam || 36 ||
analyzed: atha aham tad kṣaṇāt prāptaḥ tvayā sārddham gaṇaiḥ vṛtaḥ dṛṣṭvā kuṇḍam gaṇeśam tu liṃga ārādhana tatparam

original: samādhidhyānanirataṃ proktamasmābhirādarāt | tuṣṭā te pārvatī putra prārthyatāṃ varamuttamam || 37 ||
analyzed: samādhi dhyāna niratam proktam asmābhiḥ ādarāt tuṣṭā te pārvatī putra prārthyatām varam uttamam

original: akṣayaṃ tu padaṃ prāptaṃ tvayā liṃgasya darśanāt | adyaprabhṛti devo'yaṃ khyāto bhuvi bhaviṣyati | nāmnā kuṇḍeśvaro yasmātsarvasaṃpatkaraḥ sadā || 38 ||
analyzed: akṣayam tu padam prāptam tvayā liṃgasya darśanāt adya prabhṛti devaḥ ayam khyātaḥ bhuvi bhaviṣyati nāmnā kuṇḍeśvaraḥ yasmāt sarva saṃpad karaḥ sadā

original: kuṇḍeśvaramanādiṃ tu bhaktyā paśyati yo naraḥ | so'śvamedhasahasrasya phalaṃ prāpsyati nānyathā || 39 ||
analyzed: kuṇḍeśvaram anādim tu bhaktyā paśyati yaḥ naraḥ saḥ aśvamedha sahasrasya phalam prāpsyati na anyathā  /

original: tasya dānaphalaṃ sarvaṃ sarvatīrthaphalaṃ sadā | liṃgaṃ kuṇḍeśvaraṃ yastu bhaktyā saṃpūjayiṣyati || 40 ||
analyzed: tasya dāna phalam sarvam sarva tīrtha phalam sadā liṃgam kuṇḍeśvaram yaḥ tu bhaktyā saṃpūjayiṣyati  /

original: daśānāmaśvamedhānāmagniṣṭomaśatasya ca | sparśanātphalamāpnoti kuṇḍeśvarasya sarvadā || 41 ||
analyzed: daśānām aśvamedhānām agniṣṭoma śatasya ca sparśanāt phalam āpnoti kuṇḍeśvarasya sarvadā

original: prātaḥ paśyaṃti ye bhaktyā kṛtvā niyamapūrvakam | siddhiṃ sukāmikīṃ hṛṣṭāḥ saṃprāpsyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ || 42 ||
analyzed: prātar paśyaṃti ye bhaktyā kṛtvā niyama pūrvakam siddhim sukāmikīm hṛṣṭāḥ saṃprāpsyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | kuṇḍeśvarasya devasya śṛṇu luṃpeśvaraṃ param || 43 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ kuṇḍeśvarasya devasya śṛṇu luṃpeśvaram param

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye kuṃḍeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catvāriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṃḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye kuṃḍeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma catvāriṃśaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: śrīmahādeva uvāca | catvāriṃśattamaṃ saikamīśvaraṃ viddhi pārvati | luṃpeśvaramiti khyātaṃ nāma yasya mahītale || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī mahādevaḥ uvāca catvāriṃśattamam sa ekam īśvaram viddhi pārvati luṃpeśvaram iti khyātam nāma yasya mahī tale

original: deśe mlecchagaṇākīrṇe babhūva jagatīpatiḥ | luṃpādhipa iti khyāto maheṃdrasamavikramaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: deśe mleccha gaṇa ākīrṇe babhūva jagatīpatiḥ luṃpādhipaḥ iti khyātaḥ mahā iṃdra sama vikramaḥ

original: tasyāsīddayitā bhāryā viśālānāma nāmataḥ | sā yauvanaguṇopetā rūpeṇāpratimā bhuvi || 3 ||
analyzed: tasya āsīt dayitā bhāryā viśālā nāma nāmataḥ sā yauvana guṇa upetā rūpeṇa apratimā bhuvi

original: sa yuddhakāmo nṛpatiḥ paryapṛcchadvijottamān || 4 ||
analyzed: sa yuddha kāmaḥ nṛpatiḥ paryapṛcchat vijottamān

original: atha kenāpi kathitamāśrame sāmago dvijaḥ || | tena sārddhaṃ mahābāho yudhyasva tvaṃ nṛpottama || 5 ||
analyzed: atha kena api kathitam āśrame sāma gaḥ dvijaḥ   tena sārddham mahā bāho yudhyasva tvam nṛpa uttama

original: tataḥ sa prasthito rājā mlecchaiḥ sārddhaṃ sahasraśaḥ | tuṣārairbarbarairluṃpaiḥ pahlavaiḥ śvagaṇaistathā || 6 ||
analyzed: tatas sa prasthitaḥ rājā mlecchaiḥ sārddham sahasraśas tuṣāraiḥ barbaraiḥ luṃpaiḥ pahlavaiḥ śvagaṇaiḥ tathā

original: dasyubhiḥ saṃvṛtaḥ krūraiḥ krodhenākuliteṃdriyaḥ | ājagāmāśramaṃ puṇyaṃ sāmagasya munestadā || 7 ||
analyzed: dasyubhiḥ saṃvṛtaḥ krūraiḥ krodhena ākulita iṃdriyaḥ  ājagāma āśramam puṇyam sāmagasya muneḥ tadā  /

original: muninā pūjitastena madhuparkādiviṣṭaraiḥ | etasminnantare rājā homadhenuṃ dadarśa ha || 8 ||
analyzed: muninā pūjitaḥ tena madhuparka ādi viṣṭaraiḥ etasmin antare rājā homadhenum dadarśa ha  /

original: prārthayāmāsa sahasā na dattā muninā tadā | pramathya cāśramaṃ tasya homadhenuṃ jahāra saḥ | vanaṃ babhaṃja sakalaṃ tasya viprasya paśyataḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: prārthayāmāsa sahasā na dattā muninā tadā pramathya ca āśramam tasya homadhenum jahāra saḥ  vanam babhaṃja sakalam tasya viprasya paśyataḥ  /

original: kālyamānāṃ ca gāṃ dṛṣṭvā vatsaṃ cātīva duḥkhitam | uvāca vacanaṃ vipro mā rājansāhasaṃ kuru || 10 ||
analyzed: kālyamānām ca gām dṛṣṭvā vatsam ca atīva duḥkhitam  uvāca vacanam vipraḥ mā rājan sāhasam kuru  /

original: evaṃ vadaṃtaṃ vipreṃdraṃ śaraistīkṣṇairjaghāna ha | luṃpaḥ krodhasamāviṣṭo duṣṭo duṣṭajanairvṛtaḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: evam vadaṃtam vipra iṃdram śaraiḥ tīkṣṇaiḥ jaghāna ha luṃpaḥ krodha samāviṣṭaḥ duṣṭaḥ duṣṭa janaiḥ vṛtaḥ  /

original: asakṛtputraputreti vilapaṃtamanāthavat | hatvā ca sāmagaṃ vipraṃ jagāma svagṛhaṃ nṛpaḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: asakṛt putra putra iti vilapaṃtam anātha vat  hatvā ca sāma gam vipram jagāma sva gṛham nṛpaḥ

original: etasminnaṃtare putraḥ samitpāṇirupāgataḥ | dṛṣṭvā ca pitaraṃ vipraṃ tadā mṛtyuvaśaṃ gatam | anāgasaṃ mahātmānaṃ vilalāpa suduḥkhitaḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: etasmin aṃtare putraḥ samidh pāṇiḥ upāgataḥ dṛṣṭvā ca pitaram vipram tadā mṛtyu vaśam gatam anāgasam mahātmānam vilalāpa su duḥkhitaḥ

original: kenedaṃ kutsitaṃ karma kṛtaṃ pāpena me pitā | ayudhyamāno vṛddhaḥ sanhataḥ śaraśataiḥ śiteḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: kena idam kutsitam karma kṛtam pāpena me pitā ayudhyamānaḥ vṛddhaḥ san hataḥ śara śataiḥ śiteḥ

original: vilapyaivaṃ sakaruṇaṃ bahunā nāvidhaṃ tathā | pretakāryāṇi sarvāṇi pituścakre vidhānataḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: vilapya evam sa karuṇam bahunā tathā preta kāryāṇi sarvāṇi pituḥ cakre vidhānataḥ

original: dadāha pitaraṃ cāgnau toyamādāya satvaram | tasya luṃpādhipasyāpi dadau śāpaṃ sudāruṇam || 16 ||
analyzed: dadāha pitaram ca agnau toyam ādāya sa tvaram tasya luṃpa adhipasya api dadau śāpam su dāruṇam

original: svadharmanirato vidvānyena me nihataḥ pitā | sa pāpātmā durācāraḥ kuṣṭharogamavāpnuyāt || 17 ||
analyzed: svadharma nirataḥ vidvān yena me nihataḥ pitā  sa pāpa ātmā durācāraḥ kuṣṭha rogam avāpnuyāt  /

original: etasminnantare rājā kuṣṭharogeṇa pīḍitaḥ | acaṃkramaṇatāṃ prāpto luṃpādhīśo varānane || 18 ||
analyzed: etasmin antare rājā kuṣṭha rogeṇa pīḍitaḥ acaṃkramaṇatām prāptaḥ luṃpa adhīśaḥ varānane  /

original: auṣadhairadhiko'bhyeti brahmaśāpaprabhāvataḥ | vairāgyānmartukāmo'sau kāṣṭhānyādāya duḥkhitaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: auṣadhaiḥ adhikaḥ abhyeti brahma śāpa prabhāvataḥ vairāgyāt martu kāmaḥ asau kāṣṭhāni ādāya duḥkhitaḥ

original: citāṃ kartuṃ samārebhe samāyāto'tha nāradaḥ | pūjito vidhinā tena duḥkhitena nṛpeṇa hi || 20 ||
analyzed: citām kartum samārebhe samāyātaḥ atha nāradaḥ pūjitaḥ vidhinā tena duḥkhitena nṛpeṇa hi   /

original: atha papraccha luṃpo'sau nāradaṃ munisattamam | akasmānmama devarṣe kuṣṭharogo babhūva ha | tenāhaṃ pīḍito'tīva na ca śāṃtiṃ vrajatyasau || 21 ||
analyzed: atha papraccha luṃpaḥ asau nāradam muni sattamam akasmāt mama deva ṛṣe kuṣṭha rogaḥ babhūva ha tena aham pīḍitaḥ atīva na ca śāṃtim vrajati asau  /

original: auṣadhairvarddhate kasmādetadākhyātumarhasi | na testvaviditaṃ kiṃcidihaloke paratra ca || 22 ||
analyzed: auṣadhaiḥ varddhate kasmāt etat ākhyātum arhasi na teḥ tu aviditam kiṃcid ihaloke paratra ca

original: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā luṃpādhīśasya nāradaḥ | kathayāmāsa tatsarvaṃ brahmaśāpaṃ sudustaram || 23 ||
analyzed: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā luṃpa adhīśasya nāradaḥ kathayāmāsa tat sarvam brahma śāpam su dustaram

original: tataḥ sabhāryo nṛpatiḥ prārthayāmāsa nāradam | kathaṃ me bhagavañchāpo dustaro yāsyati kṣayam || 24 ||
analyzed: tatas sa bhāryaḥ nṛpatiḥ prārthayāmāsa nāradam katham me bhagavan śāpaḥ dustaraḥ yāsyati kṣayam

original: evamuktastu lumpena nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ | kāruṇyātkathayāmāsa sabhāryasya yaśasvini || 25 ||
analyzed: evam uktaḥ tu lumpena nāradaḥ bhagavān ṛṣiḥ kāruṇyāt kathayāmāsa sa bhāryasya yaśasvini  /

original: mahākālavane rājaṃlliṃgaṃ kuṣṭhaharaṃ param | sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ tatra vidyate pāpanāśanam || 26 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vane rājan liṃgam kuṣṭha haram param sarva saṃpad karam tatra vidyate pāpa nāśanam

original: śiprāyāśca taṭe ramye keśavārkasya pūrvataḥ | tatra tvaṃ gaccha rājeṃdra kāṃtyā yukto bhaviṣyasi || 27 ||
analyzed: śiprāyāḥ ca taṭe ramye keśava arkasya pūrvatas tatra tvam gaccha rāja iṃdra kāntyā yuktaḥ bhaviṣyasi  /

original: evamuktastu luṃpo'sau hyājagāma tvarānvitaḥ | mahākālavanaṃ ramyaṃ maharṣigaṇasevitam || 28 ||
analyzed: evam uktaḥ tu luṃpaḥ asau hi ājagāma tvarā anvitaḥ mahākāla vanam ramyam mahā ṛṣi gaṇa sevitam

original: prāptaḥ svargopamaṃ bhūpaḥ śiprayā pariśobhitam | viveśa ca mudā yukto dṛṣṭvā liṃgamanuttamam || 29 ||
analyzed: prāptaḥ svarga upamam bhūpaḥ śiprayā pariśobhitam  viveśa ca mudā yuktaḥ dṛṣṭvā liṃgam anuttamam

original: snātvā śiprājale puṇye mahāpātakanāśane | darśanāttasya liṃgasya divyarūpo vabhūva ha || 30 ||
analyzed: snātvā śiprā jale puṇye mahāpātaka nāśane  darśanāt tasya liṃgasya divya rūpaḥ vabhūva ha

original: kuṣṭharogeṇa muktastu mukto vai brahmahatyayā | kṛtakṛtyo nṛpo jāto darśanādeva pārvati || 31 ||
analyzed: kuṣṭha rogeṇa muktaḥ tu muktaḥ vai brahmahatyayā kṛtakṛtyaḥ nṛpaḥ jātaḥ darśanāt eva pārvati

original: sa tatra tāmuṣitvaikāṃ rajanīṃ pṛthivīpatiḥ | tāpasānāṃ paraṃ cakre satkāraṃ bhāryayā saha || 32 ||
analyzed: sa tatra tām uṣitvā ekām rajanīm pṛthivīpatiḥ tāpasānām param cakre satkāram bhāryayā saha  /

original: tataḥ kṛtasvastvayanastāpasaistairmahātmabhiḥ | divyajñānānvitairdivyaiḥ sūryavaiśvānaraprabhaiḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: tatas kṛta svastu ayanaḥ tāpasaiḥ taiḥ mahātmabhiḥ divya jñāna anvitaiḥ divyaiḥ sūrya vaiśvānara prabhaiḥ

original: kṛtaṃ nāma tadā tasya liṃgasya kamalānane | luṃpenārādhito yasmāddevo'yaṃ kuṣṭhanāśanaḥ | lumpeśvara iti khyāto bhaviṣyati mahītale || 34 ||

original: gauravadhyā mahīpāla vatsaṃ kṛtvā ca dugdhi mām || 14 ||
analyzed: gauḥ avadhyā mahīpāla vatsam kṛtvā ca dugdhi mām

original: tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā dudoha nṛpasattamaḥ | bhāsvadratnāni sasyāni kṛtvā vatsaṃ himālayam || 15 ||
analyzed: tasyāḥ tat vacanam śrutvā dudoha nṛpa sattamaḥ bhāsvat ratnāni sasyāni kṛtvā vatsam himālayam

original: jātāḥ prajāśca sumukhāḥ pravṛttaśca mahotsavaḥ | pravṛttā yāgadānādi kriyā magalapūrvikāḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: jātāḥ prajāḥ ca su mukhāḥ pravṛttaḥ ca mahā utsavaḥ pravṛttā yāga dāna ādi kriyāḥ magala pūrvikāḥ  /

original: rājātha ciṃtayāmāsa mayā pāpamidaṃ kṛtam | avadhyāśca striyaḥ proktā gauravadhyā dvijastathā || 17 ||
analyzed: rājā atha ciṃtayāmāsa mayā pāpam idam kṛtam avadhyāḥ ca striyaḥ proktāḥ gauḥ avadhyā dvijaḥ tathā

original: strīrūpadhāriṇī pṛthvī mohādeṣā mayā hatā | govadhe ca kṛtā buddhiraho pāpaparaṃparā | tasmādvahniṃ pravekṣyāmi citāṃ kṛtvā na saṃśayaḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: strī rūpa dhāriṇī pṛthvī mohāt eṣā mayā hatā  go vadhe ca kṛtā buddhiḥ aho pāpa paraṃparā tasmāt vahnim pravekṣyāmi citām kṛtvā na saṃśayaḥ

original: evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya pṛthoramitatejasaḥ | ājagāma punastatra nārado bhagavānṛṣiḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: evam ciṃtayataḥ tasya pṛthoḥ amita tejasaḥ ājagāma punar tatra nāradaḥ bhagavān ṛṣiḥ

original: dṛṣṭvā tathāvidhaṃ dīnaṃ ciṃtayānaṃ pṛthuṃ priye | uvāca nārado dhīmānkimetaditi pārthiva || 20 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā tathāvidham dīnam ciṃtayānam pṛthum priye  uvāca nāradaḥ dhīmān kim etat iti pārthiva

original: tataḥ sa kathayāmāsa mayā pāpamidaṃ kṛtam | avadhyā strī hatā vipra kṛtā buddhiśca govadhe || 21 ||
analyzed: tatas sa kathayāmāsa mayā pāpam idam kṛtam avadhyā strī hatā vipra kṛtā buddhiḥ ca go vadhe

original: kāṃllokānu gami ṣyāmi kṛtvā karma sudāruṇam | mariṣyāmi na saṃdeho brahmahā pāpapūruṣaḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: kān lokān anu gami syāmi kṛtvā karma su dāruṇam mariṣyāmi na saṃdehaḥ brahma hā pāpa pūruṣaḥ

original: atha ceṣṭopadeśena duḥkhāduddhara māṃ dvija | tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā kathayāmāsa nāradaḥ | mahāpāpapraśamanaṃ liṃgamāhātmyamuttamam || 23 ||
analyzed: atha ca iṣṭa upadeśena duḥkhāt uddhara mām dvija tasya tat vacanam śrutvā kathayāmāsa nāradaḥ mahā pāpa praśamanam liṃga māhātmyam uttamam

original: mahākālavane liṃgamabhayeśvarapaścime | mahāpāpakṣayakaraṃ vidyate tatra bhūpate | gaccha tvaṃ sahasā rājaṃstatra pūto bhaviṣyasi || 24 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vane liṃgam abhayeśvara paścime  mahā pāpa kṣaya karam vidyate tatra bhūpate gaccha tvam sahasā rājan tatra pūtaḥ bhaviṣyasi  /

original: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā pṛdhustatra jagāma saḥ | dṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ ca vai ramyaṃ vipāpastatkṣaṇādabhūt || 25 ||
analyzed: nāradasya vacaḥ śrutvā pṛdhuḥ tatra jagāma saḥ dṛṣṭvā liṃgam ca vai ramyam vipāpaḥ tad kṣaṇāt abhūt

original: dvādaśādityasaṃkāśo babhūva pṛthivīpatiḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: dvādaśa āditya saṃkāśaḥ babhūva pṛthivīpatiḥ

original: tatoṃ'tarikṣagairdevi kṛtaṃ nāma varānane | pṛthunā pūjito yasmādbhaviṣyati mahītale | adyaprabhṛti vikhyāto devo'yaṃ pṛthukeśvaraḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: tatas uṃ'tarikṣa gaiḥ devi kṛtam nāma varānane pṛthunā pūjitaḥ yasmāt bhaviṣyati mahī tale  adya prabhṛti vikhyātaḥ devaḥ ayam pṛthukeśvaraḥ

original: ye ca drakṣyaṃti deveśaṃ pṛthukeśvaramīśvaram | te sarvakāmasaṃpūrṇā bhaviṣyaṃti mahītale || 28 ||
analyzed: ye ca drakṣyaṃti deveśam pṛthukeśvaram īśvaram  te sarva kāma saṃpūrṇāḥ bhaviṣyanti mahī tale

original: ajñānājjñānato vāpi yatpāpaṃ jāyate nṛṇām | tatpāpaṃ yāsyati kṣipraṃ pṛthukeśvaradarśanāt || 29 ||
analyzed: ajñānāt jñānataḥ vā api yat pāpam jāyate nṛṇām tat pāpam yāsyati kṣipram pṛthuka īśvara darśanāt

original: vācikaṃ mānasaṃ vāpi kāyikaṃ guhyasaṃbhavam | prakāśaṃ vā kṛtaṃ pāpaṃ prasaṃgādapi yatkṛtam | tatsarvaṃ yāsyati kṣipraṃ puthukeśvaradarśanāt || 30 ||
analyzed: vācikam mānasam vā api kāyikam guhya saṃbhavam prakāśam vā kṛtam pāpam prasaṃgāt api yat kṛtam  tat sarvam yāsyati kṣipram puthuka īśvara darśanāt

original: pūjayiṣyaṃti ye bhaktyā devaṃ vai pṛdhukeśvaram | rājyaṃ prāpsyaṃti te samyaṅnṛloke ca triviṣṭape || 31 ||
analyzed: pūjayiṣyaṃti ye bhaktyā devam vai pṛdhuka īśvaram  rājyam prāpsyaṃti te samyak nṛ loke ca triviṣṭape

original: bhuktvā rājyaṃ manuṣyāṇāṃ devānāṃ ca mahītale | yāsyaṃti paramaṃ sthānaṃ brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: bhuktvā rājyam manuṣyāṇām devānām ca mahī tale  yāsyaṃti paramam sthānam brahmaṇaḥ parameṣṭhinaḥ  /

original: ityuktvā devasaṃghaiśca pūjitaḥ pṛthukeśvaraḥ | pṛthuḥ śaśāsa pṛthivīṃ sapattanāṃ saparvatām || 33 ||
analyzed: iti uktvā deva saṃghaiḥ ca pūjitaḥ pṛthuka īśvaraḥ pṛthuḥ śaśāsa pṛthivīm sa pattanām sa parvatām  /

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | pṛthukeśvara devasya śṛṇu vai sthāvareśvaram || 34 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ pṛthukeśvara devasya śṛṇu vai sthāvareśvaram

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ sahitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṃgamāhātmye pṛthukeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikonapaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 49 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām sahitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṃga māhātmye pṛthukeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ekonapaṃcāśattamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: śrīmahādeva uvāca | śṛṇu devi prayatnena paṃcāśattamamīśvaram | yasya darśanamātreṇa grahabādhā na jāyate || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī mahādevaḥ uvāca  śṛṇu devi prayatnena paṃcāśattamam īśvaram yasya darśana mātreṇa graha bādhā na jāyate  /

original: saṃjñānāma raverbhāryā sā sutā viśvakarmaṇaḥ | bharttustejo'sahaṃtyātha kadāciccaiva saṃjñayā | chāyāmayī cātmanastu nirmitā tarasā tayā || 2 ||
analyzed: saṃjñā nāma raveḥ bhāryā sā sutā viśvakarmaṇaḥ bharttuḥ tejaḥ asahaṃtyā atha kadācid ca eva saṃjñayā  chāyā mayī ca ātmanaḥ tu nirmitā tarasā tayā  /

original: sā proktā sādareṇaiva sthīyatāṃ sūryasaṃnidhau | pṛṣṭyāpi na vācyaṃ te madīyaṃ gamanaṃ raveḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: sā proktā sa ādareṇa eva sthīyatām sūrya saṃnidhau pṛṣṭyā api na vācyam te madīyam gamanam raveḥ   /

original: ityuktvā sā tadā saṃjñā jagāma bhavanaṃ pituḥ | saṃjñeyamiti manvāno dvitīyāyāṃ divaspatiḥ | janayāmāsa tanayaṃ nāmato yaḥ śanaiścaraḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: iti uktvā sā tadā saṃjñā jagāma bhavanam pituḥ saṃjñā iyam iti manvānaḥ dvitīyāyām divaspatiḥ janayāmāsa tanayam nāmataḥ yaḥ śanaiścaraḥ

original: tasmiñjāte bhayaṃ jagmuḥ sadevāsuramānuṣāḥ | trailokyaṃ jātamātreṇa ākrāṃtaṃ sacarācaram || 5 ||
analyzed: tasmin jāte bhayam jagmuḥ sa deva asura mānuṣāḥ trailokyam jāta mātreṇa ākrāṃtam sa carācaram

original: indro'pi bhayasaṃtrasto brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | sūryaputrasya vṛttāṃtaṃ kathayāmāsa gadgadam || 6 ||
analyzed: indraḥ api bhaya saṃtrastaḥ brahmāṇam śaraṇam gataḥ sūryaputrasya vṛttāṃtam kathayāmāsa gadgadam

original: bhinnaṃ tu rohiṇīcakraṃ vyāptaṃ nakṣatramaṃḍalam | jātamātreṇa cākrāṃtaṃ trailokyaṃ ravisūnunā || 7 ||
analyzed: bhinnam tu rohiṇī cakram vyāptam nakṣatra maṃḍalam  jāta mātreṇa ca ākrāṃtam trailokyam ravi sūnunā

original: vāsavasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ | āhūya sahasā sūryaṃ vacanaṃ cedamabravīt || 8 ||
analyzed: vāsavasya vacaḥ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ āhūya sahasā sūryam vacanam ca idam abravīt

original: maryādā kriyatāṃ bhāno vāryatāṃ putra aurasaḥ | ākrāṃtaṃ tejasā tena trailokyaṃ bhūbhuvādikam || 9 ||
analyzed: maryādā kriyatām bhāno vāryatām putraḥ aurasaḥ ākrāṃtam tejasā tena trailokyam bhūbhuva ādikam

original: brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā raviṇā proktamīdṛśaḥ | asādhyo'yaṃ mama suto vāryatāṃ svayameva tam || 10 ||
analyzed: brahmaṇaḥ vacanam śrutvā raviṇā proktam īdṛśaḥ asādhyaḥ ayam mama sutaḥ vāryatām svayam eva tam  /

original: paśya me caraṇau dagdhau dṛṣṭimātreṇa līlayā | brahmāpi bhayasaṃtrasto jagāma manasā harim || 11 ||
analyzed: paśya me caraṇau dagdhau dṛṣṭi mātreṇa līlayā brahmā api bhaya saṃtrastaḥ jagāma manasā harim

original: sūryasya vacanaṃ śrutvā hariḥ prāptastu tatkṣaṇāt | brahmaṇo vacanaṃ śrutvā bhītaḥ kṛṣṇo'bravīdidam || 12 ||
analyzed: sūryasya vacanam śrutvā hariḥ prāptaḥ tu tad kṣaṇāt brahmaṇaḥ vacanam śrutvā bhītaḥ kṛṣṇaḥ abravīt idam

original: gamyatāṃ tatra yatrāste devadevo maheśvaraḥ | kṛṣṇasya vacanātsarve mamāṃtikamupāgatāḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: gamyatām tatra yatra āste devadevaḥ maheśvaraḥ kṛṣṇasya vacanāt sarve mama aṃtikam upāgatāḥ

original: vṛttāṃtaḥ kathitaḥ sarvo raviputrasya pārvati | mayā smṛtastu saṃprāptaḥ sūryaputrastu tatkṣaṇāt || 14 ||
analyzed: vṛttāṃtaḥ kathitaḥ sarvaḥ ravi putrasya pārvati mayā smṛtaḥ tu saṃprāptaḥ sūrya putraḥ tu tad kṣaṇāt  /

original: adhodṛṣṭirmayā dṛṣṭo vakrāṃgo rūpato'sitaḥ | sthairyaṃ kṛtvā namaskṛtya vijñapto'haṃ śanaiḥśanaiḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: adhas dṛṣṭiḥ mayā dṛṣṭaḥ vakra aṃgaḥ rūpataḥ asitaḥ sthairyam kṛtvā namaskṛtya vijñaptaḥ aham śanais śanais  /

original: kimarthaṃ vai smṛto deva dehyājāṃ mama śaṃkara | ādeśe tava tiṣṭhāmi kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām || 16 ||
analyzed: kimartham vai smṛtaḥ deva dehi ājām mama śaṃkara ādeśe tava tiṣṭhāmi kim karomi praśādhi mām

original: ityukto'haṃ tadā tena raviputreṇa pārvati | mayā sa vārito'tyarthaṃ mā pīḍaya jagattrayam || 17 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ aham tadā tena ravi putreṇa pārvati mayā sa vāritaḥ atyartham mā pīḍaya jagattrayam

original: tenoktaṃ dehi me sthānaṃ pānamāhārameva ca | mayā dattaṃ viśālākṣi pūjārthaṃ sthānamuttamam || 18 ||
analyzed: tena uktam dehi me sthānam pānam āhāram eva ca mayā dattam viśāla akṣi pūjā artham sthānam uttamam

original: meṣādirāśisaṃsthaḥ saṃstriṃśanmāsānprapīḍaya | mānuṣānkramaśo vatsa tatra tṛptimavāpsyasi || 19 ||
analyzed: meṣa ādi rāśi saṃsthaḥ san triṃśat māsān prapīḍaya mānuṣān kramaśas vatsa tatra tṛptim avāpsyasi  /

original: aṣṭamaśca caturthaśca dvitīyo janmasaṃsthitaḥ | dvādaśarāśisaṃstho'pi viruddho bhava sarvadā || 20 ||
analyzed: aṣṭamaḥ ca caturthaḥ ca dvitīyaḥ janma saṃsthitaḥ  dvādaśa rāśi saṃsthaḥ api viruddhaḥ bhava sarvadā  /

original: ekādaśo vā ṣaṣṭho vā tṛtīya sthānagothavā | bhava bhavyataro nṝṇāmataḥ pūjā bhaviṣyati || 21 ||
analyzed: ekādaśaḥ vā ṣaṣṭhaḥ vā tṛtīya bhava bhavyataraḥ nṝṇām atas pūjā bhaviṣyati  /

original: paṃcamo navamaścaiva udāsīnastu saptamaḥ | bhava rāśigato nityaṃ mānuṣe karma bhiryute || 22 ||
analyzed: paṃcamaḥ navamaḥ ca eva udāsīnaḥ tu saptamaḥ bhava rāśi gataḥ nityam mānuṣe karma bhiḥ yute

original: pūjāṃ prāpsyasi cātyarthaṃ grahāṇāmadhikaṃ sadā | gatiḥ sthirā bhavitrī te varaḥ śreṣṭhobhidhīyate || 23 ||
analyzed: pūjām prāpsyasi ca atyartham grahāṇām adhikam sadā  gatiḥ sthirā bhavitrī te varaḥ śreṣṭhaḥ abhidhīyate

original: ataste sthāvaraṃ nāma bhaviṣyati mahītale | śanaiścarastvaṃ rāśistho grahāṇāmadhiko yataḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: atas te sthāvaram nāma bhaviṣyati mahī tale  śanaiścaraḥ tvam rāśi sthaḥ grahāṇām adhikaḥ yatas

original: ataḥ śanaiścaronāma bhaviṣyasi sadā bhuvi | gajagaṇḍanibhākāro mama kaṇṭhasamopi ca || 25 ||
analyzed: atas śanaiścaraḥ nāma bhaviṣyasi sadā bhuvi gaja gaṇḍa nibha ākāraḥ mama kaṇṭha samaḥ api ca  /

original: varṇato hyasito nāma bhaviṣyasi mahītale | grahamadhye hyadhodṛṣṭirgatirmaṃdā bhaviṣyati | tuṣṭo dadāsi rājyaṃ ca ruṣṭo vai harasi kṣaṇāt || 26 ||
analyzed: varṇataḥ hi asitaḥ nāma bhaviṣyasi mahī tale  graha madhye hi adhas dṛṣṭiḥ gatiḥ maṃdā bhaviṣyati tuṣṭaḥ dadāsi rājyam ca ruṣṭaḥ vai harasi kṣaṇāt

original: devāsuramanuṣyāśca siddhavidyādharoragāḥ | tvatkrūradṛṣṭinihatā nāśaṃ yāsyaṃti nānyathā || 27 ||
analyzed: deva asura manuṣyāḥ ca siddha vidyādhara uragāḥ tvad krūra dṛṣṭi nihatāḥ nāśam yāsyanti na anyathā  /

original: tava prasādātprāpsyaṃti mano'bhīṣṭaṃ sudurllabham | anyacca te pradāsyāmi sthānaṃ guhyaṃ manoharam || 28 ||
analyzed: tava prasādāt prāpsyaṃti manaḥ abhīṣṭam su durllabham anyat ca te pradāsyāmi sthānam guhyam manoharam

original: manobhīṣṭakaraṃ puṇyaṃ devadānavadurlabham | pralaye'pyakṣayaṃ proktaṃ mahākālavanaṃ param || 29 ||
analyzed: manaḥ bhīṣṭa karam puṇyam deva dānava durlabham pralaye api akṣayam proktam mahākāla vanam param

original: tatra gaccha mamādeśattvapṛthukeśvarapaścime | vidyate tatra yalliṃgaṃ tatte nāmnā bhaviṣyati || 30 ||
analyzed: tatra gaccha mama ādeśa ttva pṛthukeśvara paścime  vidyate tatra yat liṃgam tat te nāmnā bhaviṣyati  /

original: kīrttireṣā tvadīyāpi trailokye bhavitā dhuvam || 31 ||
analyzed: kīrttiḥ eṣā tvadīyā api trailokye bhavitā dhuvam

original: ityuktaḥ sthāvaro devi mamājñāpālakastadā | jagāma tvarito ramyaṃ mahākālavanaṃ śubham || 32 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ sthāvaraḥ devi mama ājñā pālakaḥ tadā jagāma tvaritaḥ ramyam mahākāla vanam śubham

original: dṛṣṭvā tatraiva talliṃgaṃ sthānaṃ labdhaṃ suśobhanam | talliṃgaṃ bhuvane khyātaṃ nāmataḥ sthāvareśvaram || 33 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā tatra eva tat liṃgam sthānam labdham su śobhanam tat liṃgam bhuvane khyātam nāmataḥ sthāvareśvaram

original: śaninoktaṃ tadā devi ye'tra drakṣyaṃti bhaktitaḥ | mayā prapūjitaṃ liṃgaṃ vikhyātaṃ sthāvareśvaram | teṣāṃ pīḍā madīyā tu na bhaviṣyati karhicit || 34 ||
analyzed: śaninā uktam tadā devi ye atra drakṣyaṃti bhaktitaḥ mayā prapūjitam liṃgam vikhyātam sthāvareśvaram teṣām pīḍā madīyā tu na bhaviṣyati karhicit  /

original: madīye ca dine yo vai niyamena prapaśyati | tasyāhaṃ sakalāṃ bādhāṃ śamayiṣyāmyasaṃśayam || 35 ||
analyzed: madīye ca dine yaḥ vai niyamena prapaśyati tasya aham sakalām bādhām śamayiṣyāmi asaṃśayam

original: dhakṣyāmi satataṃ pīḍāmanyagrahakṛtāmapi | madīyaṃ ca bhayaṃ tasya svapne'pi na bhaviṣyati || 36 ||
analyzed: dhakṣyāmi satatam pīḍām anya graha kṛtām api  madīyam ca bhayam tasya svapne api na bhaviṣyati  /

original: na grahā na piśācāśca na yakṣā na ca rākṣasāḥ | vighnaṃ kurvaṃti tasyāpi mayi tuṣṭe na saṃśayaḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: na grahāḥ na piśācāḥ ca na yakṣāḥ na ca rākṣasāḥ vighnam kurvaṃti tasya api mayi tuṣṭe na saṃśayaḥ

original: saṃkrāṃtau śanivāre ca vyatīpāte'yane tathā | ye paśyaṃti narā bhaktyā liṃgaṃ vai sthāvareśvaram | bhaviṣyatyakṣayasteṣāṃ sthiro vāsastriviṣṭape || 38 ||
analyzed: saṃkrāṃtau śanivāre ca vyatīpāte ayane tathā  ye paśyaṃti narāḥ bhaktyā liṃgam vai sthāvareśvaram  bhaviṣyati akṣayaḥ teṣām sthiraḥ vāsaḥ triviṣṭape

original: niyamena prapaśyaṃti mama vāre'tra ye narāḥ | na teṣāṃ duṣkṛtaṃ kiṃcidduṣkṛtotthā na cāpadaḥ || 39 ||
analyzed: niyamena prapaśyaṃti mama vāre atra ye narāḥ na teṣām duṣkṛtam kiṃcid duṣkṛta utthāḥ na ca āpadaḥ

original: ityuktvā pūjayāmāsa bhūyo liṃgaṃ śanaiścaraḥ | pūjayitvā śubhaiḥ puṣpairbhaktyā tatraiva saṃsthitaḥ || 42 ||
analyzed: iti uktvā pūjayāmāsa bhūyas liṃgam śanaiścaraḥ pūjayitvā śubhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ bhaktyā tatra eva saṃsthitaḥ

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | sthāvareśvaradevasya śūleśvaramatho śṛṇu || 43 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ sthāvareśvara devasya śūleśvaram atho śṛṇu  /

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye sthāvareśvaramāhātmya varṇanaṃnāma paṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 50 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvantya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye sthāvareśvaramāhātmya varṇanam nāma paṃcāśattamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: īśvara uvāca | ekādhikaṃ vijānīhi paṃcāśattamamīśvaram | devaṃ śūleśvaraṃ devi sarva vyādhivināśanam || 1 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca eka adhikam vijānīhi paṃcāśattamam īśvaram  devam śūleśvaram devi sarva vyādhi vināśanam

original: ādye kalpe pravṛtte ca rājyahetorvarānane | devānāṃ dānavānāṃ ca yuddhamāsītsudāruṇam | daityānāmīśvare jaṃbhe devānāṃ ca śacīpatau || 2 ||
analyzed: ādye kalpe pravṛtte ca rājya hetoḥ varānane  devānām dānavānām ca yuddham āsīt su dāruṇam daityānām īśvare jaṃbhe devānām ca śacīpatau  /

original: tato devāḥ parābhūtā daityā vijayino'bhavan | aṃdhako maṃdaraṃ prāpto dūtaṃ me prāhiṇottadā || 3 ||

analyzed: sa dūtaḥ mām uvāca uccais sa garvaḥ duṣṭa mānasaḥ andhakena aham ādiṣṭaḥ śṛṇu śaṃkara mad vacaḥ

original: gaurīṃ me dehi patnyarthaṃ maṃdarastyajyatāmayam | evaṃ kṛte kṛtārthastvamanyathā nāsti te gatiḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: gaurīm me dehi patnī artham maṃdaraḥ tyajyatām ayam evam kṛte kṛtārthaḥ tvam anyathā nā asti te gatiḥ  /

original: ukto'haṃ tena dūtena tvayā saha mahāgirau | smitānanaḥ kṣaṇaṃ bhūtvā mayā proktamidaṃ vacaḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: uktaḥ aham tena dūtena tvayā saha mahā girau smita ānanaḥ kṣaṇam bhūtvā mayā proktam idam vacaḥ

original: gaccha dūta mamādeśādaṃdhakaṃ brūhi satvaram | ihābhyetyāhavaṃ kṛtvā jitvemāṃ sundarīṃ naya || 7 ||
analyzed: gaccha dūta mama ādeśāt aṃdhakam brūhi satvaram iha abhyetya āhavam kṛtvā jitvā imām sundarīm naya  /

original: ityuktaḥ prayayau dūtastenākhyātaṃ vaco mama | andhako'pi tadā daityaḥ samarārthī tu mandaram | samāyātaḥ sahāmātyo balena caturaṃgiṇā || 8 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ prayayau dūtaḥ tena ākhyātam vacaḥ mama  andhakaḥ api tadā daityaḥ samara arthī tu mandaram samāyātaḥ saha amātyaḥ balena caturaṃgiṇā

original: mayā saha tatastasya ghoraṃ yuddhamabhūcciram | andhakasya ratho ghoraśchinno bhinnaḥ samaṃ tataḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: mayā saha tatas tasya ghoram yuddham abhūt ciram andhakasya rathaḥ ghoraḥ chinnaḥ bhinnaḥ samam tatas

original: tataḥ kuddhoṃ'dhako devi rathāttasmādavaplutaḥ | madrathaṃ balavāngṛhya mayā saha balotkaṭaḥ | yuyudhe sa mahādaityaḥ śūlena tāḍito mayā || 10 ||
analyzed: tatas kuddhaḥ oṃ'dhakaḥ devi rathāt tasmāt avaplutaḥ mad ratham balavān gṛhya mayā saha bala utkaṭaḥ yuyudhe sa mahā daityaḥ śūlena tāḍitaḥ mayā  /

original: mayā dhṛtontarikṣe sa śūlaproto mahāsuraḥ | śūlaproto'tha vai duṣṭastāvatsa bhrāmito mayā || 11 ||

original: susrāva tasya gātrebhyaḥ śoṇitogha stato mahān | bindaubindau tu raktasya tattulyā dānavāstathā || 12 ||

analyzed: saṃbhūtāḥ koṭiśas devi taiḥ aham punar ardditaḥ kim karttavyam iti dhyāyan sthi taḥ aham tatra bhāmini  /

analyzed: mayā ca utpāditā durgā rakta daṃtā su bhīṣaṇā andhakasya tadā pītam raktam vahuvidham tayā  /

original: tasminpīte tato rakte nottasthurdevi cāpare | pūrvotthitāstayaivāśu nihatā dānavādhipāḥ | tena śūlavareṇaiva tatkṣaṇānnidhanaṃ gatāḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: tasmin pīte tatas rakte na uttasthuḥ devi ca apare pūrva utthitāḥ tayā eva āśu nihatāḥ dānava adhipāḥ tena śūla vareṇa eva tad kṣaṇāt nidhanam gatāḥ  /

original: sa māmuvāca hṛṣṭātmā kṛtāṃ jalipuṭoṃ'dhakaḥ | tvayi bhaktiḥ sadā mestu durlabhaṃ tava darśanam || 16 ||
analyzed: sa mām uvāca hṛṣṭa ātmā kṛtām tvayi bhaktiḥ sadā me astu durlabham tava darśanam

original: svāminā nihataścāhaṃ ko'nyo dhanyataro hi mat | tvacchūlena vinirbhinno hyantarikṣe tato'pyaham || 17 ||
analyzed: svāminā nihataḥ ca aham kaḥ anyaḥ dhanyataraḥ hi mat tvad śūlena vinirbhinnaḥ hi antarikṣe tatas api aham

original: saṃkalpākṣepavikṣepaṃ kalpakāryapravarttakam | sahasravaktraśirasaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje || 18 ||
analyzed: saṃkalpa ākṣepa vikṣepam kalpa kārya pravarttakam sahasra vaktra śirasam tvām aham śaraṇam vraje  /

original: girīṃdratanayānāthaṃ girīṃdraśikharālayam | mahālayakṛtāvāsaṃ tvāmahaṃ śaraṇaṃ vraje || 19 ||
analyzed: girīṃdra tanayā nātham girīṃdra śikhara ālayam mahālaya kṛta āvāsam tvām aham śaraṇam vraje  /

original: evaṃ stuto'haṃ daityena śūlaprotena sundari | tato me karuṇā jātā kṛtoṃdhako gaṇastadā || 20 ||
analyzed: evam stutaḥ aham daityena śūla protena sundari tatas me karuṇā jātā kṛta uṃdhakaḥ gaṇaḥ tadā

analyzed: parituṣṭaḥ prayacchāmi paramam sthānam uttamam na devaiḥ na ca gandharvaiḥ na api tat parama ṛṣibhiḥ

original: saṃprāpyaṃ māmanārādhya tathā vidhvastakalmaṣaiḥ | māmuvāca tataḥ śūlaḥ praṇamyānatakandharaḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: saṃprāpyam mām an ārādhya tathā vidhvasta kalmaṣaiḥ  mām uvāca tatas śūlaḥ praṇamya ānata kandharaḥ

analyzed: yadi prasannaḥ bhagavan karuṇā mayi te yadi kathayasva param sthānam manaḥ me yatra śuddhi ati duṣṭa saṃparka saṃjātam anyat pātakam ātmanaḥ  /

original: tato mayā samādiṣṭaḥ karuṇāśliṣṭacetasā | mahākālavanaṃ ramyamatipuṇyaphalapradam || 25 ||
analyzed: tatas mayā samādiṣṭaḥ karuṇā āśliṣṭa cetasā mahākāla vanam ramyam ati puṇya phala pradam

analyzed: tatra asmad prāpti dam liṃgam loka anugraha kārakam pṛdhuka īśvara pūrveṇa tat ārādhaya yatnataḥ  /

original: snehātsaṃśleṣito'tyarthaṃ pṛṣṭastu kuśalaṃ punaḥ | kathitaṃ tena śūlena duṣṭāṃdhaka vadhaṃ tadā || 29 ||
analyzed: snehāt saṃśleṣitaḥ atyartham pṛṣṭaḥ tu kuśalam punar kathitam tena śūlena duṣṭa aṃdhaka vadham tadā

original: tato bhaviṣyatyadhikaṃ darśanātte vṛṇomyaham | kiṃ tīrthairvividhaiḥ snātaiḥ kiṃ dānairvividhaiḥ kṛtaiḥ || 31 ||

analyzed: yaḥ kariṣyati te pūjām bhakti yuktaḥ api mānavaḥ aṣṭamyām vā caturdaśyām dine bhaumasya bhaktitaḥ

original: ye tvāṃ drakṣyaṃti puruṣā bhāvahīnāḥ prasaṃgataḥ | na patiṣyaṃti saṃsāre narake cātidāruṇe || 36 ||

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye śūleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāmaikapañcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 51 ||

original: śrīviśveśvara uvāca | dvyadhikaṃ devi jānīhi paṃcāśattamamīśvaram | oṃkāreśvara ityākhyā yasyāsti bhuvanatraye || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī viśveśvaraḥ uvāca  dvi adhikam devi jānīhi paṃcāśattamam īśvaram oṃkāra īśvaraḥ iti ākhyā yasya asti bhuvanatraye

original: prākṛte kalpasaṃjñe tu prathame prathamaṃ mayā | vaktrādutpādito devi puruṣaḥ kapilākṛtiḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: prākṛte kalpa saṃjñe tu prathame prathamam mayā vaktrāt utpāditaḥ devi puruṣaḥ kapila ākṛtiḥ  /

original: nirvāṇasyeva dīpasya gatistasya na lakṣitā | tatastasyābhavacciṃtā kathamātmā vibhajyate || 4 ||
analyzed: nirvāṇasya iva dīpasya gatiḥ tasya na lakṣitā tatas tasya abhavat ciṃtā katham ātmā vibhajyate

original: evaṃ ciṃtayatastasya caturmityotthitastataḥ | trivarṇasvararūpī ca caturvargaphalapradaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: evam ciṃtayataḥ tasya catur mityā utthitaḥ tatas tri varṇa svara rūpī ca caturvarga phala pradaḥ  /

original: ṛgyajuḥsāmanāmā ca brahmaviṣṇuśivātmakaḥ | vyāpnuvansakalāṃllokānprabhāvaiḥ pṛthubhistadā || 6 ||
analyzed: ṛk yajuḥ sāma nāmā ca brahma viṣṇu śiva ātmakaḥ vyāpnuvan sakalān lokān prabhāvaiḥ pṛthubhiḥ tadā

original: oṃkāra iti tasyākhyā mayā datā prasādataḥ | tadoktābhirudārābhirvāṇībhiḥ samalaṃkṛtaḥ || 7 ||

original: hṛdayāttasya devasya vaṣaṭkāraḥ samutthitaḥ | chaṃdasāṃ pravarā devī caturviṃśākṣarā parā || 8 ||
analyzed: hṛdayāt tasya devasya vaṣaṭkāraḥ samutthitaḥ chaṃdasām pravarā devī caturviṃśa akṣarā parā

original: ṣaṭkukṣiḥ sā tripādā ca paṃcaśīrṣopalakṣitā | samīpavarttinī devī pārśve tatra vyavasthitā || 9 ||
analyzed: ṣaṣ kukṣiḥ sā tri pādā ca paṃca śīrṣa upalakṣitā samīpa varttinī devī pārśve tatra vyavasthitā  /

original: gāyatrī madhurābhāṣā sāvitrī lokaviśrutā | sa coṃkāro mayā prokto gāyatryā saha pārvati | sṛṣṭiṃ kuru mamādeśādvicitrāmanayā saha || 10 ||
analyzed: gāyatrī madhura ābhāṣā sāvitrī loka viśrutā sa ca oṃkāraḥ mayā proktaḥ gāyatryā saha pārvati sṛṣṭim kuru mama ādeśāt vicitrām anayā saha  /

original: ityuktastriśikho bhūtvā hiraṇyasadṛśākṛtiḥ | sṛṣṭimutpādayāmāsa svaśarīrānmamājñayā || 11 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ triśikhaḥ bhūtvā hiraṇya sadṛśa ākṛtiḥ sṛṣṭim utpādayāmāsa sva śarīrāt mama ājñayā

original: pūrvaṃ devagaṇāścaiva trayastriṃśacca devatāḥ | manuṣyā ṛṣayaścaiva vedaprāmāṇyataḥ kṛtāḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: pūrvam deva gaṇāḥ ca eva trayastriṃśat ca devatāḥ manuṣyāḥ ṛṣayaḥ ca eva veda prāmāṇyataḥ kṛtāḥ

original: teṣāṃ dehe praviṣṭānāṃ prādurbhāvaḥ punarbhavet | yathā sūryasya satatamudayāstamanaṃ bhavet || 13 ||
analyzed: teṣām dehe praviṣṭānām prādurbhāvaḥ punar bhavet  yathā sūryasya satatam udaya astamanam bhavet

original: sasarja sarvabhūtāni kalpāṃte parvatātmaje | avyaktaḥ śāśvataścaiva tasya sarvamidaṃ jagat || 15 ||
analyzed: sasarja sarva bhūtāni kalpa aṃte parvatātmaje  avyaktaḥ śāśvataḥ ca eva tasya sarvam idam jagat

original: karttā caiva vikarttā ca saṃhartā ca mahāṃstu yaḥ | oṃkārapūrvakā vedā yajñāścoṃkārapūrvakāḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: karttā ca eva vikarttā ca saṃhartā ca mahān tu yaḥ oṃkāra pūrvakāḥ vedāḥ yajñāḥ ca oṃkāra pūrvakāḥ   /

original: oṃkārapūrvakaṃ jñānaṃ tapaścoṃkārapūrvakam | svayaṃbhūriti vijñeyaḥ sa brahmā bhuvanādhipaḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: oṃkāra pūrvakam jñānam tapaḥ ca oṃkāra pūrvakam svayaṃbhūḥ iti vijñeyaḥ sa brahmā bhuvana adhipaḥ

original: sa vāyuriti vijñeyaḥ sarvajñaḥ sa prajākaraḥ | viśve devāstathā sādhyā rudrādityāstathāśvinau || 18 ||
analyzed: sa vāyuḥ iti vijñeyaḥ sarva jñaḥ sa prajā karaḥ viśve devāḥ tathā sādhyāḥ rudra ādityāḥ tathā aśvinau

original: prajānāṃ patayaścaiva sapta caiva maharṣayaḥ | vasavo'psarasaścaiva gaṃdharvāścaiva rākṣasāḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: prajānām patayaḥ ca eva sapta ca eva mahā ṛṣayaḥ vasavaḥ apsarasaḥ ca eva gaṃdharvāḥ ca eva rākṣasāḥ

original: daityāḥ piśācā rakṣāṃsi bhūtāni vividhāni ca | brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyā vaiśyāḥ śūdrā mlecchādayo bhuvi | sarve catuṣpadāścaiva tiryagyonigatāstadā || 20 ||
analyzed: daityāḥ piśācāḥ rakṣāṃsi bhūtāni vividhāni ca  brāhmaṇāḥ kṣatriyāḥ vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ mleccha ādayaḥ bhuvi sarve catuṣpadāḥ ca eva tiryagyoni gatāḥ tadā  /

original: jaṃgamāni ca sattvāni yaccānyajjīvasaṃjñakam | kṛtvā sarvamaśeṣaṃ ca mamāṃtikamupāgataḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: jaṃgamāni ca sattvāni yat ca anyat jīva saṃjñakam  kṛtvā sarvam aśeṣam ca mama aṃtikam upāgataḥ  /

original: praṇamya prayato bhūtvā vacanaṃ cedamabravīt | kṛtā sṛṣṭirmayā deva tvatprasādānmaheśvara || 22 ||
analyzed: praṇamya prayataḥ bhūtvā vacanam ca idam abravīt kṛtā sṛṣṭiḥ mayā deva tvad prasādāt maheśvara

original: dehi me paramaṃ sthānaṃ yathā kīrttirdhruvā bhavet | oṃkārasya vacaḥ śrutvā mayā proktaṃ varānane || 23 ||
analyzed: dehi me paramam sthānam yathā kīrttiḥ dhruvā bhavet  oṃkārasya vacaḥ śrutvā mayā proktam varānane

original: mamābhīṣṭakaraṃ sthānaṃ nityamavyayamakṣayam | mahākālavanaṃ divyaṃ sarvasaṃpatkaraṃ śubham || 24 ||
analyzed: mama abhīṣṭa karam sthānam nityam avyayam akṣayam mahākāla vanam divyam sarva saṃpad karam śubham

original: tatra te bhavitā kīrttiḥ śāśvatī nātra saṃśayaḥ | śūleśvarasya devasya pūrvabhāge vyava sthitam || 25 ||
analyzed: tatra te bhavitā kīrttiḥ śāśvatī na atra saṃśayaḥ śūleśvarasya devasya pūrva bhāge vyava sthitam  /

original: trikalpaprabhavaṃ liṃgaṃ tvannāmnā khyātimeṣyati | oṃkāreśvara ityākhyā bhaviṣyati jagattraye || 26 ||
analyzed: tri kalpa prabhavam liṃgam tvad nāmnā khyātim eṣyati oṃkāra īśvaraḥ iti ākhyā bhaviṣyati jagattraye

original: ityukto hi mayā devi oṃkāro hṛṣṭamānasaḥ | dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ tasmiṃlliṃge layaṃ gataḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ hi mayā devi oṃkāraḥ hṛṣṭa mānasaḥ dadarśa tatra tat liṃgam tasmin liṃge layam gataḥ  /

original: tataḥ prabhṛti vedeṣu oṃkāraḥ kriyate dvijaiḥ | puṇyārthaṃ maṃgalārthaṃ ca prathamaṃ sarvavastuṣu || 28 ||
analyzed: tatas prabhṛti vedeṣu oṃkāraḥ kriyate dvijaiḥ puṇya artham maṃgala artham ca prathamam sarva vastubhiḥ

original: layaṃgato yadoṃkārastadāprabhṛti pārvati | mayocyamānaṃ liṃgasya prabhāvātiśayaṃ śṛṇu || 29 ||
analyzed: layaṃgataḥ yadā oṃkāraḥ tadā prabhṛti pārvati mayā ucyamānam liṃgasya prabhāva atiśayam śṛṇu  /
