original: yadyugādisahasreṣu vyatīpātaśateṣu ca | ayanānāṃ sahasreṣu yatpuṇyaṃ samudāhṛtam | tatpuṇyamadhikaṃ devi oṃkāreśvaradarśanāt || 30 ||
analyzed: yat yuga ādi sahasreṣu vyatīpāta śateṣu ca ayanānām sahasreṣu yat puṇyam samudāhṛtam tat puṇyam adhikam devi oṃkāra īśvara darśanāt  /

original: caturṣvapi ca vedeṣu samadhīteṣu yatphalam | tato'dhikaṃ phalaṃ proktamoṃkāreśvaradarśanāt || 31 ||
analyzed: caturṣu api ca vedeṣu samadhīteṣu yat phalam tatas adhikam phalam proktam oṃkāra īśvara darśanāt  /

original: brahmacaryeṇa yatpuṇyaṃ yāvajjīvaṃ kṛtena ca | tatpuṇyamadhikaṃ proktamoṃkāreśvaradarśanāt || 32 ||
analyzed: brahmacaryeṇa yat puṇyam yāvajjīvam kṛtena ca tat puṇyam adhikam proktam oṃkāra īśvara darśanāt

original: karīṣasādhane puṇyaṃ yacca puṇyamanāśake | tatpuṇyamadhikaṃ devi oṃkāreśvaradarśanāt || 33 ||
analyzed: karīṣa sādhane puṇyam yat ca puṇyam anāśake tat puṇyam adhikam devi oṃkāra īśvara darśanāt  /

original: pūjāyāṃ yatphalaṃ proktaṃ tasya saṃkhyā na vidyate || 34 ||
analyzed: pūjāyām yat phalam proktam tasya saṃkhyā na vidyate

original: kiṃ yajñairbahuvittāḍhyaiḥ kiṃ tapobhiḥ suduṣkaraiḥ | oṃkāradarśanādeva tatphalaṃ labhate yataḥ || 35 ||
analyzed: kim yajñaiḥ bahu vitta āḍhyaiḥ kim tapobhiḥ su duṣkaraiḥ oṃkāra darśanāt eva tat phalam labhate yatas

original: pūjanātsparśanādvāpi kīrttanācchravaṇāttathā | oṃkāreśvaradevasya narāḥ syurmuktibhājanāḥ || 36 ||
analyzed: pūjanāt sparśanāt vā api kīrttanāt śravaṇāt tathā oṃkāra īśvara devasya narāḥ syuḥ mukti bhājanāḥ  /

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | oṃkāreśvaradevasya śṛṇu viśveśvaraṃ param || 37 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ oṃkāra īśvara devasya śṛṇu viśveśvaram param

original: iti śrīskānde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmya oṃkāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvipaṃcāśattamo'dhyāyaḥ || 52 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skānde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvantya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye oṃkāreśvara māhātmya varṇanam nāma dvipaṃcāśattamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: īśvara uvāca | tripaṃcāśattamaṃ viddhi suprasiddhamatheśvaram | paraṃ viśveśvaraṃ khyātaṃ viśveṣu bhuvaneṣvapi || 1 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca tripaṃcāśattamam viddhi su prasiddham atha īśvaram  param viśveśvaram khyātam viśveṣu bhuvaneṣu api  /

original: babhūva nṛpatiḥ pūrvaṃ vidarbhāyāṃ vidūrathaḥ | sontaḥpurāyutopetaṃ cakre rājyamakaṃṭakam || 2 ||
analyzed: babhūva nṛpatiḥ pūrvam vidarbhāyām vidūrathaḥ saḥ ntaḥpura ayuta upetam cakre rājyam akaṃṭakam

original: jaghāna tāpasaṃ so'tha pramādānmṛgayā gataḥ | kṛṣṇājinadharaṃ śāṃtaṃ dhyāyaṃtaṃ brahma śāśva tam || 3 ||
analyzed: jaghāna tāpasam saḥ atha pramādāt mṛgayāḥ gataḥ kṛṣṇa ajina dharam śāṃtam dhyāyaṃtam brahma śāśva tam

original: mṛgaṃ matvā mahāraṇye brāhmaṇaṃ devamohitaḥ |  tena karmavipākena dehāṃte rauravaṃ gataḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: mṛgam matvā mahā araṇye brāhmaṇam deva mohitaḥ   tena karma vipākena dehānte rauravam gataḥ

original: tatrāsau yātanā ghorāṃ anubhūyātmakālataḥ | tasmādihāgato marttye sarpo viṣadharo'bhavat || 5 ||
analyzed: tatra asau yātanāḥ ghorām anubhūya ātma kālataḥ tasmāt iha āgataḥ marttye sarpaḥ viṣadharaḥ abhavat  /

original: adaśatso'pi kopena brāhmaṇaṃ caraṇe priye | lakuṭena hataḥ so'pi paṃcatvaṃ tatkṣaṇādgataḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: adaśat saḥ api kopena brāhmaṇam caraṇe priye lakuṭena hataḥ saḥ api paṃcatvam tad kṣaṇāt gataḥ

original: cyutastu narakātsiṃho dvitīye'bhūtsudāruṇaḥ | rājānaṃ bhakṣayāmāsa rājalokairnipātitaḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: cyutaḥ tu narakāt siṃhaḥ dvitīye abhūt su dāruṇaḥ rājānam bhakṣayāmāsa rāja lokaiḥ nipātitaḥ

original: punarvyāghro babhūvāsau tṛtīye'pi bhavāṃtare | tīkṣṇapādanakhairghorairghātayāmāsa sūkarān || 8 ||
analyzed: punar vyāghraḥ babhūva asau tṛtīye api bhavāṃtare tīkṣṇa pāda nakhaiḥ ghoraiḥ ghātayāmāsa sūkarān

original: tenāpi vaiśyo nidhanaṃ nītaḥ kaścidvanāṃtare | niṣādairnihataḥ so'pi bāṇaiḥ paṃcatvamāgataḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: tena api vaiśyaḥ nidhanam nītaḥ kaścid vana aṃtare niṣādaiḥ nihataḥ saḥ api bāṇaiḥ paṃcatvam āgataḥ  /

original: caturthe 'pi gajo jātaḥ siṃhādvadhamavāptavān | paṃcame makaro jātaḥ kṣārāṃbhasi mahodadhau || 10 ||
analyzed: caturthe api gajaḥ jātaḥ siṃhāt vadham avāptavān paṃcame makaraḥ jātaḥ kṣāra aṃbhasi mahā udadhau

original: snātukāmāmatho rāmāmājaghānātipāpakṛt | dhīvaraiḥ kṛtadhikkārairbaḍiśaiḥ sannipātitaḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: snātu kāmām atho rāmām ājaghāna ati pāpa kṛt dhīvaraiḥ kṛta dhikkāraiḥ baḍiśaiḥ sannipātitaḥ

original: punaḥ ṣaṣṭhe bhave jātaḥ piśācaḥ piśitāśanaḥ | siddhamaṃtrairathodagrairatharvaprabhavairbhṛśam || 12 ||
analyzed: punar ṣaṣṭhe bhave jātaḥ piśācaḥ piśita aśanaḥ siddha maṃtraiḥ atha udagraiḥ atharva prabhavaiḥ bhṛśam

original: maṃtrī maṃtravidāṃ śreṣṭho brāhmaṇastaṃ jaghāna ha | saptame sa punarjāto durnirīkṣyavapurbhṛśam || 13 ||
analyzed: maṃtrī maṃtra vidām śreṣṭhaḥ brāhmaṇaḥ tam jaghāna ha saptame sa punar jātaḥ durnirīkṣya vapuḥ bhṛśam

original: tīkṣṇadaṃṣṭraḥ karālāsyo māṃsaśoṇitabhojanaḥ | śuṣkāṃgo marubhūmīṣu pāpiṣṭho brahmarākṣasaḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: tīkṣṇa daṃṣṭraḥ karāla āsyaḥ māṃsa śoṇita bhojanaḥ śuṣka aṃgaḥ maru bhūmīṣu pāpiṣṭhaḥ brahmarākṣasaḥ   /

original: ākramya nimirājena rājñā rākṣasaśatruṇā | samāropya dhanuḥ saṃkhye brahmāstreṇa nipātitaḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: ākramya nimi rājena rājñā rākṣasa śatruṇā samāropya dhanuḥ saṃkhye brahmāstreṇa nipātitaḥ  /

original: dāruṇaḥ sārameyo'bhūdatikṛṣṇo'ṣṭame bhave | sa śūkarakhurāghātavraṇaiḥ paṃcatvamāgataḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: dāruṇaḥ sārameyaḥ abhūt ati kṛṣṇaḥ aṣṭame bhave sa śūkara khura āghāta vraṇaiḥ paṃcatvam āgataḥ  /

original: navame jaṃbuko jātaḥ śmaśāne sa ca māṃsabhuk | laulyātsa nidhanaṃ prāpto duḥkhārtto dāvavahninā || 17 ||
analyzed: navame jaṃbukaḥ jātaḥ śmaśāne sa ca māṃsa bhuj laulyāt sa nidhanam prāptaḥ duḥkha ārttaḥ dāva vahninā  /

original: daśame tvabhavadgṛdhrastīkṣṇatuṃḍo bhayāvahaḥ | pūtimāṃsavasāhāro rogeṇa nidhanaṃ gataḥ || 18 ||
analyzed: daśame tu abhavat gṛdhraḥ tīkṣṇa tuṃḍaḥ bhaya āvahaḥ pūti māṃsa vasā āhāraḥ rogeṇa nidhanam gataḥ   /

original: ekādaśe 'pi caṃḍālo gato'vaṃtyāṃ varānane | dravyasya haraṇārthaṃ vai praviṣṭo dvijaveśmani || 19 ||
analyzed: ekādaśe api caṃḍālaḥ gataḥ avaṃtyām varānane  dravyasya haraṇa artham vai praviṣṭaḥ dvija veśmani

original: sa daṃḍapāśikenaiva prāpto baddhaśca tatkṣaṇāt | ānīto hi vadhārthāya vṛkṣāgre hyavalaṃvitaḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: sa daṃḍa pāśikena eva prāptaḥ baddhaḥ ca tad kṣaṇāt ānītaḥ hi vadha arthāya vṛkṣa agre hi avalaṃvitaḥ

original: tatraiva liṃgamāsannaṃ sādhvi śūleśvarottare | tasya dṛṣṭipathaṃ prāptamativiklavacetasaḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: tatra eva liṃgam āsannam sādhvi śūleśvara uttare tasya dṛṣṭi patham prāptam ati viklava cetasaḥ

original: kṣaṇena nidhanaṃ prāptaḥ sa gatastridaśālayam | tatra bhuktvā varānbhogānavatīrya ca bhūtale || 22 ||
analyzed: kṣaṇena nidhanam prāptaḥ sa gataḥ tridaśālayam  tatra bhuktvā varān bhogān avatīrya ca bhū tale

original: jātaḥ khyāto vidarbhāyāṃ viśveśonāma pārthivaḥ | jāti smaratvamāpanno liṃgadarśanapuṇyataḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: jātaḥ khyātaḥ vidarbhāyām viśveśaḥ nāma pārthivaḥ jāti smara tvam āpannaḥ liṃga darśana puṇyataḥ

original: durlabhānbubhuje bhogānprāptaṃ rājyaṃ cakāra saḥ | so'bhiṣicya sutaṃ rājye vinītamatidharmavit | saṃsmaranpūrvavṛttāṃtaṃ jagāmāvaṃtikāṃ purīm || 24 ||
analyzed: durlabhān bubhuje bhogān prāptam rājyam cakāra saḥ  saḥ abhiṣicya sutam rājye vinīta mati dharma vid  saṃsmaran pūrva vṛttāṃtam jagāma avaṃtikām purīm  /

original: tatra dṛṣṭvā mahalliṃgaṃ durdarśamatitejasā | divyena cakṣuṣā'paśyalliṃgamadhye carācaram || 25 ||
analyzed: tatra dṛṣṭvā mahat liṃgam durdarśam ati tejasā  divyena cakṣuṣā apaśyat liṃga madhye carācaram  /

original: liṃgamadhye sthitāḥ sarve sāgarāḥ saritastathā | dvīpāśca parvatāścaiva tathānyā divyabhūtayaḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: liṃga madhye sthitāḥ sarve sāgarāḥ saritaḥ tathā dvīpāḥ ca parvatāḥ ca eva tathā anyāḥ divya bhūtayaḥ

original: caṃdramāḥ saha nakṣatrairādityaścāgninā saha | dhanado varuṇaścaiva yamaḥ śakro marutpatiḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: caṃdramāḥ saha nakṣatraiḥ ādityaḥ ca agninā saha  dhanadaḥ varuṇaḥ ca eva yamaḥ śakraḥ marutpatiḥ  /

original: maruto devagaṃdharvā ṛṣayaśca tapodhanāḥ | nāgā yakṣāḥ piśācāśca rākṣasā bhīmavikramāḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: marutaḥ deva gaṃdharvāḥ ṛṣayaḥ ca tapodhanāḥ nāgāḥ yakṣāḥ piśācāḥ ca rākṣasāḥ bhīma vikramāḥ

original: brahmādyā devatāścānyāḥ skaṃdo laṃbodarastathā | sarvaṃ tribhuvanaṃ devi liṃgamadhye vilokitam || 29 ||
analyzed: brahma ādyāḥ devatāḥ ca anyāḥ skaṃdaḥ laṃbodaraḥ tathā sarvam tribhuvanam devi liṃga madhye vilokitam  /

original: prabhāvaṃ tasya liṃgasya jñātvā samyaṅmahīpatiḥ | saṃyataḥ pūjayāmāsa viśvayoniṃ maheśvaram || 30 ||
analyzed: prabhāvam tasya liṃgasya jñātvā samyak mahīpatiḥ saṃyataḥ pūjayāmāsa viśvayonim maheśvaram

original: prasannaścābhavattasya vacanaṃ cedamabravīt | varaṃ varaya bhadraṃ te kimabhīṣṭaṃ dadāmi te || 31 ||
analyzed: prasannaḥ ca abhavat tasya vacanam ca idam abravīt varam varaya bhadram te kim abhīṣṭam dadāmi te  /

original: tenoktaṃ vacanaṃ rājñā yadi tuṣṭosi me prabho | ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti manujāḥ śraddhayā'śraddhayā'thavā || 32 ||
analyzed: tena uktam vacanam rājñā yadi tuṣṭaḥ asi me prabho ye tvām paśyaṃti manujāḥ śraddhayā aśraddhayā athavā

original: mā bhūtteṣāṃ prapatanaṃ ghore saṃsārasāgare | viśveśvareti nāmnā vai prasiddho bhava bhūtale || 33 ||
analyzed: mā bhūt teṣām prapatanam ghore saṃsāra sāgare viśveśvara iti nāmnā vai prasiddhaḥ bhava bhū tale

original: ityukte vacane bhūyo viśveśo'laṃkṛto gaṇaiḥ |  vimānena sudīptena gato lokaṃ madīyakam || 34 ||
analyzed: iti ukte vacane bhūyas viśveśaḥ alaṃkṛtaḥ gaṇaiḥ   vimānena su dīptena gataḥ lokam madīyakam

original: gaṇairnānāvidhaiḥ sārddhaṃ stūyamāno varānane | kirīṭī kuṇḍalī caiva muktāhāravibhūṣitaḥ | vimānaṃ tasya taddivyaṃ parikramya samaṃtataḥ || 35 ||
analyzed: gaṇaiḥ nānāvidhaiḥ sārddham stūyamānaḥ varānane  kirīṭī kuṇḍalī ca eva muktā hāra vibhūṣitaḥ vimānam tasya tat divyam parikramya samaṃtataḥ

original: samaheṃdradhanādhyakṣanānānākanivāsinaḥ | munayaḥ siddhagaṃdharvāstathā cāpsarasāṃ gaṇāḥ || 36 ||
analyzed: sa maheṃdra dhanādhyakṣa nānā nāka nivāsinaḥ munayaḥ siddha gaṃdharvāḥ tathā ca apsarasām gaṇāḥ

original: nṛtyenāmaranārīṇāṃ vilokitavinodakaḥ | yugakoṭisahasraṃ tu matsamīpe vyavasthitaḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: nṛtyena amara nārīṇām vilokita vinodakaḥ yuga koṭi sahasram tu mad samīpe vyavasthitaḥ  /

original: ato devi bhuvi khyāto devo viśveśvareśvaraḥ | dṛṣṭvā liṃgaṃ ca viśveśaṃ pātakairvipramucyate || 38 ||
analyzed: atas devi bhuvi khyātaḥ devaḥ viśveśvara īśvaraḥ  dṛṣṭvā liṃgam ca viśveśam pātakaiḥ vipramucyate

original: saptajanmakṛtairdehī manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ | dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaraṃ liṃgaṃ kṛtakṛtyatvamāpyate || 39 ||
analyzed: sapta janma kṛtaiḥ dehī manaḥ vāc kāya karmabhiḥ  dṛṣṭvā viśveśvaram liṃgam kṛtakṛtya tvam āpyate  /

original: tasya naśyati daurbhāgyamalakṣmīrnāśameti ca | prāpnoti dehī kāmāṃśca samṛddhiṃ mānasīṃ sadā || 40 ||

original: taddhuṃkārāttu pātālaṃ bhittvā paṃca ca kanyakāḥ | niryayuḥ kāṃcanaṃ pīṭhamekā tāsāṃ pragṛhya vai || 15 ||

analyzed: tam uvāca tatas śakraḥ punar eva mahā yaśāḥ brāhmaṇyam durlabham vīra mā kṛthāḥ sāhasam vṛthā

analyzed: na hi śakyam prāptum evam acirāt nāśam eṣyasi vṛṇu vā kāmam anyam tvam brāhmaṇa tvam su durlabham

original: evamukto mataṃgastu saṃśitātmā dṛḍhavrataḥ | sahasramekaṃ pādena tato'bdānāmavarttata || 20 ||
analyzed: evam uktaḥ mataṃgaḥ tu saṃśita ātmā dṛḍha vrataḥ sahasram ekam pādena tatas abdānām avarttata  /

original: tadeva ca punarvākyamuvāca balavṛtrahā | caṃḍālāyaunau jātena nāvāpyaṃ te kathaṃcana || 21 ||
analyzed: tat eva ca punar vākyam uvāca bala vṛtra hā caṃḍāla ayaunau jātena na avāpyam te kathaṃcana  /

original: anyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ mā kṛthāstatsvayaṃ śramam | evamukto mataṃgastu bhṛśaṃ śokaparāyaṇaḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: anyam varam vṛṇīṣva tvam mā kṛthāḥ tat svayam śramam evam uktaḥ mataṃgaḥ tu bhṛśam śoka parāyaṇaḥ

original: atiṣṭhata gayāṃ gatvā soṃguṣṭhena śataṃ samāḥ | suduṣkaraṃ vahanyogaṃ prāṇāyāmaparāyaṇaḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: atiṣṭhata gayām gatvā sa uṃguṣṭhena śatam samāḥ su duṣkaram vahan yogam prāṇāyāma parāyaṇaḥ   /

original: tvagasthibhūto dharmātmā tatāpa paramaṃ tapaḥ | tapaṃtaṃ tamabhidrutya parijagrāha vāsavaḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: tvac asthi bhūtaḥ dharma ātmā tatāpa paramam tapaḥ tapaṃtam tam abhidrutya parijagrāha vāsavaḥ

original: varāṇāmīśvaro dātā sarvabhūtahite rataḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: varāṇām īśvaraḥ dātā sarva bhūta hite rataḥ

original: śakra uvāca | mataṃga brāhmaṇatvaṃ hi viruddhamiha dṛśyate | brāhmaṇyaṃ durllabhaṃ tāta hyasatāṃ pāpaśīlinām || 26 ||
analyzed: śakraḥ uvāca mataṃga brāhmaṇa tvam hi viruddham iha dṛśyate  brāhmaṇyam durllabham tāta hi asatām pāpa śīlinām

original: brāhmaṇe sarvabhūtānāṃ yogakṣemaḥ samāhitaḥ | tadutsṛjyeha duṣprāpyaṃ brāhmaṇyamakṛtātmabhiḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: brāhmaṇe sarva bhūtānām yogakṣemaḥ samāhitaḥ tat utsṛjya iha duṣprāpyam brāhmaṇyam akṛtātmabhiḥ

original: anyaṃ varaṃ vṛṇīṣva tvaṃ durlabho'yaṃ hi te varaḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: anyam varam vṛṇīṣva tvam durlabhaḥ ayam hi te varaḥ

original: mataṃga uvāca | kiṃ māṃ tudasi duḥkhārtaṃ mṛtaṃ mārayase ca mām | taṃ tu śocāmi yo labdhvā brāhmaṇyaṃ nānupālayet || 29 ||
analyzed: mataṃgaḥ uvāca kim mām tudasi duḥkha ārtam mṛtam mārayase ca mām  tam tu śocāmi yaḥ labdhvā brāhmaṇyam na anupālayet  /

original: brāhmaṇyaṃ yadi duṣprāpyaṃ tribhirvarṇaiḥ śatakrato | tapasā ca kathaṃ labdhaṃ viśvāmitreṇa bhūbhujā || 30 ||
analyzed: brāhmaṇyam yadi duṣprāpyam tribhiḥ varṇaiḥ śatakrato  tapasā ca katham labdham viśvāmitreṇa bhūbhujā

original: vītahavyaśca rājarṣistapasā vipratāṃ gataḥ | tasmāttapaḥ kariṣyāmi nirdvaṃdvo niṣparigrahaḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: vītahavyaḥ ca rājarṣiḥ tapasā vipra tām gataḥ tasmāt tapaḥ kariṣyāmi nirdvaṃdvaḥ niṣparigrahaḥ

original: ahiṃsādamasatyasthaḥ kathaṃ nārhāmi vipratām | daivena kṛtametaddhi yadyahaṃ mātṛdoṣataḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: ahiṃsā dama satya sthaḥ katham na arhāmi vipra tām daivena kṛtam etat hi yadi aham mātṛ doṣataḥ

original: etāmavasthāṃ saṃprāpto daivayogātpuraṃdara | nūnaṃ daivaṃ na śakyaṃ tu pauruṣeṇa nivarttitum || 33 ||
analyzed: etām avasthām saṃprāptaḥ daiva yogāt puraṃdara nūnam daivam na śakyam tu pauruṣeṇa nivarttitum  /

original: yadahaṃ yatnavānevaṃ na labhe vipratāṃ vibho | evaṃ jñātvā tu deveśa dātumarhasi me param || 34 ||
analyzed: yat aham yatnavān evam na labhe vipra tām vibho evam jñātvā tu deveśa dātum arhasi me param

original: yadi te'hamanugrāhyaḥ kiṃcidvā sukṛtaṃ mama | tadupāyaṃ hi me śaṃsa kathaṃ vipro bhavāmi vai || 35 ||
analyzed: yadi te aham anugrāhyaḥ kiṃcid vā sukṛtam mama  tad upāyam hi me śaṃsa katham vipraḥ bhavāmi vai  /

original: yathā mamākṣayā kīttirbhavedvāpi puraṃdara | kartumarhasi taddeva śirasā tvāṃ prasādaye || 36 ||
analyzed: yathā mama akṣayā kīttiḥ bhavet vā api puraṃdara kartum arhasi tat deva śirasā tvām prasādaye  /

original: ityukto hi mataṃgena vāsavo balavṛtrahā | kathayāmāsa saṃtuṣṭo liṃgamāhātmyamuttamam || 37 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ hi mataṃgena vāsavaḥ bala vṛtra hā kathayāmāsa saṃtuṣṭaḥ liṃga māhātmyam uttamam

original: indra uvāca | mahākālavane liṃgaṃ sthāpitaṃ brahmaṇā purā | divyamūrttidharaṃ divyaṃ śrīsiddheśvarapūrvataḥ || 38 ||
analyzed: indraḥ uvāca mahākāla vane liṃgam sthāpitam brahmaṇā purā divya mūrtti dharam divyam śrī siddheśvara pūrvatas

original: tasya darśanamātreṇa vipratvaṃ samavāpsyasi | vāsavasya ca vākyena mataṃgo gatavāṃstadā || 39 ||
analyzed: tasya darśana mātreṇa vipra tvam samavāpsyasi vāsavasya ca vākyena mataṃgaḥ gatavān tadā

original: mahākālavanaṃ ramyaṃ siddhakṣetramathāparam | dadarśa tatra talliṃgamaśeṣaphaladāyakam || 40 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vanam ramyam siddha kṣetram atha aparam dadarśa tatra tat liṃgam aśeṣa phala dāyakam

original: dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjayāmāsa puṣpairnānāvidhaistathā | pūjitaḥ pratyuvācedaṃ mataṃgaṃ devasattamaḥ || 41 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā saṃpūjayāmāsa puṣpaiḥ nānāvidhaiḥ tathā pūjitaḥ pratyuvāca idam mataṃgam deva sattamaḥ

original: aho mahānsabhāgyosi yastvayā toṣito'smyaham | mattaḥ sarvaṃ samudbhūtaṃ brahmāṃḍaṃ bhūrbhuvādikam || 42 ||
analyzed: aho mahān sabhāgyaḥ asi yaḥ tvayā toṣitaḥ asmi aham mattaḥ sarvam samudbhūtam brahmāṃḍam bhūrbhuva ādikam   /

original: varado'smi varārhāṇāṃ śāpado'smi durātmanāma | brāhmaṇyaṃ matprasādācca akṣayaṃ te bhaviṣyati || 43 ||
analyzed: vara daḥ asmi vara arhāṇām śāpa daḥ asmi durātma nāma brāhmaṇyam mad prasādāt ca akṣayam te bhaviṣyati  /

original: tato'sau vipratāṃ yāto mataṃgo liṃgadarśanāta | punaḥ pūjāprabhāveṇa brahmalokaṃ gato dvija || 44 ||
analyzed: tatas asau vipra tām yātaḥ mataṃgaḥ liṃga darśanāt punar pūjā prabhāveṇa brahma lokam gataḥ dvija

original: brāhmaṇyaṃ durlabhaṃ labdhaṃ liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ | mataṃgena varārohe tasmāddevo vigīyate || 45 ||
analyzed: brāhmaṇyam durlabham labdham liṃgasya asya prabhāvataḥ mataṃgena varārohe tasmāt devaḥ vigīyate

original: mataṃgeśvarako loke brahmalokapradāyakaḥ | varṇāśrameṣu vidviṣṭāḥ pāṣaṃḍavacane ratāḥ || 46 ||
nirmaryādā nirācārā niḥśaṃkāścātilolupāḥ | nirghṛṇāḥ krūrarmāṇo dhṛṣṭāḥ kaliyuge narāḥ | darśanāttasya liṃgasya te'pi yāṃti triviṣṭapam || 47 ||
analyzed: nirmaryādāḥ nirācārāḥ niḥśaṃkāḥ ca ati lolupāḥ nirghṛṇāḥ krūra rmāṇaḥ dhṛṣṭāḥ kali yuge narāḥ darśanāt tasya liṃgasya te api yāṃti triviṣṭapam

original: ye viśuddhā mahābhāgā dhyānino muktibhāginaḥ | te paśyaṃti kalau devi mataṃgeśvaramīśvaram || 48 ||
analyzed: ye viśuddhāḥ mahābhāgāḥ dhyāninaḥ mukti bhāginaḥ te paśyaṃti kalau devi mataṃgeśvaram īśvaram

original: brahmadhyānaparā ye ca yajñadānakriyāratāḥ | te paśyaṃti kalau devi mataṃgeśvaramīśvaram || 49 ||
analyzed: brahma dhyāna parāḥ ye ca yajña dāna kriyā ratāḥ te paśyaṃti kalau devi mataṃgeśvaram īśvaram

original: ye'rcayaṃti mahā devi mataṃgeśvaramīśvarama | kṛtapuṇyā narā marttye teṣāṃ vāso'kṣayo divi || 50 ||
analyzed: ye arcayaṃti mahā devi mataṃgeśvaram īśvaram  kṛta puṇyāḥ narāḥ marttye teṣām vāsaḥ akṣayaḥ divi  /

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | mataṃgeśvaradevasya śṛṇu saubhāgyamīśvaram || 51 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ mataṃga īśvara devasya śṛṇu saubhāgyam īśvaram

original: īśvara uvāca | ekaṣaṣṭitamaṃ viddhi saubhāgyeśvaramīśvaram | yasya darśanamātreṇa saubhāgya matulaṃ labhet || 1 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca ekaṣaṣṭitamam viddhi saubhāgyeśvaram īśvaram  yasya darśana mātreṇa saubhāgya matulam labhet

original: pradhamaṃ prākṛte kalpe rājābhūdaśvavāhanaḥ | prāgjyotiṣapure ramye dharmātmā kīrttivarddhanaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: prākṛte kalpe rājā abhūt aśvavāhanaḥ prāgjyotiṣa pure ramye dharma ātmā kīrtti varddhanaḥ  /

original: anekayajñakṛtprājñaḥ saṃgrāmeṣvapa rājitaḥ | tasya bhāryā viśālākṣi nāmnā madanamañjarī || 3 ||
analyzed: aneka yajña kṛt prājñaḥ saṃgrāmeṣu apa rājitaḥ tasya bhāryā viśāla akṣi nāmnā madanamañjarī  /

original: kāśirājasutā subhrū rūpeṇātīva śobhanā | dakṣā suśīlā dharmiṣṭhā gṛhavyāpārako vidā || 4 ||
analyzed: kāśi rāja sutā subhrū rūpeṇa atīva śobhanā dakṣā su śīlā dharmiṣṭhā gṛha vyāpārakaḥ

original: catuḥṣaṣṭikalāyuktā sadā bhartṛhite ratā | pūrṇenduvadanā saumyā sadā madhurabhāṣiṇī || 5 ||
analyzed: catuḥṣaṣṭi kalā yuktā sadā bhartṛ hite ratā pūrṇa indu vadanā saumyā sadā madhura bhāṣiṇī

original: pūrvakarmavaśāddevi durbhūgā samajāyata | sā neṣṭā tasya nṛpaternetrodvegakarī sadā || 6 ||
analyzed: pūrva karma vaśāt devi durbhūgā samajāyata sā na iṣṭā tasya nṛpateḥ netra udvega karī sadā

original: śrotrodvegakaraṃ vākyaṃ tasya rājñaḥ karoti sā | dadāha locane rājastasyāḥ saṃdarśanaṃ sadā || 7 ||
analyzed: śrotra udvega karam vākyam tasya rājñaḥ karoti sā  dadāha locane rājaḥ tasyāḥ saṃdarśanam sadā

original: mṛrchāṃ prāpnotyasahyāṃ sa tasyāḥ sparśena bhūpatiḥ | kadā cālokito rājā tayā premṇā varānane | dahyamāno'titīvreṇa vahninā vākyamabravīt || 8 ||
analyzed: mṛrchām prāpnoti asahyām sa tasyāḥ sparśena bhūpatiḥ kadā ca ālokitaḥ rājā tayā premṇā varānane  dahyamānaḥ ati tīvreṇa vahninā vākyam abravīt

analyzed: na vihāre na ca āhāre ramaṇīye na tad vane na kandareṣu śailānām sā babandha tadā ratim tyaktā tena varārohe nininda nija yauvanam   /

original: durbhagāhaṃ kva jātātra duṣṭadaivavaśīkṛtā | kathaṃ prāptaḥ sa me bharttā tādṛśo nṛpasa ttamaḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: durbhagā aham kva jātā atra duṣṭa daiva vaśīkṛtā katham prāptaḥ sa me bharttā tādṛśaḥ nṛpa sa ttamaḥ

original: dhanyo'yamatipuṇyo'yaṃ yo'yaṃ yauvanagocaraḥ | anyāsāmasatīnāṃ ca ramiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: dhanyaḥ ayam ati puṇyaḥ ayam yaḥ ayam yauvana gocaraḥ anyāsām asatīnām ca ramiṣyati na saṃśayaḥ

original: abhīṣṭā kasyacitkāṃtā kāṃtaḥ kasyāścidīpsitaḥ | parasparānurāgāḍhayaṃ dāṃpatyamatidurlabham || 17 ||
analyzed: abhīṣṭā kasyacid kāṃtā kāṃtaḥ kasyāścid īpsitaḥ paraspara anurāga āḍhayam dāṃpatyam ati durlabham

original: mamāyaṃ vallabho rājā na cāhaṃ nṛpavallabhā | parasparānurāgo hi dhanyānāmeva jāyate || 18 ||
analyzed: mama ayam vallabhaḥ rājā na ca aham nṛpa vallabhā paraspara anurāgaḥ hi dhanyānām eva jāyate  /

original: yadyadya sa mahīpālo na mayā saṃgameṣyati | tatkāmāgniravaśyaṃ māṃ kṣapayiṣyati duḥsahaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: yadi adya sa mahīpālaḥ na mayā saṃgameṣyati tad kāma agniḥ avaśyam mām kṣapayiṣyati duḥsahaḥ  /

original: ramaṇīyamabhūdyattu puṃskokilanināditam | hīnaṃ hi vallabhenaivaṃ dahatīvādya me vanam || 20 ||
analyzed: ramaṇīyam abhūt yat tu puṃskokila nināditam hīnam hi vallabhena evam dahati iva adya me vanam

analyzed: ittham sā madana āviṣṭā vilapantī punar punar dadarśa tāpasam tatra tri kāla jñam dṛḍha vratam  /

original: mekhalājinakaupīnadaṇḍakāṣṭhopajīvanam | mahaujasaṃ mahābhāgaṃ mumukṣuṃ munipuṃgavam || 22 ||
analyzed: mekhalā ajina kaupīna daṇḍa kāṣṭha upajīvanam mahā ojasam mahābhāgam mumukṣum muni puṃgavam

original: udayādityasaṃkāśaṃ vibhāvasusamadyutim | taṃ dṛṣṭvā sahasotthāya sā rājñī durmatā satī || 23 ||

analyzed: vinayena upasaṃyamya praṇipatya abhivādya ca viyoga kāraṇam rājñaḥ papraccha praṇatā satī  /

original: bhagavankāśirājasya sutāhamativallabhā | bhaginī śatrusenasya mātuścātīva vallabhā || 25 ||
analyzed: bhagavan kāśi rājasya sutā aham ati vallabhā bhaginī śatrusenasya mātuḥ ca atīva vallabhā

original: aśvavāhanasaṃjñena nṛpeṇoḍhā mahāmune | dharmato dharmakalpena prajapatisamena tu || 26 ||

original: sā kimarthaṃ na cābhīṣṭā jātā'haṃ tasya bhūpateḥ | sa cātīva mamābhīṣṭo nṛpatiḥ sarvadā vibho || 27 ||

original: durbhagāhaṃ kathaṃ jātā karmaṇā kena tāpasa | kathaṃ bhavati vaśyo me bharttā nṛpatisattamaḥ | saubhāgyaṃ ca kathaṃ me syāditi satyaṃ ca kathyatām || 28 ||
analyzed: durbhagā aham katham jātā karmaṇā kena tāpasa  katham bhavati vaśyaḥ me bharttā nṛpati sattamaḥ saubhāgyam ca katham me syāt iti satyam ca kathyatām  /

original: tasyāstadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa muniḥ saṃśitavrataḥ | jñānena kathayāmāsa tasyā daurbhāgyakāraṇam || 29 ||
analyzed: tasyāḥ tat vacanam śrutvā sa muniḥ saṃśita vrataḥ jñānena kathayāmāsa tasyāḥ daurbhāgya kāraṇam  /

original: pāṇigrahaṇakāle tvaṃ grahaiḥ pāpairvilokitā | bhartā te nṛpatiḥ putri grahaiḥ saumyairvilokitaḥ || 30 ||

original: tena te vallabho rājā na tvaṃ bhūpasya vallabhā | iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sā rājñī dīnamānasā | papraccha vinayopetā bhaktinamrātmakandharā || 31 ||
analyzed: tena te vallabhaḥ rājā na tvam bhūpasya vallabhā iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā sā rājñī dīna mānasā papraccha vinaya upetā bhakti namra ātma kandharā

original: bhagavankena dānena snānena niyamena ca | karmaṇā kena saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ hi kathaṃ bhavet || 32 ||

original: mahākālavane putri ligaṃ saubhāgyadāyakam | mataṃgeśvarapārśve tu vidyate'bhīṣṭadāyakam | tasya darśanamātreṇa saubhāgyaṃ samavāpsyasi || 34 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vane putri ligam saubhāgya dāyakam mataṃga īśvara pārśve tu vidyate abhīṣṭa dāyakam tasya darśana mātreṇa saubhāgyam samavāpsyasi  /

original: iṃdrāṇyārādhitaṃ liṃgaṃ purā saubhāgyakāraṇāt | saubhāgyaṃ paramaṃ labdhaṃ naṣṭaḥ śakro'pi labdhavān | tasmādgaccha mamādeśānmahākālavanaṃ śubham || 35 ||

analyzed: mahākālavanam rājan gatā saubhāgya kāmyayā bhāryā rakṣyā mahīpālaḥ iti sā śrutiḥ uttamā  /

original: bhāryāyāṃ rakṣyamāṇāyāṃ prajā bhavati rakṣitā | ātmā hi jāyate tasyāṃ sā rakṣyāto nareśvara || 43 ||
analyzed: bhāryāyām rakṣyamāṇāyām prajā bhavati rakṣitā ātmā hi jāyate tasyām sā rakṣyā atas nareśvara

original: jāyate bhūpatirloke sārvabhaumo varānane | nāputrā nādhanā nārī na dīnā na ca duḥkhitā | jāyate durbhagā naiva saubhāgyeśvaradarśanāt || 57 ||

original: na vaidhavyaṃ na ca vyādhirnākālamaraṇaṃ śriye | na putrabhartṛjaṃ duḥkhaṃ jāyate liṃgadarśanāt || 58 ||

analyzed: yathā lakṣmīḥ hareḥ nityam sāvitrī brahmaṇaḥ smṛtā  rohiṇī vallabhā ca iṃdoḥ śacī śakrasya vallabhā  tathā sā jāyate nārī saubhāgya īśvara darśanāt

original: īśvara uvāca | dviṣaṣṭikaṃ vijānīhi devaṃ rūpeśvaraṃ priye | yasya darśanamātreṇa rūpavāñjāyate naraḥ || 1 ||

original: pādmakalpe mahādevi padmonāma mahīpatiḥ | padmagarbhasamudbhūto babhūvātiparākramī | pṛthivyāścaturaṃtāyā jāto dharmarato balī || 2 ||
analyzed: pādma kalpe mahādevi padmaḥ nāma mahīpatiḥ padma garbha samudbhūtaḥ babhūva ati parākramī pṛthivyāḥ catur aṃtāyāḥ jātaḥ dharma rataḥ balī   /

original: sa kadācinmahābāhuḥ prabhūtabalavāhanaḥ | vanaṃ jagāma gahanaṃ hayanāgaśatairvṛtaḥ || 3 ||

original: tatra vanyasahasrāṇi hatvā sabalavāhanaḥ | rājā mṛgaprasaṃgena vanamanyadviveśa saḥ || 9 ||

original: kva gato bhagavānbhadre tanmamācakṣva śobhane | evamuktā tu sā kanyā tena rājñā tadāśrame | hasaṃtī pratyuvācedaṃ vākyaṃ samadhurākṣaram || 14 ||

original: rājovāca | icchāmi tvāṃ varārohe bhajamānamaniṃdite | tadarthaṃ māṃ sthitaṃ viddhi tvayā me'pahṛtaṃ manaḥ || 21 ||

analyzed: svayam svayaṃvaraḥ mohāt tasmāt kṛṣṇā bhaviṣyasi kutsitā nirghṛṇā dīnā nirlajjā rūpa varjitā

original: ityuktā tatkṣaṇājjātā sā kanyā rūpavarjitā | kurūpo nṛpatirjātaḥ śāpāttasya mahātmanaḥ || 30 ||
analyzed: iti uktā tad kṣaṇāt jātā sā kanyā rūpa varjitā kurūpaḥ nṛpatiḥ jātaḥ śāpāt tasya mahātmanaḥ

original: atha prasādayāmāsa sā kanyā pitaraṃ tadā | bālānabhijñā mūḍhāhaṃ manmathena prapīḍitā || 31 ||

original: tīrthānāṃ ca yathā gaṃgā rakṣitā yodhasattamaiḥ | tathāyaṃ rakṣako devo nāmnā dhanuḥsahasrakaḥ || 49 ||
analyzed: tīrthānām ca yathā gaṃgā rakṣitā yodha sattamaiḥ tathā ayam rakṣakaḥ devaḥ nāmnā dhanuḥsahasrakaḥ

original: tatra gaṃgāditīrthāni vidyante vividhāni ca | surahasyātipuṇyāni sadyaḥ pāpaharāṇi ca || 50 ||

original: teṣāṃ phalaṃ vinirdiṣṭaṃ ye paśyanti tu bhaktitaḥ | dhanuḥsāhasrakaṃ nāma sadā śatrukṣayaṃkaram || 51 ||
analyzed: teṣām phalam vinirdiṣṭam ye paśyanti tu bhaktitaḥ dhanuḥ sāhasrakam nāma sadā śatru kṣayaṃkaram

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanā śanaḥ | dhanuḥsāhasradevasya devaṃ paśupatiṃ śṛṇu || 52 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanā śanaḥ dhanuḥ sāhasra devasya devam paśupatim śṛṇu

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśīti liṅgamāhātmye dhanuḥsāhasramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma triṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 63 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye dhanuḥsāhasramāhātmyavarṇanam nāma triṣaṣṭitamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: īśvara uvāca | śṛṇu tvaṃ paśupatyākhyaṃ catuḥṣaṣṭikamīśvaram | yasya darśanamātreṇa paśuyonirna labhyate || 1 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca śṛṇu tvam paśupati ākhyam catuḥṣaṣṭikam īśvaram yasya darśana mātreṇa paśu yoniḥ na labhyate  /

original: paśupālo mahādevi babhūva bhuvi viśrutaḥ | rājā parama dharmiṣṭhaḥ paśūnāṃ pālane rataḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: paśupālaḥ mahādevi babhūva bhuvi viśrutaḥ rājā parama dharmiṣṭhaḥ paśūnām pālane rataḥ  /

original: didṛkṣuḥ sa kadācicca gatastoyanidhiṃ prati | dadarśa tatra puruṣānpaṃca prādhānyataḥ sthitān | ekā strī muktakeśā sā bhramantī ca punaḥpunaḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: didṛkṣuḥ sa kadācid ca gataḥ toyanidhim prati  dadarśa tatra puruṣān paṃca prādhānyataḥ sthitān ekā strī mukta keśā sā bhramantī ca punar punar  /

original: atha rājā bhayāviṣṭo visaṃjñaḥ samapadyata | saṃveṣṭito dasyubhistaistayā nāryā viśeṣataḥ || 4 ||
analyzed: atha rājā bhaya āviṣṭaḥ visaṃjñaḥ samapadyata saṃveṣṭitaḥ dasyubhiḥ taiḥ tayā nāryā viśeṣataḥ

original: tatonye samapātaṃ ca āgatya nṛpasattamam | saṃveṣṭya saṃsthitaiḥ sarvaistato ruddho mahīpatiḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: tatas anye samapātam ca āgatya nṛpa sattamam saṃveṣṭya saṃsthitaiḥ sarvaiḥ tatas ruddhaḥ mahīpatiḥ  /

original: ruddhe rājani te sarve ekībhūtāstu dasyavaḥ | ghātitāḥ paśupālena na mṛtāḥ punarutthitāḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: ruddhe rājani te sarve ekībhūtāḥ tu dasyavaḥ ghātitāḥ paśupālena na mṛtāḥ punar utthitāḥ

original: tasya tāṃ dhṛṣṭatāṃ jñātvā sthairyaṃ ca nṛpatermṛdhe | tasyaiva nṛpaterdehe līnāste daśa dasyavaḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: tasya tām dhṛṣṭa tām jñātvā sthairyam ca nṛpateḥ mṛdhe tasya eva nṛpateḥ dehe līnāḥ te daśa dasyavaḥ  /

original: amūrtā iva te sarve ekībhūtāstato'bhavan | tāndṛṣṭvā duḥkhito rājā paśupālo'bhavatkṣaṇāt || 8 ||
analyzed: amūrtāḥ iva te sarve ekībhūtāḥ tatas abhavan tān dṛṣṭvā duḥkhitaḥ rājā paśupālaḥ abhavat kṣaṇāt

original: athāpaśyattadā'yāṃtaṃ nāradaṃ munipuṃgavam | brahmaputraṃ tapoyuktaṃ papraccha sa nṛpastadā || 9 ||
analyzed: athā apaśyat tadā ayāntam nāradam muni puṃgavam  brahma putram tapaḥ yuktam papraccha sa nṛpaḥ tadā

original: paśu pāla uvāca | bhagavanbrahmaputrādya mayā dṛṣṭaṃ tu kautukam | akasmātpuruṣāḥ paṃca samāyātā bhayāvahāḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: paśu pālaḥ uvāca bhagavan brahma putra adya mayā dṛṣṭam tu kautukam akasmāt puruṣāḥ paṃca samāyātāḥ bhaya āvahāḥ  /

original: tairahaṃ veṣṭito duṣṭairvyākulaśca kṛtastadā | muṣṭibhirhanyamāno'haṃ svastho jāto dvija kṣaṇāt || 11 ||
analyzed: taiḥ aham veṣṭitaḥ duṣṭaiḥ vyākulaḥ ca kṛtaḥ tadā muṣṭibhiḥ hanyamānaḥ aham svasthaḥ jātaḥ dvija kṣaṇāt

analyzed: dṛḍhaḥ bhava mahā rāja mā viṣādam kuru prabho hīna vīryāḥ hi amī corāḥ samarthaḥ tvam sthiraḥ bhava

original: tasyā vākyena vipreṃdra mayā dhairyeṇa saṃyuge | daśa pradhāna puruṣā jitāste na mṛtāḥ prabho || 15 ||

original: pralīnā maccharīre tu kepyate kāpi sā'balā | paśupālavacaḥ śrutvā nārado vākyamabravīt || 16 ||
analyzed: pralīnā mad śarīre tu kā īpyate kā api sā abalā paśupāla vacaḥ śrutvā nāradaḥ vākyam abravīt

original: ye tvayā puruṣā dṛṣṭāstvayi līnā jitā mṛdhe | buddhīndriyāṇi te pañca paṃca karmendriyāṇi ca | bhramantī yā ca nārī sā tvayā dṛṣṭā nṛpottama || 17 ||
analyzed: ye tvayā puruṣāḥ dṛṣṭāḥ tvayi līnāḥ jitāḥ mṛdhe  buddhīndriyāṇi te pañca paṃca karmendriyāṇi ca  bhramantī yā ca nārī sā tvayā dṛṣṭā nṛpa uttama

original: manorūpeṇa sā buddhirbhramatyeva hi na sthirā | jitāni tāni pūrveṇa brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā || 18 ||
analyzed: manaḥ rūpeṇa sā buddhiḥ bhramati eva hi na sthirā jitāni tāni pūrveṇa brahmaṇā loka kartṛṇā

original: so'pi krodhavaśaṃ nīta indriyairviṣayaiḥ priyaiḥ | pitāmahena sve yajñe śambhorbhāgo na kalpitaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: saḥ api krodha vaśam nītaḥ indriyaiḥ viṣayaiḥ priyaiḥ pitāmahena sve yajñe śambhoḥ bhāgaḥ na kalpitaḥ  /

original: mahādevo jagannāthaḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhārakārakaḥ | iṃdriyairmohito rājankrodhaṃ cakre surā nprati || 20 ||
analyzed: mahādevaḥ jagannāthaḥ sṛṣṭi saṃhāra kārakaḥ iṃdriyaiḥ mohitaḥ rājan krodham cakre surān prati

original: surā vibhūtayo yasya krīḍārthaṃ bhuvanatrayam | tena bhāganimittārthaṃ cakre sajyaṃ dhanustadā || 21 ||
analyzed: surāḥ vibhūtayaḥ yasya krīḍā artham bhuvanatrayam  tena bhāga nimitta artham cakre sajyam dhanuḥ tadā  /

original: pūṣṇaśca daṃtāḥ saṃbhagnā mohitaśca divākaraḥ | netre bhagne bhagasyāpi viddho yajño mṛgākṛtiḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: pūṣṇaḥ ca daṃtāḥ saṃbhagnāḥ mohitaḥ ca divākaraḥ netre bhagne bhagasya api viddhaḥ yajñaḥ mṛga ākṛtiḥ  /

original: paśavaśca kṛtā devā munayo vedavarjitāḥ | ṛṣīṇāṃ dharmaśāstrāṇi hṛtāni vibhunā tathā || 23 ||
analyzed: paśavaḥ ca kṛtāḥ devāḥ munayaḥ veda varjitāḥ ṛṣīṇām dharma śāstrāṇi hṛtāni vibhunā tathā

original: durjayānīndriyāṇyāhurmunayo vedapāragāḥ | manorūpeṇa yā buddhiḥ sā cātīva sudurjayā || 24 ||
analyzed: durjayāni indriyāṇi āhuḥ munayaḥ vedapāragāḥ manaḥ rūpeṇa yā buddhiḥ sā ca atīva su durjayā

original: tasmādrājanmahābāho mā viṣādaṃ vṛthā kṛthāḥ | tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nāradasya mahātmanaḥ | paśupālo mahādevi vaktuṃ samupacakrame || 25 ||
analyzed: tasmāt rājan mahā bāho mā viṣādam vṛthā kṛthāḥ tasya tat vacanam śrutvā nāradasya mahātmanaḥ paśupālaḥ mahādevi vaktum samupacakrame

original: paśupāla uvāca | kathaṃ te bhagavanmuktā devāḥ śakrapurogamāḥ | paśubhāvācca brahmāpi śrotumicchāmi kathyatām || 26 ||
analyzed: paśupālaḥ uvāca katham te bhagavat muktāḥ devāḥ śakra purogamāḥ paśu bhāvāt ca brahmā api śrotum icchāmi kathyatām

original: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nāradaḥ punarabravīt | paśu tve'pi gatā devā ṛṣibhirmunibhiḥ saha || 27 ||
analyzed: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā nāradaḥ punar abravīt paśu tve api gatāḥ devāḥ ṛṣibhiḥ munibhiḥ saha  /

original: brahmāṇamagrataḥ kṛtvā gatāḥ śaraṇamīśvaram | stutibhistoṣito devo bhaktānugrahakārakaḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: brahmāṇam agratas kṛtvā gatāḥ śaraṇam īśvaram stutibhiḥ toṣitaḥ devaḥ bhakta anugraha kārakaḥ

original: uvāca vacanaṃ rājanyatkartavyaṃ taducyatām || 29 ||
analyzed: uvāca vacanam rājan yat kartavyam tat ucyatām

original: devā ūcuḥ | vedaśāstrāṇi vijñānaṃ dehi no bhava mā ciram | devastvaṃ pūrvavaddeva yadi tuṣṭo maheśvaraḥ || 30 ||
analyzed: devāḥ ūcuḥ veda śāstrāṇi vijñānam dehi naḥ bhava mā ciram  devaḥ tvam pūrvavat deva yadi tuṣṭaḥ maheśvaraḥ  /

original: īśvara uvāca | bhavaṃtaḥ paśavaḥ sarve mayā sārddhaṃ ca gamyatām | mahākālavane kṣetre paśubhāvavimokṣake || 31 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca bhavantaḥ paśavaḥ sarve mayā sārddham ca gamyatām mahākāla vane kṣetre paśu bhāva vimokṣake  /

original: ahaṃ patirvo bhavitā tato mokṣamavāpsyatha | bhavatāmanukaṃpārthaṃ lokānugrahakāraṇam | liṃgarūpī bhaviṣyāmi nāmnā paśupatīśvaraḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: aham patiḥ vaḥ bhavitā tatas mokṣam avāpsyatha bhavatām anukaṃpā artham loka anugraha kāraṇam liṃga rūpī bhaviṣyāmi nāmnā paśupatīśvaraḥ   /

original: atha te tridaśāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā devaṃ tamīśvaram | paśubhāvavinirmuktā gatā hṛṣṭāstriviṣṭapam | brahmā paśupatiṃ prāha prasannenāṃtarātmanā || 33 ||
analyzed: atha te tridaśāḥ sarve dṛṣṭvā devam tam īśvaram paśu bhāva vinirmuktāḥ gatāḥ hṛṣṭāḥ triviṣṭapam  brahmā paśupatim prāha prasannena aṃtarātmanā

original: ye tvāṃ paśyanti deveśa bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ | teṣāṃ kule paśutvaṃ ca ye gatāḥ pitaraḥ prabho | svakaiḥ karmavipākaiśca teṣāṃ mokṣo bhaviṣyati || 34 ||
analyzed: ye tvām paśyanti deveśa bhaktyā paramayā yutāḥ teṣām kule paśu tvam ca ye gatāḥ pitaraḥ prabho svakaiḥ karma vipākaiḥ ca teṣām mokṣaḥ bhaviṣyati  /

original: ajñānājjñānato vāpi yatpāpaṃ kriyate naraiḥ | tatpāpaṃ vilayaṃ yātu tasya devasya pūjanāt || 35 ||
analyzed: ajñānāt jñānataḥ vā api yat pāpam kriyate naraiḥ tat pāpam vilayam yātu tasya devasya pūjanāt  /

original: te narāḥ paśavo loke kiṃ teṣāṃ jīvite phalam | yairna dṛṣṭaḥ paśupatiḥ paśuyonivimocakaḥ || 36 ||
analyzed: te narāḥ paśavaḥ loke kim teṣām jīvite phalam yaiḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ paśupatiḥ paśu yoni vimocakaḥ   /

original: kaumāre yauvane bālye vārddhake yadupārjitam | tatpāpaṃ vilayaṃ yāti dṛṣṭvā paśupatiṃ śivam || 37 ||
analyzed: kaumāre yauvane bālye vārddhake yat upārjitam tat pāpam vilayam yāti dṛṣṭvā paśupatim śivam

original: pauṣamāse tu saṃprāpte ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti mānavāḥ | teṣāṃ tvaṃ varado deva sadābhīṣṭakaro bhavet || 38 ||
analyzed: pauṣa māse tu saṃprāpte ye tvām paśyaṃti mānavāḥ teṣām tvam vara daḥ deva sadā abhīṣṭa karaḥ bhavet  /

original: sūryagrahe yathā dattaṃ kurukṣetre viśeṣataḥ | pātre dānaṃ suvarṇasya proktamakṣayyamavyayam || 39 ||
analyzed: sūrya grahe yathā dattam kurukṣetre viśeṣataḥ pātre dānam suvarṇasya proktam akṣayyam avyayam

original: pauṣamāse dinaikena narāṇāmadhikaṃ tathā | taddarśanena deveśa bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: pauṣa māse dina ekena narāṇām adhikam tathā tad darśanena deveśa bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ

original: ityuktvā bhagavānbrahmā brahmalokaṃ gato nṛpa | kṛtakṛtyaḥ prahṛṣṭātmā munibhiḥ kavibhiḥ saha || 41 ||
analyzed: iti uktvā bhagavān brahmā brahma lokam gataḥ nṛpa kṛtakṛtyaḥ prahṛṣṭa ātmā munibhiḥ kavibhiḥ saha

original: tasmāttvamapi rājeṃdra yadīcchasi parāṃ gatim | samārādhaya talliṃgaṃ paśuyonivimocanam | mahākālavanaṃ gatvā indreśvarasya dakṣiṇe || 42 ||
analyzed: tasmāt tvam api rāja iṃdra yadi icchasi parām gatim samārādhaya tat liṃgam paśu yoni vimocanam mahākālavanam gatvā indreśvarasya dakṣiṇe  /

original: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nāradasya mahātmanaḥ | jagāma paśupālo'pi mahākālavanaṃ priye | darśanāttasya liṃgasya gato'sau paramāṃ gatim || 43 ||
analyzed: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā nāradasya mahātmanaḥ jagāma paśupālaḥ api mahākāla vanam priye darśanāt tasya liṃgasya gataḥ asau paramām gatim  /

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | paśupatyākhyadevasya śṛṇu brahmeśvaraṃ śivam || 44 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ paśupati ākhya devasya śṛṇu brahmeśvaram śivam

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye paśupatī śvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuṣṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 64 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvantya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye paśupatī śvara māhātmya varṇanam nāma catuṣṣaṣṭitamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: śrīhara uvāca | paṃcaṣaṣṭikasaṃkhyākaṃ viddhi brahmeśvaraṃ priye | yasya darśanamātreṇa brahmaloko hyavāpyate || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī haraḥ uvāca paṃca ṣaṣṭika saṃkhyākam viddhi brahmeśvaram priye yasya darśana mātreṇa brahma lokaḥ hi avāpyate

original: pulomānāma daityeṃdro mahābalaparākramaḥ | paulomānāṃ sahasraistu pūjyamānaḥ sa tiṣṭhati || 2 ||
analyzed: pulomā nāma daitya iṃdraḥ mahā bala parākramaḥ paulomānām sahasraiḥ tu pūjyamānaḥ sa tiṣṭhati  /

original: rājovāca | bhagavanbrūhi me tīrthamaviyogakaraṃ sadā | sadyaḥ pāpaharaṃ vipra liṃgaṃ vā kathaya prabho || 34 ||
analyzed: rājā uvāca bhagavan brūhi me tīrtham aviyoga karam sadā sadyas pāpa haram vipra liṃgam vā kathaya prabho

original: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā jalpasya pṛthivīpateḥ | vaśiṣṭhaḥ kathayāmāsa divyajñānena pārvati || 35 ||
analyzed: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā jalpasya pṛthivīpateḥ  vaśiṣṭhaḥ kathayāmāsa divya jñānena pārvati

original: gaccha jalpa mamādeśānmahākālavanottamam | kṛtvā niḥ kṣatriyāṃ pṛthvīṃ yatra rāmastapasyati | tatra liṃgamanādyaṃ ca kukkuṭeśvarapaścime || 36 ||
analyzed: gaccha jalpa mama ādeśāt mahākāla vana uttamam  kṛtvā niḥ kṣatriyām pṛthvīm yatra rāmaḥ tapasyati tatra liṃgam anādyam ca kukkuṭeśvara paścime

original: tadārādhaya rājeṃdra jāmadagnyāśrame sthitaḥ | vaśiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā jalpo'sau pṛthivīpatiḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: tat ārādhaya rāja iṃdra jāmadagnya āśrame sthitaḥ vaśiṣṭhasya vacaḥ śrutvā jalpaḥ asau pṛthivīpatiḥ

original: devadāruvanaṃ tyaktvā mahākālavanaṃ gataḥ | dadarśa tatra talliṃgamanādyaṃ devasaṃstutam | pūjayāmāsa vidhivatparameṇa samādhinā || 38 ||
analyzed: devadāru vanam tyaktvā mahākāla vanam gataḥ  dadarśa tatra tat liṃgam anādyam deva saṃstutam  pūjayāmāsa vidhivat parameṇa samādhinā

original: tatra vāṇī samutpannā liṃgamadhyādvarānane | na tvaṃ pāpasamācāro na tvaṃ maraṇakāraṇam | putrāṇāṃ nṛpaviprāṇāmadṛṣṭaṃ tatra kāraṇam || 39 ||
analyzed: tatra vāṇī samutpannā liṃga madhyāt varānane  na tvam pāpa samācāraḥ na tvam maraṇa kāraṇam putrāṇām nṛpa viprāṇām adṛṣṭam tatra kāraṇam

original: vipākena svakīyena gatā vaivasvataṃ puram | mā śokaṃ kuru rājeṃdra gahanā karmaṇo gatiḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: vipākena svakīyena gatāḥ vaivasvatam puram  mā śokam kuru rāja iṃdra gahanā karmaṇaḥ gatiḥ  /

original: anena śuddhabhāvena tuṣṭo'haṃ nṛpasattama | yadabhīṣṭaṃ varaṃ brūhi tatte dāsyāmi nānyathā || 41 ||
analyzed: anena śuddha bhāvena tuṣṭaḥ aham nṛpa sattama yad abhīṣṭam varam brūhi tat te dāsyāmi na anyathā  /

original: rājovāca | yadi tuṣṭo'si me deva yadi deyo varo mama | saṃsārasāgare ghore mā bhavenmama janma ca || 42 ||
analyzed: rājā uvāca yadi tuṣṭaḥ asi me deva yadi deyaḥ varaḥ mama saṃsāra sāgare ghore mā bhavet mama janma ca  /

original: akṣayāṃ dehi me kīrttiṃ nāmnā me viśruto bhuvi | ayaṃ jalpeśvaro devo jalpenārādhito vibhuḥ || 43 ||
analyzed: akṣayām dehi me kīrttim nāmnā me viśrutaḥ bhuvi ayam jalpeśvaraḥ devaḥ jalpena ārādhitaḥ vibhuḥ

original: vadaṃtu tridaśāḥ sarve eṣa me durlabho varaḥ | ye tvāṃ paśyaṃti manujā mannāmnā khyātimāgatam | teṣāṃ viyogo mā bhūyātputrato dhanato'pi vā || 44 ||
analyzed: vadaṃtu tridaśāḥ sarve eṣa me durlabhaḥ varaḥ ye tvām paśyaṃti manujāḥ mad nāmnā khyātim āgatam teṣām viyogaḥ mā bhūyāt putrataḥ dhanataḥ api vā  /

original: na saṃsārabhayaṃ teṣāṃ dasyuto naiva rājataḥ | na bhūtagraharogebhyo bhayamastu kadācana || 45 ||
analyzed: na saṃsāra bhayam teṣām dasyutaḥ nā eva rājataḥ na bhūta graha rogebhyaḥ bhayam astu kadācana

original: śivamastu sadā teṣāṃ yeṣāṃ tvaṃ darśanaṃ gataḥ | te dhanyā mānuṣe loke ye tvāṃ śaraṇamāgatāḥ || 46 ||
analyzed: śivam astu sadā teṣām yeṣām tvam darśanam gataḥ te dhanyāḥ mānuṣe loke ye tvām śaraṇam āgatāḥ   /

original: sarvatīrthābhiṣekaistu yatpuṇyaṃ prāpyate naraiḥ | tatsarvamadhikaṃ deva labhyate tava darśanāta || 47 ||
analyzed: sarva tīrtha abhiṣekaiḥ tu yat puṇyam prāpyate naraiḥ tat sarvam adhikam deva labhyate tava darśanāt

original: tāvatpataṃti saṃsāre ghore duḥkhaśatākule | yāvanna dṛśyate devaḥ saṃsārārṇavatārakaḥ || 48 ||
analyzed: tāvat pataṃti saṃsāre ghore duḥkha śata ākule yāvat na dṛśyate devaḥ saṃsāra arṇava tārakaḥ   /

original: yadā pāpakṣayaḥ puṃsāṃ tadā te darśanaṃ bhavet | mahatā sukṛtenaiva nālpena tapasā prabho || 49 ||
analyzed: yadā pāpa kṣayaḥ puṃsām tadā te darśanam bhavet mahatā sukṛtena eva na alpena tapasā prabho

original: evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā tena liṃgena pārvati | paśyatāṃ sarvadevānāṃ svatanau saṃniveśitaḥ || 50 ||
analyzed: evam bhaviṣyati iti uktvā tena liṃgena pārvati paśyatām sarva devānām sva tanau saṃniveśitaḥ  /

original: tasmiṃlliṃge layaṃ prāpte nṛpe jalpe varānane | devo jalpeśvaraḥ khyāto devairukto mahītale | bhuktido muktidaścaiva sadābhīṣṭakaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 51 ||
analyzed: tasmin liṃge layam prāpte nṛpe jalpe varānane  devaḥ jalpeśvaraḥ khyātaḥ devaiḥ uktaḥ mahī tale bhukti daḥ mukti daḥ ca eva sadā abhīṣṭa karaḥ smṛtaḥ

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | jalpeśvarasya devasya śṛṇu kedārasaṃjñakam || 52 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ jalpeśvarasya devasya śṛṇu kedāra saṃjñakam

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye jalpeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma ṣadaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 66 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvantya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye jalpeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma ṣadaṣaṣṭitamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: īśvara uvāca | saptaṣaṣṭikasaṃkhyākaṃ kedāreśvarasaṃjñakam | devaṃ śṛṇu varārohe darśanātpāpanāśanam || 1 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca sapta ṣaṣṭika saṃkhyākam kedāreśvara saṃjñakam devam śṛṇu varārohe darśanāt pāpa nāśanam   /

original: sṛṣṭikāle purā devi devā vyāptā himena hi | śītārttā vihvalāḥ sarve brahmāṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ gatāḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: sṛṣṭi kāle purā devi devāḥ vyāptāḥ himena hi śīta ārttāḥ vihvalāḥ sarve brahmāṇam śaraṇam gatāḥ  /

original: himādriṇārditāḥ sarve vayaṃ deva jagatpate | trāhi bhītāṃścatuvaktra pitāmaha namo'stu te || 3 ||
analyzed: himādriṇā arditāḥ sarve vayam deva jagatpate  trāhi bhītān catuvaktra pitāmaha namaḥ astu te

original: devānāṃ vacanaṃ śrutvā proktaṃ vai brahmaṇā priye | pīḍitā himaśailena śaṃkaraśvaśureṇa ca || 4 ||
analyzed: devānām vacanam śrutvā proktam vai brahmaṇā priye pīḍitāḥ himaśailena śaṃkara śvaśureṇa ca  /

original: nāhaṃ yātuṃ samartho'smi satyametanmayoditam | mahādeva mṛte devā gatiranyā na vidyate || 5 ||
analyzed: na aham yātum samarthaḥ asmi satyam etat mayā uditam mahādeva mṛte devāḥ gatiḥ anyā na vidyate

original: sa eva śaraṇaṃ devaḥ sarveṣāṃ no bhaviṣyati | tasyājñayā mayā sarve parvatā racitāḥ purā || 6 ||
analyzed: saḥ eva śaraṇam devaḥ sarveṣām naḥ bhaviṣyati tasya ājñayā mayā sarve parvatāḥ racitāḥ purā

original: kṛtā buddhirvicitrā ca himādriśca mayā kṛtaḥ | asevyaḥ sarvajaṃtūnāmadhṛṣyo durgamo giriḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: kṛtā buddhiḥ vicitrā ca himādriḥ ca mayā kṛtaḥ asevyaḥ sarva jaṃtūnām adhṛṣyaḥ durgamaḥ giriḥ

original: himācalasya tasyaiva śāstā devo maheśvaraḥ | tasmādyāsyāmahe devā kailāsaṃ parvatottamam || 8 ||
analyzed: himācalasya tasya eva śāstā devaḥ maheśvaraḥ tasmāt yāsyāmahe devā kailāsam parvata uttamam

original: yatra tiṣṭhati viśvātmā devadevo maheśvaraḥ | evamuktvā gato brahmā devaiḥ sārddhaṃ mamāṃtikam | dṛṣṭohaṃ pūjitastaistu stuto'haṃ vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: yatra tiṣṭhati viśvātmā devadevaḥ maheśvaraḥ evam uktvā gataḥ brahmā devaiḥ sārddham mama aṃtikam  dṛṣṭaḥ aham pūjitaḥ taiḥ tu stutaḥ aham vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ

original: mayā saṃmānitā devāścatuvaktraḥ prapūjitaḥ | pūjayitvā mayā pṛṣṭo brahmā gamanakāraṇam || 10 ||
analyzed: mayā saṃmānitāḥ devāḥ catuvaktraḥ prapūjitaḥ pūjayitvā mayā pṛṣṭaḥ brahmā gamana kāraṇam   /

original: kiṃ kāryaṃ tridaśaiḥ sārddhamāgato'si pitāmaha | kathitaṃ brahmaṇā sarvaṃ śrutaṃ sarvaṃ mayā priye || 11 ||
analyzed: kim kāryam tridaśaiḥ sārddham āgataḥ asi pitāmaha kathitam brahmaṇā sarvam śrutam sarvam mayā priye

original: himācalaṃ samāhūya maryādā ca kṛtā mayā | śailānāṃ rājarājatve himādriśca pratiṣṭhitaḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: himācalam samāhūya maryādā ca kṛtā mayā śailānām rājarāja tve himādriḥ ca pratiṣṭhitaḥ  /

original: devānāṃ viṣayāścaiva gaṃdharvāṇāṃ tathaiva ca | yakṣāṇāmatha nāgānāṃ kiṃnarāṇāṃ tathaiva ca || 13 ||
analyzed: devānām viṣayāḥ ca eva gaṃdharvāṇām tathā eva ca yakṣāṇām atha nāgānām kiṃnarāṇām tathā eva ca   /

original: vidyādharāṇāṃ krīḍārthaṃ pṛthakpṛthaṅniveśitāḥ | rūpato bhāti śaileṃdraḥ śuddhasphaṭikasaṃnibhaḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: vidyādharāṇām krīḍā artham pṛthak pṛthak niveśitāḥ rūpataḥ bhāti śaila iṃdraḥ śuddha sphaṭika saṃnibhaḥ   /

original: jāhnavīnirjharoṣṇīṣaḥ śarvāṇījanakastathā || 15 ||
sarvadevamayo divyaḥ sarvatīrthamayaḥ kṛtaḥ | sarvāśramanivāsaśca sarvāmaraniṣevitaḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: sarva deva mayaḥ divyaḥ sarva tīrtha mayaḥ kṛtaḥ sarva āśrama nivāsaḥ ca sarva amara niṣevitaḥ

original: evaṃ saṃsthāpya śaileṃdraṃ liṃgamūrttirahaṃ sthitaḥ | vikhyātastriṣu lokeṣu kedāreśvaranāmataḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: evam saṃsthāpya śaileṃdram liṃga mūrttiḥ aham sthitaḥ vikhyātaḥ triṣu lokeṣu kedāreśvara nāmataḥ

original: udakaṃ nirmitaṃ tatra maṃtrapūrṇaṃ mayā priye | māhātmyaṃ vividhaṃ proktaṃ liṃgasya ca jalasya ca || 18 ||
analyzed: udakam nirmitam tatra maṃtra pūrṇam mayā priye māhātmyam vividham proktam liṃgasya ca jalasya ca

original: yotrāgatya naro bhaktyā samyaṅmāṃ pūjayiṣyati | jalaṃ yo'traiva gṛhṇāti vidhānena varānane | tasyodare bhaviṣyāmi liṃgarūpī na saṃśayaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: yaḥ atrā āgatya naraḥ bhaktyā samyak mām pūjayiṣyati jalam yaḥ atra eva gṛhṇāti vidhānena varānane tasya udare bhaviṣyāmi liṃga rūpī na saṃśayaḥ

original: ityukte vacane devi sadevāsurapannagāḥ | yakṣarakṣaḥpiśācāśca bhūtavaitālakiṃnarāḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: iti ukte vacane devi sa deva asura pannagāḥ yakṣa rakṣaḥ piśācāḥ ca bhūta vaitāla kiṃnarāḥ

original: vidyādharagaṇāścaiva mama darśanalālasāḥ | samāyātā varārohe pītvā tatra jalaṃ śubham || 21 ||
analyzed: vidyādhara gaṇāḥ ca eva mama darśana lālasāḥ samāyātāḥ varārohe pītvā tatra jalam śubham  /

original: dṛṣṭo'haṃ vidhinā taistu liṃgamūrttigataḥ priye | mama tulyāśca te jātāstasminnadrivare sthitāḥ | janalokagataiḥ siddhaiḥ pūjyamānā varānane || 22 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭaḥ aham vidhinā taiḥ tu liṃga mūrtti gataḥ priye  mama tulyāḥ ca te jātāḥ tasmin adri vare sthitāḥ jana loka gataiḥ siddhaiḥ pūjyamānāḥ varānane

original: atha kālena bahunā śrutvā māhātmyamuttamam | kedāreśvaradevasya jalasya ca viśeṣataḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: atha kālena bahunā śrutvā māhātmyam uttamam kedāreśvara devasya jalasya ca viśeṣataḥ

original: manuṣyāḥ samupāyātāste rajobahulā yataḥ | tamaḥprāyā viśālākṣi tadāhaṃ māhiṣaṃ vapuḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: manuṣyāḥ samupāyātāḥ te rajaḥ bahulāḥ yatas tamaḥ prāyā viśāla akṣi tadā aham māhiṣam vapuḥ  /

original: kṛtavāṃstadbhayārthāya na ca te bhītimāgatāḥ | iha devotra devo'tra babhramuste didṛkṣavaḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: kṛtavān tad bhaya arthāya na ca te bhītim āgatāḥ iha deva utra devaḥ atra babhramuḥ te didṛkṣavaḥ

original: na tairdṛṣṭo mahādevi yato'haṃ mahiṣākṛtiḥ | sthito'smyalakṣyarūpeṇa tataste dīnamānasāḥ | udvignā niśvasantaśca vairāgyaṃ paramaṃ gatāḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: na taiḥ dṛṣṭaḥ mahādevi yatas aham mahiṣa ākṛtiḥ sthitaḥ asmi alakṣya rūpeṇa tatas te dīna mānasāḥ udvignāḥ niśvasantaḥ ca vairāgyam paramam gatāḥ  /

original: nātra devo na tīrthāni na gaṃgā puṇyadāyinī | na dharmo na paro lokaḥ sarvame tadviḍambanam || 27 ||
analyzed: na atra devaḥ na tīrthāni na gaṃgā puṇya dāyinī  na dharmaḥ na paraḥ lokaḥ sarvam e tat viḍambanam

original: evaṃ kila purāṇeṣu śrūyate sarvadā śrutau | himālaye ca kedāraṃ liṃgaṃ mokṣapradāyakam || 28 ||
analyzed: evam kila purāṇeṣu śrūyate sarvadā śrutau himālaye ca kedāram liṃgam mokṣa pradāyakam

original: evaṃ tu vadatāṃ teṣāṃ mānuṣāṇāṃ yaśasvini | ākāśādutthitā vāṇī mayā proktānukaṃpayā || 29 ||
analyzed: evam tu vadatām teṣām mānuṣāṇām yaśasvini ākāśāt utthitā vāṇī mayā proktā anukaṃpayā  /

original: amārgaṃ mā vadatvatra na niṃdyāḥ śrutayo'vyayāḥ | purāṇaṃ nānyathā proktaṃ brahmaṇā lokakartṛṇā || 30 ||
analyzed: amārgam mā vadatu atra na niṃdyāḥ śrutayaḥ avyayāḥ purāṇam na anyathā proktam brahmaṇā loka kartṛṇā

original: ye niṃdaṃti purāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi nāstikāḥ | te yāṃti narakaṃ ghoraṃ yāvadābhūtasaṃplavam || 31 ||
analyzed: ye niṃdaṃti purāṇāni dharma śāstrāṇi nāstikāḥ te yāṃti narakam ghoram yāvat ābhūtasaṃplavam

original: sadā devotra kedāraḥ svargamokṣapradāyakaḥ | vidyate tridaśaiḥ pūjyaḥ satataṃ naiva dṛśyate || 32 ||
analyzed: sadā deva utra kedāraḥ svarga mokṣa pradāyakaḥ vidyate tridaśaiḥ pūjyaḥ satatam na eva dṛśyate  /

original: karoti pūjāṃ himavānmāsānaṣṭau ca śāśvatān | himādristena puṇyena nagendrastu kṛto nagaiḥ | sevyaśca ramaṇīyaśca sarvatīrthanamaskṛtaḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: karoti pūjām himavān māsān aṣṭau ca śāśvatān  himādriḥ tena puṇyena naga indraḥ tu kṛtaḥ nagaiḥ sevyaḥ ca ramaṇīyaḥ ca sarva tīrtha namaskṛtaḥ

original: sarvaratnanidhānaśca devānāṃ vallabhastathā | grīṣme caiva vasante ca devadevo'tra dṛśyate || 34 ||
analyzed: sarva ratna nidhānaḥ ca devānām vallabhaḥ tathā grīṣme ca eva vasante ca devadevaḥ atra dṛśyate  /

original: niyatenaiva kālena mānuṣāṇāṃ ca sarvadā | yadi buddhiḥ parā jātā sarvadā mama darśane || 35 ||
analyzed: niyatena eva kālena mānuṣāṇām ca sarvadā yadi buddhiḥ parā jātā sarvadā mama darśane

original: ākhyāsye tadupāyaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ sāvadhānataḥ | mā vikalpo'tra karttavyaḥ sarvānkāmānavāpsyatha || 36 ||
analyzed: ākhyāsye tad upāyam ca śrūyatām sāvadhānataḥ mā vikalpaḥ atra karttavyaḥ sarvān kāmān avāpsyatha  /

original: kṣetrāṇāmuttamaṃ kṣetraṃ bhuktimuktipradāyakam | pralaye'pyakṣayaṃ proktaṃ mahākālavanaṃ narāḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: kṣetrāṇām uttamam kṣetram bhukti mukti pradāyakam pralaye api akṣayam proktam mahākāla vanam narāḥ  /

original: tatrāhaṃ saṃbhaviṣyāmi lokānāmanukaṃpayā | liṃgarūpeṇa śiprāyāstaṭe puṇye suśobhane || 38 ||
analyzed: tatra aham saṃbhaviṣyāmi lokānām anukaṃpayā liṃga rūpeṇa śiprāyāḥ taṭe puṇye su śobhane  /

original: someśvarasya devasya paścime sthānamuttamam | prasiddhamupayāsyāmi kedāreśvaranāmataḥ || 39 ||
analyzed: someśvarasya devasya paścime sthānam uttamam prasiddham upayāsyāmi kedāreśvara nāmataḥ  /

original: sarvadā darśanaṃ tatra mayā sārddhaṃ bhaviṣyati | sarveṣāṃ ca pradāsyāmi sarvā nkāmānna saṃśayaḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: sarvadā darśanam tatra mayā sārddham bhaviṣyati sarveṣām ca pradāsyāmi sarvān kāmān na saṃśayaḥ

original: iha yāvatphalaṃ tasmāddāsyāmi hyadhikaṃ tataḥ | iti te mānavāḥ sarve śrutvā vāṇīṃ manoramām | ākāśādutthitāṃ divyāṃ manaḥprahrādakārikām || 41 ||
analyzed: iha yāvat phalam tasmāt dāsyāmi hi adhikam tatas iti te mānavāḥ sarve śrutvā vāṇīm manoramām ākāśāt utthitām divyām manaḥ prahrāda kārikām

original: gatā vanaṃ mahākālaṃ saṃsmaranto maheśvaram | vikalpena vicitreṇa satyameveti nānyathā || 42 ||
analyzed: gatāḥ vanam mahākālam saṃsmarantaḥ maheśvaram vikalpena vicitreṇa satyam eva iti na anyathā  /

original: snātvā śiprājale puṇye yāvatpaśyanti bhāskaram | tāvadṛṣṭipathotpannaṃ liṃgaṃ pāpapraṇāśanam || 43 ||
analyzed: snātvā śiprā jale puṇye yāvat paśyanti bhāskaram tāvat ṛṣṭi patha utpannam liṃgam pāpa praṇāśanam

original: atha te harṣitāḥ procuḥ kedāro'yaṃ na saṃśayaḥ | dṛṣṭo'smākaṃ na sandeho gaṃgā śiprājale sthitā || 44 ||
analyzed: atha te harṣitāḥ procuḥ kedāraḥ ayam na saṃśayaḥ dṛṣṭaḥ asmākam na sandehaḥ gaṃgā śiprā jale sthitā  /

original: tataste pūjayāmāsuḥ puṣpairnānāvidhaistathā | pūjito'haṃ viśālākṣi teṣāṃ tuṣṭo varānane || 45 ||

original: durlabho'tivaro dattaḥ kailāse sthānamuttamam | akṣayaṃ ca padaṃ dattaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam || 46 ||
analyzed: durlabhaḥ ati varaḥ dattaḥ kailāse sthānam uttamam akṣayam ca padam dattam punarāvṛtti varjitam   /

original: ato'haṃ tridaśaiḥ proktaḥ kedāreśvaranā mataḥ | prārthitaḥ parayā bhaktyā lokānāmanukaṃpayā || 47 ||
analyzed: atas aham tridaśaiḥ proktaḥ kedāreśvara nā mataḥ prārthitaḥ parayā bhaktyā lokānām anukaṃpayā  /

original: ihāgatya narā ye ca tvāṃ paśyaṃti subhaktitaḥ | teṣāṃ phalaṃ tvayā deva dātavyamadhikaṃ yataḥ || 48 ||
analyzed: iha āgatya narāḥ ye ca tvām paśyaṃti su bhaktitaḥ teṣām phalam tvayā deva dātavyam adhikam yatas  /

original: himādrau himanāthasya yātrāyāḥ pratyahaṃ phalam | labhante ca narā nityaṃ nātra kāryā vicāraṇā || 49 ||
analyzed: himādrau himanāthasya yātrāyāḥ pratyaham phalam labhante ca narāḥ nityam na atra kāryā vicāraṇā

original: brahmahā vā surāpo vā ste yī vā gurutalpagaḥ | tatsaṃparkī naro yastu tvāṃ dṛṣṭvā kilviṣākaraḥ || 50 ||
analyzed: brahma hā vā surā paḥ vā ste yī vā gurutalpa gaḥ tad saṃparkī naraḥ yaḥ tu tvām dṛṣṭvā kilviṣa ākaraḥ   /

original: so'pi yāti paraṃ sthānaṃ punarāvṛttivarjitam | cāṃdrāyaṇānāṃ vidhi vacchatānāṃ caiva yatphalam | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti kedāreśvaradarśanāt || 51 ||
analyzed: saḥ api yāti param sthānam punarāvṛtti varjitam  cāṃdrāyaṇānām vidhi vat śatānām ca eva yat phalam tat phalam samavāpnoti kedāreśvara darśanāt  /

original: te narāḥ paśavo loke teṣāṃ janma nirarthakam | yairna dṛṣṭo mahākāle kedāreśvarasaṃjñakaḥ || 52 ||
analyzed: te narāḥ paśavaḥ loke teṣām janma nirarthakam  yaiḥ na dṛṣṭaḥ mahākāle kedāreśvara saṃjñakaḥ   /

original: kaumāre yauvane bālye vārddhake yadupārjitam | tatpāpaṃ saṃkṣayaṃ yāti kedāreśvaradarśanāt || 53 ||
analyzed: kaumāre yauvane bālye vārddhake yat upārjitam tat pāpam saṃkṣayam yāti kedāreśvara darśanāt

original: himālayakṛtā yātrā tasyāḥ proktaṃ ca yatphalam | tatphalaṃ samavāpnoti kedāreśvaradarśanāt || 54 ||
analyzed: himālaya kṛtā yātrā tasyāḥ proktam ca yat phalam tat phalam samavāpnoti kedāreśvara darśanāt

original: ityukto'haṃ tadā devi devaiḥ praṇatipūrvakam | tatheti ca mayā proktaṃ te'pi devā divaṃ gatāḥ || 55 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ aham tadā devi devaiḥ praṇati pūrvakam tathā iti ca mayā proktam te api devāḥ divam gatāḥ  /

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | kedāreśvaradevasya piśācākhyamataḥ śṛṇu || 56 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ kedāreśvara devasya piśāca ākhyam atas śṛṇu  /

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye kedāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma saptaṣaṣṭitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 67 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye kedāreśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam nāma saptaṣaṣṭitamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: | īśvara uvāca | aṣṭaṣaṣṭikasaṃkhyākaṃ piśācākhyamatheśvaram | śṛṇu devi prayatnena darśanātpāpanāśanam || 1 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca aṣṭa ṣaṣṭika saṃkhyākam piśāca ākhyam atha īśvaram  śṛṇu devi prayatnena darśanāt pāpa nāśanam

original: ādau kaliyuge devi śūdro bahudhano'bhavat | somo nāma suvikhyāto nāstiko vedaniṃdakaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: ādau kali yuge devi śūdraḥ bahu dhanaḥ abhavat somaḥ nāma su vikhyātaḥ nāstikaḥ veda niṃdakaḥ

original: abrahmaṇyo nṛśaṃsaśca kadaryo nirapatrapaḥ | viśvāsaghātakaścaiva parasvaharaṇe rataḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: a brahmaṇyaḥ nṛśaṃsaḥ ca kadaryaḥ nirapatrapaḥ viśvāsa ghātakaḥ ca eva para sva haraṇe rataḥ  /

original: trivargahaṃtā cānyeṣāmātmakāmānuvarttakaḥ | sa kadācinmṛto devi kaṣṭena parameṇa ca || 4 ||
analyzed: trivarga haṃtā ca anyeṣām ātma kāma anuvarttakaḥ sa kadācid mṛtaḥ devi kaṣṭena parameṇa ca  /

original: marudeśe piśāco'bhūnnagno dīno bhayāvahaḥ | nāśakṛtsa piśācānāṃ svapakṣocchedakārakaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: maru deśe piśācaḥ abhūt nagnaḥ dīnaḥ bhaya āvahaḥ nāśa kṛt sa piśācānām sva pakṣa uccheda kārakaḥ

original: bahavo mardditāstena piśācā balavattarāḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: bahavaḥ mardditāḥ tena piśācāḥ balavattarāḥ

original: atha tenaiva mārgeṇa kadācicchākaṭāyanaḥ | svādhyāyanirato vidvānvāggmī śamaparāyaṇaḥ || 7 ||
analyzed: atha tena eva mārgeṇa kadācid śākaṭāyanaḥ svādhyāya nirataḥ vidvān vāggmī śama parāyaṇaḥ  /

original: udayādityasaṃkāśo vibhāvasusamadyutiḥ | śakaṭena sadā yāti sa paśyanparvatātmaje || 8 ||
analyzed: udaya āditya saṃkāśaḥ vibhāvasu sama dyutiḥ śakaṭena sadā yāti sa paśyan parvatātmaje

original: gato dadarśa taṃ raudraṃ piśācaṃ ca bhayāvaham | sa piśācaḥ kṣudhāviṣṭo bhoktukāmo'bhyadhāvata || 9 ||
analyzed: gataḥ dadarśa tam raudram piśācam ca bhaya āvaham sa piśācaḥ kṣudhā āviṣṭaḥ bhoktu kāmaḥ abhyadhāvata

original: dṛṣṭvā taṃ śakaṭārūḍhaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śākaṭāyanam | śakaṭasya dhvaniṃ śrutvā rūpaṃ dṛṣṭvā dvijasya ca || 10 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā tam śakaṭa ārūḍham brāhmaṇam śākaṭāyanam śakaṭasya dhvanim śrutvā rūpam dṛṣṭvā dvijasya ca  /

original: tathārūpaḥ piśācastu karṇābhyāṃ badhirīkṛtaḥ | ātmatrāṇaparo bhūtvā naṣṭaḥ kaṣṭena pārvati | taṃ dhāvaṃtaṃ samālokya piśācaṃ brāhmaṇo'bravīt || 11 ||
analyzed: tathārūpaḥ piśācaḥ tu karṇābhyām badhirīkṛtaḥ ātma trāṇa paraḥ bhūtvā naṣṭaḥ kaṣṭena pārvati tam dhāvaṃtam samālokya piśācam brāhmaṇaḥ abravīt

original: piśāca trastarūpo'si tvaritaścaiva lakṣyase | kva dhāvasi samācakṣva kutaste bhayamāgatam || 12 ||
analyzed: piśāca trasta rūpaḥ asi tvaritaḥ ca eva lakṣyase kva dhāvasi samācakṣva kutas te bhayam āgatam

original: piśāca uvāca | śakaṭasyāsya mahato ghoṣaṃ śrutvā bhayaṃkaram | karṇābhyāṃ badhiro jāto visaṃjñastava darśanāt || 13 ||
analyzed: piśācaḥ uvāca śakaṭasya asya mahataḥ ghoṣam śrutvā bhayaṃkaram karṇābhyām badhiraḥ jātaḥ visaṃjñaḥ tava darśanāt  /

original: brāhmaṇa uvāca | piśācānāṃ baliṣṭhāśca śrūyaṃte brahmarākṣasāḥ | sa tvaṃ māṃ bhoktukāmo'si vikhyāto brahmarākṣasaḥ || 14 ||
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ uvāca piśācānām baliṣṭhāḥ ca śrūyaṃte brahmarākṣasāḥ sa tvam mām bhoktu kāmaḥ asi vikhyātaḥ brahmarākṣasaḥ  /

original: piśāca uvāca | piśācānāṃ samartho'smi naṣṭo'haṃ tava darśanāt | duḥkhaṃ hi mṛtyuḥ sarveṣāṃ jīvitaṃ ca sudurllabham | ato bhītaḥ palāyāmi jīvahetoḥ sukhārthataḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: piśācaḥ uvāca piśācānām samarthaḥ asmi naṣṭaḥ aham tava darśanāt duḥkham hi mṛtyuḥ sarveṣām jīvitam ca su durllabham atas bhītaḥ palāyāmi jīva hetoḥ sukha arthataḥ

original: brāhmaṇa uvāca | kutaḥ piśāca saukhyaṃ te maraṇaṃ śreya eva te | paiśācī kutsitā yoniḥ pāpināmeva jāyate || 16 ||
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ uvāca kutas piśāca saukhyam te maraṇam śreyaḥ eva te paiśācī kutsitā yoniḥ pāpinām eva jāyate

original: piśāca uvāca | sarvatra hi gato jīvo bhavatyeva sukhāśrayaḥ | tasmājjīvitumicchāmi prasīda brahmarākṣasa || 17 ||

original: brāhmaṇa uvāca | nāhaṃ tvāṃ bhoktukāmo'smi brāhmaṇo'haṃ na rākṣasaḥ | sarvabhūtahitārthāya vicarāmi mahītale || 18 ||
analyzed: brāhmaṇaḥ uvāca na aham tvām bhoktu kāmaḥ asmi brāhmaṇaḥ aham na rākṣasaḥ sarva bhūta hita arthāya vicarāmi mahī tale  /

original: sarveṣāmeva jaṃtūnāṃ maitro brāhmaṇa ucyate | mā kuruṣva bhayaṃ matto mitrabhāvagato hyaham || 19 ||
analyzed: sarveṣām eva jaṃtūnām maitraḥ brāhmaṇaḥ ucyate mā kuruṣva bhayam mattaḥ mitra bhāva gataḥ hi aham  /

original: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā piśācaḥ svasthamānasaḥ | praṇamya pratyuvācedaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ śākaṭāyanam || 20 ||
analyzed: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā piśācaḥ svastha mānasaḥ praṇamya pratyuvāca idam brāhmaṇam śākaṭāyanam

analyzed: yadi te sarva bhūtānām dattā hi abhaya dakṣiṇā karmaṇā manasā vācā mitra bhāvam gataḥ yadi

analyzed: pṛcchāmi tvām mahābhāga saṃśayaḥ hṛdaye sthitaḥ śrutvā anukaṃpayā samyak tat me vyākhyātum arhasi   /

original: kena karmavipākena paiśācaṃ yāti mānavaḥ | piśācatvātkathaṃ muktiḥ prāpyate pāpakarmabhiḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: kena karma vipākena paiśācam yāti mānavaḥ piśāca tvāt katham muktiḥ prāpyate pāpa karmabhiḥ

original: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā piśācasya varānane | mamatvenāvṛtastasmai prāvocacchākaṭāyanaḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: iti tasya vacaḥ śrutvā piśācasya varānane mamatvena āvṛtaḥ tasmai prāvocat śākaṭāyanaḥ

original: apahṛtya ca viprasvaṃ devasvaṃ ca viśeṣataḥ | tena pāpena pāpiṣṭhāḥ piśācatvaṃ prayāṃti ca || 25 ||
analyzed: apahṛtya ca vipra svam deva svam ca viśeṣataḥ tena pāpena pāpiṣṭhāḥ piśāca tvam prayāṃti ca  /

original: pitaraṃ mātaraṃ caiva striyaṃ bālaṃ dvijaṃ tathā | vaṃcayitvā haratyarthaṃ sa piśāco bhavennaraḥ || 26 ||
analyzed: pitaram mātaram ca eva striyam bālam dvijam tathā vaṃcayitvā harati artham sa piśācaḥ bhavet naraḥ  /

original: rājadravyaṃ gṛhītvā tu na yajenna dadāti yaḥ | ātmānameva puṣṇāti piśācatvaṃ sa gacchati || 27 ||
analyzed: rāja dravyam gṛhītvā tu na yajet na dadāti yaḥ ātmānam eva puṣṇāti piśāca tvam sa gacchati  /

original: viśvāsaghātakā ye ca paradāraratāśca ye | prāpnuvaṃti piśācatvaṃ tathā ye vedaniṃdakāḥ || 28 ||
analyzed: viśvāsa ghātakāḥ ye ca para dāra ratāḥ ca ye prāpnuvanti piśāca tvam tathā ye veda niṃdakāḥ

original: niṃdaṃti ye purāṇāni dharmaśāstrāṇi sarvadā | te bhavaṃti piśācāśca ye sadā piśunā narāḥ || 29 ||
analyzed: niṃdaṃti ye purāṇāni dharma śāstrāṇi sarvadā te bhavanti piśācāḥ ca ye sadā piśunāḥ narāḥ

original: iti te kathitaṃ sarvaṃ vedaprāmāṇyato'dhunā | idānīṃ kathayiṣyāmi yastvaṃ jātosi tacchṛṇu || 30 ||
analyzed: iti te kathitam sarvam veda prāmāṇyataḥ adhunā idānīm kathayiṣyāmi yaḥ tvam jātaḥ asi tat śṛṇu

original: somako nāma śūdrastvaṃ paramarmaprakāśakaḥ | viśvāsaghātako jāto devabrāhmaṇadūṣakaḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: somakaḥ nāma śūdraḥ tvam para marma prakāśakaḥ viśvāsa ghātakaḥ jātaḥ deva brāhmaṇa dūṣakaḥ

original: nāstiko bhinnamaryādo janmanyatrāpi saptame | sakulaṃ pātayitvātra narake dāruṇe bhṛśam || 32 ||
analyzed: nāstikaḥ bhinna maryādaḥ janmani atra api saptame sa kulam pātayitvā atra narake dāruṇe bhṛśam

original: piśācayoniṃ saṃprāptaḥ punaḥ prāpsyasi rauravam | mahārauravasaṃjñaṃ tu krakacaṃ kālasūtrakam | yaṃtrapīḍanakaṃ raudraṃ mathanaṃ kumbhavālukam || 33 ||
analyzed: piśāca yonim saṃprāptaḥ punar prāpsyasi rauravam mahāraurava saṃjñam tu krakacam kālasūtrakam yaṃtrapīḍanakam raudram mathanam kumbhavālukam   /

original: ityevaṃ vadatastasya brāhmaṇasya yaśasvini | sasmāra prāktanaṃ janma satsaṃgātkutsitaṃ svakam || 34 ||
analyzed: iti evam vadataḥ tasya brāhmaṇasya yaśasvini sasmāra prāktanam janma sat saṃgāt kutsitam svakam  /

original: duḥkhābhibhūto niśceṣṭo dhigdhigityasakṛdbruvan | patito bhūtale devi idaṃ vākyamathābravīt || 35 ||
analyzed: duḥkha abhibhūtaḥ niśceṣṭaḥ dhik dhik iti asakṛt bruvan patitaḥ bhū tale devi idam vākyam athā bravīt

original: aho kenāpi puṇyena bhavatā saha darśanam | jātaṃ mamālpapuṇyasya dīnasya kṛpaṇasya ca || 36 ||
analyzed: aho kena api puṇyena bhavatā saha darśanam jātam mama alpa puṇyasya dīnasya kṛpaṇasya ca  /

original: nāsti dharmasamaṃ mitraṃ nāsti dharmasamā gatiḥ | nāsti dharmasamṃ trāṇaṃ sa ca nāsti mama prabho || 37 ||
analyzed: na asti dharma samam mitram na asti dharma samā gatiḥ na asti dharma samam trāṇam sa ca nā asti mama prabho

original: magno'haṃ duḥkhajaladhau magno'haṃ pāpakardame | bhrāṃto'hamaṃdhatamasi tatastvāṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ || 38 ||
analyzed: magnaḥ aham duḥkha jaladhau magnaḥ aham pāpa kardame bhrāṃtaḥ aham andha tamasi tatas tvām śaraṇam gataḥ  /

original: namaste'stu mahābhāga kiṃ karomi praśādhi mām | tattapobalanirdiṣṭamidaṃ prāptaṃ mayā'dhunā || 39 ||
analyzed: namaḥ te astu mahābhāga kim karomi praśādhi mām tat tapaḥ bala nirdiṣṭam idam prāptam mayā adhunā  /

original: evaṃ nigadatastasya piśācasya varānane | kathayāmāsa māhātmyaṃ sa vipraḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: evam nigadataḥ tasya piśācasya varānane kathayāmāsa māhātmyam sa vipraḥ śākaṭāyanaḥ  /

original: pṛthivyāṃ yāni tīrthāni āsamudragatāni vai | kṣetrāṇi yāni saṃtīha teṣāṃ kṣetraṃ supuṇyadam || 41 ||
analyzed: pṛthivyām yāni tīrthāni āsamudra gatāni vai kṣetrāṇi yāni saṃti iha teṣām kṣetram su puṇya dam  /

original: mahākālavanaṃ kṣetraṃ pralaye'pyakṣayaṃ gatam | liṃgaṃ tatra mahākṣetre piśācatvavināśanam || 42 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vanam kṣetram pralaye api akṣayam gatam  liṃgam tatra mahā kṣetre piśāca tva vināśanam

original: ḍhuṃḍheśvarasya devasya dakṣiṇe tridaśārcitam | paiśācaṃ vidyate bhūyaḥ piśācayonināśanam | tasya darśanamātreṇa piśācatvātpramokṣyase || 43 ||
analyzed: ḍhuṃḍheśvarasya devasya dakṣiṇe tridaśa arcitam paiśācam vidyate bhūyas piśāca yoni nāśanam tasya darśana mātreṇa piśāca tvāt pramokṣyase  /

original: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā sa piśāco varānane | ājagāma tvarāyukto namaskṛtya dvijaṃ tadā || 44 ||
analyzed: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā sa piśācaḥ varānane  ājagāma tvarā yuktaḥ namaskṛtya dvijam tadā

original: mahākālavane puṇye samīhitaphalaprade | dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ snātvā śiprājale śubhe || 45 ||
analyzed: mahākāla vane puṇye samīhita phala prade  dadarśa tatra tat liṃgam snātvā śiprā jale śubhe

original: darśanāttasya liṃgasya sa piśāco varānane | tatkṣaṇāddivyadehastu divyābharaṇabhūṣitaḥ || 46 ||

analyzed: kandarpa koṭi sadṛśam viśrāntam nṛpam abravīt sutām mām viddhi rāja indra kalpasya prāṇa vallabhām

original: śuśrāva śrotrapīyūṣaṃ gītaṃ devagṛhe śubhe | tacchrutvā kautukāviṣṭo dhvaniṃ śrutvā manoramām | priyāmapaśyattatrasthāṃ lāvaṇyalalanāvadhim || 43 ||

original: ārādhito nareṃdreṇa durddharṣeṇa mahātmanā | tadāprabhṛti devo'yaṃ durddharṣeśvarasaṃjñakaḥ | triṣu lokeṣu vikhyāto vāṃchitārthaphala pradaḥ || 50 ||

original: tato daityādhipo mānī parivṛtto mahāraṇāt | nirjitārirmahātejā jvālāvāniva pāvakaḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: tatas daitya adhipaḥ mānī parivṛttaḥ mahā raṇāt nirjita ariḥ mahā tejāḥ jvālāvān iva pāvakaḥ

original: vaṃdyamāno munigaṇaiḥ stūyamāno maharṣibhiḥ | ānaṃdito jayāśīrbhiḥ pravarairdaityapuṃgavaiḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: vaṃdyamānaḥ muni gaṇaiḥ stūyamānaḥ mahā ṛṣibhiḥ ānaṃditaḥ jaya āśīrbhiḥ pravaraiḥ daitya puṃgavaiḥ
