original: tatra sarvarddhisaṃpūrṇamāsanaṃ hemabhūṣaṇam | adhyatiṣṭhata daityeṃdrastatra maṃgalaveśmani | tatropaviṣṭaḥ śuśubhe daityarājo mahāyaśāḥ || 34 ||
analyzed: tatra sarva ṛddhi saṃpūrṇam āsanam hema bhūṣaṇam adhyatiṣṭhata daitya iṃdraḥ tatra maṃgala veśmani tatra upaviṣṭaḥ śuśubhe daitya rājaḥ mahā yaśāḥ

original: divyacaṃdanapuṣṭāṃgaḥ surapuṣpasamujjvalaḥ | mukuṭākārajuṣṭāṃgaḥ sitacāmaravījitaḥ | mṛtotthitaistathā daityairdaityādhīśairadhiṣṭhitaḥ || 35 ||
analyzed: divya caṃdana puṣṭa aṃgaḥ surapuṣpa samujjvalaḥ mukuṭa ākāra juṣṭa aṃgaḥ sita cāmara vījitaḥ mṛta utthitaiḥ tathā daityaiḥ daitya adhīśaiḥ adhiṣṭhitaḥ

original: kratubhirmūrttimadbhiśca sevya māno mahābalaḥ | sarvapuṣpotkarayutairnānāvihaganādibhiḥ || 36 ||
analyzed: kratubhiḥ mūrttimadbhiḥ ca sevya mānaḥ mahā balaḥ sarva puṣpa utkara yutaiḥ nānā vihaga nādibhiḥ  /

original: tatra śrīratulā loke tatra lakṣmīrnirargalā | tatra kāṃtirdyutiḥ śobhā śaṃbaro yatra dānavaḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: tatra śrīḥ atulā loke tatra lakṣmīḥ nirargalā  tatra kāṃtiḥ dyutiḥ śobhā śaṃbaraḥ yatra dānavaḥ  /

original: evaṃ sa daityanṛpatiḥ sabhṛtyastatra modate | svayamiṃdrastu saṃjātaścaṃdrasūryau kṛtau svakau || 38 ||
analyzed: evam sa daitya nṛpatiḥ sa bhṛtyaḥ tatra modate svayam iṃdraḥ tu saṃjātaḥ caṃdra sūryau kṛtau svakau  /

original: tayoriti vacaḥ śrutvā sa devaḥ puruṣottamaḥ | ciraṃ dhyātvā svamanasi tadāvocadidaṃ priye || 39 ||
analyzed: tayoḥ iti vacaḥ śrutvā sa devaḥ puruṣottamaḥ ciram dhyātvā sva manasi tadā avocat idam priye

original: caṃdrasūryau mayā jñātaṃ śaṃbarasya viceṣṭitam | brahmaṇo varadānena bhoktavyaṃ tapasaḥ phalam || 40 ||
analyzed: caṃdra sūryau mayā jñātam śaṃbarasya viceṣṭitam  brahmaṇaḥ vara dānena bhoktavyam tapasaḥ phalam   /

original: śaṃbarāya purā kṣiptaṃ vajraṃ kuliśapāṇinā | hṛdaye nihataḥ so'pi tathāpi na mṛto'suraḥ || 41 ||
analyzed: śaṃbarāya purā kṣiptam vajram kuliśa pāṇinā hṛdaye nihataḥ saḥ api tathā api na mṛtaḥ asuraḥ   /

original: gamyatāṃ ca mayājñaptau mahākā lavanottame | candrasūryau mamādeśāttatra siddhiṃ ca lapsyatha || 42 ||
analyzed: gamyatām ca mayā ājñaptau mahākāḥ lavana uttame candra sūryau mama ādeśāt tatra siddhim ca lapsyatha  /

original: tatrānaṃto mahākālo liṃgarūpo maheśvaraḥ | tasya cottarato deśe liṃgaṃ kāmapradaṃ śivam || 43 ||
analyzed: tatra anantaḥ mahākālaḥ liṃga rūpaḥ maheśvaraḥ tasya ca uttaratas deśe liṃgam kāma pradam śivam

original: tasya darśanamātreṇa kṛtakṛtyau bhaviṣyathaḥ | tasya jvālāsamūhena maraṇaṃ śaṃbarasya ca | bhaviṣyati na saṃdehastasmāttatraiva gamya tām || 44 ||
analyzed: tasya darśana mātreṇa kṛtakṛtyau bhaviṣyathaḥ tasya jvālā samūhena maraṇam śaṃbarasya ca bhaviṣyati na saṃdehaḥ tasmāt tatra eva gamya tām

original: ityuktau vāsudevena caṃdrasūryau yaśasvini | satvaraṃ hṛṣṭaromāṇau mahākālavanaṃ gatau || 45 ||
analyzed: iti uktau vāsudevena caṃdra sūryau yaśasvini sa tvaram hṛṣṭa romāṇau mahākāla vanam gatau  /

original: tatra dṛṣṭvā mahādevaṃ tejaso rāśimavya yam | stutaṃ ca vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ pūjitaṃ kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ || 46 ||
analyzed: tatra dṛṣṭvā mahādevam tejasaḥ rāśim avya yam stutam ca vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ pūjitam kusumaiḥ śubhaiḥ

original: etasminnaṃtare vāṇī liṃgamadhyātsamutthitā | āśvāsayaṃtī tarasā candrasūryau himātmaje || 47 ||
analyzed: etasmin aṃtare vāṇī liṃga madhyāt samutthitā āśvāsayaṃtī tarasā candra sūryau himātmaje

original: hataḥ sa śaṃbaro daityo gatau tau candrabhāskarau | daityānāṃ nirmitau duṣṭau pātālāṃtarasaṃsthitau || 48 ||
analyzed: hataḥ sa śaṃbaraḥ daityaḥ gatau tau candra bhāskarau daityānām nirmitau duṣṭau pātāla antara saṃsthitau  /

original: rāhuketū grahāṃte tu kṛtau samayapūrvakau | sthāpitaḥ svapade śakro devaiḥ saha na saṃśayaḥ || 49 ||
analyzed: rāhu ketū graha aṃte tu kṛtau samaya pūrvakau sthāpitaḥ sva pade śakraḥ devaiḥ saha na saṃśayaḥ

original: svaṃ svaṃ sthānaṃ gatāḥ sarve lokapālā mudā yutāḥ | kāṃtipratāpasaṃyuktau bhavantau bhuvanatraye || 50 ||
analyzed: svam svam sthānam gatāḥ sarve lokapālāḥ mudā yutāḥ kānti pratāpa saṃyuktau bhavantau bhuvanatraye

original: gagane grahanakṣatraiḥ sahitau vicariṣyathaḥ | pūrvavatpuṇyapāpānāṃ sākṣibhūtau bhaviṣyathaḥ || 51 ||
analyzed: gagane graha nakṣatraiḥ sahitau vicariṣyathaḥ pūrvavat puṇya pāpānām sākṣi bhūtau bhaviṣyathaḥ  /

original: ityuktau candrasūryau tu tayā vāṇyā varānane | santuṣṭau kṛtakṛtyau tu saṃjātau liṃgadarśanāt || 52 ||
analyzed: iti uktau candra sūryau tu tayā vāṇyā varānane santuṣṭau kṛtakṛtyau tu saṃjātau liṃga darśanāt  /

original: etasminnaṃtare devā vimānasthā samāgatāḥ | yatra caṃdraśca sūryaśca mahākā lavane śubhau || 53 ||
analyzed: etasmin aṃtare devāḥ samāgatāḥ yatra caṃdraḥ ca sūryaḥ ca śubhau

original: jñātvā liṃgasya māhātmyaṃ nāma cakuḥ samāhitāḥ | sevitaṃ caṃdrasūryābhyāṃ liṃgaṃ tejomayaṃ param || 54 ||
analyzed: jñātvā liṃgasya māhātmyam nāma cakuḥ samāhitāḥ sevitam caṃdra sūryābhyām liṃgam tejaḥ mayam param

original: candrādityeśvaraṃnāma khyātiṃ yāsyati bhūtale | liṃgasyāsya samutthena jvālāsaṃghena śaṃbaraḥ | dagdho bhṛtyajanaiḥ sārddhaṃ candrasūryānusevanāt || 55 ||
analyzed: candrādityeśvaram nāma khyātim yāsyati bhū tale  liṃgasya asya samutthena jvālā saṃghena śaṃbaraḥ dagdhaḥ bhṛtya janaiḥ sārddham candra sūrya anusevanāt  /

original: ityuktvā tridaśāḥ saveṃ samīpe sarvataḥ sthitāḥ | stuvanto vividhaiḥ stotraiścaṃdrādityeśvaraṃ śivam || 56 ||
analyzed: iti uktvā tridaśāḥ samīpe sarvatas sthitāḥ stuvantaḥ vividhaiḥ stotraiḥ caṃdra āditya īśvaram śivam

original: candrādityau ca tatrasthau sthitau liṃgasamīpataḥ | ārādhayantau deveśaṃ padaṃ prāptau ca pūrvavat || 57 ||
analyzed: candra ādityau ca tatrasthau sthitau liṃga samīpataḥ ārādhayantau deveśam padam prāptau ca pūrvavat  /

original: ye paśyaṃti narā bhaktyā candrādityecaraṃ śivam | te yāṃti sūryalokaṃ tu candralokaṃ tathaiva ca || 58 ||
analyzed: ye paśyaṃti narāḥ bhaktyā candra ādityecaram śivam te yāṃti sūrya lokam tu candra lokam tathā eva ca  /

original: vimānaiḥ sūryasakāśaistathā caṃdraprabhaiḥ śubhaiḥ | yāvaccandraśca sūryaśca tāvatteṣāṃ sukhaṃ bhavet || 59 ||
analyzed: vimānaiḥ sūrya sakāśaiḥ tathā caṃdra prabhaiḥ śubhaiḥ yāvat candraḥ ca sūryaḥ ca tāvat teṣām sukham bhavet  /

original: candrasūryoparāge tu caṃdrādityeśvaraṃ śivam | ye paśyaṃti narā bhaktyā snātvā śiprāṃ ca pāvanīm || 60 ||
analyzed: candra sūrya uparāge tu caṃdrādityeśvaram śivam ye paśyaṃti narāḥ bhaktyā snātvā śiprām ca pāvanīm

original: teṣāṃ kulaśataṃ yāvatpaitṛkaṃ mātṛkaṃ tathā | loke caṃdrasya sūryasya modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ || 61 ||
analyzed: teṣām kula śatam yāvat paitṛkam mātṛkam tathā loke caṃdrasya sūryasya modate śāśvatīḥ samāḥ  /

original: amāsomasamāyoge ye paśyanti prasaṃgataḥ | candrādityeśvaraṃ devaṃ na te yāṃti yamālayam || 62 ||
analyzed: amā soma samāyoge ye paśyanti prasaṃgataḥ candra āditya īśvaram devam na te yāṃti yama ālayam

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | candrādityeśvareśasya śrūyatāṃ karabheśvaram || 63 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ candra ādityeśvara īśasya śrūyatām karabheśvaram

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśīti liṅgamāhātmya umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde cadrādityeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma dvisaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 72 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṃḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye umā maheśvara saṃvāde cadrādityeśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma dvisaptatitamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: śrīhara uvāca | trisaptatīśvaraṃ viddhi karabheśaṃ varānane | yasya darśanamātreṇa kuyonirnaiva labhyate || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī haraḥ uvāca trisaptati īśvaram viddhi karabheśam varānane yasya darśana mātreṇa ku yoniḥ nā eva labhyate  /

original: vīraketurabhūddhīmānayodhyāyā mahīpatiḥ | vidyāvinayasaubhāgyalāvaṇyāmṛta pūritaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: vīraketuḥ abhūt dhīmān ayodhyāyāḥ mahīpatiḥ vidyā vinaya saubhāgya lāvaṇya amṛta pūritaḥ

original: sa samyakpālayāmāsa prajāḥ putrānivaurasān | atītānāgatajñānapariniṣṭhitamānasaḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: sa samyak pālayāmāsa prajāḥ putrān iva aurasān atīta anāgata jñāna pariniṣṭhita mānasaḥ

original: athaikasmindine rājā jagāma gahanaṃ vanam | mṛgasiṃhagajākīrṇaṃ vyāghrasaṃbarasaṃkulam || 4 ||
analyzed: atha ekasmin dine rājā jagāma gahanam vanam mṛga siṃha gaja ākīrṇam vyāghra saṃbara saṃkulam  /

original: sa tatra vividhānvanyānvivyādha paravīrahā | mṛgāṃśca mahiṣāṃścaiva varāhāṃśca sahasraśaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: sa tatra vividhān vanyān vivyādha para vīra hā mṛgān ca mahiṣān ca eva varāhān ca sahasraśas

original: loḍitaṃ tadvanaṃ sarvaṃ paśupakṣimṛgākulam | rahitaṃ śvāpadaiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtaṃ tena mahībhṛtā || 6 ||
analyzed: loḍitam tat vanam sarvam paśu pakṣi mṛga ākulam rahitam śvāpadaiḥ sarvaiḥ kṛtam tena mahībhṛtā

original: yadā na śvāpadāstasmindṛśyate gahane vane | tadā viddhastu karabho bāṇenānataparvaṇā || 7 ||
analyzed: yadā na śvāpadāḥ tasmin dṛśyate gahane vane  tadā viddhaḥ tu karabhaḥ bāṇena ānata parvaṇā

original: sa cāpi karabho devi bāṇamādāya satvaram | viddho'pi niḥsṛto'tyarthaṃ rājñastasyaiva paśyataḥ | sa ca rājā balī tūrṇaṃ sasāra karabhaṃ prati || 8 ||
analyzed: sa ca api karabhaḥ devi bāṇam ādāya sa tvaram viddhaḥ api niḥsṛtaḥ atyartham rājñaḥ tasya eva paśyataḥ sa ca rājā balī tūrṇam sasāra karabham prati  /

original: tato nimnasthalaṃ caiva sa coṣṭro'dravadāśugaḥ | muhūrtena tato devi yojanāni bahūnyapi || 9 ||
analyzed: tatas nimna sthalam ca eva sa ca uṣṭraḥ adravat āśu gaḥ muhūrtena tatas devi yojanāni bahūni api   /

original: tataḥ sa rājā tāruṇyā daurasena balena ca | sasāra bāṇāsanadhṛksakhaḍgaḥ sahayo nṛpaḥ || 10 ||
analyzed: tatas sa rājā tāruṇyā daurasena balena ca sasāra bāṇāsanadhṛk sa khaḍgaḥ sa hayaḥ nṛpaḥ  /

original: tato nadānnadīścaiva palvalāni vanāni ca | atikramyānatikramya sasāraiva vanecaram || 11 ||
analyzed: tatas nadān nadīḥ ca eva palvalāni vanāni ca atikramya an atikramya sasāra eva vanecaram  /

original: sa cāpi karabho devi āsādyāsādya taṃ nṛpam | punarapyeti javano javena mahatā tataḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: sa ca api karabhaḥ devi āsādya āsādya tam nṛpam punar api eti javanaḥ javena mahatā tatas

original: sa tasya bāṇairbahubhiḥ karabho vihvalīkṛtaḥ | pṛṣṭhataḥ pārśvataścaiva punarabhyeti cāṃtikam | punaśca javamāsyāya pārśve cāgre ca dṛśyate || 13 ||
analyzed: sa tasya bāṇaiḥ bahubhiḥ karabhaḥ vihvalīkṛtaḥ pṛṣṭhatas pārśvatas ca eva punar abhyeti ca aṃtikam punar ca javam āsyāya pārśve ca agre ca dṛśyate

original: athāraṇyaṃ mahāraudraṃ praviṣṭaḥ karabhastadā | antardhānaṃ jagāmāśu sa ca rājā vane'viśat || 14 ||
analyzed: atha araṇyam mahā raudram praviṣṭaḥ karabhaḥ tadā antardhānam jagāma āśu sa ca rājā vane aviśat  /

original: praviśya ca mahāraṇyaṃ tāpasānāmathāśramam | āsasāda tato rājā śrāṃtāśvopā viśatpunaḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: praviśya ca mahā araṇyam tāpasānām atha āśramam  āsasāda tatas rājā viśat punar

original: taṃ kārmukakaraṃ dṛṣṭvā śramārttaṃ kṣudhitaṃ tadā | samabhyetyarṣayastasmai pūjāṃ cakuryathāvidhi || 16 ||
analyzed: tam kārmuka karam dṛṣṭvā śrama ārttam kṣudhitam tadā samabhyetya ṛṣayaḥ tasmai pūjām cakuḥ yathāvidhi

original: sa pūjāmṛṣibhirdattāṃ pratigṛhya yathāvidhi | apṛcchattāpasānsarvāṃstapaso vṛddhimuttamām || 17 ||
analyzed: sa pūjām ṛṣibhiḥ dattām pratigṛhya yathāvidhi apṛcchat tāpasān sarvān tapasaḥ vṛddhim uttamām

original: te tasya rājño vacanaṃ pratigṛhya tapodhanāḥ | ṛṣayo rājaśārdūlaṃ papracchusta tprayojanam || 18 ||
analyzed: te tasya rājñaḥ vacanam pratigṛhya tapodhanāḥ ṛṣayaḥ rāja śārdūlam papracchuḥ tat prayojanam

original: kena bhadra sukhārthena saṃprāpto'si tapovanam | padātirbaddhanistriṃśo dhanvī bāṇī nareśvara || 19 ||
analyzed: kena bhadra sukha arthena saṃprāptaḥ asi tapaḥ vanam padātiḥ baddha nistriṃśaḥ dhanvī bāṇī nareśvara

original: etadicchāmahe śrotuṃ kutaḥ prāpto'si mānada | kasminkule ca jātastvaṃ kiṃ nāmā brūhi pārthiva || 20 ||
analyzed: etat icchāmahe śrotum kutas prāptaḥ asi mānada  kasmin kule ca jātaḥ tvam kim nāmā brūhi pārthiva

original: tataḥ sa rājā sarvebhyo dvijebhyaḥ puruṣarṣabhaḥ | ācakhyau tadyathā nyāyaṃ kulaṃ gotraṃ ca tattvataḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: tatas sa rājā sarvebhyaḥ dvijebhyaḥ puruṣa ṛṣabhaḥ ācakhyau tat yathā nyāyam kulam gotram ca tattvataḥ  /

original: ikṣvākūṇāṃ kule jāto vīraketurdvijarṣabhāḥ | carāmi mṛgayūthāni nighnanbāṇaiḥ sahasraśaḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: ikṣvākūṇām kule jātaḥ vīra ketuḥ dvijarṣabhāḥ  carāmi mṛga yūthāni nighnan bāṇaiḥ sahasraśas

original: balena mahatā yuktaḥ sāmātyaḥ saparicchadaḥ | yadā na labdho gahane mṛgo vā sūkaro'pi vā || 23 ||
analyzed: balena mahatā yuktaḥ sa amātyaḥ sa paricchadaḥ yadā na labdhaḥ gahane mṛgaḥ vā sūkaraḥ api vā  /

original: mahiṣaścittalo vāpi śaśo vā śaṃbaro vane | tadā me karabho viddho bāṇenānataparvaṇā || 24 ||
analyzed: mahiṣaḥ cittalaḥ vā api śaśaḥ vā śaṃbaraḥ vane  tadā me karabhaḥ viddhaḥ bāṇena ānata parvaṇā   /

original: sa praṇaṣṭaḥ kṣaṇenaiva sabāṇo mama paśyataḥ | taṃ dravaṃtamanuprāpto vanametadyadṛcchayā || 25 ||
analyzed: sa praṇaṣṭaḥ kṣaṇena eva sa bāṇaḥ mama paśyataḥ tam dravaṃtam anuprāptaḥ vanam etat yadṛcchayā

original: bhavatsakāśaṃ naṣṭaśrīrhatāśaḥ śramakarśitaḥ | bhavatāṃ viditaṃ sarvaṃ sarvajñā hi tapodhanāḥ | bhavaṃtaḥ sumahābhāgāstasmātpṛcchābhi saṃśayam || 26 ||
analyzed: bhavat sakāśam naṣṭa śrīḥ hata āśaḥ śrama karśitaḥ bhavatām viditam sarvam sarva jñāḥ hi tapodhanāḥ bhavantaḥ su mahābhāgāḥ tasmāt pṛccha abhi saṃśayam

original: kva gataḥ karabho viddho mayā bāṇena sāṃpratam | kva ca prāpsyāmi sahasā brūta tatsusamāhitāḥ || 27 ||
analyzed: kva gataḥ karabhaḥ viddhaḥ mayā bāṇena sāṃpratam  kva ca prāpsyāmi sahasā brūta tat su samāhitāḥ

original: tatasteṣāṃ samastānāmṛṣīṇāmṛṣisattamaḥ | ṛṣabho devi karabhaṃ smarannidamathābravīt || 28 ||
analyzed: tatas teṣām samastānām ṛṣīṇām ṛṣi sattamaḥ ṛṣabhaḥ devi karabham smaran idam atha abravīt

original: gataḥ sa karabho bhūpa mahākālavane śubhe | gaccha tvaṃ ca mahārāja mahākālavane śubhe || 29 ||
analyzed: gataḥ sa karabhaḥ bhūpa mahākāla vane śubhe  gaccha tvam ca mahā rāja mahākāla vane śubhe

original: yatra devo mahādevaḥ kārabhaṃ rūpamāsthitaḥ | vinodārthaṃ ca devānāṃ liṃgamūrttirabhūtpurā || 30 ||
analyzed: yatra devaḥ mahādevaḥ kārabham rūpam āsthitaḥ vinoda artham ca devānām liṃga mūrttiḥ abhūt purā

original: tenaivāpyāyito lokaḥ sukhī jāto yaśasvini | tataḥ kāle tu kasmiṃścidvarṣatpākaśāsanaḥ | saṃvartto vārido bhūtvā meghānvai vinyapātayat || 28 ||
analyzed: tena eva āpyāyitaḥ lokaḥ sukhī jātaḥ yaśasvini  tatas kāle tu kasmiṃścid varṣat pākaśāsanaḥ saṃvarttaḥ vāridaḥ bhūtvā meghān vai vinyapātayat  /

original: tatastu māruto bhūtvā nṛpatistāmadhārayat | tatonalaḥ pranaṣṭo'bhūtsarvataḥ pṛthivītalāt || 29 ||
analyzed: tatas tu mārutaḥ bhūtvā nṛpatiḥ tām adhārayat tatas analaḥ pranaṣṭaḥ abhūt sarvatas pṛthivī talāt

original: na yajñā na japo homo na ca paktiravarttata | lokaśca vyādhisaṃkṣubdhastadābhūdviṣame sthitaḥ || 30 ||
analyzed: na yajñāḥ na japaḥ homaḥ na ca paktiḥ avarttata lokaḥ ca vyādhi saṃkṣubdhaḥ tadā abhūt viṣame sthitaḥ

original: tataḥ sa rājā taṃ dṛṣṭvā tvabhavaddhavyavāhanaḥ | so'dhārayatprajāḥ sarvā yajñāṃśca tridivaukasaḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: tatas sa rājā tam dṛṣṭvā tu abhavat havyavāhanaḥ  saḥ adhārayat prajāḥ sarvāḥ yajñān ca tridivaukasaḥ

original: etasminnaṃtare devi tvayā sārddhaṃ samāgataḥ | darśanārthaṃ svanagarīmahaṃ bhūtagaṇairvṛtaḥ || 32 ||
analyzed: etasmin antare devi tvayā sārddham samāgataḥ darśana artham sva nagarīm aham bhūta gaṇaiḥ vṛtaḥ  /

original: tato devagaṇāḥ sarve sakiṃnaramahoragāḥ | sayakṣarakṣogandharvāḥ siddhavidyādharoragāḥ || 33 ||
analyzed: tatas deva gaṇāḥ sarve sa kiṃnara mahā uragāḥ sa yakṣa rakṣaḥ gandharvāḥ siddha vidyādhara uragāḥ  /

original: bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāśca ye cānye gaganecarāḥ | catvāraḥ sāgarāścaiva kṣārakṣīrādisiṃdhavaḥ || 34 ||
analyzed: bhūtāḥ pretāḥ piśācāḥ ca ye ca anye gaganecarāḥ  catvāraḥ sāgarāḥ ca eva kṣāra kṣīra ādi siṃdhavaḥ

original: gaṃgā ca yamunā siṃdhuścaṃdrabhāgā sarasvatī | carmaṇvatī bhīma rathī puṇyā godāvarī nadī || 35 ||
analyzed: gaṃgā ca yamunā siṃdhuḥ caṃdrabhāgā sarasvatī carmaṇvatī bhīma rathī puṇyā godāvarī nadī

original: vipāśā devikā puṇyā śarayūḥ kauśikī tathā | gomatī dhūtapāpā ca bāhudā ca dṛṣadvatī || 36 ||
analyzed: vipāśā devikā puṇyā śarayūḥ kauśikī tathā gomatī dhūtapāpā ca bāhudā ca dṛṣadvatī  /

original: pārā veda smṛtiścaiva vetraghnī narmadā śivā | tāpī payoṣṇī nirvindhyā sarvāstatra samāgatāḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: pārā veda smṛtiḥ ca eva vetraghnī narmadā śivā tāpī payoṣṇī nirvindhyā sarvāḥ tatra samāgatāḥ

original: puṣkaraśca prayāgaśca prabhāso naimiṣastathā | pṛthutīrthodakaścaiva tathaivāmarakaṃṭakaḥ || 38 ||
analyzed: puṣkaraḥ ca prayāgaḥ ca prabhāsaḥ naimiṣaḥ tathā pṛthutīrtha udakaḥ ca eva tathā eva amarakaṃṭakaḥ

original: gaṃgādvāraḥ kuśāvartto bilvako nīlaparvataḥ | vārāhaparvataścaiva tīrthaṃ kanakhalaṃ tathā || 39 ||
analyzed: gaṃgādvāraḥ kuśāvarttaḥ bilvakaḥ nīlaparvataḥ vārāhaparvataḥ ca eva tīrtham kanakhalam tathā

original: bhṛgutuṃgaḥ sukukṣaścāpyajagaṃdhaśca pārvati | kāliṃjaraḥ sakedāro rudrakoṭirmahālayaḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: bhṛgutuṃgaḥ sukukṣaḥ ca api ajagaṃdhaḥ ca pārvati kāliṃjaraḥ sa kedāraḥ rudrakoṭiḥ mahālayaḥ

original: sthānāni ca samastāni puṇyānyāyatanāni ca | merurmaheṃdro malayo maṃdaro gaṃdhamādanaḥ || 41 ||
analyzed: sthānāni ca samastāni puṇyāni āyatanāni ca meruḥ maheṃdraḥ malayaḥ maṃdaraḥ gaṃdhamādanaḥ

original: munayo vālakhilyāśca vedāścatvāra eva ca | ete cānye ca bahavaḥ samāyātā mayā saha || 42 ||
analyzed: munayaḥ vālakhilyāḥ ca vedāḥ catvāraḥ eva ca ete ca anye ca bahavaḥ samāyātāḥ mayā saha  /

original: anaṃtaraṃ mayā meruḥ sthalākāraḥ kṛtastataḥ | tasminsthale sthito devi upaviṣṭaḥ surairvṛtaḥ | niyuktāḥ sāgarāḥ pārśve catvāro lavaṇādayaḥ || 43 ||
analyzed: anaṃtaram mayā meruḥ sthala ākāraḥ kṛtaḥ tatas tasmin sthale sthitaḥ devi upaviṣṭaḥ suraiḥ vṛtaḥ niyuktāḥ sāgarāḥ pārśve catvāraḥ lavaṇa ādayaḥ  /

original: atha vyākulatāṃ prāptaḥ sa ca rājā ripuṃjayaḥ | svasthalasthaṃ māṃ dṛṣṭvā samāyātastu māṃ prati || 44 ||
analyzed: atha vyākula tām prāptaḥ sa ca rājā ripuṃjayaḥ sva sthala stham mām dṛṣṭvā samāyātaḥ tu mām prati  /

original: tejasā dahyamāno'pi madīyena varānane | bhīto'pi toṣayāmāsa ko'si deva namo'stu te || 45 ||
analyzed: tejasā dahyamānaḥ api madīyena varānane  bhītaḥ api toṣayāmāsa kaḥ asi deva namaḥ astu te   /

original: sthalesminnṛpa rājāhaṃ mayāpyuktaṃ vinodataḥ | caturvargaścaturmūrttiścaturddhā saṃsthito nṛpaḥ || 46 ||
analyzed: sthale ismin nṛpa rājā aham mayā api uktam vinodataḥ caturvargaḥ catur mūrttiḥ caturddhā saṃsthitaḥ nṛpaḥ

original: tenāhaṃ sarvato dṛṣṭo vāṅmaye sacarācare | anaṃtaraṃ stutastena bhaktyā paramayā priye || 47 ||
analyzed: tena aham sarvatas dṛṣṭaḥ vāc maye sa carācare  anaṃtaram stutaḥ tena bhaktyā paramayā priye

original: prabhāvamatulaṃ dṛṣṭvā madīyaṃ vyāpakaṃ param | bhaktyā paramayā devi sa ca māṃ śaraṇaṃ gataḥ | bhūyaḥstuto'pi tenāhaṃ tuṣṭo vai tasya bhūpateḥ | tenoktaṃ yadi me deva tuṣṭastvaṃ parameśvara || 49 ||
analyzed: prabhāvam atulam dṛṣṭvā madīyam vyāpakam param bhaktyā paramayā devi sa ca mām śaraṇam gataḥ bhūyas stutaḥ api tena aham tuṣṭaḥ vai tasya bhūpateḥ tena uktam yadi me deva tuṣṭaḥ tvam parameśvara

original: bhaktirme sudṛḍhā bhūyāttvayi sarvaॆśa śāśvatī | tuṣṭohaṃ tena vākyena punaḥ prokto mayā nṛpa || 50 ||
analyzed: bhaktiḥ me su dṛḍhā bhūyāt tvayi sarvaśas śāśvatī  tuṣṭaḥ aham tena vākyena punar proktaḥ mayā nṛpa

original: evaṃ bhaviṣyatītyuktvā punarmāṃ brūhi pārthiva | hṛdi sthitaśca te kāmaḥ sarvakālaṃ bhaviṣyati || 51 ||
analyzed: evam bhaviṣyati iti uktvā punar mām brūhi pārthiva hṛdi sthitaḥ ca te kāmaḥ sarvakālam bhaviṣyati  /

original: adhṛṣyaḥ sarvedevānāṃ sarvadā saṃbhaviṣyasi | tenāhaṃ prārthito devi bhūyo varamanuttamam || 52 ||
analyzed: adhṛṣyaḥ sarvedevānām sarvadā saṃbhaviṣyasi tena aham prārthitaḥ devi bhūyas varam anuttamam

original: atīva rājate deva sthalo'yaṃ tava sannidhau | merureṣa na saṃdeho vṛllabhaḥ sarvadā tava || 53 ||
analyzed: atīva rājate deva sthalaḥ ayam tava sannidhau meruḥ eṣa na saṃdehaḥ vṛllabhaḥ sarvadā tava

original: rājasthaleśvaro'si tvaṃ vikhyāto bhuvanatraye | bhaviṣyasi yathā deva tathā tvaṃ kartumarhasi || 54 ||
analyzed: rājasthala īśvaraḥ asi tvam vikhyātaḥ bhuvanatraye  bhaviṣyasi yathā deva tathā tvam kartum arhasi  /

original: atrāgatya ca yo deva bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ | yātrāṃ karoti bhāvena purāṇoktavidhānataḥ || 55 ||
analyzed: atrā āgatya ca yaḥ deva bhaktyā paramayā yutaḥ yātrām karoti bhāvena purāṇa ukta vidhānataḥ

original: tasya tvayā pradātavyaṃ sarvaṃ manasi ciṃtitam | aṇimādiguṇāḥ sarve guṭikāsiddhiraṃjanam || 56 ||
analyzed: tasya tvayā pradātavyam sarvam manasi ciṃtitam aṇima ādi guṇāḥ sarve guṭikā siddhiḥ aṃjanam

original: khaḍgaṃ ca pādukāṃ caiva jalavāsaṃ rasāyanam | rājasthaleśvaraṃ yastu bhaktyā paśyati mānavaḥ || 57 ||
analyzed: khaḍgam ca pādukām ca eva jala vāsam rasāyanam rājasthaleśvaram yaḥ tu bhaktyā paśyati mānavaḥ

original: daśamyāṃ tu viśeṣeṇa kṛtvā niyamapūrvakam | devānāmapi devatvaṃ saṃprāpnoti maheśvaraḥ || 58 ||
analyzed: daśamyām tu viśeṣeṇa kṛtvā niyama pūrvakam  devānām api deva tvam saṃprāpnoti maheśvaraḥ

original: pūjanīyastu tridivairyathā devaḥ puraṃdaraḥ | dṛṣṭvā rājasthale devaṃ yo'tra yātrāṃ kariṣyati || 59 ||
analyzed: pūjanīyaḥ tu tridivaiḥ yathā devaḥ puraṃdaraḥ dṛṣṭvā rājasthale devam yaḥ atra yātrām kariṣyati  /

original: tasya śrīrvijayaścaiva bhavatyeva varo mama | śatravaḥ saṃkṣayaṃ yāṃtu saṃpadyatāṃ manorathāḥ || 60 ||
analyzed: tasya śrīḥ vijayaḥ ca eva bhavati eva varaḥ mama śatravaḥ saṃkṣayam yāṃtu saṃpadyatām manorathāḥ  /

original: vṛddhirbhavatu vaṃśe ca darśanāttava śaṃkara | sarve'tra devāstiṣṭhaṃtu meruratraiva tiṣṭhatu | tiṣṭhaṃtu sāgarāḥ sarve tava deva samīpataḥ || 61 ||
analyzed: vṛddhiḥ bhavatu vaṃśe ca darśanāt tava śaṃkara sarve atra devāḥ tiṣṭhaṃtu meruḥ atra eva tiṣṭhatu tiṣṭhantu sāgarāḥ sarve tava deva samīpatas

original: ityukto'haṃ tadā tena mayā coktaṃ varānane | sudyumnonāma bhūpālo yadātraivāgamiṣyati || 62 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ aham tadā tena mayā ca uktam varānane sudyumnaḥ nāma bhūpālaḥ yadā atrā eva āgamiṣyati  /

original: putrārthaṃ bhāryayā sārddhaṃ tadā dāsyāmi vāṃchitam | tadā samudrāścatvāraḥ sthāsyanti saphalāḥ svayam || 63 ||
analyzed: putra artham bhāryayā sārddham tadā dāsyāmi vāṃchitam tadā samudrāḥ catvāraḥ sthāsyanti sa phalāḥ svayam

original: tasyārādhanato bhūpa putraṃ dāsyāmi śobhanam | ye cātra mānavā rājanyātrāṃ kurvaṃti bhaktitaḥ | teṣāṃ manorathāvāptirbhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ || 64 ||
analyzed: tasya ārādhanataḥ bhūpa putram dāsyāmi śobhanam  ye ca atra mānavāḥ rājan yātrām kurvaṃti bhaktitaḥ teṣām manoratha avāptiḥ bhaviṣyati na saṃśayaḥ

original: rājā ripuṃjayo bhaktyā gaṇādhīśaḥ kṛto mayā || 65 ||
analyzed: rājā ripuṃjayaḥ bhaktyā gaṇādhīśaḥ kṛtaḥ mayā

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | rājasthaleśvareśasya śrūyatāṃ vaḍaleśvaram || 66 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ rājasthala īśvara īśasya śrūyatām vaḍaleśvaram

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvaṃtyakhaṃḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmye rājasthaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃnāma catuḥsaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 74 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvaṃtya khaṃḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye rājasthaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam nāma catuḥsaptatitamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: īśvara uvāca | pañcasaptatikaṃ devaṃ vaḍaleśvarasaṃjñakam | viddhi pāpaharaṃ devi darśanātkāmadaṃ nṛṇām || 1 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca pañca saptatikam devam vaḍaleśvara saṃjñakam viddhi pāpa haram devi darśanāt kāma dam nṛṇām

original: dhanadasya sakhā devi maṇibhadro babhūva ha | īrṣyāprabhāvastatputro vaḍalonāma kopanaḥ || 2 ||
analyzed: dhanadasya sakhā devi maṇibhadraḥ babhūva ha īrṣyā prabhāvaḥ tad putraḥ vaḍalaḥ nāma kopanaḥ

original: rūpavānsarvadā kāmī sadā matto balādhikaḥ | kadācitsa gato ramyāṃ nalinīṃ dhanadasya ca || 3 ||
analyzed: rūpavān sarvadā kāmī sadā mattaḥ bala adhikaḥ kadācid sa gataḥ ramyām nalinīm dhanadasya ca  /

original: ratyarthaṃ kāmasevārthaṃ guptāṃ rahasi nirmitām | dadarśa kusumaiśchannāṃ vajravaiḍūryabhūṣitām || 4 ||
analyzed: rati artham kāma sevā artham guptām rahasi nirmitām dadarśa kusumaiḥ channām vajra vaiḍūrya bhūṣitām

original: tāṃ vai vidrumasaṃchannāṃ muktādāmavirā jitām | suramyāṃ vipulacchāyāṃ svarṇapaṃkajaśobhitām || 5 ||
analyzed: tām vai vidruma saṃchannām muktā dāma virājitām  su ramyām vipula chāyām svarṇa paṃkaja śobhitām

original: kuberabhavanābhyāśe vallabhāṃ dhanadasya ca | ākrīḍaṃ rājarājasya kuberasya mahā tmanaḥ || 6 ||
analyzed: kubera bhavana abhyāśe vallabhām dhanadasya ca ākrīḍam rājarājasya kuberasya mahā tmanaḥ

original: rākṣasaiḥ kiṃnaraiścaiva guptāṃ khaṅgadharaiḥ sadā | tāṃ dṛṣṭvā paramaprīto babhūva vaḍalastadā || 7 ||
analyzed: rākṣasaiḥ kiṃnaraiḥ ca eva guptām khaṅga dharaiḥ sadā  tām dṛṣṭvā parama prītaḥ babhūva vaḍalaḥ tadā

original: priyayā sahito reme sthāne gupte manohare | reme ramaṇakairyogairanaṃgena vaśīkṛtaḥ || 8 ||
analyzed: priyayā sahitaḥ reme sthāne gupte manohare reme ramaṇakaiḥ yogaiḥ anaṃgena vaśīkṛtaḥ

original: tatra guptā raṇe śūrā rākṣasā raṇakovidāḥ | rakṣaṃti śatasāhasraṃ sarvāyudhaparicchadāḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: tatra guptāḥ raṇe śūrāḥ rākṣasāḥ raṇa kovidāḥ rakṣaṃti śata sāhasram sarva āyudha paricchadāḥ

original: te tu dṛṣṭvaiva vaḍalaṃ maṇibhadrasutaṃ priye | bhakṣyaiḥ saṃpūritamukhaṃ divyacandanabhūṣitam || 10 ||
analyzed: te tu dṛṣṭvā eva vaḍalam maṇibhadra sutam priye bhakṣyaiḥ saṃpūrita mukham divya candana bhūṣitam  /

original: ketakīgarbhapatrābhairdaṃtairdivyatarānanam | yuddhārthe baddhanistriṃśaṃ śaktiyuktamariṃdamam || 11 ||
analyzed: ketakī garbha patra ābhaiḥ daṃtaiḥ divyatara ānanam yuddha arthe baddha nistriṃśam śakti yuktam ariṃdamam

original: bhāryāsahāyamunmattaṃ paryaṃke ca sthitaṃ sadā | ratyarthamāgataṃ jñātvā anyonyamabhicukruśuḥ || 12 ||
analyzed: bhāryā sahāyam unmattam paryaṃke ca sthitam sadā rati artham āgatam jñātvā anyonyam abhicukruśuḥ  /

original: mā vīrānena mārgeṇa sabhāryo gantumarhasi | ākrīḍo'yaṃ kuberasya dhanadasya mahātmanaḥ || 13 ||
analyzed: mā vīra anena mārgeṇa sa bhāryaḥ gantum arhasi ākrīḍaḥ ayam kuberasya dhanadasya mahātmanaḥ

original: devā devarṣayo yakṣā gandharvāḥ kiṃnarāstathā | āmantrya yakṣapravaraṃ viharaṃti ramaṃti ca || 14 ||
analyzed: devāḥ devarṣayaḥ yakṣāḥ gandharvāḥ kiṃnarāḥ tathā āmantrya yakṣa pravaram viharaṃti ramaṃti ca

original: neha śakyaṃ vinādeśādvihartuṃ krīḍituṃ ciram | bhrātrāmātyena suhṛdā kenāpi ca sutena ca || 15 ||
analyzed: na iha śakyam vinā ādeśāt vihartum krīḍitum ciram bhrātrā amātyena suhṛdā kena api ca sutena ca  /

original: yenakenacidanyāyādavamanya dhaneśvaram | vihāraḥ kriyate darpātsa vinaśyedasaṃśayam || 16 ||
analyzed: yena kenacid anyāyāt avamanya dhaneśvaram vihāraḥ kriyate darpāt sa vinaśyet asaṃśayam

original: evaṃ sa rākṣasairghorairvaḍalo vinivāritaḥ | mā maivamiti sakrodhaṃ bhartsayadbhiḥ samaṃtataḥ || 17 ||
analyzed: evam sa rākṣasaiḥ ghoraiḥ vaḍalaḥ vinivāritaḥ mā mā evam iti sa krodham bhartsayadbhiḥ samaṃtataḥ  /

original: kadarthīkṛtya tu sa tānrākṣasānbhīmavikramaḥ | vyagāhata mahātejāste sarve taṃ nyavārayan || 18 ||
analyzed: kadarthīkṛtya tu sa tān rākṣasān bhīma vikramaḥ vyagāhata mahā tejāḥ te sarve tam nyavārayan

original: gṛhṇīta badhnīta nikṛntatainaṃ pibāma khādāma ca vṛttahīnam | kruddhā bruvaṃto hyapatandrutaṃ te śastrāṇi codyamya vivṛttanetrāḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: gṛhṇīta badhnīta nikṛntata enam pibāma khādāma ca vṛtta hīnam  kruddhāḥ bruvaṃtaḥ hi apatan drutam te śastrāṇi ca udyamya vivṛtta netrāḥ

original: tataḥ sa gurvīṃ yamadaṇḍakalpāṃ mahāgadāṃ kāṃcanapaṭṭanaddhām | pragṛhya tāmabhyapatattarasvī tato'bravīttiṣṭhata tiṣṭhateti || 20 ||
analyzed: tatas sa gurvīm yama daṇḍa kalpām mahā gadām kāṃcana paṭṭa naddhām pragṛhya tām abhyapatat tarasvī tatas abravīt tiṣṭhata tiṣṭhata iti  /

original: te tasya vīryaṃ ca valaṃ ca dṛṣṭvā vidyābalaṃ bāhubalaṃ tathaiva | na śaknuvaṃtaḥ sahituṃ sametā hatāḥ pravīrāḥ sahasā nivṛttāḥ || 21 ||
analyzed: te tasya vīryam ca valam ca dṛṣṭvā vidyā balam bāhu balam tathā eva  na śaknuvaṃtaḥ sahitum sametāḥ hatāḥ pravīrāḥ sahasā nivṛttāḥ  /

original: vidāryamāṇāstata eva tūrṇamākāśamāsthāya vimūḍhasaṃjñāḥ | kailāsaśṛṃgāṇyabhi dudruvuste yakṣārditā rakṣapālāḥ prabhagnāḥ || 22 ||
analyzed: vidāryamāṇāḥ tatas eva tūrṇam ākāśam āsthāya vimūḍha saṃjñāḥ kailāsa śṛṃgāṇi abhi dudruvuḥ te yakṣa arditāḥ rakṣa pālāḥ prabhagnāḥ  /

original: sa śakravaddānavadaityasaṃghānvikramya jitvā madanābhitaptaḥ | vigāhya tāṃ puṣkariṇīṃ samarthaḥ kāmaṃ sa cikrīḍati yakṣaputraḥ || 23 ||
analyzed: sa śakra vat dānava daitya saṃghān vikramya jitvā madana abhitaptaḥ vigāhya tām puṣkariṇīm samarthaḥ kāmam sa cikrīḍati yakṣa putraḥ  /

original: tatastu te rakṣapālāḥ sametya dhaneśvaraṃ vai vaḍalena nunnāḥ | yakṣasya dhairyaṃ subalaṃ ca saṃkhye yathāvadācakhyuratīva bhītāḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: tatas tu te rakṣa pālāḥ sametya dhaneśvaram vai vaḍalena nunnāḥ yakṣasya dhairyam su balam ca saṃkhye yathāvat ācakhyuḥ atīva bhītāḥ

original: teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ śrutvā maṇibhadro mahāyaśāḥ | śaśāpa putraṃ dayitaṃ vaḍalaṃ prabhukāraṇāt || 25 ||
analyzed: teṣām tu vacanam śrutvā maṇibhadraḥ mahā yaśāḥ śaśāpa putram dayitam vaḍalam prabhu kāraṇāt

original: yasmātsā nalinī ramyā sevitā vaḍalena tu | dayitā dhanadasyāpi yathā mātā tathaiva sā || 26 ||
analyzed: yasmāt sā nalinī ramyā sevitā vaḍalena tu dayitā dhanadasya api yathā mātā tathā eva sā

original: tasmātputro madīyastu sarvabhāgavivarjitaḥ | paṃgvandho badhiro dīnaḥ kṣayarogamavāpsyati || 27 ||
analyzed: tasmāt putraḥ madīyaḥ tu sarva bhāga vivarjitaḥ paṃgu andhaḥ badhiraḥ dīnaḥ kṣaya rogam avāpsyati  /

original: iti śaptastadā jāto vaḍalo bhogavarjitaḥ | patito bhūtale caiva tasminsthāne gato'pi san || 28 ||
analyzed: iti śaptaḥ tadā jātaḥ vaḍalaḥ bhoga varjitaḥ patitaḥ bhū tale ca eva tasmin sthāne gataḥ api san  /

original: pīḍitaḥ kṣayarogeṇa na śaśāka viceṣṭitum | andho'tha badhiro jāto guruśāpahatastadā || 29 ||
analyzed: pīḍitaḥ kṣaya rogeṇa na śaśāka viceṣṭitum andhaḥ atha badhiraḥ jātaḥ guru śāpa hataḥ tadā

original: ciṃtayāmāsa sahasā śāpamatyadbhutaṃ mahat | śapto'haṃ kena sahasā jīvanyonyaṃtaraṃ gataḥ || 30 ||
analyzed: ciṃtayāmāsa sahasā śāpam ati adbhutam mahat śaptaḥ aham kena sahasā jīvan yoni aṃtaram gataḥ

original: kathaṃ śapto'smi tātena maṇibhadreṇa vallabhaḥ | putro yuvā ca śūraśca śatrupakṣakṣayaṃkaraḥ || 31 ||
analyzed: katham śaptaḥ asmi tātena maṇibhadreṇa vallabhaḥ putraḥ yuvā ca śūraḥ ca śatru pakṣa kṣayaṃkaraḥ

original: dhanyo'sau maṇibhadro'pi mattāto yena bhūtale | prabhubhaktyā nijaḥ putraḥ śaptastyaktaśca tatkṣaṇāt || 32 ||
analyzed: dhanyaḥ asau maṇibhadraḥ api mad tātaḥ yena bhū tale prabhu bhaktyā nijaḥ putraḥ śaptaḥ tyaktaḥ ca tad kṣaṇāt

original: vaḍalena punaḥ proktaṃ dhanyo'haṃ prabhukāraṇāt | utsavo nidhanaṃnāma bhartṛpiṇḍopajīvinām || 33 ||
analyzed: vaḍalena punar proktam dhanyaḥ aham prabhu kāraṇāt  utsavaḥ nidhanam nāma bhartṛ piṇḍa upajīvinām

original: anyāyena yathākāmaṃ prārabdhaḥ saṃcitaściram | tenāhaṃ śāpatāṃ prāpto yāsyāmi narakaṃ dhruvam || 34 ||
analyzed: anyāyena yathākāmam prārabdhaḥ saṃcitaḥ ciram tena aham śāpa tām prāptaḥ yāsyāmi narakam dhruvam

original: evaṃ vilapatastasya vaḍalasya varānane | ājagāma tamuddeśaṃ maṇibhadro mahābalaḥ | dadarśa putraṃ paṃgvaṃdhaṃ kṣayarogaprapīḍitam || 35 ||
analyzed: evam vilapataḥ tasya vaḍalasya varānane  ājagāma tam uddeśam maṇibhadraḥ mahā balaḥ dadarśa putram paṃgu aṃdham kṣaya roga prapīḍitam  /

original: niḥśvasaṃtaṃ suduḥkhārttaṃ vila paṃtaṃ punaḥpunaḥ | pratyuvāca sutaṃ yakṣo maṇibhadro'tiduḥkhitaḥ | mayā kupitrā hā vatsa śaptastvaṃ prabhukāraṇāt || 36 ||
analyzed: niḥśvasaṃtam su duḥkha ārttam punar punar  pratyuvāca sutam yakṣaḥ maṇibhadraḥ ati duḥkhitaḥ mayā kupitrā hā vatsa śaptaḥ tvam prabhu kāraṇāt

original: tvayeyaṃ nalinī ramyā dhana dasyātivallabhā | sevitā kāmataptena pravarā rākṣasā hatāḥ || 37 ||
analyzed: tvayā iyam nalinī ramyā dhana dasya ati vallabhā sevitā kāma taptena pravarāḥ rākṣasāḥ hatāḥ  /

original: tasmātputra mayā śapto na mithyā sa bhaviṣyati | prabhurdevaḥ prabhuḥ svāmī prabhurmātā prabhuḥ pitā || 38 ||
analyzed: tasmāt putra mayā śaptaḥ na mithyā sa bhaviṣyati prabhuḥ devaḥ prabhuḥ svāmī prabhuḥ mātā prabhuḥ pitā

original: svāmyarthe yaḥ priyānprāṇānparityajati saṃgare | sa yāti paramaṃ sthānaṃ brahmalokaṃ sanātanam || 39 ||
analyzed: svāmi arthe yaḥ priyān prāṇān parityajati saṃgare sa yāti paramam sthānam brahma lokam sanātanam  /

original: na mantrasādhyaḥ śāpoyaṃ nauṣadhena vratena ca | niyamena ca dānena tasmānmadvacanaṃ kuru || 40 ||
analyzed: na mantra sādhyaḥ śāpaḥ yam na auṣadhena vratena ca niyamena ca dānena tasmāt mad vacanam kuru  /

original: mayā śrutaṃ śakraloke purāṇaṃ skaṃdakīrttitam | bruvato nāradasyaiva devānāṃ saṃnidhau purā || 41 ||
analyzed: mayā śrutam śakra loke purāṇam skaṃda kīrttitam bruvataḥ nāradasya eva devānām saṃnidhau purā

original: prabhāvo varṇitastena mahākālavanasya ca | kṣetre hyasminmahāliṃgaṃ svargadvārasya dakṣiṇe || 42 ||
analyzed: prabhāvaḥ varṇitaḥ tena mahākāla vanasya ca kṣetre hi asmin mahā liṃgam svargadvārasya dakṣiṇe  /

original: vidyate vyādhiśamanaṃ rūpasaubhāgyadāyakam | tatrāhaṃ tvāṃ ca neṣyāmi vimānenāśugāminā || 43 ||
analyzed: vidyate vyādhi śamanam rūpa saubhāgya dāyakam tatra aham tvām ca neṣyāmi vimānena āśu gāminā

original: ityuktvā maṇibhadreṇa samānītaḥ sutastadā | yatra devādhidevo'sau svargadvārasya dakṣiṇe || 44 ||
analyzed: iti uktvā maṇibhadreṇa samānītaḥ sutaḥ tadā yatra deva adhidevaḥ asau svargadvārasya dakṣiṇe  /

original: sparśanāttasya liṃgasya cakṣuṣmānrūpavānbalī | supādaḥ śrutisaṃyuktastatkṣaṇādabhavattadā || 45 ||
analyzed: sparśanāt tasya liṃgasya cakṣuṣmān rūpavān balī su pādaḥ śruti saṃyuktaḥ tad kṣaṇāt abhavat tadā  /

original: dṛṣṭvā sumahadāścaryaṃ maṇibhadreṇa pārvati | kṛtaṃ nāma suhṛṣṭena svīyaputrasya nāmataḥ | cakṣuṣmānvaḍalo jāto liṃgasyāsya prabhāvataḥ || 46 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭvā su mahat āścaryam maṇibhadreṇa pārvati kṛtam nāma su hṛṣṭena svīya putrasya nāmataḥ cakṣuṣmān vaḍalaḥ jātaḥ liṃgasya asya prabhāvataḥ   /

original: adyaprabhṛti devo'yaṃ vaḍaleśvarasaṃjñakaḥ | bhaviṣyati trilokeṣu vikhyāto netradāyakaḥ || 47 ||
analyzed: adya prabhṛti devaḥ ayam vaḍaleśvara saṃjñakaḥ bhaviṣyati tri lokeṣu vikhyātaḥ netra dāyakaḥ

original: pūjayiṣyaṃti ye devaṃ vaḍaleśvarasaṃjñakam | liṃgaṃ lokeṣu vikhyātaṃ te prāpsyaṃti manoratham || 48 ||
analyzed: pūjayiṣyaṃti ye devam vaḍaleśvara saṃjñakam  liṃgam lokeṣu vikhyātam te prāpsyaṃti manoratham

original: dṛṣṭo harati pāpāni spṛṣṭo rājyaṃ prayacchati | arcito bhaktibhāvena mokṣaṃ dadyānna saṃśayaḥ || 49 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭaḥ harati pāpāni spṛṣṭaḥ rājyam prayacchati arcitaḥ bhakti bhāvena mokṣam dadyāt na saṃśayaḥ

original: kārttike śuklapakṣasya tithirvai dvādaśī bhavet | tasyāṃ ye pūjayiṣyaṃti vaḍaleśvarasaṃjñakam || 50 ||
analyzed: kārttike śukla pakṣasya tithiḥ vai dvādaśī bhavet tasyām ye pūjayiṣyaṃti vaḍaleśvara saṃjñakam

original: dānaṃ taiḥ satataṃ dattaṃ te yāṃti paramaṃ padam | prayāge ca prabhāse ca gaṃgāsāgarasaṃgame || 51 ||
analyzed: dānam taiḥ satatam dattam te yāṃti paramam padam prayāge ca prabhāse ca gaṃgāsāgara saṃgame

original: tapastaptaṃ bhavettaistu te muktā nātra saṃśayaḥ | garbhavāse na jāyaṃte sarvasaukhyasamanvitāḥ || 52 ||
analyzed: tapaḥ taptam bhavet taiḥ tu te muktāḥ na atra saṃśayaḥ garbha vāse na jāyaṃte sarva saukhya samanvitāḥ

original: gāṇapatyā bhaviṣyaṃti śaṃkarasya sadā priyāḥ | saubhāgyarūpasaṃpannāḥ putrapautraiśca saṃyutāḥ | jāyaṃte mānavā loke vaḍaleśvaradarśanāt || 53 ||
analyzed: gāṇapatyāḥ bhaviṣyaṃti śaṃkarasya sadā priyāḥ saubhāgya rūpa saṃpannāḥ putra pautraiḥ ca saṃyutāḥ jāyaṃte mānavāḥ loke vaḍaleśvara darśanāt

original: garbhavāse mahākaṣṭe yasya vāso na rocate | so'bhyarcayatu bhāvena vaḍaleśvaramīśvaram || 54 ||
analyzed: garbha vāse mahā kaṣṭe yasya vāsaḥ na rocate saḥ abhyarcayatu bhāvena vaḍaleśvaram īśvaram  /

original: na liṃgena vinā siddhirdurlabhaṃ paramaṃ padam | gatirna jāyate svarge yāvalliṃgaṃ tu nārcayet || 55 ||
analyzed: na liṃgena vinā siddhiḥ durlabham paramam padam  gatiḥ na jāyate svarge yāvat liṃgam tu na arcayet  /

original: liṃgārcana vihīnānāṃ siddhiścāpi sudurlabhā | mama putreṇa saṃprāptamīpsitaṃ liṃgato yataḥ || 56 ||
analyzed: liṃga arcana vihīnānām siddhiḥ ca api su durlabhā mama putreṇa saṃprāptam īpsitam liṃgataḥ yatas  /

original: ityuktvā maṇibhadro'pi sutena sahito yayau | yatra devo dhanādhyakṣaḥ sthānaṃ svaṃ paramaṃ gataḥ || 57 ||
analyzed: iti uktvā maṇibhadraḥ api sutena sahitaḥ yayau yatra devaḥ dhanādhyakṣaḥ sthānam svam paramam gataḥ   /

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | vaḍaleśvaradevasya śrūyatāmaruṇeśvaram || 58 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ vaḍaleśvara devasya śrūyatām aruṇeśvaram

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ paṃcama āvaṃtyakhaṇḍe caturaśītiliṅgamāhātmya umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde vaḍaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāma paṃcasaptatitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 75 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām paṃcame āvaṃtya khaṇḍe caturaśīti liṅga māhātmye umā maheśvara saṃvāde vaḍaleśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam nāma paṃcasaptatitamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /

original: īśvara uvāca | ṣaṭsaptatitamaṃ devamaruṇeśvarasaṃjñakam | viddhi pāpaharaṃ devi darśanātkāmadaṃ nṛṇām || 1 ||
analyzed: īśvaraḥ uvāca ṣaṭsaptatitamam devam aruṇeśvara saṃjñakam  viddhi pāpa haram devi darśanāt kāma dam nṛṇām

original: purā devayuge devi prajāpatisute śubhe | āstāṃ bhaginyau rūpeṇa samupete'dbhute'naghe || 2 ||
analyzed: purā deva yuge devi prajāpati sute śubhe  āstām bhaginyau rūpeṇa samupete adbhute anaghe

original: te bhārye kaśyapasyāstāṃ kadrūśca vinatā tathā | prādāttābhyāṃ varaṃ prītaḥ prajāpatisamaḥ patiḥ || 3 ||
analyzed: te bhārye kaśyapasya āstām kadrūḥ ca vinatā tathā prādāt tābhyām varam prītaḥ prajāpati samaḥ patiḥ  /

original: kaśyapo dharmapatnībhyāṃ mudā paramayā yutaḥ | varātisargaṃ śrutvaiva kaśyapāduttamaṃ tu te || 4 ||
analyzed: kaśyapaḥ dharma patnībhyām mudā paramayā yutaḥ vara atisargam śrutvā eva kaśyapāt uttamam tu te  /

original: harṣādabhyadhikāṃ prītiṃ prāpatuḥ sma varastriyau | vavre kadrūḥ sutānnāgānsahasraṃ tulyavarcasaḥ || 5 ||
analyzed: harṣāt abhyadhikām prītim prāpatuḥ sma vara striyau  vavre kadrūḥ sutān nāgān sahasram tulya varcasaḥ

original: dvau putrau vinatā vavre kadrūputrādhikau bale | ojasā tejasā caiva vikrameṇādhikau ca tau || 6 ||
analyzed: dvau putrau vinatā vavre kadrū putra adhikau bale  ojasā tejasā ca eva vikrameṇa adhikau ca tau  /

original: tasyai bharttā varaṃ prādāllapsyase putrakottamau | evamastviti tāṃ cāha kaśyapo vinatāṃ tadā || 7 ||
analyzed: tasyai bharttā varam prādāt lapsyase putraka uttamau evam astu iti tām ca āha kaśyapaḥ vinatām tadā

original: yathā ca prārthitaṃ labdhvā varaṃ tuṣṭā'bhavattadā | kṛtakṛtyā tu vinatā labdhvā vīryādhikau sutau || 8 ||
analyzed: yathā ca prārthitam labdhvā varam tuṣṭā abhavat tadā kṛtakṛtyā tu vinatā labdhvā vīrya adhikau sutau

original: kadrūśca labdhvā putrāṇāṃ sahasraṃ tulyatejasām | dhāryau garbhau prayatnena ityuktvā sa mahātapāḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: kadrūḥ ca labdhvā putrāṇām sahasram tulya tejasām dhāryau garbhau prayatnena iti uktvā sa mahā tapāḥ

original: te bhārye varasaṃhṛṣṭe kaśyapo vanamāviśat | kālena mahatā kadrūrnāgānāṃ sā śatīrdaśa | janayāmāsa cārvaṃgī dve cāṃḍe vinatā tadā || 10 ||
analyzed: te bhārye vara saṃhṛṣṭe kaśyapaḥ vanam āviśat kālena mahatā kadrūḥ nāgānām sā śatīḥ daśa janayāmāsa cāru aṃgī dve cāṃḍe vinatā tadā

original: tayoraṃḍāni nidadhuḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ paricārikāḥ | sopasvedeṣu bhāṃḍeṣu paṃcavarṣaśatāni ca || 11 ||
analyzed: tayoḥ aṃḍāni nidadhuḥ prahṛṣṭāḥ paricārikāḥ sa upasvedeṣu bhāṃḍeṣu paṃca varṣa śatāni ca

original: tataḥ paṃcaśate kāle kadrūputrā vinirgatāḥ | aṃḍabhyāṃ vinatāyāstu mithunaṃ na vyadṛśyata || 12 ||
analyzed: tatas paṃcaśate kāle kadru putrāḥ vinirgatāḥ aṃḍabhyām vinatāyāḥ tu mithunam na vyadṛśyata  /

original: tataḥ putrārthinī devī vrīḍitā sā tapasvinī | aṃḍaṃ bibheda vinatā tatra putraṃ dadarśa ha || 13 ||
analyzed: tatas putra arthinī devī vrīḍitā sā tapasvinī  aṃḍam bibheda vinatā tatra putram dadarśa ha  /

original: pūrvārddhakāyasaṃpannamitareṇā prakāśitam | sa putro roṣasaṃrabdhaḥ śaśāpaināmiti śrutam || 14 ||
analyzed: pūrva arddha kāya saṃpannam itareṇa prakāśitam sa putraḥ roṣa saṃrabdhaḥ śaśāpa enām iti śrutam

original: yo'hamevaṃ kṛto mātastvayā lobhaparītayā | śarīreṇāsamagreṇa tasmāddāsī bhaviṣyasi || 15 ||
analyzed: yaḥ aham evam kṛtaḥ mātar tvayā lobha parītayā śarīreṇa asamagreṇa tasmāt dāsī bhaviṣyasi  /

original: paṃcavarṣaśatānyasyā yayā visparddhase sadā | eṣa te ca suto mātardāsyādvai mokṣayiṣyati || 16 ||
analyzed: paṃca varṣa śatāni asyāḥ yayā visparddhase sadā eṣa te ca sutaḥ mātar dāsyāt vai mokṣayiṣyati  /

original: yadyenamapi mātastvaṃ māmivāṃḍavibhedanāt | na kariṣyasyanaṃgaṃ vā putraṃ cāti tarasvinam || 17 ||
analyzed: yadi enam api mātar tvam mām iva aṃḍa vibhedanāt  na kariṣyasi anaṃgam vā putram ca ati tarasvinam  /

original: pratipālayitavyaste janmakālo'sya dhīrayā | viśiṣṭabalamīpsaṃtyā paṃcavarṣaśatānyataḥ || 18 ||
analyzed: pratipālayitavyaḥ te janma kālaḥ asya dhīrayā viśiṣṭa balam īpsaṃtyā paṃca varṣa śatāni atas  /

original: evaṃ śaptvā tato devi vinatāṃ mātaraṃ svakam | aruṇo vilalāpātha vāṣpaśokapariplutaḥ || 19 ||
analyzed: evam śaptvā tatas devi vinatām mātaram svakam  aruṇaḥ vilalāpa atha vāṣpa śoka pariplutaḥ

original: hāhā mayā nṛśaṃsena mātā svajananī svakā | śaptā vināparādhena kathaṃ yāsyāmi sadgatim | mātā dehāraṇiḥ puṃsāṃ mātā duḥkhasahā parā || 20 ||
analyzed: hāhā mayā nṛśaṃsena mātā sva jananī svakā  śaptā vinā aparādhena katham yāsyāmi sat gatim mātā deha araṇiḥ puṃsām mātā duḥkha sahā parā

original: garbhakleśe paraṃ duḥkhaṃ mātā jānāti yādṛśam | vātsalyaṃ cādhikaṃ māturdṛśyate na tu paitṛkam || 21 ||
analyzed: garbha kleśe param duḥkham mātā jānāti yādṛśam vātsalyam ca adhikam mātuḥ dṛśyate na tu paitṛkam

original: gurūṇāmeva sarveṣāṃ mātā gurutarā smṛtā | ekasyāpi sutasyaiva na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ śrutau || 22 ||
analyzed: gurūṇām eva sarveṣām mātā gurutarā smṛtā ekasya api sutasya eva na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛtiḥ śrutau  /

original: yadi piṃḍapradānaṃ tu gayāyāṃ kurute sutaḥ | gate pitari paṃcatvaṃ mātā putrasya nirvṛtiḥ | na ca mātṛvihīnasya mamatvaṃ kurute pitā || 23 ||
analyzed: yadi piṃḍa pradānam tu gayāyām kurute sutaḥ gate pitari paṃcatvam mātā putrasya nirvṛtiḥ na ca mātṛ vihīnasya mamatvam kurute pitā

original: vikalo mātṛhīnastu putro hi procyate tadā | yadā sa vṛddho bhavati tadā bhavati duḥkhitaḥ | tadā śūnyaṃ jagatsarvaṃ yadā mātā viyujyate || 24 ||
analyzed: vikalaḥ mātṛ hīnaḥ tu putraḥ hi procyate tadā  yadā sa vṛddhaḥ bhavati tadā bhavati duḥkhitaḥ tadā śūnyam jagat sarvam yadā mātā viyujyate

original: so'haṃ pāpasamācāro jāto mātṛvihiṃsakaḥ | mariṣyāmi na saṃdehaḥ sādhayitvā hutāśanam || 25 ||
analyzed: saḥ aham pāpa samācāraḥ jātaḥ mātṛ vihiṃsakaḥ mariṣyāmi na saṃdehaḥ sādhayitvā hutāśanam

original: jāto'haṃ vikalāṃgastu prākkṛtenaiva karmaṇā | na mātā kāraṇaṃ yasmātsvakīyaṃ karma bhujyate || 26 ||

original: tuṣṭe bharttari nārīṇāṃ tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarvadevatāḥ | vimukhe vimukhāḥ sarve tasmātsevyaḥ sadā patiḥ | bhasmībhavati sā nārī yayā bharttā na toṣitaḥ || 36 ||
analyzed: tuṣṭe bharttari nārīṇām tuṣṭāḥ syuḥ sarva devatāḥ vimukhe vimukhāḥ sarve tasmāt sevyaḥ sadā patiḥ bhasmībhavati sā nārī yayā bharttā na toṣitaḥ  /

original: yasya prasādātprāpyaṃte bhogāśca vividhāḥ sadā | taṃ vaśyaṃ kurute yā ca sā kathaṃ sukhamāpnuyāt || 37 ||
analyzed: yasya prasādāt prāpyaṃte bhogāḥ ca vividhāḥ sadā tam vaśyam kurute yā ca sā katham sukham āpnuyāt  /

original: tiryagyoniśataṃ yāti kṛmipakṣiśatāni ca | tasmāttattatsadā kāryaṃ strībhirbhartṛvacaḥ kila || 38 ||
analyzed: tiryagyoni śatam yāti kṛmi pakṣi śatāni ca tasmāt tat tat sadā kāryam strībhiḥ bhartṛ vacaḥ kila  /

original: evaṃ punarmayā bhuktā narakā bhṛśadāruṇāḥ | tiryagyonisahasraṃ tu karmaṇā kutsitena ca || 39 ||
analyzed: evam punar mayā bhuktāḥ narakāḥ bhṛśa dāruṇāḥ tiryagyoni sahasram tu karmaṇā kutsitena ca  /

original: kiṃcitpātakaśuddhyarthaṃ caṃḍālasya ca veśmani | jātāhamatirūpeṇa pīḍitā vividhairvraṇaiḥ || 40 ||
analyzed: kiṃcid pātaka śuddhi artham caṃḍālasya ca veśmani jātā aham ati rūpeṇa pīḍitā vividhaiḥ vraṇaiḥ   /

original: sārameyairvṛtā dīnā bhakṣyamāṇā punaḥpunaḥ | duṣṭāhaṃ bhakṣyamāṇāpi mārge ruddhā vṛkairaham | tairahaṃ tudyamānāpi mahākālavanaṃ gatā || 41 ||
analyzed: sārameyaiḥ vṛtā dīnā bhakṣyamāṇā punar punar  duṣṭā aham bhakṣyamāṇā api mārge ruddhā vṛkaiḥ aham  taiḥ aham tudyamānā api mahākāla vanam gatā  /

original: dṛṣṭo mayā mahādevo daivato mṛgamāṇayā | samīpe devadevasya pippalādeśvarasya ca || 42 ||
analyzed: dṛṣṭaḥ mayā mahādevaḥ daivataḥ mṛgamāṇayā samīpe devadevasya pippalāda īśvarasya ca  /

original: tasya darśanamātreṇa gatā śakrapuraṃ prati | vimānena sudīptena kiṃkiṇījālamālinā | divyāṃbaradharā divyā divyamālāvibhūṣaṇā || 43 ||
analyzed: tasya darśana mātreṇa gatā śakra puram prati vimānena su dīptena kiṃkiṇī jāla mālinā divya aṃbara dharā divyā divya mālā vibhūṣaṇā

original: tatrāhaṃ pūjitā devaiḥ stutāhaṃ cāraṇaistathā | darśanāttasya liṃgasya jātāhaṃ tava veśmani || 44 ||
analyzed: tatra aham pūjitā devaiḥ stutā aham cāraṇaiḥ tathā darśanāt tasya liṃgasya jātā aham tava veśmani

original: vallabhā rūpasaṃpannā śākale nagare śubhe | smṛtvā tu kutsitāṃ yoniṃ vilāpaśca kṛto mayā || 45 ||
analyzed: vallabhā rūpa saṃpannā śākale nagare śubhe smṛtvā tu kutsitām yonim vilāpaḥ ca kṛtaḥ mayā  /

original: smṛtvā liṃgasya māhātmyaṃ harṣo jātastu tatkṣaṇāt | tanme naiva ca vātūlyaṃ gṛhītā na graheṇa ca || 46 ||
analyzed: smṛtvā liṃgasya māhātmyam harṣaḥ jātaḥ tu tad kṣaṇāt tat me nā eva ca vātūlyam gṛhītāḥ na graheṇa ca  /

original: jātā jātismarā tāta brahmacaryavrate sthitā | ato yāsyāmi taṃ devaṃ darśanārthaṃ punaḥ prabho | yathā na bhūyo me janma syācca saṃsārasāgare || 47 ||
analyzed: jātā jātismarā tāta brahmacarya vrate sthitā  atas yāsyāmi tam devam darśana artham punar prabho yathā na bhūyas me janma syāt ca saṃsāra sāgare

original: iti putrīvacaḥ śrutvā citraseno mahīpatiḥ | sabhṛtyamaṃtrisahito mahākālavanaṃ gataḥ || 48 ||
analyzed: iti putrī vacaḥ śrutvā citrasenaḥ mahīpatiḥ sa bhṛtya maṃtri sahitaḥ mahākālavanam gataḥ

original: dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ | sāpi dṛṣṭvaiva talliṃgaṃ tasmiṃlliṃge layaṃ gatā || 49 ||
analyzed: dadarśa tatra tat liṃgam pūjayāmāsa bhaktitaḥ sā api dṛṣṭvā eva tat liṃgam tasmin liṃge layam gatā  /

original: rājā ca putravāñjāto liṃgadarśanataḥ priye | babhūva cakravartī sa yathā svāyaṃbhuvo manuḥ || 50 ||
analyzed: rājā ca putravān jātaḥ liṃga darśanataḥ priye babhūva cakravartī sa yathā svāyaṃbhuvaḥ manuḥ  /

original: etasminnaṃtare devi dṛṣṭvā deve layaṃ gatām | rājaputrīṃ mahādevi kṛtaṃ nāma mudānvitaiḥ || 51 ||
analyzed: etasmin antare devi dṛṣṭvā deve layam gatām  rājaputrīm mahādevi kṛtam nāma mudā anvitaiḥ

original: avimuktasya liṃgasya darśanādeva tatkṣaṇāt | avimukteśvaro deva iti khyāto bhavatviti || 52 ||
analyzed: avimuktasya liṃgasya darśanāt eva tad kṣaṇāt avimukteśvaraḥ devaḥ iti khyātaḥ bhavatu iti

original: yo'sau kāśyāṃ prasiddho'sti devo viśveśvaraḥ śivaḥ | sa caivātra suvikhyāto'vimukteśvarasaṃjñayā || 53 ||
analyzed: yaḥ asau kāśyām prasiddhaḥ asti devaḥ viśveśvaraḥ śivaḥ  sa ca eva atra su vikhyātaḥ avimukteśvara saṃjñayā  /

original: vārāṇasī yathā puṇyā tathāvaṃtī ca muktidā | tasyā daśaguṇaṃ puṇyaṃ śrūyate'tra viśeṣataḥ || 54 ||
analyzed: vārāṇasī yathā puṇyā tathā avaṃtī ca mukti dā tasyāḥ daśaguṇam puṇyam śrūyate atra viśeṣataḥ

original: tasmādviśveśvaro devaḥ samāyātaḥ kuśasthalīm | yatrāgatya suvidvāṃso mānavāḥ śaṃsitavratāḥ || 55 ||
analyzed: tasmāt viśveśvaraḥ devaḥ samāyātaḥ kuśasthalīm  yatra āgatya su vidvāṃsaḥ mānavāḥ śaṃsita vratāḥ

original: paśyaṃti parayā bhaktyā hyavimukteśvaraṃ śivam | teṣāṃ muktirna saṃdeho bhaviṣyati suniścalā || 56 ||
analyzed: paśyanti parayā bhaktyā hi avimukteśvaram śivam teṣām muktiḥ na saṃdehaḥ bhaviṣyati su niścalā

original: amuktā naiva paśyaṃti muktāḥ paśyaṃti sarvadā | brahmacaryavrataiḥ samyagiṣṭaiḥ sarvamakhairbhavet || 57 ||
analyzed: amuktāḥ na eva paśyaṃti muktāḥ paśyaṃti sarvadā brahmacarya vrataiḥ samyak iṣṭaiḥ sarva makhaiḥ bhavet  /

original: tatphalaṃ prāpyate samyagavimukteśadarśanāt | naiḥśreyasī gatiḥ puṇyā darśanādeva jāyate || 58 ||
analyzed: tat phalam prāpyate samyak avimukta īśa darśanāt naiḥśreyasī gatiḥ puṇyā darśanāt eva jāyate   /

original: yā gatiḥ prāpyate sāṃkhyaiyogairvā yā gatirbhavet | sā gatiḥ nāpyate samyagavimukteśadarśanāt || 59 ||
analyzed: yā gatiḥ prāpyate sāṃkhyaiḥ yogaiḥ vā yā gatiḥ bhavet sā gatiḥ na āpyate samyak avimukta īśa darśanāt  /

original: janmamṛtyubhayaṃ hitvā sa yāti paramāṃ gatim | yaḥ pūjayati bhāvena hyavimukteśvaraṃ śivam || 60 ||
analyzed: janma mṛtyu bhayam hitvā sa yāti paramām gatim yaḥ pūjayati bhāvena hi avimukteśvaram śivam

original: brahmahāpi ca yo gacchedavimukteśvaraṃ yajet | tasya liṃgasya māhātmyātsarvvapāpānnivarttate || 61 ||
analyzed: brahma hā api ca yaḥ gacchet avimukteśvaram yajet tasya liṃgasya māhātmyāt sarvva pāpāt nivarttate

original: śāṭhyenāpi ca yaḥ paśyedavimukte śvaraṃ śivam | sa muṃcati jarāṃ mṛtyuṃ janma caitadaśāśvatam || 62 ||
analyzed: śāṭhyena api ca yaḥ paśyet avimukte śvaram śivam  sa muṃcati jarām mṛtyum janma ca etat aśāśvatam

original: smṛtaḥ saṃpūjito bhaktyā stuto vā vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ | muktiṃ dadāti deveśo hyavi mukteśvaraḥ śivaḥ || 63 ||
analyzed: smṛtaḥ saṃpūjitaḥ bhaktyā stutaḥ vā vividhaiḥ stavaiḥ muktim dadāti deveśaḥ mukteśvaraḥ śivaḥ

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | avimukteśvareśasya hanumatkeśvaraṃ śṛṇu || 64 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ avimukteśvara īśasya śṛṇu  /

original: śrīmahādeva uvāca | ekonāśītikaṃ viddhi hanumatkeśvaraṃ priye | yasya darśanamātreṇa samīhitaphalaṃ labhet || 1 ||
analyzed: śrī mahādevaḥ uvāca  ekonāśītikam viddhi hanumant keśvaram priye yasya darśana mātreṇa samīhita phalam labhet  /

original: prāptarājyasya rāmasya rākṣasānāṃ vadhe kṛte | āgatā munayo devi rāghavaṃ pratinaṃditum || 2 ||
analyzed: prāpta rājyasya rāmasya rākṣasānām vadhe kṛte āgatāḥ munayaḥ devi rāghavam pratinaṃditum

original: rāmeṇa pūjitāḥ sarve hyagastipramukhā dvijāḥ | prahṛṣṭamanaso viprā rāmaṃ vacanamabruvan || 3 ||
analyzed: rāmeṇa pūjitāḥ sarve hi agasti pramukhāḥ dvijāḥ prahṛṣṭa manasaḥ viprāḥ rāmam vacanam abruvan

original: diṣṭyā tu nihato rāma rāvaṇaḥ putrapautravān | diṣṭyā vijayinaṃ tvā'dya paśyāmaḥ saha bhāryayā || 4 ||
analyzed: diṣṭyā tu nihataḥ rāma rāvaṇaḥ putra pautravān  diṣṭyā vijayinam tvā adya paśyāmaḥ saha bhāryayā

original: hanūmatā ca sahitaṃ vānareṇa mahātmanā | diṣṭyā pavanaputreṇa rākṣasāṃtakareṇa ca || 5 ||
analyzed: hanūmatā ca sahitam vānareṇa mahātmanā diṣṭyā pavanaputreṇa rākṣasa aṃta kareṇa ca  /

original: ciraṃ jīvatu dīrghāyurvānaro hanumānsadā | aṃjanīgarbhasaṃbhūto rudrāṃśo hi dharātale || 6 ||
analyzed: ciram jīvatu dīrgha āyūḥ vānaraḥ hanumān sadā  aṃjanī garbha saṃbhūtaḥ rudra aṃśaḥ hi dharā tale

original: ākhaṃḍalo'gnirbhagavānyamo vai niṛtistathā | varuṇaḥ pavanaścaiva dhanādhyakṣastathā śivaḥ | brahmaṇā sahitāścaiva dikpālāḥ pātu sarvadā || 7 ||
analyzed: ākhaṃḍalaḥ agniḥ bhagavān yamaḥ vai niṛtiḥ tathā varuṇaḥ pavanaḥ ca eva dhanādhyakṣaḥ tathā śivaḥ brahmaṇā sahitāḥ ca eva dikpālāḥ pātu sarvadā  /

original: śrutvā teṣāṃ tu vacanaṃ munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām | vismayaṃ paramaṃ gatvā rāmaḥ prāṃjalirabravīt || 8 ||
analyzed: śrutvā teṣām tu vacanam munīnām bhāvitātmanām vismayam paramam gatvā rāmaḥ prāṃjaliḥ abravīt

original: kimarthaṃ lakṣmaṇaṃ tyaktvā vānaro'yaṃ praśaṃsitaḥ | kīdṛśaḥ kiṃprabhāvo vā kiṃvīryaḥ kiṃparākramaḥ || 9 ||
analyzed: kimartham lakṣmaṇam tyaktvā vānaraḥ ayam praśaṃsitaḥ kīdṛśaḥ kiṃprabhāvaḥ vā kiṃvīryaḥ kiṃparākramaḥ   /

original: athocuḥ satyamevaitatkāraṇaṃ vānarottame | na tvasya sadṛśo vīrye vidyate bhuvanatraye || 10 ||
analyzed: athā ūcuḥ satyam eva etat kāraṇam vānara uttame  na tu asya sadṛśaḥ vīrye vidyate bhuvanatraye

original: eṣa deva mahāprājño yojanānāṃ śataṃ plutaḥ | dharṣayitvā purīṃ laṃkāṃ rāvaṇāṃtaḥpuraṃ gataḥ || 11 ||
analyzed: eṣa deva mahā prājñaḥ yojanānām śatam plutaḥ dharṣayitvā purīm laṃkām rāvaṇa aṃtaḥpuram gataḥ  /

original: prādeśamātrapratimaṃ kṛtaṃ rūpamanena vai | dṛṣṭā saṃbhāṣitā sītā pṛṣṭā viśvāsitā tathā || 12 ||
analyzed: prādeśa mātra pratimam kṛtam rūpam anena vai dṛṣṭā saṃbhāṣitā sītā pṛṣṭā viśvāsitā tathā

original: senāgragā maṃtriputrāḥ kiṃkarā rāvaṇātmajāḥ | hatā hanumatā tatra tāḍitā rāvaṇālaye || 13 ||
analyzed: senā agragāḥ maṃtri putrāḥ kiṃkarāḥ rāvaṇa ātmajāḥ hatāḥ hanumatā tatra tāḍitāḥ rāvaṇa ālaye

original: bhūyo bandhavimuktena saṃbhāṣya tu daśānanam | laṃkā bhasmīkṛtā tena pātakeneva medinī || 14 ||
analyzed: bhūyas bandha vimuktena saṃbhāṣya tu daśānanam laṃkā bhasmīkṛtā tena pātakena iva medinī

original: na kālasya na śakrasya na viṣṇorvedhaso'pi vā | śrūyaṃte tāni karmāṇi yādṛśāni hanūmataḥ || 15 ||
analyzed: na kālasya na śakrasya na viṣṇoḥ vedhasaḥ api vā śrūyaṃte tāni karmāṇi yādṛśāni hanūmataḥ  /

original: rāma uvāca | etasya bāhuvīryeṇa laṃkā sītā ca lakṣmaṇaḥ | prāpto mama jayaścaiva rājyaṃ mitrāṇi bāndhavāḥ || 16 ||
analyzed: rāmaḥ uvāca etasya bāhu vīryeṇa laṃkā sītā ca lakṣmaṇaḥ prāptaḥ mama jayaḥ ca eva rājyam mitrāṇi bāndhavāḥ  /

original: sakhāyaṃ vānarapatirmuktvainaṃ haripuṃgavam | pravṛttimapi ko vettuṃ jānakyāḥ śaktimānbhavet || 17 ||
analyzed: sakhāyam vānara patiḥ muktvā enam hari puṃgavam  pravṛttim api kaḥ vettum jānakyāḥ śaktimān bhavet

original: vālī kimarthametena sugrīvapriyakāmyayā | tadā vaire samutpanne na dagdhastṛṇavatkatham || 18 ||
analyzed: vālī kimartham etena sugrīva priya kāmyayā tadā vaire samutpanne na dagdhaḥ tṛṇa vat katham

original: nāyaṃ viditavānmanye hanumānātmano balam | upekṣitaḥ kliśyimāne kimarthaṃ vānarādhipe || 19 ||
analyzed: na ayam viditavān manye hanumān ātmanaḥ balam upekṣitaḥ kliśyimāne kimartham vānara adhipe

original: evaṃ bruvāṇaṃ rāmaṃ tu munayo vākyamabruvan | satyametadraghuśreṣṭha yadbravīṣi hanūmataḥ || 20 ||
analyzed: evam bruvāṇam rāmam tu munayaḥ vākyam abruvan satyam etat raghu śreṣṭha yat bravīṣi hanūmataḥ

original: na bale vidyate tulyo na gatau na matāvapi | amoghavākyaiḥ śāpastu datto'sya munibhiḥ purā || 21 ||
analyzed: na bale vidyate tulyaḥ na gatau na matau api  amogha vākyaiḥ śāpaḥ tu dattaḥ asya munibhiḥ purā  /

original: na jñātaṃ hi balaṃ yena balinā vālimardane | bālye'pyanena yatkarma kṛtaṃ nāma mahātmanā || 22 ||
analyzed: na jñātam hi balam yena balinā vāli mardane  bālye api anena yat karma kṛtam nāma mahātmanā

original: tanna varṇayituṃ śakyametasya tu balaṃ mahat | yadi śrotuṃ tavecchāsti niśāmaya vadāmahe || 23 ||
analyzed: tat na varṇayitum śakyam etasya tu balam mahat yadi śrotum tava icchā asti niśāmaya vadāmahe

original: asau hi jātamātro'pi bālārka iva mūrttimān | grahītukāmo bālārkaṃ puplāvāṃbaramadhyataḥ || 24 ||
analyzed: asau hi jāta mātraḥ api bāla arkaḥ iva mūrttimān grahītu kāmaḥ bāla arkam puplāva aṃbara madhyatas

original: tūrṇamādhāvato rāma śakreṇa viditātmanā | hanustenāsya sahasā kuliśenaiva tāḍitaḥ || 25 ||
analyzed: tūrṇam ādhāvataḥ rāma śakreṇa vidita ātmanā hanuḥ tena asya sahasā kuliśena eva tāḍitaḥ  /

original: tato girau papātaiṣa śakravajrābhitāḍitaḥ | patatosya mahāvegādvāmo hanurabhajyata | asmiṃstu patite bāle mṛtakalpe'śanikṣatāt || 26 ||
analyzed: tatas girau papāta eṣa śakra vajra abhitāḍitaḥ patataḥ asya mahā vegāt vāmaḥ hanuḥ abhajyata  asmin tu patite bāle mṛta kalpe aśani kṣatāt

original: tato vāyuḥ samādāya mahā kālavanaṃ gataḥ | liṃgamārādhayāmāsa putrārthaṃ pavanastadā || 27 ||
analyzed: tatas vāyuḥ samādāya mahā kālavanam gataḥ  liṃgam ārādhayāmāsa putra artham pavanaḥ tadā

original: spṛṣṭamātrastu liṃgena samuttasthau plavaṃgamaḥ | jalasiktaṃ yathā sasyaṃ punarjīvi tamāptavān || 28 ||
analyzed: spṛṣṭa mātraḥ tu liṃgena samuttasthau plavaṃgamaḥ jala siktam yathā sasyam punar jīvi tam āptavān

original: prāṇavaṃtamimaṃ dṛṣṭvā pavano harṣitastadā | pratyuvāca prasannātmā putramādāya satvaram || 29 ||
analyzed: prāṇavantam imam dṛṣṭvā pavanaḥ harṣitaḥ tadā pratyuvāca prasanna ātmā putram ādāya sa tvaram

original: sparśanādasya liṃgasya mama putraḥ samutthitaḥ | hanumatkeśvaro devo vikhyāto'yaṃ bhaviṣyati || 30 ||
analyzed: sparśanāt asya liṃgasya mama putraḥ samutthitaḥ hanumatkeśvaraḥ devaḥ vikhyātaḥ ayam bhaviṣyati  /

original: etasminnaṃtare śakraḥ samāyātaḥ surairvṛtaḥ | nīlotpalamayīṃ mālāṃ saṃpragṛhyedamabravīt || 31 ||
analyzed: etasmin aṃtare śakraḥ samāyātaḥ suraiḥ vṛtaḥ nīlotpala mayīm mālām saṃpragṛhya idam abravīt

original: matkarotsṛṣṭavajreṇa yasmādasyahanurhataḥ | tadeṣa kapiśārdūlo hanumāṃstu bhaviṣyati || 32 ||
analyzed: mad kara utsṛṣṭa vajreṇa yasmāt asya hanuḥ hataḥ tat eṣa kapi śārdūlaḥ hanumān tu bhaviṣyati  /

original: varuṇo'sva varaṃ prādānnāsya mṛtyurbhaviṣyati | yamo daṃḍādavadhyatvamārogyaṃ dhanado dadau || 33 ||
analyzed: varuṇaḥ asva varam prādāt na asya mṛtyuḥ bhaviṣyati yamaḥ daṃḍāt avadhya tvam ārogyam dhanadaḥ dadau  /

analyzed: adṛśyaṃtīm vadhūm dīnām yatra āśvāsayati prabhuḥ adṛśyaṃtī tu tam dṛṣṭvā kūra karmāṇam agratas  bhaya saṃvignayā vācā vaśiṣṭham idam abravīt

original: asau mṛtyurivogreṇa daṇḍena vahugarvitaḥ | pragṛhītena kāṣṭhena rākṣaso'bhyeti bhīṣaṇaḥ || 42 ||
analyzed: asau mṛtyuḥ iva ugreṇa daṇḍena vahu garvitaḥ pragṛhītena kāṣṭhena rākṣasaḥ abhyeti bhīṣaṇaḥ

original: tannivārayituṃ śakto nānyo vai bhuvi kaścana | tvāmṛte'dya mahābhāga sarvavedavidāṃ vara || 43 ||
analyzed: tat nivārayitum śaktaḥ na anyaḥ vai bhuvi kaścana tvām ṛte adya mahābhāga sarva veda vidām vara

original: trāhi māṃ bhaga vanpāpādasmāddāruṇadarśanāt | rākṣaso'yamihāgatya nūnamāvāṃ samīhate || 44 ||
analyzed: trāhi mām bhaga van pāpāt asmāt dāruṇa darśanāt rākṣasaḥ ayam iha āgatya nūnam āvām samīhate  /

original: vaśiṣṭha uvāca | mā bhaiḥ putri na bhetavyaṃ rākṣasātte kathaṃcana | naitadrakṣo bhayaṃ yasmātpaśyasi tvamupasthitam | rājā kalmāṣapādo'yamamātyaiḥ sahito vibhuḥ || 45 ||
analyzed: vaśiṣṭhaḥ uvāca mā bhaiḥ putri na bhetavyam rākṣasāt te kathaṃcana  na etat rakṣaḥ bhayam yasmāt paśyasi tvam upasthitam rājā kalmāṣapādaḥ ayam amātyaiḥ sahitaḥ vibhuḥ

original: sa eṣo'sminvanoddeśe samā yāto mamāṃtikam | tamāyāṃtamathālakṣya vaśiṣṭho bhagavānṛṣiḥ | vārayāmāsa tejasvī huṃkāreṇa nṛpottamam || 46 ||
analyzed: saḥ eṣaḥ asmin vana uddeśe samāḥ yātaḥ mama aṃtikam tam āyāṃtam atha ālakṣya vasiṣṭhaḥ bhagavān ṛṣiḥ vārayāmāsa tejasvī huṃkāreṇa nṛpa uttamam

original: mantrapūtena ca tataḥ samabhyukṣya ca vāriṇā | mokṣayāmāsa vai bhāvādrākṣasādrājasattamam || 47 ||
analyzed: mantra pūtena ca tatas samabhyukṣya ca vāriṇā mokṣayāmāsa vai bhāvāt rākṣasāt rāja sattamam

original: pratilabhya tataḥ saṃjñāmabhivādya kṛtāṃjaliḥ | uvāca nṛpatiḥ kāle vaśiṣṭhamṛṣisatta mam || 48 ||
analyzed: pratilabhya tatas saṃjñām abhivādya kṛtāṃjaliḥ uvāca nṛpatiḥ kāle vaśiṣṭham ṛṣi satta mam

original: saudāso'haṃ mahābhāga dāso'haṃ tava suvrata | asminkāle yadiṣṭaṃ te brūhi kiṃ karavāṇi te || 49 ||
analyzed: saudāsaḥ aham mahābhāga dāsaḥ aham tava suvrata asmin kāle yat iṣṭam te brūhi kim karavāṇi te  /

original: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā nṛpasya dvijasattamaḥ | jñātvā tapobalenaiva viśvāmitrasya ceṣṭitam | rājānaṃ pratyuvācedaṃ vinayāvanataṃ tathā || 50 ||
analyzed: tasya tat vacanam śrutvā nṛpasya dvijasattamaḥ jñātvā tapaḥ balena eva viśvāmitrasya ceṣṭitam  rājānam pratyuvāca idam vinaya avanatam tathā

original: jñātameva yathākālaṃ gaccha rājankuśa sthalīm | mahākālasamīpe tu liṃgaṃ duḥsvapnanāśanam || 51 ||
analyzed: jñātam eva yathākālam gaccha rājan kuśa sthalīm mahākāla samīpe tu liṃgam duḥsvapna nāśanam  /

original: rājasaṃpatkaraṃ divyaṃ putrapautravivarddhanam | brahmahatyāsahasrāṇāṃ sphoṭanaṃ pāpanāśa nam | tasya darśanamātreṇa vipāpmā ca bhaviṣyasi || 52 ||
analyzed: rāja saṃpad karam divyam putra pautra vivarddhanam brahmahatyā sahasrāṇām sphoṭanam pāpa nāśa nam tasya darśana mātreṇa vipāpmā ca bhaviṣyasi  /

original: duḥsvapnajaṃ bhayaṃ ghoraṃ vinaṃkṣyati na saṃśayaḥ | grahāśca sānukūlāste bhaviṣyanti nṛpo ttama || 53 ||
analyzed: duḥsvapna jam bhayam ghoram vinaṃkṣyati na saṃśayaḥ grahāḥ ca sa anukūlāḥ te bhaviṣyanti nṛpo ttama

original: ityukto guruṇā bhūyo vaśiṣṭhena mahātmanā | jagāma tvarito devi mahākālavanaṃ śubham | dadarśa tatra talliṃgaṃ duṣṭaduḥsvapnanāśanam || 54 ||
analyzed: iti uktaḥ guruṇā bhūyas vasiṣṭhena mahātmanā  jagāma tvaritaḥ devi mahākāla vanam śubham dadarśa tatra tat liṃgam duṣṭa duḥsvapna nāśanam

original: naṣṭāḥ sarvepi duḥsvapnāḥ susvapnāścābhavaṃstadā | rājā niṣkalmaṣo bhūtvā punaḥ prāpnonnijaṃ padam | ayodhyāyāṃ gato rājyaṃ cakāra muditastadā || 55 ||
analyzed: naṣṭāḥ sarve api duḥsvapnāḥ susvapnāḥ ca abhavan tadā rājā niṣkalmaṣaḥ bhūtvā punar prāpnot nijam padam ayodhyāyām gataḥ rājyam cakāra muditaḥ tadā

original: tadāprabhṛti devo'yaṃ susvapneśvarasaṃjñakaḥ | babhūva bhuvane khyātaḥ sarvaduḥsvapnanāśanaḥ || 56 ||
analyzed: tadā prabhṛti devaḥ ayam susvapneśvara saṃjñakaḥ babhūva bhuvane khyātaḥ sarva duḥsvapna nāśanaḥ   /

original: aṣṭamyāṃ ca caturdaśyāṃ devaṃ svapneśvaraṃ śivam | darśanaṃ ye kariṣyaṃti snātvā śiprājale śubhe | ājanmaprabhavaṃ teṣāṃ duḥsvapnaṃ ca vinaśyati || 57 ||
analyzed: aṣṭamyām ca caturdaśyām devam svapneśvaram śivam  darśanam ye kariṣyanti snātvā śiprā jale śubhe  ājanma prabhavam teṣām duḥsvapnam ca vinaśyati  /

original: sa eva sarvadā pūjya iha loke paratra ca | yaḥ paśyati naro bhaktyā devaṃ svapneśvaraṃ śivam || 58 ||
analyzed: saḥ eva sarvadā pūjyaḥ iha loke paratra ca  yaḥ paśyati naraḥ bhaktyā devam svapneśvaram śivam

original: yaṃ yaṃ kāmamabhidhyāya manasābhimataṃ naraḥ | taṃ taṃ durllabhamāpnoti susvapneśvaradarśanāt || 59 ||
analyzed: yam yam kāmam abhidhyāya manasā abhimatam naraḥ tam tam durllabham āpnoti susvapneśvara darśanāt

original: niyamena prapaśyaṃti devaṃ svapneśvaraṃ sadā | te prayāṃti tanuṃ tyaktvā madīyaṃ bhavanaṃ priye || 60 ||
analyzed: niyamena prapaśyaṃti devam svapneśvaram sadā  te prayāṃti tanum tyaktvā madīyam bhavanam priye

original: bhaktihīnaḥ kriyāhīno yaḥ paśyati prasaṃgataḥ | supuṇyāṃ gatimāpnoti yogigamyāṃ yaśasvini || 61 ||
analyzed: bhakti hīnaḥ kriyā hīnaḥ yaḥ paśyati prasaṃgataḥ su puṇyām gatim āpnoti yogi gamyām yaśasvini  /

original: ye ca puṣpairvicitraiśca pūjayanti ca parvasu | te sarvakāmasaṃpannāḥ śrībalārogyasaṃyutāḥ | dīrghāyuṣaḥ śubhācārā jāyante dehino'malāḥ || 62 ||
analyzed: ye ca puṣpaiḥ vicitraiḥ ca pūjayanti ca parvasu  te sarva kāma saṃpannāḥ śrī bala ārogya saṃyutāḥ dīrgha āyuṣaḥ śubha ācārāḥ jāyante dehinaḥ amalāḥ   /

original: ete ca brahmaviṣṇviṃdrakuberadahanādayaḥ | susvapnaṃ paramaṃ prāptāḥ śrīsvapneśvaradarśanāt || 63 ||
analyzed: ete ca brahma viṣṇu iṃdra kubera dahana ādayaḥ susvapnam paramam prāptāḥ śrī svapneśvara darśanāt  /

original: eṣa te kathito devi prabhāvaḥ pāpanāśanaḥ | svapneśvarasya devasya śṛṇu liṃgacatuṣṭayam || 64 ||
analyzed: eṣa te kathitaḥ devi prabhāvaḥ pāpa nāśanaḥ svapneśvarasya devasya śṛṇu liṃga catuṣṭayam

original: iti śrīskāṃde mahāpurāṇa ekāśītisāhasryāṃ saṃhitāyāṃ pañcama āvantyakhaṇḍe umāmaheśvarasaṃvāde svapneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanaṃ nāmāśītitamo'dhyāyaḥ || 80 ||
analyzed: iti śrī skāṃde mahāpurāṇe ekāśīti sāhasryām saṃhitāyām pañcame āvantya khaṇḍe umā maheśvara saṃvāde svapneśvaramāhātmyavarṇanam nāma aśītitamaḥ adhyāyaḥ  /
